### 1. [Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09949v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09949

**作者：** Dongwu Qian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09949v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09949v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用合成测试床诊断视频 LLM 的事件计数失败：逐窗口存在性可被线性探针解码（93%），全局计数读出却因时长混淆而崩溃，并尝试片段定位监督与离散事件符号旁路两种读出修复，另附真实视频审计。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「内部表征存在但未被读出使用」的失败模式，其探针解码、跨片段不迁移与符号通道零样本失效的结果，可供核查 latent 内容是否真正进入答案，以及读出监督与证据筛选的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).

**comment/C1：** Preprint v1 (2026-10-21). 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. A corrected-prompt retrain of the REALCOUNT adaptation arms is in progress; v2 will update those results. Comments welcome

</details>

### 2. [WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10151v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10151

**作者：** Haoming Wang、Yongjian Fu、Ju Ren、Wei Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10151v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10151v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** WorldMind 提出以 latent world simulation 做空间推理的测试时扩展：VLM 自行选择有用的空间变换动作，由 world model 执行并直接把对齐的中间 latent 特征交给 VLM 融入后续推理，从而迭代模拟而不必反复解码为像素；并配合过程可验证强化学习，仅在动作与 latent 转移有效时奖励推理进展。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及 LVR 核心议题：latent 证据是否被后续推理真正使用、如何避免「latent→像素→latent」视觉旁路，以及把测试时算力分配给主动模拟；其过程验证式奖励与贡献分配、模拟步数与计算分配策略可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WorldMind: Test-Time Scaling for Visual Spatial Reasoning through Latent World Simulation

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have continuous deficiency in spatial reasoning tasks that require \\emph{mental spatial transformation}, such as reasoning under hypothetical changes in viewpoint or position, known as perspective-taking tasks. Existing approaches either scale linguistic reasoning or augment VLMs with static geometric representations, but neither directly enables active transformation of the represented scene. World models offer this capability, yet existing systems typically communicate through synthesized RGB images, introducing a latent-to-pixel-to-latent bottleneck. We introduce \\emph{WorldMind}, a framework for test-time scaling of spatial reasoning through latent world simulation. Given a query and observation, the VLM selects useful spatial transformations, while a world model executes them and exposes aligned intermediate latent features directly to the VLM. The resulting latent evidence is incorporated into subsequent reasoning steps, enabling iterative spatial simulation without repeatedly decoding imagined states into pixels. To optimize this interaction, WorldMind further employs process-verifiable reinforcement learning that rewards reasoning progress only when the associated action and latent transition are valid. WorldMind thus scales spatial reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation to active world simulation rather than generating more language or pixels. Across VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and MindCube-Tiny, WorldMind achieves an average improvement of 16.0% over the base VLM and 8.3% over the strongest RGB-based world simulation.

</details>

### 3. [Mental Imagery That Matters: Curing Latent Collapse in Multimodal Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10423v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10423

**作者：** Mi Luo、Rohan Dugad、Zihui Xue、Alex Dimakis、Kristen Grauman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10423v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10423v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对多种 latent-reasoning MLLM 做视觉 latent 的删除、替换与打乱扰动分析，发现这些内部视觉状态对最终答案概率影响甚微，而文本推理轨迹受扰后损伤明显，称此失败模式为「Mental Simulation Collapse」，并指出现有训练目标（视觉对齐加纯文本监督）自然导致该问题；随后提出 AnchorSim 对比蒸馏框架，使生成的视觉 latent 对预测产生实际作用。

**相关性简评：** 直接命中 LVR 的核心争议——视觉 latent 是否被答案真正使用、贡献分配与信息坍缩；其扰动式因果诊断和「latent 须锚定模型行为」的监督思路，可供核查 THINK/LOOK 收益归因、视觉证据筛选与停止决策的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mental Imagery That Matters: Curing Latent Collapse in Multimodal Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Mental simulation, the ability to reason by constructing and updating internal visual states, is central to flexible human cognition, but remains elusive in current multimodal large language models. Latent multimodal reasoning offers a promising route toward this capability by interleaving text with continuous visual latent blocks, allowing models to maintain internal visual workspaces without decoding them into pixels. In this paper, we ask whether these latent visual states actually matter. Through a direct perturbation analysis across representative latent-reasoning MLLMs, we find that they often do not: dropping, replacing, or shuffling generated visual latents has only minor effects on the model's own final-answer probability, while equivalent perturbations to the linguistic reasoning trace are substantially more damaging. We call this failure mode Mental Simulation Collapse (MSC): the model appears to perform interleaved visual reasoning, but routes most answer-relevant computation through text. We further diagnose that MSC follows naturally from existing training objectives: visual alignment can make generated latents resemble helper-image embeddings, but it does not require the decoder to rely on them; subsequent text-only supervision further leaves the semantic role of the latent pathway unidentifiable. To address this, we introduce AnchorSim (Anchored Mental Simulation), a contrastive distillation framework that trains models to make their generated visual latents consequential. Across multiple visual reasoning benchmarks, AnchorSim improves performance, while diagnostic re-evaluation shows that visual perturbations now meaningfully affect predictions. Our results expose a fundamental failure mode of latent multimodal reasoning and demonstrate that mental simulation must be anchored to model behavior in order to matter.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026, Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/AnchorSim/

</details>

### 4. [Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09897v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09897

**作者：** Arpita Shanbhag、Julia Tran、Dhruv Mandala、Ayda Sultan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09897v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09897v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文从 embedding 层的信息密度差异入手，考察 VLM 模态差距的来源：文本 token 进入模型时语义密度远低于视觉 token，使早期层先处理文本表征、再与视觉结合；作者用机制分析替换视觉 token 位置为语义最近的文本 token，观察到早期层对相应位置的注意力上升。

**相关性简评：** 对 VLM 内部表征与模态融合顺序的诊断，可支撑「视觉旁路」与视觉证据是否被真正使用的问题，其中「早期层先处理文本再融合视觉」的结论可供核查 latent 推理中视觉信息被压缩或忽略的时机。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.

</details>

### 5. [Video-DCI: How Far Are VLM Agents from Human Viewers in Direct Video Corpus Interaction?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09951v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09951

**作者：** Garry Yang、Yuqiao Liu、Hao Lin、Luohao Pan、Xinru Chen、Wanqi Ren、Zhikang Xu、Yizhan Huang、Huaixiao Tou、James Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09951v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09951v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Video-DCI 诊断基准与人类对齐协议，用 DCI-Loc 和 DCI-QA 评估 VLM agent 在多轮视频证据定位、保留及跨视频组合上的表现，并报告「检索到落地」的差距。

**相关性简评：** 其多轮局部窗口检视、证据累积与带引用作答的评估，直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本与视觉证据筛选问题；可供核查「已暴露证据却未转为精确引用」是否源于状态保留或停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Video-DCI: How Far Are VLM Agents from Human Viewers in Direct Video Corpus Interaction?

**abstract/A1：** Humans answer complex visual questions by inspecting short moments, updating what they know, and redirecting attention toward missing evidence. Existing video benchmarks, however, often provide the relevant video, evaluate only final answers or isolated localization, or permit textual shortcuts, leaving multi-round visual evidence seeking underexplored. We introduce Video-DCI, a diagnostic benchmark and functionally matched human-agent protocol for Direct Video-Corpus Interaction. It comprises DCI-Loc for temporal evidence localization and DCI-QA for end-to-end discovery, retention, and composition of cross-video evidence. In DCI-QA, videos within each pool are topically related, yet every answer requires hidden temporal evidence from multiple videos. Given only the question and video pool, humans and agents iteratively inspect bounded local windows, retain supporting evidence, and answer with cited temporal spans. Human trajectories provide reference curves for evidence acquisition and use across rounds. Experiments reveal a consistent retrieval-to-grounding gap. On DCI-Loc, frontier VLMs often retrieve and expose the reference moment, yet convert far less of this exposure into precise final citations than the human reference. On DCI-QA, the loss begins earlier and compounds across videos. Ablation studies further confirm that iterative search outperforms one-shot retrieval. Multi-round search is therefore necessary but insufficient: current agents accumulate candidates and observations more readily than precise, jointly sufficient evidence.

</details>

### 6. [HALMES: Knowing When to Intervene in LVLM Hallucination Mitigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09957v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09957

**作者：** Ruining Hu、Jiaqi Lu、Xiao Liu、Ying Shen、Yu Wang、Lin Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09957v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09957v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 HALMES：从 LVLM 生成过程中的内部注意力特征识别幻觉前兆片段，按需触发对比解码，而非全程干预，以提升幻觉缓解并减少对正确输出的破坏。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关注的视觉证据使用、内部状态监测及「何时介入或停止」直接相关；其注意力特征驱动的触发机制可供核查能否迁移到 latent 推理中的证据筛选与动态干预。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HALMES: Knowing When to Intervene in LVLM Hallucination Mitigation

**abstract/A1：** Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in multimodal tasks. Nevertheless, their outputs remain prone to object hallucinations that are inconsistent with visual content. Contrastive decoding, as a training-free inference-time mitigation approach, typically intervenes in the output distribution at every decoding step. However, such indiscriminate full-stage intervention may disrupt originally correct generations and even induce new hallucinations. To address this issue, we first analyze the relationship between internal attention features and hallucinated token segments in LVLMs, revealing that hallucination-related abnormalities already emerge progressively in preceding token segments. Based on this observation, we propose HALMES, a lightweight plug-and-play module that identifies hallucination precursor segments from attention features during generation and selectively triggers contrastive decoding. HALMES can be integrated with various full-stage contrastive decoding methods, transforming indiscriminate intervention into on-demand targeted correction. Extensive experiments across different LVLM architectures and multiple benchmarks show that HALMES further improves the hallucination mitigation performance of existing contrastive decoding methods while reducing the negative impact of full-stage intervention on normal outputs, validating the importance of modeling and selectively intervening on hallucination-prone segments.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 7. [QCVS: Question-Contrastive Visual Steering for Multimodal Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09982v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09982

**作者：** Tong Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09982v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09982v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 QCVS，用「问题对比」的双重差分激活探针分离与当前查询相关的视觉干预方向，并以双阈值门控决定是否对隐状态施加一次有界更新，从而在数学类多模态基准上以稀疏干预提升准确率并压低误改率。

**相关性简评：** 关注 VLM 内部状态中视觉信息的选择性注入与附带损伤，可核查其差分探针与门控是否能作为「LOOK」何时、注入多少证据的贡献分配线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QCVS: Question-Contrastive Visual Steering for Multimodal Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Inference-time steering in vision-language models often entangles query-relevant reasoning dynamics with low-level perceptual noise, causing collateral degradation on correct predictions. We propose Question-Contrastive Visual Steering (QCVS) to isolate task-specific intervention directions via double-differential activation probing. By contrasting spatial layout perturbations under the target query against a generic description reference, QCVS cancels task-agnostic visual artifacts without ground-truth supervision. A dual-threshold gating mechanism then evaluates relative interaction strength and signal amplitude, selectively applying a single bounded hidden-state update only when necessary. Empirical evaluations across multiple scales of Qwen3.5 (2B to 9B) and DeepSeek-VL2 on DynaMath and We-Math demonstrate that QCVS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy gains under sparse coverage (approximately 22%-30%). Crucially, QCVS yields repair rates up to 13.98% while suppressing collateral damage down to 0.41%, proving high intervention precision and computational efficiency.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 8. [EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10005v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10005

**作者：** Pengyu Dai、Yao Zhang、Jian Song、Junjue Wang、Yafei Ou、Yuzeng Chen、Junshi Xia、Hongruixuan Chen、Naoto Yokoya

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10005v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10005v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EarthJev 面向超高分辨率遥感 VQA，将区域打分与答案生成分离，用空间指针验证器和基于冻结表征的批量证据筛选，配合置信度校准降低主动搜索成本。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及动态视觉证据获取与停止决策：其证据存在判断、搜索绕行和候选视图筛选可供核查 LOOK/STOP 的成本收益，但未涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires locating fine-grained evidence in large scenes under limited visual input budgets. Active observation addresses this challenge through selective exploration, but repeated generative judgments can make region search costly. Its decisions also concern distinct prediction targets: spatial pointer validity, evidence presence, and reasoning correctness. We propose EarthJev, a framework that separates region scoring from answer generation and uses target-specific decision signals while keeping the answering model frozen. A spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search. An evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches using a lightweight head on frozen representations, without generating textual region judgments. Format-specific confidence calibration then guides selection between candidate answers generated from memory and overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks, EarthJev achieves a mean accuracy of 53.06% with Qwen3.5-9B, outperforming ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33 to 14.73 percentage points per benchmark while reducing mean latency from 11.30 - 1.67 seconds per question. With four additional frozen answering models, model-specific fitting of the decision modules and calibration mappings yields mean accuracy gains of 3.41 - 6.53 percentage points over the corresponding single-pass baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Da1daidaidai/EarthJev

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 9. [ScreenProof: Where Is This Screen Wrong? Finding UI Faults Without a Reference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10234v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10234

**作者：** Huiming Sun、Yue Li、Kangning Yang、Ruineng Li、Jie Cai、Lan Fu、Yunwan Fu、Jinlong Li、Jinglin Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10234v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10234v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免参考图的截图 UI 缺陷检测任务与基准 ScreenProof：用页面代码注入三类缺陷并记录被改元素框，配合同质 sibling 的硬负样本，评测前沿模型逐框指出缺陷的能力，并训练小型评审模型 ProofJudge（Qwen3.5-9B + LoRA，仅在高置信时报告）。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断 VLM 对细粒度视觉异常（字距、行高、断行、局部风格破例）的感知、定位与是否报告的判断，其置信度截断与 clean-page 误报指标可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和弃权／停止决策的联系，但未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ScreenProof: Where Is This Screen Wrong? Finding UI Faults Without a Reference

**abstract/A1：** A phone screen can be wrong in ways that need no reference: a label that runs off the screen, letters that touch, a line that breaks one character before its end, one button with sharp corners among round ones. We ask whether a model can box every such fault on a screenshot, given no target design and no reference image. Such a critic could serve as a cheap first pass over generated pages before a designer reviews them, but only if it stays silent on clean pages. ScreenProof poses this target-free critique over three families of faults: general faults, local style faults (one element breaks the style its page sets) and text layout faults (letter spacing, line height, line breaks). A data engine makes each fault in page code and records the changed element's box, and hard negatives change every sibling alike. No frontier judge is reliable: frontier models flag 18-62% of clean real screenshots and 18-82% of clean generated pages, find 47-72% of text layout faults, and rarely find a foreign icon (5-19%). Our small critic ProofJudge (Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA), trained on code-made pages with one to four faults each and keeping a finding only when it is confident, reaches F1 0.48, the highest of all judges (Gemini 4 Argon 0.37; open models at most 0.15; 0.46 even without the confidence cut), and is the only fault-finding judge within 15% false alarms on clean pages (2% real, 9% generated), the property such a first pass needs, at about a hundredth of Argon's cost. It finds the most general faults (59%) but fewer local style faults than Argon (25% against 41%) and fewer text layout faults than the API judges (43%; Gemini 4 Argon 47%). Against a named brand the task is harder still: models know a design language about as well as its public documentation states it.

</details>

<a id="paper-10"></a>

### 10. [PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10240v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10240

**作者：** Suman Chatterjee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10240v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10240v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出长程 LLM agent 的 KV cache 淘汰中「保留所需 token」并不够：随定义与使用间距增大，被保留 token 因 rotary 位置距离过远而不可取用，并据此提出 PACE，结合 planner 告知未来将读取哪些上下文的保留策略与把保留 token 重新编号以限制位置距离的有界位置机制。

**相关性简评：** 它给出「内部状态中保留 ≠ 可被使用」的具体诊断，直接涉及缓存与位置结构如何影响证据可获取性，可供核查该结论是否适用于多模态 LVR 的视觉证据保留与位置编码设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PACE: Keeping the Right Tokens in the KV Cache Is Not Enough for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate sessions of up to millions of tokens, far more key-value (KV) cache than one GPU holds, so serving systems keep a small budget of tokens and evict the rest. Eviction methods differ in which tokens they keep but share one goal: that the tokens a later step needs are still cached. We show this is not enough. In 100K-token coding sessions on Qwen3-8B with a 2,048-token budget, a planner-guided policy that keeps over 99% of the needed tokens resident still fails late steps increasingly often: its accuracy falls from 93% to 64% as the gap between a definition and its use grows from 2K to 90K tokens, at residency 0.996. The needed tokens are resident but unretrievable: what grows is their rotary-position distance to the query. We present PACE (Planner-Aware Context Engine), a KV-cache engine that couples plan-aware retention, in which the agent's planner tells the cache which context future steps will read, with bounded positions, which renumber kept tokens so their rotary distance to the query stays below 8K at any session length. In a pre-registered evaluation on fresh tasks, PACE passes 97% of hidden unit tests at 100K tokens, against 42% for H2O and 3% for SnapKV under the same budget, and needs both components: either alone reaches 63% (the combination beats each, p &lt; 10^-4). The result holds with length: in 1M- and 2M-token sessions on one 24 GB GPU, with definitions written 0.9M and 1.8M tokens before use, PACE passes 99% and 100% of checks and recalls every session fact, while bounded positions without foresight falls from 33% to 13%; PACE holds under 0.7 GB of KV state where the full cache would need 147-295 GB. Renumbering is exact, costs no measurable perplexity, and adds 9% wall time. On Mistral-7B, whose coding ability caps it at 40% even with nothing evicted, PACE stays at that ceiling while retention alone falls below it.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 11. [Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10297v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10297

**作者：** Mohamed I. Eldagla、Zeyad H. ElShafei、Ahmed M. Anter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10297v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10297v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用表征探针、激活引导和强制二选一，检验四种指令微调VLM在胸部X光与报告冲突时，究竟是隐瞒已检测到的矛盾，还是仅表现为不确定。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联VLM内部是否保留冲突证据、又能否因果用于生成；探针与steering可供核查「表征有而输出不用」，跨模态注意力下降也提示视觉证据筛选与不确定性门控。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. The sycophancy mask hypothesis holds that these models internally detect conflicts but refuse to report them, concealing a detected contradiction. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice. Across four instruction-tuned VLMs on chest X-rays, we confirm behavioral suppression of contradiction and find that a linear probe separates matched from mismatched inputs, beyond what a simple CLIP model achieves. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. We conclude that these models fail to contradict because the mismatch registers as hedged, gated uncertainty rather than concealed knowledge, calling for re-grounding and uncertainty surfacing. Code is available at https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Med-Reasoner Workshop

</details>

### 12. [TimeTraveler: Temporal Strategy Planning with Time Dictionary for Streaming Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10337v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10337

**作者：** Minkuk Kim、Junho Kim、Seong Tae Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10337v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10337v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TimeTraveler 流式视频问答框架，将每个已观测时刻存为带时间戳的结构化字幕字典，并针对查询选择回忆过去、读取当前或等待未来，再执行相应的证据获取策略。

**相关性简评：** 其查询驱动的时序证据获取与「等待/读取/回忆」决策直接关联 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 与证据筛选；但证据是显式文本字典而非 latent 状态，可供核查细粒度视觉信息损失、视觉旁路及决策收益成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TimeTraveler: Temporal Strategy Planning with Time Dictionary for Streaming Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires models to answer user queries over continuously evolving video streams. Unlike offline video QA, SVU must handle queries whose evidence may lie in the past, appear in the current scene, or emerge only after future observations. Existing streaming video systems often rely on compact visual memories or fixed evidence-access schemes, which can lose fine-grained details and fail to adapt the answering process to the temporal intent of each query. In this paper, we propose TimeTraveler, a streaming VQA framework that performs temporal strategy planning with a Time Dictionary. Inspired by the need to search across different temporal regions of a stream, TimeTraveler stores each observed moment as a timestamp-indexed structured caption and uses this dictionary as an explicit source of queryable evidence. Given a query, TimeTraveler determines whether to recall past evidence, read the present context, or wait for future observations, and then applies a strategy-specific evidence acquisition process. Comparative experiments on streaming video QA benchmarks show that TimeTraveler improves streaming question answering by preserving fine-grained temporal evidence and selecting the appropriate temporal strategy for each query. The project page is available at https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler

</details>

### 13. [MaRiO: Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning via Shared Observations in MLLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10344v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10344

**作者：** Nathaniel Redmond、Fidel Omar Tito Cruz、Devansh Sharma、Shehreen Azad、Sirshapan Mitra、Shruti Vyas、Yogesh S. Rawat

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10344v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10344v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MaRiO 基准，用于评测多智能体在各自独立视角下观察同一环境时的协同推理能力，评测了 23 个 MLLM，并尝试用几何引导的合成视角增强（生成中间过渡帧）作为改进手段。

**相关性简评：** 其诊断发现——跨智能体对应关系难以建立、难以利用场景几何线索、事件序列任务显著难于静态感知——可直接对上 LVR 关注的视觉细节与几何信息是否保留、多源视觉证据筛选与整合问题，属可近期阅读的失败分析类工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MaRiO: Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning via Shared Observations in MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual perception capabilities, but existing evaluations largely focus on single-view or multi-view settings with shared camera parameters, leaving the challenge of multi-agent collaborative scenarios underexplored. In such settings, multiple agents observe a shared environment from independent viewpoints, and reliable decisions require reasoning across these independent observations of the same environment. To study this problem, we introduce MaRiO, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaborative reasoning, and evaluate 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs on it. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) tasks governed by static perception are generally easier than tasks that require transformational event sequences; (2) most models struggle to resolve cross-agent correspondences, with errors increasing with scene complexity; and (3) models show limited ability to leverage geometric cues present in the scene. As an initial step toward addressing these challenges, we explore geometry-guided synthetic view augmentation that generates intermediate transition frames between agent observations, providing auxiliary spatial context that improves performance in certain categories. Overall, our results highlight that multi-agent collaborative reasoning remains an open challenge and an important direction for multimodal embodied systems. The code is available on the project page: https://omarftt.github.io/MaRiO-page/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations &amp; Datasets Track (poster). First two authors contributed equally

</details>

### 14. [They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10483v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10483

**作者：** Mengyu Wang、Ken Deng、Yftah Ziser、Shay B. Cohen、Tiejun Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10483v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10483v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 系统分析 VLM 在相对位姿识别中的稳定输出偏差，并提出免标注的 SKR-ID：以去偏的物体中心 prompt 冷启动，再用中位数 logit 作动态阈值做递归排序，把输出从 next-token 预测改为任务分类头，使开源 VLM 的 Macro-F1 由 35.0–45.4% 升至 53.7–58.0%。

**相关性简评：** 「看得见却说不出」正对应视觉证据已进入内部状态却未被答案使用的缺口，可作为输出偏置与视觉旁路的诊断参照；其 logit 阈值式去偏是否真正恢复证据使用、而非仅校正先验，仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification

**abstract/A1：** The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes\_of\_SKR-ID.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as NeurIPS 2026 Oral

</details>

### 15. [Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10552v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10552

**作者：** Gregory Kang Ruey Lau、Minh Huynh Nguyen、Bryan Kian Hsiang Low

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10552v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10552v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 MLLM 能识别图像文字却难以直接对图像推理，提出「模态推理通达差距」，并用合成文本—渲染图像反事实样本配合 GRPO、SFT、DPO 训练 TIGER，以打通视觉到既有推理通路的连接。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉内容能否进入推理机制及训练监督如何改变该路径，其激活分析与 activation patching 可供核查视觉证据是否被路由到文本式推理状态；是否真正改善内部使用而非仅答案分布仍需读原文。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit strong textual reasoning capabilities from their language backbones and text pretraining, but often fail to apply the same level of competency to visual inputs. We show that this degradation cannot be attributed to only perception failures, by evaluating models on semantically-equivalent text and rendered-text image inputs: models can accurately read text in the images and recover near-text performance when provided their own transcriptions, but just cannot reason well on the images directly. We characterize this discrepancy as a modality reasoning-access gap, where models fail to route perceived visual content into existing reasoning machinery accessible with text. To bridge this, we propose TIGER (Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning), which first mines synthetic modality counterfactuals where a model succeeds on a text problem but fails when provided the corresponding rendered image, and post-trains the model on the image input via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), along with SFT and DPO variants. Importantly, although trained exclusively on synthetic rendered-text images with no multimodal annotations, TIGER results in model performance improvements across diverse real-world visual benchmarks including geometric diagrams (MathVerse), multi-disciplinary sciences (EMMA, MMMU), complex charts (ChartQAPro), and embodied spatial reasoning (RoboSpatial-Home). TIGER also complements existing state-of-the-art RLVR visual reasoning methods, yielding further performance gains. Analysis involving reasoning-subspace activation and activation patching provide support indicating that TIGER helps to align visual-to-reasoning pathways toward text reasoning states. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/minhngh/Tiger.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 16. [CompositionEvidence: Controlling Geometric Evidence for Cinematic Composition Reasoning with Frozen Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10559v1>)

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CompositionEvidence: Controlling Geometric Evidence for Cinematic Composition Reasoning with Frozen Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Cinematic composition questions depend on in-frame geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) use inconsistently. External perception tools can expose this geometry, but naive prompt injection can overwrite useful visual predictions. On ShotBench composition, pre-question geometry reduces Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 49.5% to 46.3%; corrupted measurements lower it to 33.6%. CompositionEvidence derives nine reproducible features from frozen detection, depth, and line experts and supplies their shared 24-dimensional representation through two interfaces. A training-free channel appends gated neutral evidence after the question, reaching 56.2% (+6.7, exact McNemar p=0.0018) and 48.4% under corrupted evidence. A minimal-training channel maps the same representation to four soft tokens with a 7.37M-parameter projector while leaving the VLM frozen; it reaches 61.0% (+11.5). Across nine VLMs, including five commercial models queried through official provider APIs, zero-shot accuracy ranges from 43.8% to 63.0%, and the text channel changes it by +6.7 to -6.9 points; the highest baseline is among the regressions. The effect of explicit geometry depends on measurement reliability and on how the receiving model integrates it.

### 17. [ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10575

**作者：** Niaz Mohaiman Abtahi、Evan Maksud

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10575v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ROLECUE 诊断基准，用 192 张经过验证的双人动作图像配德语、土耳其语、日语、英语、韩语、孟加拉语的规范语序与受事先行句子，将任务拆分为纯图像角色识别、纯文本角色解析、图文直接匹配、应答合规性以及用模型自身组件预测做外部模块化组合，并评测八个开源 VLM。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联 LVR 关心的「视觉细节与实体关系是否保留在内部状态并被答案使用」：其组件—联合差距与恒定语义附和表明图像、文本单侧可靠并不保证联合推理使用这些信息，可供核查视觉旁路与信息坍缩的诊断与评价方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize events in images and parse sentences, but it remains unclear when they bind visual Agent-Patient structure to linguistic semantic roles across languages whose role cues depend on morphology, word order or construction. We introduce ROLECUE, a controlled diagnostic that pairs 192 validated two-person action images with German, Turkish, Japanese, English, Korean and Bangla sentences in canonical and patient-first orders. The evaluation separates image-only role recognition, text-only role parsing, direct image-sentence matching, response-compliance behavior and an external modular composition of the model's own component predictions. Across eight recent open-weight VLMs, ROLECUE reveals a structured spectrum: some models fail visual or linguistic component tests, some largely solve the diagnostic, some collapse to constant semantic assent and several show component-joint gaps in which reliable image-only and text-only role predictions do not survive direct joint inference. The largest non-degenerate gaps reach 44.9 percentage points, with final bootstrap intervals confirming that the effect is not a point-estimate artifact. These results reveal multilingual component-joint performance gaps and acceptance biases hidden by aggregate VLM benchmarks and show why component diagnostics are necessary before interpreting joint multimodal errors.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to WACV 2027, Evaluations and Datasets Track

</details>

### 18. [Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10609v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10609

**作者：** Yisong Hu、Junbo Wang、Yuke Li、Jiangbin Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10609v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10609v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无需训练、可即插即用的 HypoKFS 框架：先在稀疏采样帧上推理构建初始假设空间，由答案分布判断是否需补充选帧，再由保留假设引导挑选有区分度的帧并重新推理以精化假设。

**相关性简评：** 其“答案分布决定是否继续取帧”的机制与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡直接相关，用竞争假设筛选视觉证据也可供核查视觉证据筛选与停止决策的联系；但方法完全在文本假设层面，未涉及 latent 状态，需判断其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Long video understanding requires models to identify and reason over sparse, temporally distributed evidence within limited frame budgets. Existing keyframe selection methods typically retrieve query-relevant frames from a densely sampled candidate set before inference. However, global image-text matching incurs unnecessary computation when a small set of uniformly sampled frames already provides sufficient evidence. Query relevance alone may also overlook evidence that distinguishes competing answers, while one-shot selection offers no opportunity to correct earlier selection errors. We propose HypoKFS, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples keyframe selection with iterative inference by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). HypoKFS first reasons over sparsely sampled frames to construct an initial hypothesis space. The resulting answer distribution determines whether additional frame selection is needed. When needed, the retained hypotheses guide the selection of discriminative frames, followed by renewed inference and hypothesis refinement. This iterative process directs additional visual computation toward unresolved hypotheses while avoiding unnecessary global frame matching. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple MLLM backbones. HypoKFS improves accuracy by up to 6.7 percentage points and achieves 72.9% accuracy on Video-MME at only 1.3% of the reference frame-hypothesis matching cost.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 19. [VisProve: Learning Typed Visual Provenance for Scientific Document Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10642v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10642

**作者：** Jingxuan Wei、Zhengyang Wang、Zheng Guo、Xiaoming Wu、Fuqiang Wang、Xin Wang、Bihui Yu、Yining Wang、Junnan Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10642v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10642v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 ReViE 数据集（3,941 道科学文档问答，标注页面、章节、区域及 Quotation/Compression/Inference 支撑类型），并提出 VisProve，用可微空间证据读取与证据-答案关系反馈、经门控残差把生成条件化在局部视觉证据上。

**相关性简评：** 类型化支撑关系与区域证据注入为「视觉证据筛选」「答案是否真正使用视觉内容」及贡献分配提供了可核查的监督与诊断线索，但文档问答设定不同于 latent 状态生成，且 Typed-F1 极低提示证据归因仍是开放缺口。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VisProve: Learning Typed Visual Provenance for Scientific Document Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Visual citations show where an answer is supported, but not how the cited content contributes to it. In scientific document question answering, a model may read a value directly, compress several observations, or combine evidence to infer a conclusion. We study typed visual provenance, where a system generates an answer together with source regions and explicit support relations. We introduce ReViE, a dataset of 3,941 questions over complete scientific documents, with page, section, and region annotations labeled as Quotation, Compression, or Inference. We further propose VisProve, which augments joint answer and provenance generation with differentiable Spatial Evidence Reading and Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback. VisProve conditions next-token prediction on localized visual evidence and its estimated support relation through a gated norm-bounded residual. On the document-disjoint ReViE test set, VisProve improves Typed-F1 from 3.52 to 5.48 and Section-F1 from 45.99 to 53.24 over joint supervised fine-tuning with the same backbone, while Page-F1 changes only marginally. These results suggest that coupling visual grounding with support relation modeling mainly improves fine-grained provenance, while the low absolute Typed-F1 reveals a substantial gap between answer generation and precise visual evidence attribution.

</details>

### 20. [Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10694v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10694

**作者：** Mohamed Rayan Barhdadi、Syed Talal Wasim、Juergen Gall、Erchin Serpedin、Hasan Kurban

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10694v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10694v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出五条件解离协议：保持推理任务不变、把同一问题的感知输入从纯视觉渐变到纯文本，并用 Perceptual Contribution Ratio 量化各保真度能弥合多少视觉—文本差距；在抽象二维面板与两个自然 3D 游戏场景上评测七个 VLM（约 15.9 万次 API 调用），发现真实场景状态脚手架可基本闭合差距，而自动解析器（含前沿 VLM）构造的脚手架无效。

**相关性简评：** 该诊断把视觉 ToM 瓶颈定位在感知前端（是否追踪各时刻在场 agent、能否抽取出结构化场景状态），而非信念推理，并报告视觉条件下 60% 的错误为「reality bias」，与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留、视觉证据筛选与信息坍缩直接相关，值得核查视觉通路是否只传递物体实际位置而丢失任务必要状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \\emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (E&amp;D). Code and dataset: https://kurbanintelligencelab.github.io/perception-not-reasoning/

</details>

### 21. [Tiny Evidence Region Localization with Selective Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10734

**作者：** Yujuan Pang、Wenhao Xu、Yinglei Teng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10734v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对多模态大模型在细粒度小区域证据任务中易受背景干扰的问题，提出 SPN-OPSD，对证据与背景区域进行选择性正负 on-policy 自蒸馏和 token 级监督，以提升证据定位与抗干扰能力。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选及任务必要视觉信息保留直接相关；其 token 级正负蒸馏可能影响模型对证据区域内部状态的编码与使用，值得核查增益究竟来自定位、注意力还是蒸馏监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tiny Evidence Region Localization with Selective Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models have made progress in general visual tasks. However, limitations remain in fine-grained visual tasks requiring evidence from minute image regions. Existing methods primarily train models using evidence-related regions while overlooking the influence of extensive background regions, resulting in a limited ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. We propose selective positive-negative on-policy self-distillation (SPN-OPSD), which considers both evidence and background regions. Supervision from both views improves the model's ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. Furthermore, selective token-level distillation provides more informative supervision, improving the model's ability to attend to evidence regions in Fine-Grained Visual Tasks. On Qwen3.5-2B, SPN-OPSD improves accuracy on V\* Bench, ZoomBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite from 76.44%, 45.92%, and 57.43% to 84.82%, 54.56%, and 59.56%, respectively. Similar gains are also observed on Qwen3.5-0.8B.

</details>

### 22. [Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10831v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10831

**作者：** Berke Bunyamin Sule、Yavuz Selim Aygan、Ahmed Zeer、Elif Ince、Ali Mert Temizsoy、Ozgur Agar、Himmet Toprak Kesgin、Muzaffer Kaan Yuce、Mehmet Fatih Amasyali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10831v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10831v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在多语言框架下评测视觉语言模型的抽象视觉推理，涵盖 BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles 与 PuzzleVQA，比较多种数据混合与 SFT 策略，并用 LLM-as-a-Judge 在最终答案之外评估推理链质量。

**相关性简评：** 属 VLM 抽象视觉推理的诊断与失败分析：报告「答案正确不等于推理链有效」、微调后推理稳定性下降乃至文本循环或空输出式崩塌，可作为核查训练监督与推理链评价对 latent 推理影响的线索；但未涉及内部状态或视觉证据读取机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models have had massive leaps in recent years. Yet, when tested on high-level cognitive tasks like pattern completion, abstract logic, and relational reasoning, they still fall short. This limitation stems from the models' lack of ability to find out underlying rules and maintain constant intermediate steps, rather than merely deciding on the correct option. To research these shortcomings, this study analyzes visual reasoning performance throughout a multilingual evaluation framework encompassing the BİLSEM, MM-IQ, Visual Puzzles, and PuzzleVQA datasets. We evaluate various data mixing strategies and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We observed that a correct answer does not always mean the reasoning chain is valid. Because of this, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to assess the quality of reasoning beyond final answer accuracy. Our experimental results reveal that baseline models often exhibit more stable reasoning compared to fine-tuned counterparts. Most importantly, we observe that SFT can lead to model collapse, manifesting as infinite text loops or empty outputs. The study concludes that current VLMs still struggle with abstract visual reasoning.

</details>

### 23. [What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11062v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11062

**作者：** Elliott Piercy、Justin Chan、Sepand Dyanatkar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11062v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11062v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作考察 VideoQA 多选题评测究竟测到了什么：在六个基准上发现无视觉输入时准确率仍显著高于随机，并将其归因于选项先验与捷径依赖。作者用「选项利用」和答案条件化的推理轨迹刻画不忠实性，提出 Option-Delayed Replay（ODR），在开放式推理轨迹的受控阶段才披露选项，以获得去除选项泄露的客观分数，并把诊断流程整理为可复现协议、发布重标注的 LVBench。

**相关性简评：** 其核心问题是分数是否真正来自视觉证据而非上下文捷径，与 LVR 关心的答案是否使用视觉/latent 内容、证据筛选和不忠实推理轨迹直接相关；ODR 可提供一种在受控时点插入选项、检验视觉旁路的评测思路，值得核查其是否适用于 latent 推理状态的分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation

**abstract/A1：** Video understanding evaluations are intended to measure a model's proficiency in video perception and task solving. However, current VideoQA benchmarks struggle to isolate these capabilities due to their reliance on multiple-choice (MC) answer guidance, language priors, and fragile scoring pipelines. Disentangling these confounding factors reveals how much of a model's score is supplied by the evaluation context rather than earned through faithful perception. Across six VideoQA benchmarks of varying length, we find that accuracy is significantly above chance without any visual input. This is caused by shortcutting and option-prior reliance. We express these effects in the language of faithfulness: option-exploitation and answer-conditioned reasoning traces are unfaithful even when they are correct. Together, our results show that a VideoQA score is jointly determined by language priors, option timing, and how outputs and labels are converted into correctness. We produce a novel Option-Delayed Replay (ODR) mechanism that discloses options at controlled stages of an open-ended (OE) trajectory, to obtain objective MC scores from faithful option-free inference. Our work demonstrates that agentic methods with ODR and faithful inference can match option-exploiting performance. Finally, we formalize our diagnostic collection and ODR as a reproducible evaluation protocol, and we release a human-relabelled edition of LVBench (correcting $20.5\\%$ of keys) to remove annotation noise as a confounding variable.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/loc/sydney/178197

</details>

### 24. [Viscot-steer: Disentangling and Transferring Visual Chain-of-Thought via Activation Steering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11209v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11209

**作者：** Ningning Wang、Beier Zhu、Xingyu Zhu、Kaiyun Yang、Xun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11209v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11209v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Viscot-steer，一个免训练的 activation steering 框架：将 visual-CoT 拆成 grounding 与 reasoning 两段激活向量，从源模型对应层提取并对齐到目标 LVLM 的激活空间，在不同阶段分别施加干预，实现跨异构模型的能力迁移。

**相关性简评：** 把「定位关键视觉证据」与「基于证据推理」视为可分离的内部状态方向，直接对应 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容是否被使用的分解思路，其阶段特定干预与层选择也可供核查激活层面的表示是否承载视觉信息；但干预发生在激活向量层面而非显式 latent 推理状态，需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Viscot-steer: Disentangling and Transferring Visual Chain-of-Thought via Activation Steering

**abstract/A1：** Visual chain-of-thought (visual-CoT), also known as "thinking with images", equips LVLMs with the ability to locate and use key visual evidence for reasoning. However, acquiring such visual-CoT capabilities requires costly post-training and tightly couples them to a specific backbone, making transfer to other LVLMs difficult. Existing cross-model transfer methods typically treat visual-CoT as a monolithic capability, using a unified representation that ignores the functional distinction between grounding and reasoning and introduces stage-irrelevant interventions. To address this problem, we propose Viscot-steer, a training-free activation steering framework for transferring visual-CoT capabilities across heterogeneous LVLMs. Specifically, Viscot-steer first disentangles visual-CoT into grounding and reasoning vectors and extracts them from the source-model layers associated with the corresponding capabilities. It then aligns the vectors with the activation space of the target model and steers the grounding and reasoning layers during bounding-box prediction and reasoning-trace generation, respectively. Across benchmarks covering high-resolution visual understanding, general visual perception and reasoning, and mathematical visual reasoning, Viscot-steer transfers capabilities from different visual-CoT models to architecturally diverse LVLMs and outperforms the strongest capability-transfer baseline by an average of 1.86 percentage points on the primary evaluation metrics.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://nn-wang.github.io/viscot-steer/

</details>

### 25. [Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11344v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11344

**作者：** Chentao Cao、Zhanke Zhou、Sangni Duan、Bo Han、Hang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11344v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11344v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Spatial Harness，将场景显式表示为可执行世界状态：用 Perceiver 结合问题约束与视觉估计放置物体和相机，再由物理引擎执行视角变换并生成测量与渲染视图来引导 VLM 空间推理。

**相关性简评：** 可作为「显式外部世界状态」与 LVR 隐式场景表征的直接对照，涉及几何信息保留、视角变换证据获取及物理引擎计算成本；其外部状态是否真正替代模型内部推理、以及感知误差如何传导，仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines

**abstract/A1：** Spatial reasoning requires understanding how objects and observers are arranged in a scene and how their relations change with viewpoint or movement. Vision-language models (VLMs) typically perform both steps through model-internal reasoning, forming an implicit scene interpretation from partial views and imagining the consequences of spatial transformations. A misread scene can lead to a wrong answer, while even a correct interpretation does not ensure that imagined transformations satisfy spatial constraints. We introduce Spatial Harness, which represents scenes as explicit and executable world states to ground spatial reasoning in physics-engine feedback. A Perceiver integrates scene constraints extracted from the question with specialized visual estimates to place objects and cameras in a shared coordinate frame. The resulting state is instantiated in a physics engine, where a Reasoner executes viewpoint changes and uses computed measurements and rendered views to guide reasoning. We evaluate on MindCube, SAT, MMSI-Bench, and SpatialRGPT-Bench with open- and closed-weight VLMs. On MindCube, Spatial Harness improves Qwen3.5-27B from 52.70% to 71.14%, surpassing pySpatial by 7.52 percentage points. Given identical annotated object and camera poses, it reaches 98.25% versus 71.81% for model-internal reasoning. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tmlr-group/Spatial-Harness

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 26. [How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11437v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11437

**作者：** Gengyuan Zhang、Xiao Han、Shijie Zhou、Abdullah Koukash、Jingpei Wu、Jindong Gu、Yuqicheng Zhu、Nassir Navab、Volker Tresp、Ghazal Ghazaei

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**内容简述：** 该文构建两阶段评测框架：先以 SurgKnowBench 统一多个公开手术数据集与任务，诊断通用 MLLM 在手术场景理解上的能力边界，再用 SurgAgentGym 提供有界知识检索与通用视觉定位的 agent 环境，检验推理期工具中介的证据使用能否弥补不足。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki and general-purpose visual grounding for surgical tasks. SurgAgentGym evaluates whether generalist agents can improve surgical understanding at inference time through tool-mediated evidence use, without additional surgical training. Our results show that agentic inference narrows the gap mainly for perception-heavy tasks, while fine-grained localization and expert-style assessment remain persistent bottlenecks. This opens a path toward future studies of agentic surgical understanding.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 64 pages including appendices. Project page: https://vitagent.github.io/

### 27. [Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11531v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11531

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对视觉基础模型与大型语言模型做了超过 14.4 万次线性探测，联合考察层与模块（残差流、FFN、归一化等）的可探测性，发现最优层-模块组合的收益远大于只调层，并据此给出固定探测策略（视觉的 Act@100、语言的 LN2@60）。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系 LVR 中「任务必要信息保留在哪些内部状态」的表示诊断：其层×模块视角可供核查读取 latent 的层级选择、深度与位置对表示相似度与证据筛选的影响，但论文未涉及推理期 latent 生成或视觉推理任务本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module

**abstract/A1：** Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.

</details>

**内容简述：** DriveFoundry 将数据引擎（因果场景-候选轨迹记录、反事实标注、由模型失败驱动的 VLM 辅助修正）与模型引擎 Xiaomi-Drive-o1 结合：后者在共享视觉语言 backbone 上统一感知、因果、动作、世界与价值，用 block-wise latent refill 在任务块间传递候选证据与预测视觉后果，并由 value-of-computation 头按预期收益与成本分配 latent token，在 PhysicalAI、AlpaSim 与实车上报告结果。

**相关性简评：** 块间 latent 传递视觉证据与预测后果、按收益成本自适应分配 latent token，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 计算分配直接相关；其 latent token 是否真正承载并影响最终决策尚待读原文核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** A driving foundation model must learn reusable decision knowledge from rare critical events and apply it under strict runtime constraints. We introduce DriveFoundry, a closed-loop framework improving iteration efficiency under data and computation budgets by coupling structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference. The Data Engine builds traceable scene-candidate records linking scene evidence and factor-decision relations to candidate trajectories and outcome assessments. Candidate comparisons and counterfactual annotations clarify how scene factors affect behavioral feasibility and preference. Verified model failures guide VLM-assisted annotation and expert correction, refining training data and annotation systems. The model engine, Xiaomi-Drive-o1, unifies Perception, Causation, Action, World, and Value within a shared vision-language backbone to enable cross-task knowledge transfer. Block-wise latent refill passes candidate-specific evidence and predicted visual consequences between task blocks, connecting scene understanding, planning, and evaluation. A learned value-of-computation head selects tasks and allocates latent tokens based on expected benefit and cost, adapting inference to each decision. On PhysicalAI, the 9B model achieves the lowest ADE@1 across evaluated splits and horizons among tested models. In AlpaSim, it outperforms Alpamayo 1.5 across all metrics and achieves lower close-encounter and off-road rates than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, while trailing in progress and AlpaSim scores. For the 0.8B variant, joint training reduces 5 s minADE@6 by about 54% without altering the inference path or token budget. Adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens. Real-vehicle tests confirm runtime feasibility, supporting a unified paradigm for learning from critical experience and dynamically allocating computation.

**comment/C1：** 57 pages, 31 figures, Project page: https://Xiaomi-EV.github.io/Xiaomi-Drive-o1

### 29. [Answer or Defer? Testing VLMs' Stated Confidence on Brain MRI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11833v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11833

**作者：** Amir Sabbaghziarani、Parsa Ghazvinian、Sepehr Salem、Sergey Plis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11833v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11833v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在脑 MRI 切片上评测八个开源 VLM，考察能否用陈述置信度阈值筛选可接受答案、将其余转交临床医生，并分析置信度与正确性的关联如何随人群变化。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 VLM 的停止/转交决策与置信度校准；其阴性结果可供核查「依据置信度决定停止或继续推理」在分布变化下的可靠性，但未涉及 latent 状态或推理轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Answer or Defer? Testing VLMs' Stated Confidence on Brain MRI

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) could support medical-image interpretation, but their use requires deciding which interpretations to accept and which images to refer to a clinician. We test whether thresholding stated confidence can retain useful coverage while limiting errors among accepted answers, and how this depends on the population. Eight open-weight VLMs, including two reasoning models, assess 3,888 brain MRI slices from post-treatment glioma patients (BraTS 2024) and healthy volunteers (IXI) for tumor or gross abnormality. BraTS labels are mask-derived; IXI slices are treated as negatives. On BraTS, no threshold selects a nonempty set with at most 5% empirical error for any model, even when chosen retrospectively. This also holds for four models evaluated on a large-lesion, distant-negative subset. At a 10% error budget, Gemma-4-12B retains 24.4% of slices and every other model at most 2.5%. To investigate this limited selection ability, we separate confidence differences between predicted answers from differences within each answer. For four models with available outcome-level summaries, pooled mean confidence differs more between answers than between correct and incorrect responses within each answer. A covariance decomposition explains how this pattern can produce opposite confidence-correctness associations across populations. At a 20% error budget, accepting every "tumor" answer covers more slices than any confidence threshold for two models. These findings caution against using unvalidated stated confidence as a standalone deferral signal and support population-specific validation before deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/VLM-Answer-or-Defer.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the WACV 2027 FABRIC Workshop

</details>

### 30. [Where Does Proposal Selection Fail? Diagnosing Frozen Vision-Language Queries over Detector Proposals](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11873v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文固定冻结检测器给出的候选框，逐项变动选择接口，用 Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL 等同族 VLM 诊断模块化 grounding 中候选选择究竟在哪一步失败，发现选择器读取的图文条件查询状态比选择头结构更关键，而训练出的头在分布外数据上普遍失效。

**相关性简评：** 该诊断直接检验 VLM 内部查询状态是否保留指代物位置等任务必要视觉信息，并涉及视觉证据筛选、latent 内容是否被真正使用以及验证器与存在性判断的区分，可供核查「接口信息 vs 选择头容量」的贡献分配思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Does Proposal Selection Fail? Diagnosing Frozen Vision-Language Queries over Detector Proposals

**abstract/A1：** In modular grounding a frozen detector proposes regions and a vision-language model (VLM) selects one, at lower cost than letting the VLM decode a box, but it is unclear where such systems fail. We hold perception fixed---every trained selector chooses among the same frozen proposals, which contain the referent for at least $99.8\\%$ of RefCOCO/+/g queries---and vary the selection interface one factor at a time for two VLMs of one family (Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B). On RefCOCOg, what the selector reads matters more than how it is built: the VLM's image-conditioned query encodes the referent's location and beats a text-only query by $0.15$--$0.18$ with every head tested (by less for InternVL3-8B, whose vision encoder differs; one head tested). The remaining errors are rankings among a few top candidates; a cross-attention selector supervised with every valid box reaches the VLM's coordinate decoding on RefCOCOg, and with Qwen2.5-VL on RefCOCO/+ when also trained on their data. Beyond that distribution it does not: on Ref-L4's Objects365 images, mostly of categories outside training, every trained head falls to $0.19$--$0.28$ while Qwen decoding keeps about $0.8$ (InternVL3's drops too), neither a wider detector prompt nor a class-agnostic proposer closes the gap, and on public reasoning benchmarks Ref-Adv-s and RefBench-PRO full-budget heads trail decoding by $0.19$--$0.37$ although proposals cover most referents. A trained verifier reduces to an existence probe on the VLM's query state and does not beat the VLM's yes/no answer on public no-target benchmarks.

</details>

### 31. [Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11949v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11949

**作者：** Rohan Dugad、Mi Luo、Kristen Grauman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11949v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11949v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VIOS 后训练框架：以「有/无视频」两种条件下下一 token 分布的散度衡量逐位置视觉依赖，再由学生与答案特权教师的 reliance gap 定位视觉未被利用的 token，并用 EMA 教师、对比目标与门控实现稠密监督，单次 rollout 无需外部奖励或大教师。

**相关性简评：** 逐 token 视觉依赖差异直接对应「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」与贡献分配问题，其有/无视觉输入的对照可能为诊断视觉旁路和筛选视觉证据提供可核查信号；需注意它是训练期监督方法，而非推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/

</details>

### 32. [Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12293v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12293

**作者：** Chaoyuan Hao、Wentao Yue、Yanyan Wu、Boyuan Gao、Tianyou Lai、Maolin Wang、Yongxin Ni、Hanwen Du、Youhua Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文通过初步分析发现循环 latent 推理中不同 recurrent depth 的成功集合并不嵌套、更深层会丢掉浅层已得出的正确答案，据此提出 Depth Portfolio Allocation，把测试时计算重述为多深度候选源之间的预算分配，并比较固定组合与反馈引导的顺序分配，在 GSM8K、SVAMP、MultiArith、MBPP 上考察 oracle 覆盖与计算成本。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及 latent 循环推理的深度—停止决策与计算预算问题，「深度不仅是成本、还决定可访问的候选解」这一结论可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的支持组合与多层状态复用；但实验限于纯文本任务，其与视觉证据筛选的关联需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Recurrent latent reasoning in large lanugage models (LLMs) scales test-time computation by increasing recurrent depth, naturally framing inference as a problem of deciding when to stop. We identify a previously overlooked limitation of this single-depth view through systematic preliminary analysis: deeper recurrence can lose correct solutions found at shallower depths, while depth-specific success sets remain broadly non-nested even after controlling for marginal accuracy. This suggests that depth determines not only computation cost, but also access to distinct candidate solutions. Motivated by this finding, we propose Depth Portfolio Allocation (DPA), which reformulates recurrent test-time scaling as budgeted allocation across depth-specific candidate sources. DPA supports both fixed portfolios and feedback-guided sequential allocation under a shared inference budget. Experiments on GSM8K, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MBPP show that mixed-depth portfolios expand oracle coverage under matched candidate counts and nominal costs, while feedback-guided allocation generally matches or improves uniform allocation and can reduce computation in high-budget settings. Code and data are avaible at : https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LLM-latent-B7BC/.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12305v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12305v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建 HumanSightBench，一个面向 MLLM 人类级视觉感知的基准，含 2,876 道短答视觉题、7 大类 21 子类，并通过清晰性、答案唯一性、视觉接地、人类可解性、纯文本捷径过滤五道门槛筛选题目，报告八个模型最高 pass@3 为 65.6%、Counting 均低于 27.5%。

**相关性简评：** 其按感知类别拆分的失败诊断与纯文本捷径过滤，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留于内部状态、语言先验与视觉旁路造成的混淆提供可控评测线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories. We only include items that pass five inclusion gates: question clarity, answer uniqueness, visual grounding, human solvability, and text-only shortcut filtering. According to the protocol, errors are defined as incorrect answers on human-validated visual tasks with the evaluated interface. The inclusion gates are intended to reduce confounds from ambiguity and external knowledge. The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs. No evaluated model exceeds 27.5% on Counting. These results identify capability gaps that are hidden by overall scores and can help future training experiments and held-out evaluation.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在超高分辨率遥感图像中测量 VLM 的计数能力上限（「counting horizon」），并用幂律响应模型预测少计与虚计，进而提出免训练的 GeoScope：由纯文本 LLM 将问题解析为带类型空间程序，VLM 仅在其工作范围内定位与计数，超出上限的视图才拆分，方向关系由框显式计算。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系到「该看哪里」与「何时停止/拆分」的收益成本权衡，其对单视图容量上限的量化与「只有在超限时才拆分」的规则，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策，以及容量–分辨率之间的信息瓶颈；无需生成 latent 亦可提供对照基线。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

**comment/C1：** Preprint. 72 pages including the Supplementary Material. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

</details>
