摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多模态大模型在视觉与文本证据冲突时如何仲裁模态，识别出少数因果影响预测偏向的「arbitration heads」，并提出无需训练的推理期干预，使模型转向指定可信模态。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接关联 VLM 推理中是否使用视觉证据及视觉旁路问题，其因果头识别与推理期控制可供核查内部状态调控、证据筛选和模态贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.

**comment/C1：** WACV 2027

</details>

### 37. [Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12886v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12886

**作者：** Haozhi Yuan、Handong Li、Yifan Zhang、Qianshan Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12886v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12886v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Reframe 是一个面向视觉 agent 的后训练框架，将「观察状态」而非仅输出分布作为对齐对象：GD-GRPO 通过证据感知奖励并随机移除原始视觉输入，训练专家依赖工具返回的观察；OG-MOPD 则在 rollout 中把失败的工具调用替换为规范动作，并从修复后的观察继续多教师 on-policy 蒸馏。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及多模态推理中视觉证据是否被真正使用的训练与评价问题，其 observation-gated 蒸馏和随机遮挡原始图像的做法，可供核查能否作为检验 LVR 中视觉旁路与证据依赖的诊断或监督信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

</details>

### 38. [Represented but Not Used: Value-Policy Dissociation in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10457v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10457

**作者：** Yuzhang Luo、Mohamed Aghzal、Liangming Pan、Ziyu Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10457v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10457v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 Grid 与 WebShop 环境中研究 LLM 智能体的动作价值能否从隐藏状态线性解码，并比较价值读出方向干预与自然价值迁移（NVT）对策略选择的因果影响，提出价值表示与策略选择之间的「价值—策略分离」，并测试以价值读出为传感器、NVT 为执行器的闭环控制器。

**相关性简评：** 虽不涉及视觉推理，但其「可解码却未被策略使用」的诊断及基于自然状态变化的干预方法，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正参与答案生成、区分表示与使用及贡献分配提供可借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Represented but Not Used: Value-Policy Dissociation in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents need to choose actions whose consequences unfold over multiple future steps, yet poor decisions do not reveal whether the model failed to represent those consequences or failed to use them. Mechanistic interpretability has studied internal representations of environment state and plans, but sequential decision making also requires evaluating how candidate actions change future outcomes. Reinforcement learning formalizes this as action value. We study this computation in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and GPT-OSS-20B across a partially observed Grid environment and WebShop, a simulated web shopping environment. We find that the relative values of candidate actions are linearly decodable from intermediate hidden states, including at states where the policy prefers a worse action. We call this gap between value representation and policy choice value-policy dissociation. To investigate how represented value relates to action selection, we compare direct interventions along the value readout direction with Natural Value Transport (NVT), a transformation learned from hidden state changes that naturally result from differences in action value. While readout-direction interventions have limited and inconsistent effects, NVT more consistently influences action preferences, particularly at later layers. We also test a closed-loop controller that uses the value readout as a sensor and NVT as an actuator, observing improvements in task outcomes. These results suggest that LLM agents can represent useful prospective value without reliably translating it into policy choice.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 39. [PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10477v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10477

**作者：** Yi Ge、Heng Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10477v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10477v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PatternBloom：把 agentic RAG 的检索单位由内容改为逻辑，用信息密度奖励（IDR）按冻结 oracle 的信息增益给证据图轨迹打分，蒸馏成图模式记忆，再用模式增强奖励（PAR）做第二阶段 RL，将程序性推理外化为可复用的结构先验。

**相关性简评：** 其「按信息增益筛选证据路径、并把推理结构外化为可复用模式以支撑深度增长」的思路，可供核查 LVR 的证据筛选、轨迹监督分配与长度泛化；但工作为纯文本、无 latent 状态，迁移线索仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 46 pages. Code: https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.MA

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建带「收到共谋指令但拒绝」控制组的多智能体共谋基准（约 2,500 个委员会与 1,476 个代码评审回合），发现已发表的激活探针主要读取「被指示共谋」而非「决定共谋」，并指出投票后打分、公开辩护缺失等评估陷阱，进而给出监测器测试协议与可在任意规模群体上运行的在线扫描统计监测器。

**相关性简评：** 其「指令 vs 决策」对照设计和探针实际读取内容的归因分析，可供核查 LVR 中「latent 状态保留视觉证据或推理决策」的结论是否只是读到了输入提示，也可为贡献分配与评测控制提供参照；但论文属纯文本多智能体监控，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors

**abstract/A1：** Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/mainul3195/collusion-probe-pitfalls ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mainul3195/collusion-probe-pitfalls ; archive: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23636508

</details>

### 41. [Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10660v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10660

**作者：** Yinuo Jiang、Guangzhi Wang、Yiran Wang、Junfu Pu、Cheng Cheng、Honghao Chen、Cheng Cheng、Ying Shan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10660v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10660v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DIAL：训练时用 rollout alignment 让前向潜动力学模型接触自身的自回归潜状态预测，并以多步逆动力学监督训练轻量逆头（固定参数用于模型生成的转移）以保持动作相关信息；测试时耦合逆头与前向动力学自回归生成动作序列，用于初始化 CEM 提议分布，在四个视觉控制基准及长时程设定上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练对齐自回归潜 rollout 以缓解 teacher-forcing 与规划时状态分布的错配」，以及「用逆动力学探测潜状态是否保留任务必需信息」，可能为 LVR 的潜轨迹训练、暴露偏差与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但对象是视觉控制规划而非多模态推理，需较多迁移核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning

**abstract/A1：** Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Adaptive Internal Computation（AIC）：一种迭代策略，联合训练动作选择与「何时停止精炼 latent 表示」，并以期望深度惩罚与中间价值预测作为辅助监督；在十二个基准上平均 3.3 步，相较固定八步策略降低 31–44% 单决策延迟，奖励在七个任务上优于最佳固定深度策略。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯 RL 控制任务，但其状态自适应的停止学习、深度惩罚与中间价值监督可能直接对应 LVR 中 STOP 决策与动态计算分配的收益-成本问题，可供核查能否迁移到 VLM 推理期的停止判据与监督设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning When to Think: Adaptive Internal Computation for Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Iterative neural policies usually spend the same computation on every decision, although the benefit of additional processing varies across states. We introduce Adaptive Internal Computation (AIC), an iterative policy that learns when to stop refining its latent representation and act. In AIC, we train action selection and stopping jointly, an expected-depth penalty values computation and intermediate value predictions provide auxiliary supervision. We show that when only some states benefit from further refinement, an ideal state-dependent allocator outperforms every state-independent stopping schedule at the same expected depth. With at most eight refinement steps per decision, AIC executes 3.3 steps on average across twelve benchmark tasks and lowers per-decision latency by 31--44% relative to a fixed eight-step policy on four control and robotics tasks. Its mean reward exceeds the best fixed-depth policy on seven tasks and trails it on four. Ablating adaptive stopping and value supervision separately shows that stopping accounts for most of the reward gain on PickCube and AntMaze, where it also executes more refinement steps and that supervision accounts for most of it on RareEvent.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

### 43. [Prune to Probe: Causal Decision-Stability Probes for Efficient Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11034v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11034

**作者：** Yufei Qi、Chonghe Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11034v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11034v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Prune-to-Probe：在答案生成后定位对答后继续生成有贡献的 late-MLP 坐标并临时抑制，以相对随机干预的停止响应探测决策稳定性；干预仅作探针，模型返回原答案或从未改动缓存续写，在 MATH/MMLU-Pro 上节省少量 token。

**相关性简评：** 为 STOP 判据提供可核查线索：用因果激活干预而非输出置信度决定是否继续推理；但属纯文本设定，且 AUROC 0.502 表明该信号反映决策稳定性而非正确性，迁至 VLM 推理需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Prune to Probe: Causal Decision-Stability Probes for Efficient Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning models often continue generating after producing an answer, yet stopping prematurely may interrupt useful verification or revision. In this work, we investigate whether targeted interventions in a model's internal computation can provide a reliable signal for when to stop reasoning. We introduce Prune-to-Probe, an inference-time controller that uses causal activation interventions to probe the stability of a model's current answer. Specifically, we identify late-MLP coordinates that contribute to post-answer continuation while excluding those important for answer completion. Once an answer is stated, Prune-to-Probe temporarily suppresses the selected coordinates and measures the resulting stopping response relative to matched random interventions. Crucially, these interventions serve only as probes: the model either returns its existing answer or resumes generation from an untouched cache. On MATH, Prune-to-Probe reduces reasoning-token forwards by 2.60%, preserving all naturally correct trajectories while repairing six errors. On MMLU-Pro, it achieves 1.145% pooled savings with no observed harm. Further analysis shows that the intervention captures decision stability rather than correctness (AUROC 0.502). These results demonstrate the potential of causal activation probes for efficient inference-time control without permanent model modification.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11201v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11201v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 ≤1B 小模型上考察带自洽性（采样多条 CoT 并多数投票）的提示推理，用 oracle 门控给出上界，并提出基于贪心解信号的近似门控，从而跳过大部分采样调用、节省算力。

**相关性简评：** 多数投票会把原本正确的贪心答案翻成错误的诊断，以及「是否值得再花算力采样、如何聚合多假设」的门控思路，可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 采样聚合与 STOP 决策的收益成本；但对象是纯文本数学任务，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models

**abstract/A1：** We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two &lt;=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted by the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)

</details>

### 45. [When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11330v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11330

**作者：** Xiangyu Lu、Zhanke Zhou、Jiazhe Ning、Chentao Cao、Jiangchao Yao、Bo Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11330v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11330v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断 agentic RL 训练中工具调用能力退化，将其归因于工具 token 不平衡、token 均值聚合放大负优势及失败重试延长轨迹，并提出 TACA，以 Advantage Projection、Decision Contrast 和 Supervised Replay 分别校正工具调用 token 优势、对比工具辅助与直接作答的收益并回放正确调用轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 虽非视觉多模态工作，但其对「何时调用工具」的决策对比与调用 token 的信用分配，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK 动作的贡献分配、工具调用触发监督及推理到证据获取的过渡训练，尚未涉及 latent 内容是否被答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains language models through multi-turn tool interactions, yet their reasoning performance and tool-calling ability can decline during training. We trace this degradation to three coupled mechanisms: (1) tool-token imbalance produces negative overall tool credit when incorrect trajectories contain more tool tokens per turn than correct ones; (2) aggregation amplification can further strengthen this negative signal as token-mean aggregation gives longer incorrect trajectories greater weight in policy updates; and (3) failure-driven retries prolong trajectories as models tend to call tools again after execution errors, extending potential negative credit to recovery attempts. To counter this suppression, we propose Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which targets the transition from reasoning to tool use through supervision of both call initiation and generation. Specifically, TACA uses Advantage Projection to enforce a nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens within each prompt group through a minimal uniform shift. Additionally, TACA guides tool-use decisions with Decision Contrast, comparing rewards for tool-assisted and direct answers to the same prompt. Through Supervised Replay, it reinforces tool-call generation using calls from previously sampled correct trajectories. Across models and tasks, TACA improves performance and sustains more reliable tool interaction during training, raising mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 46. [How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11887v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11887

**作者：** Yong Hwi Song、Keon Myung Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11887v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11887v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在冻结的 DINOv2/v3 patch token 上训练一步式随机世界模型，检验「nearest-of-m（IMLE）」只需小 m 的猜想，并以随机码本视角给出关于记忆化、模式概率平坦化与连续高维欠分散的三条预注册预测，另报告规划未提升的负结果。

**相关性简评：** 「采多个候选 latent、只对最接近观测者施加监督」可为 LVR 的多 latent 假设筛选与贡献分配提供线索，其模式平均、token 流形漂移及 m 的成本收益权衡可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens

**abstract/A1：** One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages (12-page main text, appendices A-H). Code: https://github.com/thddydgnl/nearest-of-m-world-models

</details>

### 47. [When Answer Decodability Is Not a Decision: Separating Final-Answer and Imminent-Emission Signals in Chain-of-Thought](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11892v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11892

**作者：** Hyojung Han、Jongmin Kim、Seung-Hun Jeon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11892v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11892v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 emission-controlled dual-target probing（ECDP），在相同位置用同一低秩 reader 族分别探测「即将提及的候选」与「最终答案」，并配目标特定的 null 与预设阈值；在 DecisionDepth 上即将提及高度可解码而最终答案很弱，而在 Qwen3-8B thinking/MMLU 全前缀 reader 下顺序反转，据此主张答案可解码性是目标相对且依赖协议的。

**相关性简评：** 该文关于「答案可解码不等于已决策」的探针协议与 null、阈值、位置和 reader 设定，可供核查 LVR 中「内部状态是否真正承载并决定答案」的证据强度；其文本 CoT 结论迁移到多模态 latent 需另行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Answer Decodability Is Not a Decision: Separating Final-Answer and Imminent-Emission Signals in Chain-of-Thought

**abstract/A1：** Answer probes applied to chain-of-thought hidden states are often read as evidence that a language model has already decided its final response. This reading overlooks a competing signal, the candidate the model is about to mention. We introduce emission-controlled dual-target probing (ECDP), which fits the same low-rank reader family separately to the imminent mention and to the final answer at identical positions, with target-specific nulls and thresholds fixed before any fit. On correct DecisionDepth (DD) rollouts in which a distractor is mentioned before the final answer, Qwen3.5-4B decodes the next mention at .966 (null .234) but the final answer only at .221 (null .186), an emission gap of .696 \[.648, .744\]; Llama-3.1-8B gives .575 \[.514, .632\]. This pattern is not universal. In a pre-specified evaluation of Qwen3-8B with thinking enabled on held-out MMLU questions, using a full-prefix attention reader over every thinking position, both targets are decodable and the final answer is read far more strongly (mention-minus-answer lift -.398 \[-.459, -.336\] at layer 22 over 467 questions). Model, task, positions, and reader change together between these settings, and an attempted matched comparison on DD produced no valid statistics because the imminent-mention probe did not train reliably, so we do not identify what reverses the order. On DD, planted-signal controls show that the reader recovers an injected final-answer signal at one tenth of full dose. Answer-candidate decodability is therefore target-relative and protocol-dependent: a strong answer readout does not by itself establish when a model commits, and a probe that fails to train is not evidence that the information is absent. ECDP is a practical control for distinguishing imminent text emission from evidence of a settled decision.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 48. [Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11910v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11910

**作者：** Sina Barazandeh、Benjamin E. Lundell、Jose Lugo-Martinez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11910v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11910v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究自动实验室中 LLM 推理受硬截止时间约束时的价值测量问题：在已知最优答案的合成样本决策上，用运行时截止约束比较 fast 与 thinking 模式，指出分别报告答案质量和延迟会高估推理收益，并附 Qwen3-8B 并发压力下截止满足率随请求量骤降的实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「按实际执行动作与到达时间计分」的截止感知评价口径，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本、停止决策与延迟分布，尤其「晚到但更优」的答案如何影响计算分配结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Late but Valuable: Why Deadlines Change the Measured Value of LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) increasingly plan and run experiments in automated laboratories. These experiments keep running while the model reasons and run on schedules with hard deadlines. If an LLM-generated answer arrives late, the system executes a safe fallback action instead, such as rejecting a sample. This creates a systems problem that standard serving metrics do not capture. An answer that matches the fallback adds no value, and answers that differ from the fallback may require more reasoning time. Reporting answer quality and latency separately can therefore overstate the value of reasoning. We test this on synthetic sample decisions, where the best choice is known exactly and a runtime enforces the deadline. We compare one LLM's fast mode, which answers directly, with its thinking mode, which reasons first. In a prespecified replay of 1,200 new decisions, thinking answers that missed a deadline were worth about five times as much as on-time ones. Multiplying the on-time rate by the mean answer value predicted about twice the value that thinking delivered. This prediction overstated thinking's advantage over fast mode by 0.0241 per decision, and by 0.0191 in a repeat on 300 new decisions. Both 95% confidence intervals excluded zero. In a single-GPU Qwen3-8B experiment using simultaneous request bursts, raising the number of requests from 8 to 56 reduced the share of thinking answers that met a 45 s deadline from 79.2% to 1.4%, although total output tripled. Evaluations of LLM agents for laboratories should therefore measure each answer's value and arrival time together and score the action that actually runs.

**comment/C1：** 55 pages, 7 figures, 38 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11926

**作者：** David Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11926v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11926v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出开放词表分割的 readout 会静默丢弃某些类别：仍输出高置信掩码，但该类拿不到任何像素，训练损失却照常下降。作者仅凭类名与训练词表的文本相似度，在未见图像前排序各类崩塌风险（AUROC 0.69–0.96，跨九个模型族），并通过增删近名类别复训翻转该类的增益，归结为词表距离机制；同时发现崩塌类别在冻结特征中仍可分辨，调低 readout 幅度或早停即可恢复。

**相关性简评：** 该文的「信息仍在特征中、却被下游 readout 压制」现象与干预手段（幅度调节、早停、仅凭文本预判风险），可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正使用 latent 内容、以及如何区分信息坍缩与读出头失效。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Text Alone Predicts Which Classes a Segmentation Readout Keeps

**abstract/A1：** An open-vocabulary segmentation readout silently loses a class deployed beyond its training categories. It still emits masks with high confidence, but the class never wins a single pixel. The training loss falls anyway, and mIoU can even rise while classes die. We show that which classes collapse is written in the class-name list alone. Before any image is seen, we rank each class's collapse risk from its text similarity to the training vocabulary alone. The ranking holds at AUROC 0.69-0.96 across nine model families, twelve backbones and eight pretraining recipes. Two further families, measured only after the predictions were written down, land in the same band. What the list writes, it can rewrite. With identical images and a class's counterpart moved in or out of the training list, retraining flips that class's gain over the frozen baseline by 21 IoU points; swapping in unrelated names changes nothing. We find a vocabulary-distance mechanism behind the collapse. Collapsed classes lose every vote to near-name neighbors, but in the frozen features they survive. Turning down the readout's amplitude, or stopping training early, brings them back, up to +16 points, without retraining; trained with its amplitude held down, the readout never collapses.

</details>

### 50. [Attention Is Only as Good as Its Witnesses: When Higher-Order Layers Help, and When They Do Not](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11937v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11937

**作者：** Mostafa 'Neo' Mohsenvand

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11937v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11937v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将注意力层视为对“见证者”族配分函数的温度读取，推导出可达搜索步数的深度律与候选数相关的规模律，并用传播层、2-simplicial attention 的 Newton softmax、OR-join 与 power-mean 通道在图搜索、SET 和 CLRS-30 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 虽非多模态视觉工作，但其关于层数、候选规模、并行层何时必须循环及高阶注意力的理论，可供核查 LVR 的循环/并行状态更新、深度泛化与计算成本问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attention Is Only as Good as Its Witnesses: When Higher-Order Layers Help, and When They Do Not

**abstract/A1：** Transformers stop learning graph search as graphs grow, and learn the card game SET only after many distinct questions, although attention can represent both. We read these failures, and the uneven record of higher-order attention, from what a layer sums over: each layer we study computes the partition function of a family of witnesses and reads it at a temperature. Two laws follow. The depth law is a known result of logic, which we state for these layers: L layers over two-step walks reach exactly 2^L - 1 steps, just as a logical statement with L nested clauses of the form "there is a vertex such that" sees exactly that far. We build a construction that reaches this far, checked in Lean, and, when vertices carry no names, no such network reaches further. The size law is the cost of reading at a temperature, which logic does not have: existence is read correctly at every size, in the worst case, if and only if inverse temperature times margin is at least the logarithm of the number of candidates. Layers built on these laws, and on two principles that we test, learn where Transformers fail. One propagator layer trained on 49-vertex graphs answers every question at every search depth on 250-vertex graphs. Given the modulus 3, exponential Newton computes the softmax of 2-simplicial attention over pairs exactly in 3^d n operations for d clocks; with six clocks it learns SET from as few deals as 2-simplicial attention and transfers from 8- to 20-card tables. On CLRS-30 without hints, a 186,000-parameter block of OR-join and power-mean channels matches (within half a point) or beats a model of at least 73 million parameters on 9 of 12 graph tasks of the official test set, and on 8 of 12 with freshly drawn test graphs. The same account explains where pair layers did not help and where parallel layers must loop.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 5 figures, 7 supplementary tables. Code (Apache 2.0): https://github.com/NeoVand/witnesses ; demo and tutorial: https://neovand.github.io/witnesses

</details>

### 51. [ChainCheck: Near-Perfect Evidence-Sufficiency Scores Can Conceal Sensitivity to Construction Artifacts -- Paired Conditional Contrasts that Expose an Evaluation Confound](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11965v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11965

**作者：** Hyojung Han、Ryangkyung Kang、Youngeun Kim、Seung-Hun Jeon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11965v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11965v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ChainCheck 对 evidence-sufficiency 基准做评估有效性审计：将验证器认证的反事实单元格与仅含构造伪影的基线成对比较，用交叉控制统计量 CS4 与 HotpotQA、MuSiQue 等数据考察近满分是否只反映对文本编辑的敏感性。

**相关性简评：** 其「成对条件对比＋伪影基线」审计思路可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 的证据充分性判断究竟是使用了视觉证据，还是只捕捉到编辑或捷径信号，需读原文确认该统计量能否迁移到多模态设定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ChainCheck: Near-Perfect Evidence-Sufficiency Scores Can Conceal Sensitivity to Construction Artifacts -- Paired Conditional Contrasts that Expose an Evaluation Confound

**abstract/A1：** Evidence-sufficiency benchmarks ask whether a model can tell a complete passage set from one whose reasoning chain is broken. When broken sets are made by editing text, near-perfect sufficiency scores--and even positive crossed-control scores--need not demonstrate multi-hop reasoning. We present ChainCheck, an evaluation-validity audit that pairs validator-certified counterfactual cells with artifact-only baselines. In an exploratory crossed control on 2,214 HotpotQA pairs, a language-model scorer that never reads the chain reaches a nominal AUC of 0.997, and a one-string match reaches the maximum of the crossed chain-sensitivity statistic CS4 (0.500), while the 11 evaluated systems score from 0.308 to 0.484; the two statistics are different metrics. We therefore read positive CS4 as operational bridge-consistency sensitivity, not as semantic multi-hop reasoning. Every system is also sensitive to one extra edit, and the edits are detectable according to model-based naturalness ratings. On an independent HotpotQA set of 2,276 pairs, patterns pre-specified on MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA did not replicate: 5 of 6 trained readouts were edit-dominated, and the reference judge's selectivity interval \[-0.007, +0.042\] includes zero. Judge scores also depended on batch layout. The MuSiQue and 2Wiki records are public; the HotpotQA records and the fine-tuned checkpoints are not, so external reproduction is partial.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 11 tables, 6 figures

</details>

### 52. [Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12062v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12062

**作者：** Povilas Kvedaras、Tomas Rasymas

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12062v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12062v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何把源模型的 KV cache 翻译成目标模型自身的缓存格式，分别处理 MLA 压缩 latent、线性注意力循环状态和稀疏注意力 indexer keys，使目标模型无需重读完整历史即可续接对话，并在 16–48B 的混合注意力模型对上验证质量与首 token 时延。

**相关性简评：** 其「从 layer-0 MLA latent 解码 token 身份可将长程 needle recall 从 0.09 提升到 0.99」及循环状态的复制与重放结果，可供核查压缩 latent 状态中究竟保留多少内容，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据信息坍缩、缓存与注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响提供诊断线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers

**abstract/A1：** A model that takes over another model's conversation must normally re-read the whole history; a text hand-off shortens the re-read only by dropping content. KV-cache translation instead maps the source's cache into the target's own format, so the target continues from the full context without re-reading it. It works for grouped-query attention (GQA), but open-weights frontier models now cache compressed latents (MLA), sparse-attention indexer keys and fixed-size linear-attention states. We replicate KV-Lingo on a GQA pair and then give, for each of these objects, where to capture and inject it and a mechanism that reaches native quality. We study two hybrid pairs at 16-48B scale in both directions, Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B (MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention) and Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B (Gated DeltaNet hybrids), plus a sparse-attention target (Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). MLA latents translate with token-wise linear maps; recurrent states are copied with a closed-form correction or synthesised by replaying the target's own recurrence. Exact long-range recall needs token identity: decoding token ids from the source's layer-0 MLA latent raises needle recall from 0.09 to 0.99 at 2-32K and to 0.83-1.00 at 64K, eight times the longest training prompt. The hybrid full-MLA direction is within the paired confidence interval of native quality on every task metric, and same-shape GDN hybrids reach the native level in both directions (apart from 6% refusals inherited from the source), with time to first token 18.7 and 46.8 times shorter than a re-read at 64K tokens. Segment-wise multi-turn transfer stays at the re-prefill level; naive re-translation collapses. On the sparse-attention target, predicted indexer keys recall the needle as well as the target's own keys (one seed). We state as a hypothesis how the recipes transfer to 300B+ hybrid flagships.

**comment/C1：** 50 pages, 27 figures, 16 tables

</details>

### 53. [Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12521v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12521

**作者：** Julien Delaunay

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12521v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12521v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建确定性的审计基准，对 Jev 式「System 1」决策模型（单次前向直接输出 schema 上的 typed 概率分布）进行校准、跨问题干扰与事后归因忠实性检验，并与单 token logprob、JSON/CoT 等 System 2 生成式基线对比。

**相关性简评：** 其「provider confidence 只是输出分布的闭式离散度变换、并非经验准确率」的发现，以及 logit-link KernelSHAP 在单次前向模型上的归因方案，可供核查 LVR 中以熵或 margin 充当证据置信度、以及视觉 latent 是否被答案因果使用的诊断线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with &gt;= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE\_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), &gt;= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p\_adj = 0.004).

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and benchmark artifacts available at https://github.com/j2launay/jev-decision-models-xai

</details>

### 54. [Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12728v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12728

**作者：** Brendan P. Murphy、Agustina Saenz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12728v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12728v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在药物续配、急诊诊断和剂量滴定三个多轮临床环境中，比较仅结果奖励与对降低不确定性的提问给予密集过程奖励的强化学习，并分析过早决策、提问坍缩和高风险病例退化。

**相关性简评：** 虽非视觉任务，其关于不确定性驱动提问、停止证据收集、过程信用分配及监督偏差残留的发现，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 奖励设计与视觉证据筛选的训练线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 11 figures. Code: https://github.com/csbrendan/Safe-Reinforcement-Learning-for-Multi-Turn-Clinical-Agents

</details>

### 55. [MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12825v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12825

**作者：** Jihwan Jeong、Guy Tennenholtz、Yinlam Chow、Chih-Wei Hsu、Craig Boutilier

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12825v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12825v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MaxIM 将无界交互历史的增量摘要建模为容量受限的记忆更新问题，以预测未来任务相关目标的变分下界和互信息一致性构造信息论奖励，并用非对称 critic 提供稠密奖励，缓解稀疏延迟奖励下的信用分配。

**相关性简评：** 其以任务可用信息约束记忆、用稠密互信息奖励训练状态更新的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉状态的筛选、信息坍缩诊断及稀疏答案奖励下的贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 56. [Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12869v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12869

**作者：** Julia Herbst、Simon Roschmann、Quentin Bouniot、Zeynep Akata

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12869v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12869v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察单模态视觉与语言模型在哪些层和表示维度上出现对齐，检验新模型下 PRH 的能力—对齐趋势是否依赖 caption 质量，并用单模态与多模态基线重新定位跨模态对齐。

**相关性简评：** 其逐层、逐维度的对齐分析及深度/宽度混淆基线，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度比较是否受层深与表示结构影响；但未涉及推理状态生成或证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis

**abstract/A1：** The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality (Spotlight)

</details>

### 57. [Causal Discovery Bench: Can LLMs Autonomously Conduct Effective Experiments?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09934v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09934

**作者：** Zhuoyang Liu、Ning Peng、Ming Shen、Zijun Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09934v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09934v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Causal-Discovery-Bench，用可验证沙盒与结构化方程模型评测 LLM agent 在资源约束下设计实验、序列探索因果关系并自主停止的能力，并在 13 个模型、3,802 个 episode 上按七类 40 项指标分析行为。

**相关性简评：** 虽非视觉多模态工作，但其对证据获取、实验设计、停止决策与冲突证据消解的分解，可为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 收益—成本评估及因果作用诊断提供问题表述与评价线索，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Causal Discovery Bench: Can LLMs Autonomously Conduct Effective Experiments?

**abstract/A1：** As large language model (LLM) agents get actively adopted for autonomous research, they must not only reason over existing evidence, but also design informative experiments, allocate resources, analyze sequential observations, and decide when to stop and make conclusions. Yet these capabilities remain poorly measured. We introduce Causal-Discovery-Bench (https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench), a verifiable sandbox with configurable structural equation models and resource constraints to evaluate sequential experimental design and causal discovery without domain-semantic cues. Across 3,802 episodes with 13 models from 5 vendors, we analyze agent behavior along 40 metrics in seven families. Agents' performance exhibits a four-level difficulty hierarchy spanning single-experiment design, sequential exploration of causal relationships, resource-aware experimentation balancing cost and statistical power, and autonomous resolution of conflicting evidence. We identify a substantial performance gap between causal inference from correctly curated evidence and navigating causal discovery through autonomous experimentation: Analyzing agents' action trajectories attributes 94.5% of their mistakes to experimental design rather than to inference, which is further consolidated with ablation studies. Relaxing resource constraints alone does not reliably resolve failures in sequential discovery. In contrast, basic statistical tools substantially improve performance across multiple model families, while advanced tools provide little additional benefit when models lack prerequisite lower-level capabilities.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/mshen1019/causal-discovery-bench

</details>

### 58. [Update Slope Is Bounded by Prior Calibration: A Structural Bound and Its Contingent Empirical Signature](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10325v1>)

**作者：** Ben Jenkins、Mihaela Cardei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.AP

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断 LLM 预测器「更新斜率」指标的两处混淆：结果可知的证据构造会把响应度放大约四倍，且斜率存在依赖先验校准的结构上限；因此建议使用结果盲化的证据阶梯、以先验校准为条件，并同时报告 headroom 归一化指标。

**相关性简评：** 该文对「证据增多带来多少更新」的度量批判，可能可供核查于 LOOK/视觉证据注入的收益评估：收益需按先验能力 headroom 归一化并避免结果泄漏地构造证据，但原文不涉及多模态与 latent 状态内容。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Update Slope Is Bounded by Prior Calibration: A Structural Bound and Its Contingent Empirical Signature

**abstract/A1：** Evaluations of LLM forecasters increasingly measure how forecasts improve as richer evidence is supplied. We identify two confounds in this update-slope metric. First, outcome-aware evidence construction substantially inflates measured responsiveness: on the same models and questions, slopes are roughly four times larger than with resolution-blinded evidence ladders. Second, update slope is a change score with a prior-dependent structural ceiling, so raw comparisons can reflect differences in starting calibration rather than updating behavior. The ceiling defines only a feasible region; whether slope and prior calibration are empirically coupled depends on headroom utilization and varies across our Manifold, ForecastBench, and ACLED pools. Despite this variability, conditioning on prior calibration roughly triples the association between intermediate updating and final Brier score under both blinded and outcome-aware construction. Question identity also explains substantially more variance than model identity across the evaluated pools. We recommend building evidence ladders blind to outcomes, conditioning on prior calibration, and reporting headroom-normalized measures alongside raw slopes.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026). 5 pages

</details>

**作者：** Ryan Liu、David Lee、Icey Siyi Ai、Marwa Abdulhai、Rachit Dubey、Thomas L. Griffiths

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10536v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10536v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用四组递进评测考察 LLM 的时间能力：模型能正确作答时间相关定理题，却严重低估自身运行时长、无法判断哪些任务更慢，估计还受措辞影响，且在回答时几乎完全无视等待时间成本。

**相关性简评：** 「多花时间是否值得」与 STOP 决策及计算成本评估直接相关；其时间成本盲区可供核查 VLM 推理中思考预算、停止时机与代价权衡的评测缺口，但该文不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** In Search of Lost Time: Temporal Competence in Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Today's large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with time: AI agents schedule tasks, coordinate with people and other AI systems, and even decide how long to think. Yet LLMs only ever encounter time secondhand---in descriptions rather than experience. Does this hinder their reasoning and decisions that involve time? Our paper traces this question from a model's knowledge to its actions through four successive evaluations. We find that models know the rules of time, which can be read, but struggle to predict durations, which must be lived; while they are highly accurate (92.0-97.5\\%) on a collection of questions built from the theorems of various time-related literatures, they underestimate their own completion times by up to 99.5\\% and fail to identify which tasks will take them longer to run. And while they are better at estimating durations of human tasks, their duration judgments change based on how an event is worded, magnifying similar human biases by up to 1.3$\\times$. Moving from estimation to action, we find that some LLMs disregard time costs completely when answering user queries, ignoring a 1,200-fold increase in wait time entirely. Together, our experiments reveal new challenges posed to LLMs as they navigate a dimension they cannot directly perceive, and highlight how their blind spots can even be simple cognitive abilities that humans take for granted.

</details>

**内容简述：** 构建 SituRecBench：在高保真 3D 购物场景中让前沿 VLM 以用户第一人称视角充当情景化推荐助手，通过多轮对话询问偏好、在环境中定位目标并引导用户前往，统一评测对话质量、推荐效用与导航效果。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments

**abstract/A1：** Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

### 61. [EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10626v1>)

Nageshwar Reddy

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建内镜视频的多轮结构化报告与临床推理评测框架，含1,307段真实视频和20,274轮由临床报告模板生成的问答，并采用逐轮注入金标答案的上下文剪枝协议评测14个开源LMM与3个前沿模型。

**相关性简评：** 长视频多轮设置与逐轮隔离评测可用于核查VLM在长时间跨度上对视觉证据的保留与使用及失败模式，但其为特定临床领域基准，与latent推理机制的联系较间接，可供核查其子任务差距是否反映证据筛选而非领域知识欠缺。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 62. [Layer Roles Matter: Mitigating Modality Imbalance in Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Adaptive Layer Profiling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11907v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11907

**作者：** Pengyu Huang、Peipei Song、Beier Zhu、Zhiyuan Han、Jinpeng Hu、Xun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11907v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11907v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文分析多模态情感推理中的模态不平衡，指出「单模态过度依赖」与「跨模态利用不足」两种失效模式，并发现 MLLM 各层在情感处理中承担稳定单模态表示或整合跨模态信息的不同角色；据此提出免训练的层级感知模态再平衡框架，用 Modality Entropy 与 Cross-modal Intensity 两个量化指标刻画每层角色，再分层施加对应干预。

**相关性简评：** 其层级功能分工与模态贡献度量，与 LVR 关注的视觉细节是否留在内部状态、模态旁路及层间信息流直接相关，可供核查层级 profiling 是否能定位视觉证据被削弱或跳过的位置。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Layer Roles Matter: Mitigating Modality Imbalance in Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Adaptive Layer Profiling

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Emotion Reasoning (MER) requires perceiving and integrating emotion cues from multiple modalities. Recent advances increasingly leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to enhance reasoning capacity. However, due to the inherent heterogeneity in conveying emotions across modalities, these models often suffer from modality imbalance and confront flawed emotion understanding. In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis on MER models and uncover two key empirical insights. (i) In MER, modality imbalance manifests two distinct failure modes: unimodal over-reliance and insufficient cross-modal utilization, which call for different intervention strategies. (ii) MLLM layers exhibit implicit functional hierarchies in multimodal emotion processing, playing separable roles in stabilizing unimodal representations and integrating cross-modal information. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Layer-Aware Modality Rebalancing (LAMR) framework by explicitly aligning intervention strategies with layer roles. Specifically, we first introduce two quantized metrics for adaptive layer role profiling. In each layer, Modality Entropy (ME) measures the dispersion of modality contributions, and Cross-modal Intensity (CMI) captures the strength of cross-modal interactions. Then, we respectively enhance modality equilibrium in stabilization layers and cross-modal propagation in integration layers. Extensive experiments on two comprehensive MER benchmarks demonstrate that LAMR effectively mitigates modality imbalance and improves emotion reasoning across diverse MLLM backbones, without additional training.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12087

**作者：** Hai Zhang、Siqi Liang、Yanjun Guo、Shoufeng Zhang、Yunhao Wang、Hangyu Du、Haoguang Mai、Hongchen Li、Jiazhi Yang、Jialong Zeng、Yu Hu、Chen Chen、Gangcheng Jiang、Zishun Zhuo、Lirui Zhao、Zhigang Li、Yu Qiao、Zhenjie Yang、Fu Zhang、Hongyang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12087v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12087v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该技术报告提出统一语言理解与视频生成的具身导航基础模型 Compass 1，用稀疏视觉关键帧加显式 History Representation Map 保留近两分钟视觉历史，并以任务阶段落地、探索一致性、时空目标检索三类 VQA 监督驱动长时程导航。

**相关性简评：** 其「稀疏关键帧＋显式历史图」的视觉记忆组织与时空目标检索监督，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、长历史缓存与内部状态中证据保留问题直接相关，可供核查其证据选取与长程泛化表现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos

**abstract/A1：** Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

**comment/C1：** Technical Report. Project Page: https://www.archon.tech/research/compass1

</details>

**相关性简评：** 答案—证据—区域三层标注可供核查多模态推理是否真正依赖视觉证据，其「文本重叠提升大于证据分数提升」也提示刷分与证据使用脱节，与视觉证据筛选相关；但领域专用，与 LVR 机制本身联系有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DisasterVL: Evidence-Based Visual Reasoning Dataset and Model for Disaster Scene Understanding

**abstract/A1：** We introduce DisasterVL, a dataset and benchmark for evidence-grounded reasoning about disaster imagery. It contains approximately 1.2 million images from 142 countries, paired with 25 million structured annotations covering scene captions, incident and location assessments, spatial relationships, and visual question answering (VQA). The VQA annotations link answers to visible evidence and include questions about both present and absent cues, multiple answer formats, and difficulty labels. Region-level annotations link caption phrases to bounding boxes and spatial relationships to the regions they connect. The test set contains 38,254 images spanning 75 countries and 28 hazard types. Gemini 3.1 Pro audited the test annotations, and human reviewers validated a stratified subset. On this benchmark, the 9B DisasterVLM model outperforms the evaluated general-purpose baselines on captioning, open-ended VQA, incident reasoning, and region-level grounding. Gains in text overlap are larger than gains in evidence scores. We plan to publicly release the dataset, trained models, and code.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建音频诊断基准 AuDiR（201 题、18 个任务族），通过逐步提供任务规则与声学观测文本、以及移除音频的四类输入条件，尝试区分声学感知、规则知识与规则应用的失败，并给出 Gemini-3.8-flash 的初步评测。

**相关性简评：** 把声学观测改以文本提供时准确率由 31.3% 升至 98.5%，与 LVR 关注的「视觉证据经文本旁路供给」及感知缺失和信息坍缩问题同构，其干预条件与标签可供核查能否迁移到分离视觉 latent 内容的贡献。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions

**abstract/A1：** Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.

</details>

### 66. [EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12524v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12524

**作者：** Jens Parslov、Marco Schouten、Dim P. Papadopoulos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12524v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12524v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 EditJudge-Bench：1,382 对由 Blender 渲染的合成前后图像，覆盖九类源自真实用户请求的编辑，并以已知 3D 场景参数提供精确真值，从而把 VLM 判官当作「指令是否被正确执行」的二值验证器来审计，报告 25 种判官配置下的可靠性差距、空间类编辑难点及提示格式带来的性能波动。

**相关性简评：** 其受控合成与精确真值的判官协议可用于核查 VLM 是否能依据真实视觉证据判断细粒度变化、而非依赖文本或格式捷径，与视觉证据筛选及验证停止决策的评估可能相关；但不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，联系需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations &amp; Datasets Track). 26 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://jenspars.github.io/EditJudge-Bench/

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 EMNIST 手写字母识别上提出 CAML：用试点训练留出的划分构造稀疏加权混淆图，在最终训练中针对八对易混字母施加成对余弦分离约束，并与严格匹配的交叉熵 CNN 基线对比。

**相关性简评：** 这种按混淆对定向施加表示间隔的训练监督，可能可供核查 LVR 中易混视觉实体的细节区分与信息坍缩问题；但研究仅限单字符分类，无推理状态或证据使用，且整体增益不显著。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning for Handwritten Letter Recognition: A Controlled Study on EMNIST Letters

**abstract/A1：** Handwritten character recognition systems can achieve high accuracy while retaining concentrated errors among visually similar classes. Motivated by residual letter confusions in earlier geometry-based recognition work, we investigate whether these errors can be addressed through the training objective. We introduce Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning (CAML), which constructs a sparse weighted confusion graph from a discovery partition held out from pilot training and applies pair-specific cosine-separation constraints during final training. CAML adds no classifier, routing rule, or inference-time parameters. We evaluate CAML on EMNIST Letters against a strictly matched cross-entropy CNN baseline, using the same architecture, final training data, deterministic augmentation, optimizer, and checkpoint selection. Eight confusion pairs are targeted: I/L, G/Q, U/V, R/V, D/O, C/E, I/J, and H/N. On the official clean test set, accuracy changes from 95.6346% to 95.6731%, and macro-F1 from 0.956326 to 0.956724. Mean accuracy across ten predefined corrupted conditions increases from approximately 95.3812% to 95.4303%; symmetric errors within targeted pairs decrease from 614 to 605 (1.47%). The global differences are small and not statistically reliable. CAML fixes 124 baseline errors but introduces 116 new errors on clean data (exact McNemar p=0.6515), and no corruption-specific difference remains significant after Holm correction. Thus, CAML does not establish global superiority, but shows that a leakage-controlled, pair-specific margin objective can alter targeted error structure with limited overall benefit for an already strong classifier.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 DiffusedSplitFed，在 SplitFed 的客户端—服务器切分点插入潜去噪扩散模型来混淆传输的中间表示，并设计三种双条件与全局特征融合变体，在三个医学影像数据集上评估重建攻击抵抗、分割精度与计算开销的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其用潜扩散对中间特征做条件化扰动、同时维持下游分割性能的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 表示的任务必要信息保留与可控信息损失之间的权衡，但论文本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DiffusedSplitFed: Latent Diffusion-based Obfuscation for Reconstruction-Resilient Split Federated Medical Image Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and Split Federated Learning (SplitFed) enable collaborative medical image analysis without sharing raw patient data. However, intermediate features and gradients exchanged during SplitFed training may reveal sensitive information through reconstruction attacks. To address this vulnerability, we propose \\textbf{DiffusedSplitFed}, a SplitFed framework that integrates Latent Denoising Diffusion Models (LDDMs) at client--server split points to obfuscate transmitted representations while preserving segmentation performance. Three architectural variants (V1--V3) are developed using different combinations of dual conditioning and global feature fusion to investigate trade-offs among reconstruction resistance, segmentation accuracy, and computational complexity. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets (HAM10K, Blastocysts, and FHPsAOPMSB), supported by multiple independent runs and paired statistical analyses, demonstrate improved resistance to the evaluated image reconstruction attacks compared with Baseline SplitFed, while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Comparisons with existing diffusion-based segmentation methods further demonstrate competitive segmentation accuracy under the evaluated settings. A conditional convergence analysis is also provided to characterize the effects of LDDM-induced gradient perturbations and local optimization on training. These findings highlight the potential of latent diffusion-based representation obfuscation for reconstruction-resilient collaborative medical image segmentation. The implementation is available at https://github.com/ChamaniS/DiffusedSplitFed.

</details>

**title/T1：** MAPA: Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation for Latent Dataset Distillation in 3D Medical Classification

**abstract/A1：** Dataset distillation (DD) synthesizes a small training set from a large one, but applying it to 3D medical classification is constrained by the memory and optimization costs of synthesizing full volumetric samples. Under a storage-equivalent budget, distilling in the latent space of a frozen autoencoder reduces this cost and fits more synthetic samples (prototypes) than in voxel space. However, class-level matching, such as distribution matching, causes prototypes to concentrate in dense latent regions while underrepresenting sparser intra-class regions, a consistent imbalance that we term prototype concentration. To address this, we propose MAPA (Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation), a latent distillation method that spreads prototypes across intra-class modes while preserving class-level matching. MAPA marks these modes with fixed anchors estimated by clustering the real latents and distributes prototypes over them through a soft assignment, together with a lightweight anti-collapse regularizer and curriculum weighting that stabilize the optimization. Across five 3D medical classification tasks, MAPA improves the aggregate balanced accuracy by +4.2 points over the strongest latent baseline while using the same number of prototypes. An exploratory severity analysis on MosMedData suggests improved worst-stratum recall without loss of normal-case specificity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at WACV 2027. 17 pages including supplementary material

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HippoMamba: A Mamba-augmented network for hippocampal segmentation and serial volumetry in Alzheimers disease

**abstract/A1：** Hippocampal atrophy is among the earliest structural markers of Alzheimer's disease, and reliable hippocampal segmentation across serial MRI visits is a prerequisite for measuring it. We present HippoMamba, a network that combines a 3D convolutional encoder and decoder with a Mamba selective state space block at the bottleneck, designed to process one or more MRI visits of a subject. On the Medical Segmentation Decathlon hippocampus dataset (260 subjects, five-fold cross-validation), HippoMamba obtained a mean Dice similarity coefficient of 0.8861 $\\pm$ 0.0094, the highest among six convolutional and transformer-based methods trained with the same folds and patch size, and its per-subject Dice was significantly higher than that of each method (Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests, $p \\leq 0.013$). Its mean 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (1.45 mm) and average surface distance (0.44 mm) were the lowest of the compared methods, although they did not differ significantly from those of Attention U-Net, and the Hausdorff distance did not differ significantly from that of SegResNet. Without retraining, the five-fold ensemble was applied to 600 T1-weighted sessions from 150 participants of the OASIS-3 cohort. In sessions meeting a registration quality criterion, predicted hippocampal volumes ranked consistently with FreeSurfer volumes (Pearson r = 0.778, 95% CI 0.699 to 0.838; ICC(3,1) = 0.772) but were systematically smaller by about 27%. In a pre-specified analysis of participants followed for at least two years, annualised volume change derived from per-visit segmentation was moderately correlated with that of FreeSurfer (r = 0.503, 95% CI 0.319 to 0.659), with a larger mean rate. These results support the use of HippoMamba for hippocampal segmentation and for ranking hippocampal volume within a cohort, with absolute volumes and rates of change interpreted relative to the reference method.
