### 71. [SceneShifter: Training-free Multi-Scene Temporal Control for Audio-driven Human Animation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09960v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09960

**作者：** Jianzhi Long、Rong-Cheng Tu、Hao Guan、Siyuan Liang、Shunyu Liu、Xiao Luo、Dacheng Tao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09960v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09960v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的 SceneShifter 框架，用于音频驱动人体动画的多场景时间控制：在 diffusion transformer 的自注意力中抑制跨场景背景 token 的交互、保留前景 token 的跨场景注意力，并从最能追踪主体轨迹的注意力层与头上提取动态前景掩码，同时构建评测基准。

**相关性简评：** 其用自注意力层与注意力头定位前景主体、区分前景与背景证据的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中「LOOK」阶段的视觉证据筛选，以及 latent 相似度受注意力结构影响的问题；但该工作本身是视频生成的注意力编辑，不涉及推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SceneShifter: Training-free Multi-Scene Temporal Control for Audio-driven Human Animation

**abstract/A1：** Although audio-driven human animation has achieved impressive realism, it still lacks effective Multi-Scene Temporal Control: orchestrating background transitions at precise timestamps while preserving a coherent foreground subject. We show that this challenge stems from the diffusion transformer's self-attention mechanism, and addressing it requires two capabilities: (1) Semantic-Aware Temporal Decoupling, which isolates background attention across scenes while retaining cross-scene foreground attention for subject consistency; and (2) Foreground Motion Localization, which accurately tracks the foreground subject across latent frames, especially under large motion. To address these challenges, we introduce SceneShifter, a training-free framework for precise multi-scene control in audio-driven human animation. SceneShifter guides spatio-temporal self-attention by suppressing cross-scene attention among background tokens while preserving cross-scene attention among foreground tokens. To support this guidance under large motion, SceneShifter extracts dynamic foreground masks from the self-attention layers and heads that best capture subject trajectories. We further introduce SceneShifterBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate scene-timing accuracy, foreground preservation, and visual quality under large motion, multiple subjects. Experiments show that SceneShifter achieves frame-level scene timing, strong subject preservation, and high visual quality, outperforming existing baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/JamesLong199/SceneShifter.

**comment/C1：** Neurips 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文在四个 LIBERO 套件上同时改变示范数量与训练步数，比较六种 VLA（π0、π0.5、GR00T N1–N1.7）的适配样本效率，并分析冻结 VLM 的影响以及验证损失与闭环成功率是否一致。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结 VLM 以归因预训练因素」和「验证损失低估适配差距」的做法，可供核查视觉表征贡献分配与代理指标能否反映 latent 推理收益；但研究对象是机器人动作适配，与 LVR 主线联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Many Demonstrations Does a VLA Need? On the Sample Efficiency of VLA Finetuning

**abstract/A1：** Pretrained vision language action (VLA) models show strong zero-shot performance, but are rarely deployed directly and are often first post-trained on demonstrations from the target setting. Yet VLAs are typically compared by zero-shot or full-data fine-tuned success, revealing little about the data and compute required for adaptation. We study adaptation efficiency for six VLAs ($π\_{0}$, $π\_{0.5}$, and GR00T N1-N1.7) on four LIBERO suites, varying both demonstrations and training steps. This reveals differences hidden by full-data fine-tuning: models within two points on the full LIBERO-Spatial dataset differ by up to $3\\times$ in success with 50 demonstrations. $π\_{0.5}$ needs $2$--$5\\times$ fewer demonstrations than $π\_{0}$ and is the most sample-efficient model at every budget, with the largest gap on the long-horizon suite. Within GR00T, N1.5 adapts more efficiently than N1.6 and N1.7 on three of four suites, despite their stronger zero-shot performance. We study one pretraining factor behind these differences by freezing the VLM during finetuning: this severely degrades the $π$ models, whose VLM is jointly trained with the action expert during pretraining, but barely affects GR00T models. Finally, validation loss on held-out demonstrations tracks closed-loop success within a suite, but understates how much more sample-efficient $π\_{0.5}$ is than $π\_{0}$.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 10 figures, CoRL Workshop

</details>

### 73. [ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09973v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09973

**作者：** Tianyu Wang、Daiyang Yu、Zhiwei Ren、Junbo Li、Jitian Zhang、Longfei Shangguan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09973v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09973v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 ReelCache，面向多轮长视频生成，用层内低秩分解加视频编码压缩 KV cache，并按层在线预测分解秩，同时用跨 chunk 共享基与树状 cache 管理支持恢复与分叉，报告 14–21 倍存储压缩和 1.25–3.36 倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 视频生成本身不在主线，但其按层能量目标选择压缩秩、跨段共享基与树状状态复用/回溯机制，或可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态缓存的压缩保真、深度与位置差异及分支轨迹复用问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive video diffusion models produce large KV caches during multi-round video generation. Keeping all these KV chunks would consume substantial memory, while rebuilding discarded caches would significantly delay video chunk generation. This paper presents ReelCache, a KV cache compression system for efficient multi-round, long video generation. ReelCache combines an intra-chunk compressor with an inter-chunk cache manager. The compressor applies low-rank decomposition across channels and video coding to the resulting coefficients, predicting the decomposition rank per transformer layer online to meet retained-energy targets. The cache manager shares basis directions across consecutive chunks and organizes chunk states in a tree, allowing generation branches to share historical state while supporting restoration for resume, rewind, and fork. Experiments across five video generation models show that ReelCache reduces KV storage by 14.46-21.13x relative to baselines and accelerates next-chunk generation by 1.25-3.36x, with less than 1% drop in six representative VBench metrics. GitHub: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/ReelCache

**comment/C1：** 18 pages total, 11 pages body plus 5 pages appendix

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09977

**作者：** Woongki Kim、Seungkook Baek、Minhyeok Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09977v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09977v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 VLM 作为「合成消费者」能否复现真实购物行为，并构建 ShelfSight 货架渲染集与因子模型，将商品偏好与位置、字母标签引起的「答案效应」分离。

**相关性简评：** 其因子模型把位置与标签偏差从内容偏好中剥离的做法，可供核查 LVR 中视觉内容证据与位置、缓存、注意力结构等混杂因素对 latent 状态及答案的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Like a Shopper: Validating Vision-Language Models as Synthetic Consumers

**abstract/A1：** Language models are widely used as synthetic respondents in surveys, behavioral experiments, and market research. Most of these respondents read text, whereas shoppers in a store choose by looking at shelves, which makes vision-language models (VLMs) natural synthetic shoppers. We test whether VLM shoppers follow real consumers at two levels. At the purchase level, VLM shoppers built from household records plan their trips from a store directory and select products from shelf images, and we compare their purchases with six public datasets from three countries. The synthetic baskets hit held-out purchases as often as the households' own past trips, and synthetic group differences correlate with real ones twice as strongly as those of a trained regression. Without fitting, VLM shoppers reproduce alcohol purchases by gender and age in Russia and trip sizes by store distance in Taiwan, and respond to situations, prices, and displays within measured ranges. At the level of a single shelf choice, a model's answer confounds the product with its position and letter label. We therefore introduce ShelfSight, shelf renderings that vary products, positions, labels, viewpoints, and prices independently, together with a factor model that separates product preferences from the effects of label and position, which we call answer effects. On ShelfSight, hosted VLMs read the shelf, follow stated needs, keep their product preferences across views, and respond to price as budget shoppers. These answer effects, a preference for the letter A and for positions in the image, are estimated once per image type and removed. VLMs are thus good synthetic shoppers whose corrected shelf choices reflect product preferences.

</details>

### 75. [Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09987v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09987

**作者：** Guray Ozgur、Tahar Chettaoui、Eduarda Caldeira、Naser Damer、Fadi Boutros

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09987v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09987v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SD-ViT 训练框架：每次随机选取一个中间块，经与最终层共享的嵌入头与加权 margin-penalty softmax 损失监督，使各深度均产生可直接与全深度 gallery 比对的判别性人脸嵌入，从而支持预算选定的固定深度早期退出。

**相关性简评：** 共享分类头对齐中间层与最终层嵌入空间的做法，可能为 LVR 中跨深度 latent 状态一致性、早停与计算预算退出提供可核查线索；但原论文研究人脸识别而非推理，迁移性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at WACV2027

</details>

**title/T1：** Retrieval-Grounded Multi-View Reasoning for Clinically Reliable Radiology Report Generation

**abstract/A1：** Chest radiograph report generation is hampered by retrieved reports that resemble the current image but are clinically inconsistent with it, and by diagnostic-label imbalance. We present RG-MVR, a retrieval-grounded framework comprising Retrieval-Augmented Evidence Grounding, which combines dense memory summaries with visually gated sparse retrieved evidence; Adaptive Multi-view Evidential Reasoning, which weights image, memory, and retrieved evidence per case; and a Clinical Prompt Learner, which models finding mention separately from positive, negative, or uncertain status. On MIMIC-CXR, RG-MVR achieved a clinical-label F1 of 0.483 and a BLEU-4 of 0.118 (IU X-ray: 0.202 and 0.110). In an exploratory external cohort of 22 examinations, clinical-label agreement declined markedly (F1, 0.071) and unsupported statements remained common, although physicians found fewer unsupported temporal comparisons (9 vs. 20 cases) and device-related statements (7 vs. 15) than with the baseline. Evidence-aware retrieval and structured diagnostic prompting may reduce specific reporting errors, but broader external validation is required.

**title/T1：** Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network for Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** The segmentation of brain tumors from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential step for computer-aided neuro-oncology, treatment planning and follow-up. While effective encoder-decoder representations are achieved by U-Net and Attention U-Net, the skip sections of the network can generate weak-contrast or noisy responses in the case of heterogeneous boundaries of the tumor. In this paper, we introduce a Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network (QGDL-Net) that can be used for binary tumor segmentation from FLAIR MRI slices. The proposed model is able to predict the slice quality based on contrast and SNR statistics and to fine-tune the encoder features prior to decoding by learnable quality gates. We used the 80:20 train-validation split for experiments with BraTS 2021. QGDL-Net achieved a Dice of 0.9747, IoU of 0.9506, precision of 0.9755, recall of 0.9739, F1 of 0.9747 and accuracy of 0.9982, outperforming U-Net and Attention U-Net. The EigenCAM maps and segmentation overlays provide better tumor localization and interpretable activation around the lesion regions.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10004v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10004v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MATA，在冻结 CLIP 上挂接仅约 3.6M 参数的时间适配器，用可学习时间位置嵌入做相位对齐、用深度可分离卷积建模局部运动转移，以提升少样本细粒度视频动作识别。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MATA: Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter

**abstract/A1：** Few-shot fine-grained video action recognition requires recognizing novel action classes from only a few labeled examples. The difficulty is that visually similar actions often share actors, scenes, poses, and objects, differing only in the order, timing, and short duration of motion changes. We study this problem under three practical constraints: few tunable parameters, low compute cost, and use of the video modality alone. We propose Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter (MATA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. MATA specializes CLIP features along the temporal dimension using two components: temporal phase alignment through learnable temporal positional embeddings, and a local motion transition operator through depth-wise convolution. With only ~3.6M tunable parameters, MATA achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple fine-grained benchmarks while remaining robust to both visual corruptions and temporal disruptions induced by frame dropping. Code is available at https://github.com/prakashchhipa/MATA-Motion-aligned-Temporal-Adapter

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10045

**作者：** Chao Peter Yang、Catherine Zehr、Pranav Bijith、Brandon Fain

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在三个模型族的训练流程上测量谄媚（sycophancy），发现该行为在 SFT 结束时已基本形成，偏好对齐仅在部分情况下小幅加剧；并用机制可解释性定位与谄媚相关的内部表示，统计各训练阶段数据上的激活强度以追溯来源。

**相关性简评：** 其「用探针隔离行为相关表示、再在训练数据上测量激活以做归因」的做法，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中把 latent 推理行为的来源归因到具体轨迹监督数据，属纯文本、非主线工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training

**abstract/A1：** AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence. Although prior work has benchmarked sycophancy in released models and proposed mitigations, its origins during training remain poorly understood. Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and DPO are often blamed, but their effects are rarely compared with earlier training stages. We investigate sycophancy across the training pipelines of three model families and three benchmarks. We find that sycophancy is largely established by the end of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than introduced by preference alignment. Across all nine model benchmark combinations, SFT checkpoints attain at least 92% of preference aligned models' sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models' scores; on average, they are about as sycophantic as final models. Preference alignment increases sycophancy in only four of nine cases, by an average of 4.2 percentage points when it does. To probe the underlying causes, we isolate model representations associated with sycophancy using mechanistic interpretability and measure their activation on training datasets from each stage. SFT datasets show roughly the same average activation as other training data but contribute substantially more examples, and the highest-scoring individual datasets all come from SFT. Our findings suggest that addressing sycophancy requires interventions throughout the training pipeline, particularly in data selection and augmentation for pre-training and SFT.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 REFORM-3D 表示中心评测框架，在冻结的 3D 医学视觉基础模型上考察采集间距扰动下的特征稳定性、跨模态解剖对齐与有限标注下的解剖迁移，并训练 Med3DINO 系列对比各向同性归一化、体素相对采样与间距感知重采样三种几何假设。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定解剖、只扰动 spacing 并度量嵌入漂移」加双向平衡检索探针的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否稳定保留任务必要的视觉与几何信息；但不涉及推理期状态生成，属 3D 医学编码器评测，迁移线索需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** REFORM-3D: A Representation-Centric Evaluation Framework for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Evaluation of 3D medical foundation models is typically dominated by downstream task scores, which entangle representation quality with adaptation choices. This is especially critical in volumetric imaging, where spacing and anisotropy can substantially alter image statistics while the anatomy itself remains unchanged. We therefore introduce \\textbf{REFORM-3D}, a \\textbf{R}epresentation-centric \\textbf{E}valuation \\textbf{F}ramew\\textbf{OR}k for benchmarking frozen 3D medical vision foundation \\textbf{M}odels across three questions: Acquisition Robustness, asking whether features remain stable when spacing varies while anatomy is fixed; Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment, asking whether labeled anatomical structures remain recoverable across modalities under balanced bidirectional retrieval; and Anatomical Transfer, asking whether organ identity remains recoverable from limited labeled support under case-disjoint evaluation. These are also pretraining questions, because what a 3D encoder learns depends on how volumes are geometrically presented during self-supervised pretraining. We further introduce Med3DINO encoder family, pretrained on $62.6$K unlabeled MR, CT, PET, CTA, and CBCT volumes under three explicit geometric assumptions: isotropic normalization, voxel-relative sampling, and spacing-aware resampling. Across Med3DINO and heterogeneous external encoders, REFORM-3D reveals module-specific strengths rather than a single model ordering. Within the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling yields lower embedding drift, whereas spacing-aware resampling favors anatomical transfer; semantic-transfer advantages depend on the dataset and feature type. Project link: \\href{https://endarzboy.github.io/reform3d-website/}{\\highlightLR{REFORM-3D}}.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 FlowEdit 源锚定耦合过强导致「零编辑」的问题，提出免训练框架 V2C-Edit：构造互补的耦合控制速度，用指令级相似度 ILS 逐步挑选更符合编辑指令的速度，并配合自适应空间掩码，在 MagicBrush、PIE-Bench 上以 FLUX 和 SD3 验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「VLM 逐时间步评判并择优选取候选更新、兼顾改变与保持」的机制，可供核查作为 latent 推理中候选状态筛选与维持/停止决策的线索，但论文本身面向图像编辑质量而非视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VLM as an Editing Pilot: VLM-Steered Velocity Control for Flow-Based Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Text-guided image editing requires realizing the requested semantic change while preserving content unrelated to the instruction. FlowEdit provides an efficient inversion-free solution, but its source-anchored coupling can become overly restrictive, causing zero-edit, where the output remains close to the source and the requested change fails to emerge. We find that source coupling directly governs the preservation--editing trade-off, while a fixed coupling schedule cannot adapt to timestep-specific editing needs. Motivated by this observation, we propose V2C-Edit, a training-free VLM-steered velocity control framework. V2C-Edit constructs complementary coupling-controlled velocities and dynamically selects among them using Instruction-Level Similarity (ILS), which evaluates whether the predicted transformation follows the editing instruction. Adaptive spatial masking further preserves regions unrelated to the edit. Experiments on MagicBrush and PIE-Bench with FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 show that V2C-Edit consistently improves instruction alignment over FlowEdit while maintaining competitive structural preservation, and that ILS better reflects editing effectiveness than target-caption CLIP similarity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kuanshen77/V2C-Edit.

</details>

### 82. [META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10089v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10089

**作者：** Mahabubur Rahman Miraj、Hongyu Huang、Nankun Mu、Chao Chen、Shanqin Yi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10089v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10089v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 META-IR 安全对齐框架：内层循环借助 SI-MCTS 做结构化风险分析、自评与反思纠错，外层用元学习在多种越狱任务族上优化内省策略，并配合动态越狱模拟以泛化到未见攻击。

**相关性简评：** 「内层推理循环＋外层元学习策略」的线索可供核查其与 LVR 中循环状态更新、由自评驱动的纠错与停止决策、以及轨迹训练监督的对应关系；但该工作为纯文本安全对齐、无视觉证据，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

### 83. [Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10096v1>)

**作者：** Weizhong Huang、Jinchao Zhang、Xiawu Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10096v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对多智能体同时驻留 KV cache 的内存瓶颈，提出 CoMixKV：用无需校准的在线敏感度估计（基于局部注意力误差界）与共享控制器，在内存预算下联合分配各 agent-层的混合精度位宽。

**相关性简评：** 其「按注意力误差估计敏感度、在字节预算下分配表示精度」的线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据与关键推理状态应以何种精度保留在缓存中；但原文面向文本多智能体的系统效率，未涉及 latent 状态生成或视觉信息使用，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies independently ignores differences in agents' precision needs, potentially degrading collective reasoning. We introduce Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization (CoMixKV), which combines online sensitivity estimation with joint agent-layer bit-width allocation under a shared memory budget. To our knowledge, CoMixKV is the first mixed-precision KV-cache quantization framework to jointly allocate precision across simultaneously resident agent caches under such a budget. The estimator derives sensitivity from a local attention-error bound using recent queries, keys, and values, without calibration data, trial quantization, or additional model passes. A shared controller combines these scores with remaining quantizable capacity and byte-level storage costs to minimize total estimated error. Allocations are refreshed as agents start or finish and new observations become available. Selected widths apply only to newly quantized blocks; recent states retain native precision and previously quantized blocks remain unchanged. Across four benchmarks and three LLM backbones at average 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit settings, CoMixKV achieves strong accuracy against the evaluated quantization baselines. At the average 3-bit setting on Gemma-4-31B-it, it achieves 68.35% average accuracy, exceeding the strongest quantized baseline by 0.59%. On Qwen3-32B, it reduces peak KV-cache memory by 32.08% and achieves a 1.38x inference speedup over FullKV.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 8 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对临床场景中患者检查组合不同、特征空间部分或完全不相交的问题，提出按特征空间分组、优化「最差组超额损失」的组鲁棒学习框架：用组特定编码器把各组输入映射到共享 latent 空间，并以可学习高斯锚点按结局聚类患者，从而在完全不相交的设定下也能跨组迁移知识。

**相关性简评：** 共享 latent 空间加结局锚点聚类，以及用「可达最优」衡量损失差距的思路，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 是否保留任务必要信息、区分无用表示与欠拟合提供可核查的借鉴；但属临床表格与影像数据，与 VLM 推理无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness

**abstract/A1：** In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\\times$ fewer parameters.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report

**abstract/A1：** Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.

### 86. [Improving the Diffusability of Motion Tokenizer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10160v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10160

**作者：** Guanhe Huang、Songqiao Han、Tangzheng Lian、Oya Celiktutan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10160v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10160v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对文本驱动人体动作生成中 VAE tokenizer 的「生成—重建权衡」，将其归因于 latent 空间高频偏置与解码器时间伪影，提出 DiMoT：用预训练扩散模型作 critic 的 CSA 抑制高频 latent 能量，并用基于平均速度预测的 AMD 实现一步生成式解码。

**相关性简评：** 其「tokenizer latent 是否可被下游生成器有效利用」的诊断与 LVR 中 latent 状态能否承载并被使用的信息坍缩问题可能同构，critic 驱动的 latent 频谱整形可供核查作为 latent 表示训练监督的线索；但研究领域为动作生成，非视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving the Diffusability of Motion Tokenizer

**abstract/A1：** Latent diffusion models paired with a variational auto-encoder (VAE) tokenizer have shown promising performance for efficient text-driven human motion generation. However, motion latent diffusion suffers from a generation-reconstruction trade-off: simply increasing tokenizer capacity enhances reconstruction but fails to proportionally improve text-conditioned generation quality. We assume this trade-off stems from a spectral mismatch inside the VAE tokenizer: the encoder yields a latent space biased toward high frequencies, and the decoder introduces temporal artifacts. In this paper, we propose the Diffusable Motion Tokenizer (DiMoT) to improve the diffusability of the tokenizer, rather than scaling up the diffusion backbone. To improve text-conditioned optimization, Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) leverages a pretrained diffusion model as the critic to suppress high-frequency latent energy. To preserve motion dynamics, the Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD) performs generative decoding via average-velocity prediction, enabling efficient one-step decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMoT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various challenging text-to-motion benchmarks, yielding superior motion fidelity and text-motion alignment. Project page: https://githubhgh.github.io/dimot/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 26 pages, including appendix

**title/T1：** AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement

**abstract/A1：** Existing LLM post-training quantization techniques determine precision before inference begins, yet the precision a model requires varies dynamically across prompts, layers, and inference phases. We present AutoEMatic, a full-stack co-design that adapts the precision of weights, activations, and the KV cache at runtime. A lightweight policy selects each layer's precision at every prefill and decode step from two runtime signals: the entropy of the next-token distribution and the magnitude of each layer's update to its hidden states. This runtime adaptation is made practical by AutoFP, a multi-scale floating-point format that derives 2-, 4-, and 6-bit precisions from a single NVFP4 base format. We realize AutoEMatic on two targets: GPU kernels that execute AutoFP on NVFP4 Tensor Cores, and an accelerator whose vector MAC datapath executes all AutoFP formats natively. Across reasoning and agentic benchmarks, AutoEMatic improves accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 and matches group-scaled FP6 accuracy on most benchmarks, using 4.9 bits per weight versus 4.5 for NVFP4. On GB300 GPUs, AutoEMatic retains approximately 90-98% of NVFP4 decode throughput across the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, the AutoEMatic accelerator reduces latency by 1.6-2.3x and energy by 7-23% compared to an accelerator with NVFP4-only datapath at iso-accuracy.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出轻量跨模态特征聚合网络 CXR-CMFA，用于胸部X光二分类：用 EfficientNet-B0 与 DenseNet-121 构成双流视觉编码器分别取全局与局部特征，配 TF-IDF-MLP 报告编码器，并通过报告嵌入门控视觉特征（DMSAM）和学习样本级视觉/文本融合权重（CGFF），在 MIMIC-CXR 上报告高分与消融增益。

**相关性简评：** 其文本条件化的空间注意力门控与样本级模态权重，可能可供核查 LVR 中由文本假设筛选视觉证据、以及判断答案是否依赖视觉旁路/贡献分配的线索；但该文属分类式模态融合，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，迁移需自行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CXR-CMFA: A Cross-Modal Feature Aggregation Network for Chest X-Ray Pathology Classification

**abstract/A1：** Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ATLAS-120k 手术视频语义分割数据集，以及基于域内基础模型嵌入的 ATLAS 模型，通过引入术式与手术阶段的 context query 和跨帧 query 传播提升分割精度与时序一致性。

**相关性简评：** 跨帧 query 传播可视为 latent 状态在时间上携带与更新的一个具体实现，context query 的条件注入方式可供核查 LVR 中任务信息与短期记忆如何进入状态表示；属方法线索而非主线研究。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ATLAS: A Multi-Procedure Benchmark and Context-Aware Model for Surgical Anatomy Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. This work addresses both limitations through a new dataset and model. First, we introduce ATLAS-120k, a clip-level semantic segmentation dataset of 121,018 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos, covering 14 laparoscopic and robot-assisted procedures and 41 classes. Annotations were created with a pipeline that combines manual labeling, tracker-based propagation, and review by surgeons. Second, we propose ATLAS (Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations), a video semantic segmentation model for surgical anatomy recognition. ATLAS builds on in-domain foundation-model embeddings and adds context queries for the procedure and surgical phase, together with query propagation between frames for short-term memory. ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art natural-image and in-domain foundation models in both segmentation accuracy and temporal consistency, achieving a Dice score of 0.70 with ViT-L while running in real time at 76.2 FPS. Ablations show that the context queries improve accuracy and that query propagation improves temporal consistency. ATLAS also generalizes well, matching a dedicated model zero-shot on CholecSeg8k and improving phase recognition on AutoLaparo over SurgeNet initialization. The model weights, dataset annotations, and annotation tool are publicly available at https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS.

</details>

### 90. [BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10188v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10188

**作者：** Zhen Qin、Zhiyao Zhang、Yingbin Liang、Jia Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10188v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10188v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BiMuon，一种几何感知的随机双层优化方法：上层用隐式超梯度估计配合 Muon 式正交化矩阵更新，给出 O(ε⁻⁴) 复杂度，并扩展出分块对角近似与相对步长分配规则。

**相关性简评：** 双层结构（内层优化状态、外层分配权重）可供核查是否适配 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配与步级监督；正交化矩阵更新与「表示几何」线索相关，但原文是通用优化器，与 VLM 推理无直接联系，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach

**abstract/A1：** Stochastic bilevel optimization provides a general framework for many machine learning applications, such as hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, language model alignment, and actor-critic reinforcement learning. However, most existing bilevel optimization methods treat matrix-valued gradients as flattened vectors and perform optimization in the resulting vectorized space, ignoring the matrix structures common in modern neural networks. Moreover, the lower-level (LL) problem curvature can induce significant spectral imbalance in the upper-level (UL) geometry. Such limitations of existing bilevel optimization methods motivate us to develop BiMuon, a geometry-aware stochastic bilevel optimization method that integrates implicit hypergradient estimation in bilevel optimization with Muon-style orthogonalized updates at the UL. To our knowledge, BiMuon is the first stochastic BLO method with Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates and an $O(ε^{-4})$ iteration-complexity guarantee, matching the best-known rates achieved by Muon-type methods based on matrix parameterizations. To improve computational and parallel efficiency for models with multiple matrix parameters, we further study BiMuon for blockwise diagonal matrix approximation and derive a relative stepsize allocation rule based on UL progress and blockwise LL sensitivity. We evaluate BiMuon on representation learning and blockwise bilevel optimization, providing empirical support for our methods.

</details>

### 91. [Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10193v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10193

**作者：** Saul Urso、Emanuele Carlini、Patrizio Dazzi、Matteo Mordacchini

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10193v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10193v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PISA 与 PISA-E：用软聚类成员度加各模型能力预测器估计模型对单个 prompt 的表现，进而在可调的成本—质量偏好下同时选择单模型或集成的组成与规模，且无需集成专用训练。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，但其按请求自适应分配计算并显式权衡成本与质量的选择机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 假设的集成/验证深度选择与动态计算预算分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.

</details>

**作者：** Brendan O Donoghue、Nenad Tomasev、Volodymyr Mnih、Timothy Nguyen、Dalin Guo、Arun Nair、Kenneth Yang、Alexandre Frechette、Jasper Xian、Jean Tarbouriech、Pavel Tyletski、Ingrid von Glehn、Johannes Bausch、Demis Hassabis、Raia Hadsell

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10202v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10202v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用离散去噪扩散 Transformer 配合引导式测试时 beam search，从训练样本直接学习半素数分解，将成功分解位数推进到 68 位，并给出精度随数据量、模型规模和测试时计算变化的经验 scaling law。

**相关性简评：** 「扩散生成候选因子 + 束搜索与精确验证补全」的流程可供核查 LVR 中生成与验证的分工、测试时计算的分配与停止判据，其按问题规模的经验 scaling 也可能类比 latent 长度泛化；但无视觉与多模态成分，迁移需较多推断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws

**abstract/A1：** We demonstrate that transformer architectures trained with discrete denoising diffusion and decoded via guided test-time beam search can learn to recover the prime factors of semiprime integers directly from data. Our approach establishes a new frontier for learning-based semiprime factorization, successfully factoring 68-bit integers-a substantial advance over the prior 56-bit state of the art. While computationally less efficient than classical factoring algorithms, our model requires no domain-specific number-theoretic priors and learns purely from training examples. In practice, the diffusion model acts as a generative prior, identifying promising factor candidates where exact verification or lattice-based post-processing can complete the factorization. Furthermore, we derive empirical scaling laws relating approximation quality to training data volume, model size, and test-time computation. In contrast to language, problem size is the key driver of scaling behavior. Achieving a fixed accuracy on a held-out test set requires compute that scales exponentially with bit length. Consequently, our findings pose no threat to security, as the projected compute cost required to factorize cryptographically relevant integers remains prohibitive.

</details>

### 93. [Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10217v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10217

**作者：** Shuo Zhang、Senwei Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10217v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10217v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对 PDE 神经算子训练中解标注昂贵的问题：采集实验显示用物理信息挑选输入去标注并不优于随机采样，于是提出 PI-Init，先在无标注输入上用物理约束损失预训练，再在标注集上监督微调。

**相关性简评：** 其「放弃数据筛选、改用廉价无监督信号改善初始化以提升标签效率」的训练策略，可能为 LVR 中如何利用无答案视觉输入预训练、以及监督与贡献分配的设计提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking How to Leverage Cheap Physics for Data-Efficient Neural Operators

**abstract/A1：** Neural operators learn mappings from PDE inputs, such as initial conditions and coefficient fields, to the corresponding solutions. Once trained, they can rapidly predict solutions for new inputs. However, obtaining input-solution pairs for supervised training often requires expensive numerical simulations, whereas PDE inputs and governing equations provide inexpensive physical information. This raises a question: how can cheap physical information reduce the need for labeled solutions? A natural approach is to use physics to select inputs for labeling, but our acquisition experiments show no consistent advantage over random sampling. This observation motivates exploring an alternative: using cheap physics to improve neural operator initialization before supervised training. We propose Physics-Informed Initialization (PI-Init), a simple yet effective method that pretrains neural operators on unlabeled inputs using physics-informed losses and retains the learned parameters for supervised fine-tuning on the labeled dataset. A linearized analysis shows that pretraining can improve downstream prediction accuracy by reducing initialization errors that limited labeled data cannot effectively correct. Experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks and neural operator architectures demonstrate improvements in predictive accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and label efficiency. Representative results show error reductions of up to 62.7% at the same label budget and comparable or better accuracy with 90% fewer labels, relative to supervised-only training.

</details>

### 94. [Lower-Level Agnostic Bilevel Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10223v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10223

**作者：** Peiwen Qiu、Prashant Khanduri、Jia Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10223v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10223v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究「下层不可知」的双层优化：上层只能调用近似下层解 ȳ(x)，无法访问下层目标、梯度或生成过程，提出 LeGo-BiO 用坐标式有限差分估计缺失的 Jacobian 列并构造伪超梯度，给出确定性与随机情形的收敛率。

**相关性简评：** 当 latent 推理状态由不透明生成器产生时，可借鉴其「只观测近似响应」并用有限差分估计状态对参数敏感度的思路，供核查其在轨迹训练与贡献分配中的可用性；与视觉推理本身的关联需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lower-Level Agnostic Bilevel Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Bilevel optimization is a fundamental framework for machine learning problems, where an upper-level (UL) objective depends on the solution of a nested lower-level (LL) problem. Existing bilevel algorithms typically assume that the LL objective is available for evaluation, differentiation, or unrolling. However, this assumption can fail when the LL response is produced by a black-box solver, simulator, adversary, or learned predictor. In this paper, we study LL agnostic bilevel optimization, where the UL learner has access only to an approximate LL solution $\\bar{\\mathbf{y}}(\\mathbf{x})$ and cannot query the LL objective, its gradients, Hessian/Jacobian information, or the procedure that generates the LL response. We propose LeGo-BiO, a coordinate-wise pseudo-hypergradient method that estimates the missing Jacobian $\\nabla \_{\\mathbf{x}}\\bar{\\mathbf{y}}(\\mathbf{x})$ using finite differences of $\\bar{\\mathbf{y}}(\\cdot)$. For each UL coordinate, LeGo-BiO constructs a decision vector subject to 1-sparse updates, thereby isolating the corresponding Jacobian column needed in the UL gradient computation. This avoids the directional-projection limitation of full-parameter response differences and, unlike derivative-free/zeroth-order approximations of the entire UL gradient, preserves the available first-order gradient information with respect to the UL variables for more accurate UL gradient evaluation. We establish convergence guarantees for LeGo-BiO in both deterministic and stochastic settings under an LL error-bound/Polyak-Lojasiewicz-type condition, without requiring LL strong convexity. Our bounds yield an $O(T^{-1})$ rate in the deterministic setting and an $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate in the stochastic setting when the LL approximation error decreases geometrically. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance of LeGo-BiO despite being agnostic to the LL objective.

</details>

### 95. [Implicit Bias in State Space Models and Linear Autoregressive Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10237v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10237

**作者：** Gal Katzhendler、Gilad Yehudai、Gal Vardi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10237v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10237v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文以「多个非齐次多项式预测器共享参数」的分类模型为抽象，分析线性 SSM 与线性自回归模型在指数损失上梯度下降的隐式偏置，证明其方向收敛到以「有效阶数」加权的最大间隔问题的 KKT 点，只有最小有效阶数的样本施加硬间隔约束，从而刻画随输入变长或自回归步数增加而产生的长度偏置机制。

**相关性简评：** 共享参数跨步复用与 looped/循环 latent 推理的训练动力学结构相似，其「有效阶数决定谁主导极限分类器」的结论可能为长度泛化与多步 latent 计算的偏置来源提供理论核查线索；但该文为纯分类理论、无视觉或多模态内容，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Implicit Bias in State Space Models and Linear Autoregressive Training

**abstract/A1：** Linear State Space Models (SSMs) and linear autoregressive sequence models reuse the same parameters across a sample-dependent number of steps. As a result, different examples impose constraints through different predictors, even though all predictors share the same weights. We study this phenomenon through a general model of multiple non-homogeneous polynomial predictors with shared parameters, in a classification setting. Under standard interpolation and directional-convergence assumptions, together with a trajectory-dependent effective-degree condition, we show that gradient descent on the exponential loss converges in direction to a KKT point of an effective-degree max-margin problem. In this problem, only examples with minimal effective degree impose hard margin constraints; examples with faster-growing margins are asymptotically inactive except for feasibility. Our result provides a first-order characterization of the implicit bias in linear SSMs and linear autoregressive models. It exposes a mechanism of length bias: a longer input sequence or additional autoregressive steps may increase the example's effective degree, and the examples with the smallest effective degree dominate the limiting classifier. Our result highlights how non-homogeneity and parameter sharing alter classical homogeneous implicit-bias results.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to Neurips 2026. 51 pages, 27 figures

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets

**abstract/A1：** Context selection can reduce input length during long-input inference but can remove evidence required to answer a query. We introduce CoRA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation under shared token budgets. We compare head and tail truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, dense retrieval with reranking, LLMLingua-2, and Provence across BABILong, LOONG Financial Spotlight, a custom NoLiMa diagnostic, and LongMemEval. Evidence-preservation results reveal task-dependent tradeoffs: BM25 achieves 0.921 supporting-fact recall on BABILong at 128K, dense retrieval and dense reranking each achieve 0.908 needle recall on NoLiMa at 64K, and dense retrieval achieves 0.993 answer-bearing-turn recall on LongMemEval at 64K. Evidence, token retention, and complementary reader evaluations use the same selected contexts. Reader evaluations use dataset-native answer metrics and three runs on the same questions, with paired bootstrap confidence intervals. At a 32K budget, BM25 achieves 46.20% BABILong answer accuracy and dense retrieval achieves 71.13% LongMemEval accuracy. The results show that method rankings vary across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10251v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10251v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 TORNADO，将 PDE 下一步预测建模为 VAE 编码器后验之间的潜空间随机传输，用状态依赖扩散的 SDE 使预测不确定性随局部潜动态自适应，并以高斯插值得到的解析端点目标实现免模拟训练，外加能量距离正则改善分布对齐，在少步推理下提升校准。

**相关性简评：** 不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其「潜状态依赖的随机步进 + 解析端点监督 + 少步推理」线索可供核查：LVR 中 latent 状态如何随证据自适应更新、以及在计算受限下如何训练与截断迭代，可能提供方法参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TORNADO: Adaptive Latent Stochastic Transport for Calibrated Probabilistic PDE Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Probabilistic neural surrogates for PDEs enable ensemble forecasting, but often exhibit miscalibration when used for uncertainty quantification, especially in compute-constrained, few-step inference regimes. Existing generative approaches typically rely on fixed global stochasticity, which cannot adapt predictive uncertainty to the local dynamical state. We propose TORNADO, a latent probabilistic forecasting framework that formulates next-step prediction as stochastic transport between VAE encoder posteriors. Unlike existing approaches with globally prescribed stochasticity, TORNADO learns a SDE with state-dependent diffusion, enabling the predictive uncertainty to adapt to the local latent dynamics. The model is trained using analytic conditional endpoint targets derived from a Gaussian interpolant, enabling simulation-free learning. An additional energy distance regularization term improves distributional alignment. Empirically, TORNADO improves uncertainty calibration over representative generative baselines, including stochastic interpolants, diffusion models, and flow matching, while maintaining comparable predictive accuracy. Our results show that adapting stochasticity to the latent state, rather than prescribing it globally, is an effective mechanism for improving calibration in practical neural PDE forecasting settings. Project page: https://tornado-sde.github.io.

**comment/C1：** 49 pages, 35 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出仅用源域的 OAMSC 框架：借助扩散模型将源数据扩展为 20 种风格，并在场景级与物体级施加「原点锚定」的跨风格一致性约束，以抑制风格捷径、提升目标检测的域泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其跨风格一致性与风格不变表征监督，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否被外观风格而非物体语义主导；但该文不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或证据筛选，迁移需较多判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Domain Generalization for Style-Debiased Object Detection via Label-Consistent Training across Multiple Styles

**abstract/A1：** Domain generalization (DG) for object detection aims to improve model performance on unseen target domains. Existing detectors, however, suffer substantial degradation on visually distinct unseen domains, as models confined to limited training styles tend to overfit superficial statistical cues rather than object-level semantics. Motivated by human perception, which attends primarily to semantically relevant features while ignoring irrelevant style cues, we propose Origin-Anchored Multi-Style Consistency (OAMSC), a source-only framework that couples multi-style data synthesis with cross-style consistency learning to suppress style-sensitive shortcut learning. For data preparation, we leverage off-the-shelf diffusion models to expand the source datasets into 20 distinct styles, with all generated images manually verified to ensure that object instances and annotations remain consistent across style variants. During training, we impose Origin-anchored consistency constraints at scene and object levels to reinforce the learning of domain-stable features while suppressing the influence of style-sensitive cues. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on multiple challenging DG benchmarks demonstrate the consistent effectiveness and strong generalization performance of OAMSC across diverse domain shifts. Notably, our approach applies to both one-stage and two-stage detectors, while its data-centric design is complementary in principle to other DG methods. The training code and two style-transfer datasets constructed for the experiments, comprising approximately 180K images in total, are publicly available on GitHub.

</details>

**作者：** Dingying Fan、Mingkai Liu、Haohua Que、Haojia Gao、Xianliang Huang、Qian Zhang、Xueqian Wang、Fei Qiao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10263v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10263v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向相机重定位的场景坐标回归，用残差上下文适配器与多尺度自注意力重新校准冻结编码器特征，并以图像级池化描述符驱动软专家路由，配合双阈值 RANSAC–Levenberg–Marquardt 估计位姿，在 Cambridge Landmarks 与 7-Scenes 上降低误差。

**相关性简评：** 其把路由输入与专家回归输入解耦、用全局上下文缓解局部描述子歧义的做法，或可供核查 latent reasoning 中条件式专家选择与计算分配的输入设计；但任务本身是 3D 重定位，与 VLM 推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DAC-MACE: Context-Conditioned Expert Routing for Compact Scene Coordinate Regression in Camera Relocalization

**abstract/A1：** A camera becomes an absolute pose sensor when its images can be relocalized against a prebuilt map of the scene. On mobile robots and augmented-reality devices, that map must be small and quick to build. Scene coordinate regression (SCR) stores the scene in a compact network that predicts a 3D coordinate for every pixel, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants extend its capacity to larger outdoor scenes. In existing MoE-based SCR, however, the router assigns each pixel to an expert from the same local descriptor that the experts regress from, so repeated facades and windows at different locations receive similar routing inputs. We present DAC-MACE, which conditions soft expert routing on recalibrated and contextualized features. A residual context adapter (RCA) reweights the channels and locations of frozen encoder features, a global context encoder (GCE) mixes them with multi-scale self-attention, and an image-level pooled descriptor is added to the router input. A dual-threshold RANSAC--Levenberg--Marquardt estimator recovers the pose. On Cambridge Landmarks, DAC-MACE attains a mean per-scene median translation error of 13.0 cm over three seeds, the lowest among the RGB-only SCR methods compared (GLACE 13.6 cm, MACE 14.4 cm), and reduces the error on the largest scene from 24 to 19 cm relative to MACE. In a cumulative study, the MoE head, GCE, RCA, and the dual-threshold estimator lower the mean error from 17.0 cm to 14.4, 14.0, 13.6, and 13.0 cm. On 7-Scenes, adding GCE to a single ACE head raises Recall@(5 cm, 5$^\\circ$) from 86.56% to 87.60%.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建放射报告的患者友好摘要对抗评测框架，通过受控术语替换与印象删除，结合 LLM 评判和放射科医生一致性校验，比较六个 LLM 的忠实性与幻觉等失败模式。

**相关性简评：** 其受控编辑与忠实性评分设计可供核查能否迁移到 LVR，用于检验视觉细节、解剖修饰和诊断确定性是否被保留并用于生成；但原文仅处理文本摘要，不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adversarial Evaluation of Large Language Models for Patient-Friendly Radiology Report Summarization

**abstract/A1：** Purpose: To develop and validate a scalable adversarial evaluation framework for assessing the robustness of large language models (LLMs) that generate patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports. Methods: We introduced a clinically grounded adversarial framework that uses controlled term substitutions and impression removals across intensity levels. Using a radiologist-validated adversarial dictionary, we generated adversarial variants of CT and MRI reports. Six LLMs summarized original and adversarial impressions using 2 prompt styles, yielding 18,000 evaluation pairs. Robustness was evaluated with an automated LLM-as-a-judge framework scoring factual faithfulness, sensitivity to adversarial edits, certainty fidelity, and hallucination rate. Failure mode analysis quantified vulnerabilities in incorporating clinical modifiers. Agreement with two radiologists was assessed on 105 cases. Results: GPT-5-mini achieved the highest factual faithfulness and certainty fidelity under both adversarial edits. Under term substitution, hallucinations occurred in 28.1-30.1% of GPT-5-mini summaries, compared with 35.3-36.4% for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 41.4-41.9% for MedGemma. Impression-removal edits were handled more robustly than term substitutions. Even for the highest-scoring summarizer, substitutions of anatomical terms were not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, and descriptor terms (e.g., "substantial") in 21.2%. Judge-radiologist agreement (macro-F1: 0.55-0.56) was comparable to inter-radiologist agreement (0.53). Conclusions: Adversarial evaluation exposes clinically meaningful failure modes, including missed anatomical modifiers, altered diagnostic certainty, and omitted severity descriptors.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPECTRA，一种免训练、权重层面的方法：通过激活感知的低秩更新把基座模型的「拒绝方向」写入领域微调模型，从而在不使用领域安全偏好数据、不做梯度优化的情况下恢复拒绝行为。

**相关性简评：** 其「定位对有害输入最具因果作用的低秩子空间并直接改写权重」的做法，可为 LVR 中免训练地定位与干预承载视觉证据的 latent 子空间提供核查线索，但该文面向纯文本安全对齐，与多模态推理状态的距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Restoring General and Improving Domain-Specific Safety in Fine-Tuned LLMs Without Retraining

**abstract/A1：** Safety-aligned language models are known to suffer degradation in refusal behavior following domain-specific fine-tuning, even when the fine-tuning data is entirely benign. The predominant mitigation strategy, preference optimization on the fine-tuned model, is computationally expensive and requires domain-specific preference data that is often unavailable in practice. We propose SPECTRA, a training-free, weight-level method that restores refusal behavior by transferring the base model's refusal direction into the fine-tuned model's weights via an activation-aware, low-rank update, requiring no gradient-based optimization or domain-specific safety data. The low-rank design restricts the intervention to the subspace most causally active on harmful inputs, leaving benign behavior largely undisturbed by construction. Empirically, SPECTRA substantially improves refusal behavior across a comprehensive safety evaluation, while preserving general coherence, domain-specific knowledge, and producing negligible change in false refusal rates.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conformal Fair Decoding for Large Language Model Recommenders

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) can generate personalized recommendations without task-specific training, but changing a protected attribute while holding interaction history fixed can alter the semantic content of recommended items. We study fairness control when model weights and full-vocabulary logits are unavailable. We propose Fair- Rec, an item-level decoding framework that uses an offline-calibrated semantic-disparity threshold and controls candidate selection as recommendation lists are generated. A hard variant filters candidates against the threshold; a soft variant trades off candidate likelihood and disparity while adapting a penalty using observed violations. Under an explicit uniform enforceability assumption, we establish a pathwise O(1/T) upper bound on the excess empirical violation rate of the soft decoder. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and Amazon Movies &amp; TV using Qwen3-8B and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct show that the soft variant lowers measured counterfactual disparity relative to zero- =shot recommendation, UP5, and FACTER, while retaining competitive HR@10 and NDCG@10.

**内容简述：** 该文提出 CLARITY 临床可接受性标准，用放射科医生标注 MLLM 生成的胸片报告，并据此评测 conformal prediction 策略与自动评价指标能否识别具有临床后果的错误。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Clinical Evaluation of Conformal Prediction for Chest Radiograph Report Generation

**abstract/A1：** While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved automated radiology report generation, they remain prone to hallucinations, necessitating clinically meaningful risk-control methods. Conformal prediction (CP) provides statistical guarantees, yet existing CP approaches rely on uncalibrated automated extractors and fail to account for the clinical relevance of errors. We introduce clinical admissibility criteria (CLARITY), a framework for evaluating radiology reports that explicitly distinguishes clinically consequential errors from minor deviations. To eliminate reliance on automatic judges, we collected radiologist annotations of MLLM-generated reports using CLARITY. By benchmarking CP strategies and automatic evaluation metrics against these expert annotations, we demonstrate that commonly used admissibility proxies systematically fail to detect clinically relevant errors. Our findings reveal that automated admissibility judgments are largely decoupled from true clinical admissibility.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出即插即用验证器框架，从长程智能体轨迹中抽取中间推理产物并用领域验证器打分，聚合为有界的稠密过程奖励，再与稀疏结果奖励分两阶段后训练，以缓解 GRPO 等方法的奖励稀疏问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「解耦过程验证并为中间步骤分配稠密奖励」的思路，可能为 latent 推理多步状态的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供可核查线索；但工作面向纯文本智能体 RL，未涉及视觉证据或 latent 状态，与 LVR 主线的距离需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Plug-and-Play Verifier for Decoupling Process Reward in Stabilizing Long-Horizon Agentic Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Stabilizing long-horizon reasoning requires intelligent agents to sustain useful progress across successive reasoning steps and tool interactions. Such agents are typically trained with reinforcement learning (RL), where actor-critic RL uses a learnable critic network to estimate step advantages, while critic-free methods such as GRPO eliminate critic models and rely mostly on the group variants of sparse outcome-only rewards. Both reward types leave partially useful failed trajectories either implicit or indistinguishable from entirely unproductive ones, and as reasoning horizons grow, it becomes difficult to maintain consistent reasoning trajectories. In this work, we propose a \\textit{plug-and-play verifier} framework for stabilizing long-horizon reasoning through explicit verification of intermediate reasoning artifacts. Specifically, the framework decouples process verification through a unified interface that extracts intermediate reasoning artifacts from agent running trajectories, evaluates them using domain-specific verifiers, and aggregates the verification scores as bounded process reward. Then, we combine our dense verified process rewards and the sparse outcome rewards through a two-stage post-training schedule. We showed that with plug-and-play verifiers, we further stabilize the reasoning steps as last-mile self-reflection and self-consistency. Typical evaluation on HotpotQA using Qwen3.5-4B achieves a superior accuracy (60.18\\%), outperforming the standard GRPO baseline (57.73\\%). Our results suggest that plug-and-play verifiers provide a modular approach to learn more stable and reliable reasoning behaviors over long horizons.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向开放词表多标签识别，重新审视局部预测分支，提出 LoCo：用空间一致的视觉编码器减轻局部特征纠缠，并以 Selective Softmax 只在局部互斥概念间施加竞争、保留兼容响应，配合多尺度推理与全局预测器集成，在四个基准上提升 F1 与 mAP。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部语义稀疏性」假设与按区域只激活少量相关概念的筛选机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与候选假设竞争提供可核查线索，但论文本身不做推理状态生成或答案使用分析，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoCo: Selective Local Competition for Discriminative Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition (OV-MLR) aims to identify all queried semantic concepts present in an image. Existing methods mainly improve global image-text matching or text-side representations, leaving local prediction largely under-explored. In this paper, we revisit local prediction and reveal that it can serve as a strong discriminative branch once two properties are properly handled: spatial consistency of local visual features and compatibility-aware local competition. This perspective is motivated by local semantic sparsity: each image region is related to only a small subset of queried concepts, while compatible concepts of different granularities or types may still coexist locally. We instantiate this perspective with LoCo, a selective Local Competition framework for OV-MLR. LoCo adopts a spatially consistent visual encoder to reduce local feature entanglement, and introduces Selective Softmax to impose competition only among locally incompatible categories while preserving compatible responses. Multi-scale inference further improves local prediction at different scales. LoCo can also be ensembled with an existing global predictor to provide complementary image-level context. Experiments on four multi-label benchmarks show that standalone LoCo improves average F1-score and mAP over TagCLIP by 3.4% and 3.8%, respectively. LoCo + DualPrompt achieves the highest averages among the compared methods, with gains of 4.8% and 5.2% over TagCLIP. Our results suggest that local semantic sparsity offers a useful basis for developing more discriminative open-vocabulary multi-label recognition methods. The code is available at https://github.com/lee-plus-plus/LoCo.

**comment/C1：** The paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026

### 106. [SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10329v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10329

**作者：** Jinwoo Hwang、Sukmin Cho、Tao Zhang、Soheil Abbasloo、Jongse Park、Peng Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10329v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10329v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Siris：通过扰动模拟器构造候选方案、局限描述与模拟器推荐都相同的工作负载对，只有一侧的推荐仍被参考模拟器支持，以此测试 13 个前沿 LLM 能否判断建模局限是否会推翻推荐，并考察复审式自我修正的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「成对扰动 + 推荐是否仍成立」的诊断范式可能可供核查，用于检验 LVR 中 latent 状态能否区分关键与非关键视觉细节，以及自我修正是否会破坏原本正确的选择。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents increasingly drive systems research and rely on simulators to evaluate candidate designs at scale. Simulators are imperfect by design: their modeling limitations can distort predictions yet leave the recommended design correct, or change which design should be selected. We introduce Siris to test whether LLMs can tell these cases apart, judging from their systems understanding when a limitation invalidates the simulator's recommendation. By perturbing a simulator, Siris constructs workload pairs with the same candidates, limitation, and simulator recommendation. The perturbation changes predictions on both workloads, yet a reference simulator supports the recommendation on only one. Evaluating thirteen frontier LLMs on LLM serving design problems, we find that identifying a limitation does not ensure a correct choice, and even the strongest models sometimes abandon valid recommendations. Self-correction through a review turn helps these models restore valid choices but introduces new errors in several others. These findings motivate evaluating systems understanding through design decisions under imperfect simulators.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, including references and appendices

</details>

**作者：** Thomas James Wood、Oktay Karakuş、Can Eyüpoğlu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文基于LITHOS双流ViT的岩石薄片分类，分析25类矿物的错误结构、PPL/XPL模态替换敏感性与五种XAI归因图，并用超像素删除检验归因。

**相关性简评：** 其模态消融与归因删除协议可供核查VLM推理是否真正使用视觉证据、是否存在视觉旁路，但研究对象是岩相分类而非latent推理，迁移需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evaluating classification and explainability in multimodal petrographic image analysis

**abstract/A1：** Automated thin-section classifiers increasingly combine plane-polarised and cross-polarised light (PPL and XPL), two complementary views central to petrographic identification. Classification accuracy alone does not reveal whether model errors reflect mineralogical relationships, how predictions depend on each optical view, or whether attribution maps identify regions that influence model decisions. Here, we examine these complementary aspects of the released LITHOS dual-stream vision transformer using outputs from an earlier evaluation of 105,802 expert-annotated grains across 25 categories. Classification errors frequently followed the label taxonomy: 72.6\\% of misclassified plagioclase, microcline and sanidine grains were assigned the generic Feldspar label, while 87.1\\% of quartz-family grains received a label within that family, compared with 66.6\\% assigned their exact label. Replacing the XPL input with its per-channel spatial means produced a greater reduction in true-class probability than equivalent PPL replacement in 20 of 25 categories, but not in the three quartz categories. Five explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) attribution procedures generated visually distinct maps for identical inputs. In a superpixel-deletion analysis involving 30 grains from 29 thin sections, method-minus-random contrasts ranged from $-0.043$ to $0.057$, with all 41 simultaneous 95\\% confidence intervals including zero. Together, these findings show that error structure, modality sensitivity and attribution behaviour capture distinct aspects of model performance that cannot be established from classification accuracy or visual inspection of attribution maps alone.

</details>

### 108. [Two-Sided Conformal Evidence Sets for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10335v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10335

**作者：** Ben Jenkins、Mihaela Cardei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10335v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10335v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Conformal Evidence Sets，让 RAG 同时返回支持集与反驳集，并在可交换性下给出每侧至少 1−α 的有限样本覆盖保证；在 VitaminC、FEVER 等候选池上检验覆盖—规模前沿、分布偏移、打分器替换与端到端试点。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据覆盖可校准、判定可靠性另计」的分离结论与 conformal 证据集构造，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和「何时停止取证作答」提供可核查的校准工具，但纯文本 RAG 设定与视觉 latent 状态仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two-Sided Conformal Evidence Sets for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

**abstract/A1：** Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can surface passages that support a claim, contradict it, or fail to address it, yet existing calibrated grounding methods are typically one-sided and model only supporting evidence. We introduce Conformal Evidence Sets (CES), a two-sided framework that returns separate support and refutation sets with finite-sample inclusion coverage of at least $1-α$ on each side under exchangeability; a Bonferroni union yields joint coverage of at least $1-2α$. On labeled candidate pools from the contrastive VitaminC benchmark, CES closely tracks nominal coverage across $α\\!\\in\\!\\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30\\}$, with maximum deviations of $3.0$ percentage points for support and $5.4$ for refutation, and reaches essentially the same empirical coverage--size frontier as a test-tuned fixed-threshold heuristic without any test exposure. Stress tests mark the boundary of that guarantee: under FEVER distribution shift both sides under-cover, by up to $12.7$ percentage points, and support-side group-stratified recalibration substantially reduces the support gap. Scorer swaps, hard-negative retrieval, cross-dataset transfer, and a live end-to-end pilot expose a clear separation: when exchangeability holds and relevant evidence is retrieved, evidence inclusion remains calibrated even with an imperfect scorer, whereas the support/refute verdict tracks scorer quality directly. Calibrated evidence coverage and reliable verdicts are therefore distinct properties and should be reported separately.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026). 8 pages

### 109. [Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10348v1>)

**作者：** Muntaqim Ahmed Raju、Priyanka Siddappa、Md Shifat Haider Al Amin、Ruizhe Ma、Md Ripon Ahammed

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10348v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10348v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种面向医学图文分类的多模态融合框架，结合逐 token 引导、双向交叉注意力和样本自适应门控，并在胸片与放射报告配对数据上验证各模块的互补作用。

**相关性简评：** 其「先筛选 token 相关性、再双向交互、最后按样本门控两路表示」的流程，可供核查如何筛选视觉证据并动态平衡视觉与 latent 推理信息；但论文本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.

**comment/C1：** IEEE BIBM 2026

</details>

**作者：** Hajeong Lee、Jong-Il Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移
