摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对透明界面重建中同一透明度同时控制颜色与几何、导致几何学习被削弱的问题，提出共享平面 Gaussian 表示、双不透明度合成与基于多源证据的基元保留机制。

**相关性简评：** 其「双证据生命周期」按多视图几何或 RGB 重建证据决定基元去留，可能为 latent 视觉状态的证据式保留、剪枝与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但领域相距较远、联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ClearForm: Shared-Surface Gaussian Splatting for Transparent and Opaque Scenes

**abstract/A1：** Transparent-interface reconstruction must recover glass surfaces even when most observed color comes from the scene behind them. We present ClearForm, a shared-planar-Gaussian method for jointly reconstructing transparent interfaces and the appearance seen through them. We identify and analyze the Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma (GACD): when the same transparency-dependent alpha controls both color and geometry, revealing the background can weaken a transparent surface's contribution to geometric reconstruction. We derive its effect on plane-based depth estimation, identify a mechanism that can weaken geometric learning, and quantify the loss of interface support through controlled comparisons. To address this conflict, we develop geometry-preserving dual-opacity surface reconstruction. Shared planar Gaussians retain interface contributions in geometry compositing while modeling transmission and sparse reflection in RGB, supported by transparency-aware geometric constraints. To manage the different primitive-visibility requirements of these compositors, we introduce Dual-Evidence Lifecycle (DEL), which retains Gaussians supported by multi-view geometry or RGB reconstruction evidence. On 3D-FRONT-T, ClearForm achieves 27.05 mm Chamfer distance (CD) and 0.928 F1, compared with 59.18 mm CD for our PGSR reproduction and the reported 34 mm CD and 0.836 F1 for GLINT. On TransLab, it achieves 1.65 mm CD, 0.963 F1, and 40.14 dB PSNR. In matched ablations, dual-opacity compositing reduces CD from 59.25 to 27.09 mm, while DEL improves PSNR by 2.06 dB. Our project page is available at https://hajeongx.github.io/clearform/.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 9 figures

### 111. [PhysDNet: Physics-Driven Gradient Amplification for Real-Time Image Dehazing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10376v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10376

**作者：** Rayen Dhahri、Lei Sun、Victor Javier Kartsch Morinigo、Alice Pagnoux、Luca Benini、Danda Pani Paudel、Luc Van Gool

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10376v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10376v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出轻量多模态去雾网络 PhysDNet，融合 NIR 图像与稀疏 LiDAR 深度，以物理约束双头目标训练；对固定 Koschmieder 逆变换求导得到随雾密度自适应的梯度放大，在不增加推理开销下把学习集中到重退化区域。

**相关性简评：** “可微物理逆变换→随退化程度自适应的梯度加权”是一种训练期资源／监督分配机制，或可供核查如何按证据可靠性重加权 latent 状态的训练信号；但论文本身无推理期状态生成，与 LVR 主线联系间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhysDNet: Physics-Driven Gradient Amplification for Real-Time Image Dehazing

**abstract/A1：** Modern dehazing networks are often computationally expensive and overfit to synthetic haze, limiting real-time deployment. This underscores an urgent demand for efficient, high-fidelity restoration methods that can operate on resource-constrained edge devices in practical, dynamic environments. We introduce PhysDNet, a lightweight multimodal architecture that fuses NIR imagery with sparse LiDAR depth and is trained with a physics-constrained dual-head objective. Differentiating through a fixed Koschmieder inversion induces density-adaptive gradient amplification, acting as an implicit resource allocation mechanism that concentrates learning on heavily degraded regions without increasing inference cost. PhysDNet delivers superior restoration with minimal capacity and enhanced training efficiency, facilitating real-time deployment on edge devices without increasing inference overhead. On the Seeing Through Fog benchmark, PhysDNet outperforms competitors by 1.67 dB at 5.2 times lower compute while recovering 54.9% of fog-induced detection loss. Ablations and cross-domain evaluations show that physics-guided training improves generalization, including under non-homogeneous haze that violates the Koschmieder assumption. PhysDNet further demonstrates compatibility with fixed-function NPUs, running at 29/45/99 FPS at &lt;4 W across L/M/S variants. Code, deployment scripts and pre-trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Heatdh/PhysDnet.

### 112. [From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10382v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文研究 LLM agent 长程交互中的经验记忆筛选，提出 Anchor：定位关键轨迹步骤并抽取候选记忆，在相同上下文下分别带与不带候选重放源决策，据分布偏移幅度与源动作角色一致性决定是否保留，在 ALFWorld、WebShop 上以冻结策略验证收益与 token 成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

### 113. [From Task Affinities to Optimal Allocations: Probabilistic Graphical Modelling for Supervised Finetuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10389v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10389

**作者：** Prateek Chanda、Saral Sureka、Krishnateja Killamsetty、Ganesh Ramakrishnan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10389v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10389v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TASKMIXPGM，把 SFT 任务视为 Markov random field 节点，用一元势表示任务效用、成对势以单任务微调模型预测分布间的行为散度刻画任务关系，在固定预算下学习连续任务混合，并证明其诱导的集合函数弱次模性以支撑离散选择的近似保证，实验给出可跨模型族复用的混合方案。

**相关性简评：** 其以「预测分布间的行为散度」构造任务互补与冗余的成对势，可能可供核查用于衡量 LVR 轨迹或子任务监督之间的相似与冗余，进而指导推理期状态生成相关训练的任务配比；但论文本身不涉及视觉推理或 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Task Affinities to Optimal Allocations: Probabilistic Graphical Modelling for Supervised Finetuning

**abstract/A1：** Supervised fine-tuning over a large pool of heterogeneous tasks is often computationally expensive, leading practitioners to train language models on a fixed training budget of carefully chosen SFT tasks. Thus, achieving strong downstream performance hinges on selecting an effective subset of tasks, or equivalently, identifying an optimal task mixture under a fixed budget constraint. In practice, supervised finetuning mixtures are often determined using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant task sources. We introduce TASKMIXPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures through energy-based modelling over SFT tasks. Each task forms a node in a Markov random field, with unary potentials capturing task utility and pairwise potentials modelling inter-task relationships via behavioral divergences between predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models. Optimizing this objective yields task mixtures that balance utility, coverage, and redundancy. We further show that the induced set function defined over the set of such tasks is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete task selection. Empirically, we provide a fixed, benchmark-independent mixture that improves over heuristic mixing across multiple model families and different training budgets. TASKMIXPGM also uncovers interpretable structure in task interactions, revealing complementarities and redundancies that inform effective SFT mixtures.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 114. [Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10392v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10392

**作者：** Fengyi Wu、Yifei Dong、Yetong Sha、Lingdong Kong、Qiyu Hu、Bohan Xiong、Qi Dai、Alexander G. Hauptmann、Zhi-Qi Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10392v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10392v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出统一的语言条件世界模型任务 LCWM 及跨导航、机器人、3D 游戏与驾驶的基准 LCWM-Bench，并给出 Tiresias：由语言条件 diffusion policy 生成候选轨迹、轨迹排序器筛选，再用视频预训练世界模型想象其视觉后果并由视觉排序器打分选出最终计划。

**相关性简评：** 「先多候选、再以想象出的视觉后果验证并排序」的做法，与 LVR 中多 latent 假设生成及视觉证据筛选、想象计算如何分配的问题结构相近，可供核查其排序器与视觉验证的分工能否迁移到 latent 状态选择。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models

**abstract/A1：** World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, including appendix and references. Code: https://github.com/UWMILab/Tiresias

</details>

### 115. [Tail-risk-aware Agent Safety: Constraining Tail Risks Across Multi-step LLM Agent Workflows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10411v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10411

**作者：** Shilong Pan、Zhiliang Tian、Zihan Chen、Wentao Zou、Weiguo Chen、DongSheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10411v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10411v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TAS 框架，将 LLM agent 多步工作流的安全状态转移建模为 MDP，度量并利用共享预算约束跨步骤的尾部风险，从而得到逐步安全策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「依赖状态序列转移 + 共享预算 + 逐步策略」的建模方式，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的步骤级决策与预算分配提供可核查的方法线索，但原文针对安全风险而非视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tail-risk-aware Agent Safety: Constraining Tail Risks Across Multi-step LLM Agent Workflows

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based agents extend LLMs with tool calls, memory, planning, and retrieval to act in external environments, but they are vulnerable to attacks at different workflow steps. Existing defenses, including prompt engineering and post-training alignment, primarily improve LLM-only safety and often overlook risks that arise from multi-step execution. External verification adds guardrails to check each step separately, but it typically ignores how risks can propagate across steps. We argue that we should consider risk transitions across dependent steps through the agent workflow, rather than separate verification on a single step. In this paper, we propose \\textbf{T}ail-risk-aware \\textbf{A}gent \\textbf{S}afety (TAS), a tail-risk-aware safety framework that models agent workflow safety as a sequence of dependent safety states and constrains the rare but extreme risks (i.e., tail risk) with a shared budget. TAS first models safety-state transitions sequentially along the workflow as an MDP to trace risk propagation, then measures a tail-sensitive risk to target rare but high-cost risks (i.e., tail risk), and constrains the risk with a shared budget to derive a step-wise safety strategy. By constraining tail risk rather than the overall average, TAS suppresses rare high-cost failures while preserving utility in normal cases. Experiments show that TAS achieves better performance compared with eleven baselines across three benchmarks.

</details>

### 116. [TurnFlow: Benchmarking User-State Reasoning in Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Scene-Guided User Simulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10412v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10412

**作者：** Zhixun Chen、Ming Li、Anjie Liu、Xiaoyuan Zhang、Quanyu Dai、Huangxun Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10412v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10412v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TurnFlow 是面向多轮 LLM 助手的交互式基准，用场景引导的自适应用户模拟配合可验证判分，检验模型能否在对话中保持、修订并真正执行不断变化的用户需求；9 个模型在 490 个场景上的通过率为 42.86%–59.59%，并在 Scope Creep、Goal Shift 上明显更差。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本任务、无视觉 latent，但它把「察觉到约束」与「在最终回答中执行约束」分开检验，并隐藏关键需求由模拟用户展开，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真被答案使用、以及视觉旁路/未执行问题的评测设计借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TurnFlow: Benchmarking User-State Reasoning in Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Scene-Guided User Simulation

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed through conversational interfaces, yet strong single-turn performance does not imply reliability in multi-turn settings. Multi-turn assistance requires a model to maintain an evolving representation of user requirements and to reason over it before complying with later requests. Failures can therefore be subtle: models may fail to recognize a changed constraint or hidden conflict, or recognize it without enforcing it in the final response. Existing benchmarks primarily test fully specified prompts, long-context recall, or controlled domain environments, leaving open-domain requirement reconciliation undermeasured. We introduce TurnFlow, an interactive benchmark for evaluating whether models preserve, revise, and act on user requirements across turns. TurnFlow combines adaptive user simulation with verifiable judging, allowing conversations to unfold naturally while keeping hidden requirements and pass/fail criteria controlled. In our evaluation, nine LLMs achieve overall pass rates from 42.86% to 59.59% on 490 scenarios. Performance varies substantially across challenge types: models perform well on Stateful Multi-Constraint Following but remain considerably less reliable on Scope Creep and Goal Shift. These results reveal persistent limitations in reasoning over evolving user requirements across turns.

**comment/C1：** EMNLP 2026 Findings

</details>

### 117. [D-REAL: Acceptance-Length Optimization with Unbiased Gradients for Speculative Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10432v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10432

**作者：** Meng Wei、Yefei Chen、Antong Li、Yanan Gao、Xingliang Shi、Xin Gao、Zhiling Ye、Yun Yue、Chunxiao Guo、Peng Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10432v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10432v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 D-REAL，一种投机解码 draft 模型的后训练方法：直接优化固定解码上下文下的期望接受长度，按草稿前缀存活概率对各位置的 draft-target 分布重叠加权，并为随机验证下的单轮目标推导无偏梯度估计器，在 Qwen3-8B 等设定上提升平均接受长度与端到端吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但「以前缀存活概率为各位置分配训练信号、对序列级目标构造无偏梯度估计」的思路，可能为 latent 多步推理中早期状态对后续验证的贡献分配与监督提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** D-REAL: Acceptance-Length Optimization with Unbiased Gradients for Speculative Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding efficiency depends on the number of consecutively accepted draft tokens, yet token-level training objectives do not directly optimize this quantity. We introduce D-REAL (Drafter Reinforcement of Expected Acceptance Length), a post-training method that directly optimizes expected acceptance length for a fixed decoding context. D-REAL weights position-wise draft-target distributional overlap by prefix survival probabilities along a draft-sampled prefix, faithfully capturing the sequential dependence of verification on earlier proposals. By accounting for the parameter dependence of the proposal distribution, we derive an unbiased gradient estimator for this single-round objective under stochastic verification. We evaluate D-REAL on DSpark and DFlash2 with Qwen3-8B as the target model across ten benchmarks. Starting from baselines whose mean acceptance length has plateaued, one epoch of D-REAL post-training consistently improves the benchmark-averaged mean acceptance length by up to 0.23 tokens across both architectures under greedy (T = 0.0) and stochastic (T = 1.0) sampling, translating into up to a 9.4% end-to-end serving throughput improvement.

</details>

### 118. [ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10448v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10448

**作者：** Enhuai Liu、Yunke Wang、Yutong Wang、Changming Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10448v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10448v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ESTRA，一种免训练的视频扩散加速方法：将精确注意力集中在少量重要 key-value 上，用查询分组代表对 key 打分、再用聚类代表近似其余贡献，并加入基于方差的权重修正，在 5% 甚至 1% 密度下保持接近稠密生成的保真度。

**相关性简评：** 该文对长序列注意力做重要性筛选与近似修正的做法，可能为 LVR 中长上下文注意力稀疏化、KV 缓存筛选以及注意力结构对 latent 相似度影响的核查提供线索，但属视频生成加速，需核查其近似误差是否影响推理状态内容。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration

**abstract/A1：** Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but attention over long spatiotemporal sequences makes inference computationally expensive. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of query-key interactions exactly, and recent training-free methods further approximate the remaining interactions. These methods, however, degrade quickly at high sparsity, which limits the achievable speedup. We present ESTRA (Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention), a training-free acceleration method that preserves generation quality even at extreme sparsity. ESTRA concentrates exact attention computation on a small set of important key-value tokens and approximates the remaining contributions with cluster representatives. To identify these tokens efficiently, it groups similar queries and uses their representatives to score individual keys. A variance-based correction further refines the attention weights of the cluster representatives, improving the accuracy of the approximation. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B show that ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention, achieving $3.26\\times$ and $4.71\\times$ end-to-end speedups at 5% attention density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in fidelity to dense generation and on most VBench dimensions. Even at 1% density, ESTRA remains more faithful to dense generation than Sol-Attn at 12.5%, while reaching up to $5.39\\times$ speedup.

</details>

### 119. [BunshinRL: Splitting Live Agent Workspaces for Memory-Efficient Agentic RL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10453v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10453

**作者：** Yutong Huang、Vikranth Srivatsa、Alex Asch、Yiying Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.OS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10453v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10453v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BunshinRL 这一 agentic RL rollout 系统，通过跨环境内存共享、工具前缀缓存与投机式工具执行，并基于 BunshinFork 的容器级活工作区 fork 降低并发 rollout 的内存占用与延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其投机工具执行配合状态快照与错误回滚，可能为 LVR 中「先推测再核验」的 LOOK/STOP 决策与状态回退提供系统层线索，可供核查；但论文关注的是 rollout 基础设施开销，未涉及视觉证据或 latent 表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BunshinRL: Splitting Live Agent Workspaces for Memory-Efficient Agentic RL

**abstract/A1：** Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) rollouts interleave model reasoning with tool calls in persistent workspaces. Scaling these rollouts incurs substantial memory costs for concurrent environments, while slow tool calls delay entire rollout batches. We present BunshinRL, an agentic RL rollout system that exploits shared environment state and recurring tool calls through three techniques: memory sharing across environments, tool-prefix caching, and speculative tool execution. These techniques build on BunshinFork, a novel live whole-workspace forking mechanism for containers. BunshinFork reconstructs process trees, shares memory copy-on-write, and preserves file, communication, and GUI state, enabling cached-state reuse and rollback after incorrect speculation. We implement BunshinRL and BunshinFork through Linux kernel module and CRIU modifications. BunshinRL reduces peak memory by up to 43%, total memory consumption by up to 51%, and end-to-end rollout latency by 23%.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10455

**作者：** Khanh Nguyen、Antonio Emanuele Cinà、Andrey Barsky、Alejandra Reinares、Fabio Roli、Dimosthenis Karatzas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10455v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10455v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向大规模 VLM 的成员推断攻击，用 LoRA 子空间上的贝叶斯低秩后验（SWAG）从单次训练中采样「虚拟参考模型」，替代昂贵的 shadow 模型集成来估计目标条件分数分布，并在 Document VQA 与 Medical VQA 等适配后 VLM 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「单次训练即在低秩子空间内采样多组参数近似分布」的做法，可能可供核查能否廉价生成多假设以支持 LVR 中的答案验证、贡献分配或不确定性估计；但论文本身研究隐私攻击，未涉及推理状态，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bayesian Low-Rank Posteriors for Scalable Membership Inference

**abstract/A1：** Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a sample was used during the training of a target model. Strong MIAs rely on reference (or shadow) models to estimate target-conditional score distributions, but training such ensembles is computationally expensive for modern large-scale Vision--Language Models (VLMs). In this work, we propose a scalable alternative that replaces explicit reference-model training with a Bayesian approximation over low-rank adaptation parameters. Specifically, we model uncertainty only within the LoRA subspace and construct a posterior from a single training run, from which we sample a diverse set of \\emph{virtual reference models}. We instantiate this approach using Stochastic Weight Averaging Gaussian (SWAG), enabling efficient approximation of target-conditional score distributions at a fraction of the cost of conventional shadow-model ensembles. We evaluate the resulting attack on three downstream-adapted VLMs across two privacy-sensitive visual question answering tasks, namely Document VQA and Medical VQA. To isolate the effect of pretraining knowledge, we additionally introduce a controlled synthetic dataset. Our approach outperforms standard reference-based attacks while requiring only a single reference-model fine-tuning run, making membership inference more practical for large VLMs.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 121. [Decoupling Direction and Magnitude: Language-Steered Flow Matching for Super-Resolution in the Dark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10485v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10485

**作者：** Jiaxin Gao、Ziyu Yue、Yaohua Liu、Danchen Cui、Zhihui Zhao、Zhixun Su

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10485v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10485v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一步式 flow matching 图像暗光超分框架 DeLang-SR，把退化相关的物理统计量转成「退化语言」引导速度场方向，并用连续空间更新强度场充当位置可变的 Euler 步长以控制更新幅度。

**相关性简评：** 论文不研究 VLM 推理，但其「方向与幅度解耦」加逐位置自适应步长的机制，可供核查是否能迁移为 latent 状态更新中按视觉证据质量分配计算与更新强度的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decoupling Direction and Magnitude: Language-Steered Flow Matching for Super-Resolution in the Dark

**abstract/A1：** Image super-resolution in the dark is fundamentally challenged by extreme spatial heterogeneity: severely underexposed and noisy regions demand aggressive generative enhancement to reconstruct missing details, while relatively well-exposed areas require conservative updates to prevent hallucinated textures. Standard diffusion and flow-matching models, however, rely on globally uniform integration trajectories, making them sub-optimal for such spatially varying degradations. In this paper, we propose DeLang-SR (Degradation-Language steered Super-Resolution), a one-step flow-matching framework that explicitly decouples the restoration direction and magnitude. Rather than treating low-light corruption as arbitrary latent features, DeLang-SR translates measurable physical statistics into structured degradation language, harnessing the semantic prior of pretrained text-to-image models. The degradation-language intent, complemented by image-specific visual tokens, steers the velocity field (direction) toward restoration-relevant manifolds. Simultaneously, a continuous spatial update-strength field acts as a locally varying Euler step-size field (magnitude), applying stronger integration steps in heavily degraded shadows while enforcing conservative updates in reliable regions. Experiments on paired and real dark images, together with ablations and diagnostic analyses, show that DeLang-SR provides an effective and interpretable one-step route to super-resolution in the dark. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/moriyaya/DeLang-SR.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 32 pages, 12 figures, and 13 tables. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/moriyaya/DeLang-SR

</details>

### 122. [Disentangling Channel Semantics in Vision Transformers via Token Decorrelation and Composition-Aware Modulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10497v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10497

**作者：** Daeun Kim、Hyesong Choi、Hyejin Park、Dongbo Min

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10497v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10497v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断多通道ViT中上下文token在高通道冗余下坍缩至少数主导通道的问题，提出token级去相关的FTL与以CLS为语义锚的样本级调制CAM，并在三个基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其冗余诊断与token去相关机制可能可供核查VLM视觉token或潜状态中的信息坍缩和主导通道偏置，但并非推理期latent生成，需核查迁移适用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Disentangling Channel Semantics in Vision Transformers via Token Decorrelation and Composition-Aware Modulation

**abstract/A1：** Multi-channel images encode heterogeneous channel semantics aligned over a shared spatial structure, which requires models to jointly capture globally shared structure and channel-specific variations. Recent multi-channel Vision Transformers attempt to address this challenge by augmenting the \[CLS\] token with memory tokens to organize multi-channel representations under varying channel compositions. However, we find that these context tokens collapse onto a few dominant channels under high inter-channel redundancy, producing redundant representations and a biased global summary that fails to reliably support composition-aware channel interpretation. We propose MuCa-ViT (Multi-Channel Composition-Aware Vision Transformer), a unified framework that addresses these limitations through two coupled mechanisms. Factorial Token Learning (FTL) enforces token-level decorrelation among context tokens, encouraging the \[CLS\] token to capture globally shared semantics while memory tokens preserve complementary channel-specific cues. Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM) uses the FTL-refined \[CLS\] as a semantic anchor to generate sample-wise modulation signals, which enable composition-aware interpretation of channels within a unified backbone rather than relying on static channel embeddings. Experiments on JUMP-CP, CHAMMI, and So2Sat show that MuCa-ViT outperforms prior multi-channel ViTs across all three benchmarks, and the magnitude of improvement aligns with the inter-channel redundancy of each dataset ($ρ\\in \[0.19, 0.77\]$), validating the diagnostic analysis that motivates our design. Our code is available at https://github.com/kimdanni/MuCa-ViT .

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 12 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器 GB-SAE，将跨模型可解释性表述为表示分解问题，同时学习一个可跨模型复用的共享字典和多个模型私有字典，并在 ViT、SigLIP、DINOv2、ConvNeXt 上评估重建、可解释性与泛化。

**相关性简评：** 共享字典与私有残差字典的分解思路，可能为 LVR 中区分跨模型共有的视觉语义与模型特有成分（如分析 latent 相似度中的内容与结构因素）提供可供核查的表示分解线索，但原文不涉及推理、生成或证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning a Unified Cross-Model Semantic Dictionary via Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoders

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models pretrained on similar data distributions tend to learn overlapping semantic structure, but their representations are distinct due to different model architecture, pretraining objectives and protocols. This prevents unified interpretability and cross-model feature reuse. Existing approaches extract interpretable concepts from individual models and align these concepts in a shared coordinate system using cross-reconstruction objectives, but the alignment only applies to latent coordinates while the concepts themselves remain model-specific and cannot be shared or reused. This paper introduces the Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoder (GB-SAE), which casts unified cross-model interpretability as a representation factorization problem and solves it by simultaneously learning a unified shared dictionary and multiple private model-specific dictionaries via a gated bottleneck sparse autoencoder framework. The shared dictionary encodes the cross-model common semantic structure in unified concepts that are reusable across all participating models (and beyond), while each private dictionary comprises residual concepts that capture model-specific biases. We evaluate GB-SAE with distinct foundation models including ViT, SigLIP, DINOv2, and ConvNeXt. GB-SAE demonstrates superior reconstruction capability, unified and faithful interpretability, strong reusability and generalization to unseen models and downstream tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/trustAIoT/GB-SAE\_NeurIPS.

**comment/C1：** The 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SRA：一个可插入扩散/流匹配轨迹预测器的图去噪模块，在每个反向步依据宿主当前预测的未来轨迹重建稀疏欧氏交互图并输出残差修正，包含可学习 query-key 邻域检索、未来条件关系特征与不确定性加权消息传递，在三个宿主、四个基准上平均提升 ADE 5.8%。

**相关性简评：** 其按当前估计逐步重算关系结构、并以置信度加权（确定度高的个体作锚点）的思路，可能为 LVR 中随 latent 状态动态筛选视觉证据、按可靠性聚合信息提供借鉴线索，但该文属多智能体轨迹预测，未涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SRA: Spatial Reasoning Adapter via Evolving Social Interaction Graphs for Trajectory Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Predicting where multiple agents will move next is fundamental to autonomous driving, robotics, and any system that must share space with people safely. Modern stochastic predictors read off inter-agent interactions once from the observed past and keep that view fixed throughout the generative rollout, so the reciprocal geometric constraints that emerge as the joint future sharpens are not re-examined. We address this gap with SRA (Spatial Reasoning Adapter), a modular graph denoiser that is integrated into existing diffusion and flow-matching predictors without redesigning their generative cores. At every reverse step, SRA reads the host's current future estimate, builds a sparse Euclidean interaction graph on the predicted trajectories, and returns a residual correction to the host's decoding path. Our adapter consists of three core components: a sparse neighborhood retrieved with a learned query-key score and a geometric bias, a future-conditioned relational feature recomputed on the evolving prediction, and uncertainty-weighted message passing where confident agents act as anchors for uncertain ones. We instantiate SRA on three structurally different hosts (LED, MID, and MoFlow) across four multi-agent benchmarks: SDD, NBA, Soccer, and Football. SRA improves ADE for every host on every dataset, with average gains of 5.8% in ADE and 7.0% in FDE. A cumulative ablation shows that the three components act as one mechanism: only together do they improve every host on every sports dataset, indicating that spatial reasoning over the model's own evolving future, weighted by how far that future can be trusted, is broadly useful across denoising architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoo97/SRA.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 125. [Scaling Optimization-Oriented Hypernetworks for Implicit Neural Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10509v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10509

**作者：** Lulu Cai、Hanxiang Ren、Siyan Dong、Li Sun、Jiefeng Wu、Youyi Zheng、Yi Ma、Yanchao Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10509v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10509v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以注意力替代 MLP 的 hypernetwork，对给定信号一次前向生成 INR 参数，从而免去测试时优化；把目标 INR 单步优化的链式结构实现为五个参数不随目标网络宽度增长的交叉注意力模块，并用输出神经元为中心的 tokenization 与信息流一致性规则约束各模块角色，在 2D/3D INR 生成和 NeRF 上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「将一步优化展开为固定结构的注意力模块并做 token 空间迭代 rollout」可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新与摊销式计算提供线索，信息流一致性规则对贡献分配也可供核查；但研究对象是 INR 参数生成，与视觉推理任务本身无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Optimization-Oriented Hypernetworks for Implicit Neural Representations

**abstract/A1：** We present a hypernetwork that generates the parameters of an implicit neural representation (INR) for a given signal in a single forward pass, without test-time optimization. Existing hypernetworks for this problem either ignore the chain-rule structure of the test-time optimization that produces an INR or, when they preserve it, instantiate the structure with MLPs whose parameter count grows quartically in target-network width. Our central contribution is to show that this parameter-count cost is structural to the MLP instantiation, not to the optimization-oriented principle of preserving chain-rule structure, and to resolve it by replacing the MLP body with attention. The resulting hypernetwork combines three design choices: an output-neuron-centric tokenization that aligns the token axis with each layer's output-neuron axis; an information-flow consistency rule that fixes the role of every cross-attention module from the representation its output should occupy; and a token-space iterative rollout that realizes the five quantities one optimization step on the target INR computes as five cross-attention modules with parameter count independent of target-network width. Across five 2D and 3D INR generation benchmarks, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art single-pass and optimization-oriented baselines; scales to target-network widths at which the MLP-based optimization-oriented paradigm exhausts GPU memory; and produces the highest result on NeRF generation without ground-truth INR weights supervision.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/lulucai435/hyper-inrs

</details>

### 126. [CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10511v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10511

**作者：** Xiancai Tian、Leichao Zhang、Shenhui Zhang、Yi Shan、Hailong Li、Feng Lin、Xiaotian Yu、Aijun Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10511v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10511v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CALFA-KV：离线联合拟合 key 中心、径向归一化参数与 K/V 码本以对齐冻结模型的注意力输出，并用参考交叉熵梯度估计逐通道 Fisher 敏感度；在线据此打分并逐层逐 KV 头保留少量高精度 KV 状态作为锚点，在固定锚点预算下给出选择超额风险界。

**相关性简评：** 其「按敏感度挑选少数 KV 状态保留高精度」的锚点选择机制，可能为 LVR 中如何以有限缓存预算保住任务关键的视觉证据状态提供可核查线索，但论文面向纯文本 1-bit 压缩，尚无多模态验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CALFA-KV: Joint Calibration and Fisher-Guided Anchors for 1-Bit KV Cache Compression

**abstract/A1：** 1-bit key-value (KV) cache compression can combine quantizer calibration with selective high-precision storage to reduce reconstruction error. We propose Calibration and Fisher-guided Anchors for KV cache compression (CALFA-KV). Offline, we jointly fit a key center, radial normalization parameters, and K/V vector codebooks to match the frozen model's projected attention output. We also estimate channel-wise Fisher-type sensitivities from squared gradients of a reference next-token cross-entropy loss. Online, we use these sensitivities to weight the squared reconstruction errors of each KV state. Here, a KV state is one token's key-value pair within one layer and KV head. We retain the highest-scoring states at high precision under a per-layer, per-KV-head budget. Under exact restoration, we bound the excess risk of score-based anchor selection relative to the optimum at the same anchor budget, where risk is the conditional mean square of the first-order loss change. With a budget of 56 additional FP16 anchors per layer and KV head, CALFA-KV (d8b8) outperforms all evaluated nominal 1-bit baselines on the mean score across seven benchmarks for each of the three models. At the same anchor budget, CALFA-KV (d8b10) uses a nominal index rate of 1.25 bits per channel and narrows the gap to BF16 to 0.90--2.01 points on the same metric.

</details>

### 127. [FADE: Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation for Training-Free Diffusion Transformers Acceleration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10514v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10514

**作者：** Jinlong Yang、Lizilin、Jinke Wu、Yao Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10514v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10514v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 DiT 特征演化具有反常扩散与时空异质性，提出免训练加速框架 FADE，用 Mittag–Leffler 分数阶算子外推高曲率 latent 轨迹，并结合离线 profiling 的多维查找表在推理时自适应取参，以减少特征缓存式跳步的误差累积。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测 latent 轨迹演化 + 缓存复用 + 自适应参数检索」的做法，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的跨步更新、近似误差累积与缓存对 latent 相似度的影响提供可核查线索，但该工作面向图像生成加速，迁移有效性需阅读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FADE: Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation for Training-Free Diffusion Transformers Acceleration

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as the preeminent paradigm for high-fidelity generative modeling across various modalities, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the severe computational overhead of iterative sampling. While recent feature-caching methods mitigate this latency through feature reuse or forecasting based on integer-order operators, they remain limited in adapting to the non-stationary and highly curved dynamics of DiT latent trajectories. In this work, we reveal that DiT feature evolution exhibits anomalous diffusion characteristics and a certain degree of spatiotemporal heterogeneity, rendering static, integer-order forecasting operators inadequate and prone to error accumulation. To address this, we propose Fractional Anomalous Dynamics Extrapolation (FADE), a unified framework for training-free diffusion transformers acceleration. FADE models DiT feature evolution via anomalous diffusion and employs a Mittag--Leffler fractional operator to better adapt to high-curvature and non-linear latent trajectories of DiTs. Leveraging the empirical observation that these complex dynamics maintain cross-sample stability, we further construct a Look-Up Table with multiple dimensions through offline profiling. This enables negligible LUT-retrieval overhead, spatiotemporally adaptive parameter retrieval during online inference. Extensive evaluations across diverse architectures and modalities demonstrate that FADE achieves state-of-the-art acceleration, preserving exceptional generation fidelity under aggressive skip intervals with negligible latency overhead. Our project page is available at https://youngkinlon.github.io/fade-project-page/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 128. [Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10523v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10523

**作者：** Amarnath R

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10523v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10523v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究从视频无标注习得的 latent action 能否迁移到不同身体结构的 2D 角色，提出以同源正确动作与错误动作对比的迁移评分，并在合成角色基准与 DeformingThings4D 上比较五种训练目标。

**相关性简评：** 其「忽略动作也能得高分」的度量批判与线性探针检验 latent 是否保留动作类别，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正承载任务信息、以及贡献分配与评价指标是否可被旁路这两类问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters

**abstract/A1：** Latent-action world models learn actions from video without labels, and recent methods aim to share these actions across bodies. Transfer between 2D characters with different body structures remains underexplored. In this paper, we study whether an action learned from one character can make a character with a different body perform the same action. A cat, a blob and a human can all jump, but each moves its body in its own way. The usual transfer gain mixes body motion with screen movement and can assign a perfect score to a model that ignores its action. To address this, we introduce a transfer score that compares the correct action with wrong ones from the same source. We test five training objectives on a new synthetic benchmark of 2D cartoon characters with six body plans, the standard Sprites benchmark, and 431 selected animal and human animations from DeformingThings4D. With a fixed camera, a baseline that only copies the source's screen movement scores 0.71, as high as most learned models. In contrast, with a camera that follows the body, the best model reaches only 0.46 for an unseen animal family and 0.20 for humans. With this camera, a linear probe identifies the action class of unseen animal families with 66% to 86% balanced accuracy (chance 17%). The learned actions therefore retain information about which action is performed, but the correct action closes only part of the prediction error gap for a new character.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/amarnathresearch/synthetic-2d-body-plans

</details>

### 129. [PrivMark: Pixel-Space Steering against Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10528v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10528

**作者：** Ruofan Xing、Arman Akbari、Weikai Lin、Yuhao Zhu、Xuan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10528v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10528v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PrivMark，从 VLM 隐状态中识别两个与生物特征泄露行为相关的引导方向，并将其编码为单个有界像素扰动，使受保护图像在部署时即可抑制年龄、性别、种族等属性输出，同时构建 BioleakBench 进行评估。

**相关性简评：** 其从模型激活提取行为方向并映射回像素扰动的思路，可供核查视觉输入能否定向操控 latent 状态及生成行为与内部表示的对应关系；但研究目标是隐私抑制而非视觉推理，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PrivMark: Pixel-Space Steering against Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) routinely disclose soft-biometric attributes such as age, gender, and race in their text outputs, exposing demographic information from uploaded images to any downstream API user. Existing privacy defenses do not fit this setting: face de-identification leaves distributed soft-biometric cues intact, classifier-targeted adversarial perturbations do not transfer to open-ended generation, and stronger VLM-specific methods require retraining or runtime activation access unavailable to downstream APIs. We propose PrivMark, a framework that suppresses biometric leakage at the image level. By analyzing VLM activations, we identify two weakly aligned steering vector directions in hidden-state space, each tied to a distinct leakage behavior --- one corresponding to incidental attribute disclosure under open-ended descriptions, the other to compliance with direct biometric probes instead of refusal --- and encode both directions into a single bounded pixel perturbation, so the protected image alone enforces privacy with no invasive access to model internals at deployment. To support evaluation, we assemble BioleakBench, $1{,}600$ VQA pairs covering biometric privacy attributes under both free-form description and direct-probe protocols. Across three white-box source models, PrivMark achieves up to $85.9\\%$ biometric suppression while retaining $75\\%$ of clean OK-VQA utility, up to $1.4\\times$ the privacy-utility tradeoff of the strongest pixel-only baseline. The same one-shot perturbations transfer consistently to seven unseen VLMs including closed-source APIs.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 12 figures

</details>

### 130. [Dual-Granularity Learning for Regression with Continuous Noisy Labels](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10550v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10550

**作者：** Hui Guo、Boyu Wang、Grace Y. Yi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10550v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10550v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GRAIN 双粒度框架处理连续噪声标签回归：细粒度从鲁棒损失导出残差学习并以实例级辅助变量解耦标签噪声，粗粒度用分箱对比正则建立与标签邻近性一致的有序特征结构，两级通过直方图桥接双向耦合。

**相关性简评：** 其「全局有序结构 + 实例级残差修正」的噪声—信号解耦训练思路，可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 推理状态或中间监督含噪时的训练与贡献分配；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dual-Granularity Learning for Regression with Continuous Noisy Labels

**abstract/A1：** Learning with noisy labels has been extensively studied for classification, yet its regression counterpart remains relatively underexplored. Unlike classification, regression involves continuous-valued targets where label noise exhibits heterogeneous magnitudes across instances, which poses conflicting requirements on the model: correcting small-to-moderate deviations requires sensitivity to label values for instance-level refinement, whereas large deviations caused by corrupted or outlying annotations render exact label values unreliable, necessitating reduced reliance on exact labels and instead leveraging ordinal structure among samples. These requirements call for methods that capture both global structure and sample-specific deviations in a unified manner. To this end, we propose GRAIN, a dual-granularity framework for robust noisy regression. At the fine-grained level, we derive an explicit residual learning mechanism from a robust loss formulation, introducing instance-specific auxiliary variables to decouple label noise from predictive signals. At the coarse-grained level, we introduce a binning-based contrastive regularization that enforces an order-preserving feature structure aligned with label proximity, addressing noise beyond the capacity of local residual refinement. The two levels are coupled via a histogram-based bridging mechanism that enables bidirectional information flow: coarse-grained structural guidance establishes a well-ordered feature space that anchors residual learning, while fine-grained residual refinement corrects instance-level deviations that structural regularization alone cannot resolve. Experimental results show that GRAIN consistently improves robustness and generalization under diverse noise conditions.

</details>

### 131. [Understanding the Effect of Visual Attention in CNNs: A Decision-Space Alignment Perspective](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10571v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10571

**作者：** Niladri B. Puhan、K. Kamala Priya

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10571v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10571v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出决策空间框架，把 CNN 中的乘性视觉注意力视为中间特征扰动，用一阶近似预测其对目标-竞争者分类间隔的影响，并引入 Decision Alignment Score 衡量扰动方向与局部 margin 梯度的对齐程度，在 CIFAR-100 上用 SimAM、CBAM 与五种 CNN 骨干做了验证，发现注意力位置越靠后预测一致性越强。

**相关性简评：** 该一阶扰动-间隔预测与方向对齐打分可能可供核查为「视觉证据对最终决策贡献」的定量归因工具，用于检验 VLM 中视觉注意或视觉 token 调制是否真正进入 latent 推理状态，但论文限于 CNN 分类，尚无多模态或 latent 推理证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding the Effect of Visual Attention in CNNs: A Decision-Space Alignment Perspective

**abstract/A1：** Visual Attention enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by modulating intermediate features, yet their effects on downstream decisions remain less understood. We present a decision-space framework that models multiplicative attention as an intermediate feature perturbation and derives a first-order prediction of its effect on the target-versus-competitor classification margin. We further introduce the Decision Alignment Score (DAS) to quantify the directional alignment between the perturbation and the local margin gradient. We evaluate the framework on CIFAR-100 using SimAM and CBAM across five popular CNN backbones, ResNet-18, ResNet-20, ResNet-50, ResNet-56, and MobileNetV2. The analysis examines prediction agreement, DAS margin correlations, and downstream activation-state changes. Across most final-attention configurations, predicted and actual margin changes show good agreement, while DAS exhibits positive correlations with actual margin changes. Single-attention experiments further show that prediction agreement and DAS margin correlations depend on attention placement, with stronger associations at later stages.

</details>

### 132. [Receiver-Resolution APS-PDP Maps for Wireless Channels: Benchmarking and Coarse-to-Fine Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10581v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10581

**作者：** Peilin Zheng、Haozhe Jia、Xiucheng Wang、Wenshuo Chen、Nan Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10581v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10581v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 UrbanADPSMap 基准，显式建模带宽与孔径受限的接收端响应核，把射线追踪监督转为固定网格的 APS/PDP 目标以消除重建歧义；并给出 SpecFlowAR，用多尺度自回归 flow matching 先捕捉粗粒度弥散结构、再细化波束相关峰值与低功率尾部，以 NFE 控制采样预算，在 NFE=80 下降低 BPL@5 等误差。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「粗到细」多尺度自回归 flow matching 以及用 NFE 显式调节质量—延迟的采样预算机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的并行/迭代生成与动态计算分配提供方法线索，可供核查其是否适用于推理状态更新与成本控制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Receiver-Resolution APS-PDP Maps for Wireless Channels: Benchmarking and Coarse-to-Fine Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Angle Power Spectrum (APS) and Power Delay Profile (PDP) are receiver-facing spectra that govern beam selection and wideband equalization. Most ray-tracing benchmarks provide supervision as variable-size multipath component lists. This format does not match practical receivers, whose angular and delay resolutions are limited by array aperture and system bandwidth. As a result, learning targets are ambiguous and evaluations can change with reconstruction conventions. We introduce UrbanADPSMap, a benchmark that converts ray-traced supervision into fixed-grid APS and PDP targets by explicitly modeling bandwidth-limited and aperture-limited response kernels. By fixing the receiver-domain kernels, discretization, and validity mask, UrbanADPSMap removes reconstruction-induced target ambiguity and stabilizes downstream evaluation across methods. Built on this benchmark, we propose SpecFlowAR, a coarse-to-fine generator based on multi-scale autoregressive flow matching. The model first captures coarse dispersion structure and then refines beam-relevant peaks and low-power tails. The number of function evaluations controls the sampling budget, enabling latency and quality to be adjusted for dense spectrum queries. Experiments on the test set show that SpecFlowAR reduces BPL@5 to 2.03 dB under a unified NFE=80 budget, while improving beam utility and reducing errors of 3GPP dispersion statistics.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 133. [MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10592v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10592

**作者：** Jiaju Ma、Ashvini Kumar Jindal、Chuhua Wang、Sumithra Bhakthavatsalam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10592v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10592v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MotionGraphicsBench：基于真实 Lottie 设计构建 100 个「静态 SVG + 运动编辑指令」实例，为每个实例配套确定性、人类可读的验证程序，逐项判定空间、外观与时间要求是否满足，并以此评测 32 个 LLM 的运动图形生成能力。

**相关性简评：** 该程序化验证器能接受多种合法实现并给出细粒度的通过/失败信号，可能为 LVR 中轨迹级验证、贡献分配与多约束（时空）证据核查提供可借鉴的评价构造；但论文本身面向动画生成而非 latent 推理状态，联系需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification

**abstract/A1：** Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

</details>

### 134. [Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10610v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10610

**作者：** Baichuan Huang、Ananth Balashankar、Amir Aminifar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10610v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10610v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出仅前向的 LLM 适配方法：用每个 SVD 分量引起的激活角度集中度衡量其对隐藏状态的贡献是分散还是集中，据此搜索最值得降秩的权重矩阵，并选择性地移除高阶分量、保留低阶分量，从而免梯度、低峰值显存地完成适配。

**相关性简评：** 其以激活几何（角度集中度）免梯度地刻画各 SVD 分量对隐藏状态的贡献，可能为 LVR 中 latent 方向的贡献分配与训练-free 状态成分筛选提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) inference serving is undergoing rapid growth and large-scale deployment, motivating us to rethink how the inference process itself can be leveraged to enable efficient task-specific LLM adaptation. In this paper, we propose a forward-only approach for efficient LLM adaptation with forward-only passes in LLM inference serving. We exploit the angle concentration of activations induced by each singular value decomposition (SVD) component to measure its contribution-dispersed or concentrated-to the angle concentration of the hidden states. Based on this, our forward-only search then efficiently identifies the weight matrix with the highest dispersion that merits rank reduction. We then selectively remove the higher-order components and retain the lower-order components in SVD. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate the competitive accuracy of our forward-only approach, while theoretical analysis shows lower peak memory and greater speedup than the gradient-based approach and greater speedup than the exhaustive search approach. The experiments further present the robustness and generalization of our forward-only approach to various LLMs with up to 57B parameters. The code is included in the supplementary material.

</details>

### 135. [Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10632v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10632

**作者：** Yichen Zhang、Yupeng Zheng、Linbo Wang、Pengxuan Yang、Zebin Xing、Junli Wang、Shiwei Li、Kangwei Liu、Fan Ren、Qichao Zhang、Yifeng Pan、Ji Tao、Dongbin Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10632v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10632v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向端到端自动驾驶的表示中心世界-动作模型，按规划角色分别监督世界表示与动作表示，并用 MeanFlow 规划器直接生成多模态轨迹、对齐动作特征与当前视觉语义。

**相关性简评：** 其世界表示的未来预测、分布稳定化、几何先验及视觉-动作对齐，可能为 LVR 的潜表示保留、防退化与监督设计提供核查线索；但任务属自动驾驶规划而非 VLM 推理，迁移性待核。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Latent-WAM++, a representation-centered World Action Model (WAM) for end-to-end autonomous driving. Existing WAMs are primarily trained to predict future states or final actions, leaving the intermediate world and action representations that connect prediction to planning only indirectly constrained. Latent-WAM++ matches the supervision of each representation to its role in planning. World Representation Construction combines scene-ego future prediction, SIGReg-based distribution stabilization, and frozen geometric priors to learn a temporally predictive, non-degenerate, and geometry-aware world representation without an EMA target encoder. Trajectory MeanFlow Planner directly predicts multimodal trajectory proposals while being optimized with an Improved MeanFlow velocity-space objective, enabling one-step sampling. Visual-Action Representation Alignment further aligns the resulting pre-output action features with a stop-gradient target derived from current visual semantics. Latent-WAM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM v2 and under zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM, reaching 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 47.0 average RC and 30.1 average HD-Score on HUGSIM. Training the planner end to end costs 190 GPU-hours for Latent-WAM++ versus 1,600 for Latent-WAM, a reduction of 88.1%.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 136. [Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10634v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10634

**作者：** Yan-Cheng Li、Chun-Yi Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10634v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10634v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CVSA：把被选 token 上的 softmax 质量（coverage）作为与单步输出误差存在精确代数关系的信号，训练-free 地构成「验证—纠正」闭环稀疏注意力解码，仅对 coverage 不足的注意力头回退到稠密计算，在 7B/70B 上接近稠密注意力并取得显著解码加速。

**相关性简评：** coverage 作为「已选证据是否足够」的可度量信号，并兼作接受准则与插值权重，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选是否保留必要信息、以及 LOOK/STOP 式动态计算与停止决策提供可供核查的验证与纠正思路；但该工作为纯文本 KV 稀疏化，多模态迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the KV cache, but existing methods are open-loop: the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. The needed signal already exists inside the kernel. The fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens, which we call coverage, satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention (CVSA) turns coverage into a training-free, closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short, with no sampling, no draft model, and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. Quality varies by only $0.14$ points across the threshold sweep; budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. On LongBench at 7B and 70B, CVSA comes within $1.13$ points of dense attention, statistically matching it at 70B, and it loses $0.8$ points on RULER; measured median decode-step speedup reaches $6.21\\times$ at 128K context.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 12 figures, 35 tables

</details>

### 137. [FG-DSA: Frequency-Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10653v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10653

**作者：** Yiyao Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10653v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10653v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FG-DSA：用 2D FFT 高通滤波把频域先验显式注入深度可分离注意力，以线性复杂度在语义分割与扩散 U-Net 中恢复细粒度边界细节。

**相关性简评：** 其「注意力中显式保留高频细节」的轻量做法可能为 LVR 中视觉细节在内部表示里的保留提供模块级线索，但材料未涉及推理状态、证据筛选或答案使用，需核查是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FG-DSA: Frequency-Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Dense prediction and generative modeling in resource-constrained scenarios remain challenging, as repeated downsampling substantially reduces spatial detail and degrades boundaries. Although recent attention mechanisms have alleviated the problem of semantic ambiguity, they often fail to preserve high-frequency features or do so at the expense of a very high computational cost. In this paper, we propose the Frequency Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction (FG-DSA), a novel framework for efficient dense visual understanding and generation. FG-DSA employs a 2D FFT high-pass filtering module to explicitly inject frequency domain priors into the spatial attention mechanism, allowing lightweight networks to recover sharp boundary transitions with linear complexity. A range of experiments show that FG-DSA is effective at recovering fine object boundaries and leads to a consistent performance gain in the task of semantic segmentation. Importantly, we show that FGA-DSA can be used as a module in diffusion-based generative U-Nets, leading to a significant improvement in the detail of the generated images with very little additional parameter and Floating Point Operation (FLOP) cost.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 138. [STABLE: A Continual Learning Optimizer with Adaptive Drift Control](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10655v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10655

**作者：** Xiaoyan Li、Lanpei Li、Massimo Coppola、Vincenzo Lomonaco、Antonio Carta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10655v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10655v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把灾难性遗忘归因于学习动力学不稳定，提出优化器层面的 STABLE：用原始-对偶方式自适应调节漂移预算（越界则增大对偶变量），并证明有界参数漂移可限制距离分类器的间隔侵蚀，在长序列单模态与 CLIP 多模态任务流上验证其可匹配或超过专用持续学习方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「漂移预算＋对偶调节」这一约束更新幅度、兼顾稳定性与可塑性的优化机制，可能可供核查用于抑制 VLM 适配或 latent 推理状态中视觉信息的漂移与坍缩；但论文作用于参数层而非推理期状态生成，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** STABLE: A Continual Learning Optimizer with Adaptive Drift Control

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning suffers from catastrophic forgetting, leading to the loss of past knowledge and unstable adaptation across task streams. Existing approaches typically address this issue through replay buffers, architectural changes, or additional regularization terms. We argue that forgetting is a consequence of unstable learning dynamics, which may benefit from an optimizer-level solution. The main challenge is that learning dynamics are time-dependent, as demonstrated by empirical phenomena such as the stability gap. First, we formally prove that, for distance-based classifiers, bounded parameter drift guarantees bounded margin erosion under a local score-stability condition. Based on this insight, we propose STABLE, a primal-dual optimizer with adaptive drift control. STABLE enforces a drift budget by increasing the dual variable when the budget is violated and decreasing it otherwise. This results in high stability without penalizing plasticity. Experiments on long-horizon unimodal streams and CLIP-based multimodal streams show that vanilla PEFT baselines trained with STABLE match or outperform specialized continual learning methods. In the multimodal setting, STABLE further preserves zero-shot transfer, matching or exceeding dedicated multimodal continual learning methods.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 139. [Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10672v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10672

**作者：** Qi Wang、Jinjia Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10672v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10672v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation（HACD），把异构教师与学生的 logits 映射为去中心、温度软化的概率方向并置于共享单位超球面，以批内对比的方式让学生识别自己的教师目标，从而迁移预测的关系结构而非逐样本数值，并在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet-1K 的 Transformer→CNN 等异构对上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「迁移样本间关系结构而非点对点数值匹配」的监督思路，可能可供核查用于异质模型间 latent 推理状态的对齐与训练监督；但原文只在分类 logits 上操作，未涉及视觉证据、latent 状态生成或推理期计算，联系需较多核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge distillation (KD) between architectural families, e.g., from a Transformer teacher to a CNN student, is difficult because the two networks learn different representations. Logits share a label space, but heterogeneous teachers differ in logit offset, scale, and sharpness, and their non-target classes are less semantically organized. Conventional logit distillation matches these values sample by sample, asking the student to imitate how another architecture expresses its predictions. We argue that a heterogeneous teacher should pass on the relational structure of its predictions, i.e., how it arranges samples relative to one another, and propose Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation (HACD) to transfer this structure. HACD maps teacher and student logits to centered, temperature-softened probability directions on a shared unit hypersphere, which removes architecture-dependent offsets and lets the temperature control how sharply peaked outputs enter the representation while keeping informative non-target classes. Each student output must then identify its own teacher target within the batch. Because every teacher target also acts as a negative for the others, HACD computes the targets on a moderately augmented view and contrasts both a moderate and a strong student view against them. HACD adds no learnable parameters and needs one teacher pass per sample. It achieves the best or second-best accuracy on 11 of 12 heterogeneous pairs on CIFAR-100, without ground-truth labels, and on 14 of 15 pairs on ImageNet-1K, improving over the reported vanilla KD results by 8.82 and 1.33 percentage points on average. Checkpoints are available at https://github.com/BTAEYANG/HACD-Heterogeneous-Asymmetric-Contrastive-Distillation; the code will be released upon publication.

**comment/C1：** 13pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 140. [Audit Before You Merge: Provenance, Probing, and Continual LoRA Composition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10684v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10684

**作者：** Lenny Aharon、Neta Glazer、Lior Aharon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10684v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10684v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把公开 LoRA 适配器的事后合并视为持续学习中的顺序任务，在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上研究灾难性遗忘的可靠测量，提出「基座版本匹配＋delta 范数非平凡」两项审计与无泄漏探测协议，并在审计后的适配器集上比较合并方法、发现负系数坐标搜索可找到数学适配器的最优系数。

**相关性简评：** 论文没有视觉或 LVR 内容，但其「先审计再探测」的评测纪律与逐适配器贡献归因（含负系数坐标搜索），可供核查 LVR 中训练信号与模块贡献分配、以及防止 latent 评测受版本错配或泄漏污染的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Audit Before You Merge: Provenance, Probing, and Continual LoRA Composition

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc merging of public LoRA adapters is an attractive gradient-free path to continual adaptation, but reliable measurement of catastrophic forgetting in this setting depends on infrastructure that prior work has not addressed. We treat each adapter merge as a sequential task in a continual-learning setting, with the instruction-tuned base model's capabilities as Task 0, and study forgetting on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Public adapter hubs contain modules that fail basic provenance checks: silent base-version mismatches and near-zero delta norms whose inclusion inflates measured interference by ~10pp. We propose a two-check audit (base-model match, non-trivial delta norm) and a leakage-free probing protocol as preconditions for any forgetting study in this setting. On an audited 4-adapter set, naive merging causes -10.5pp on GSM8K and -18.3pp on HumanEval, while Task Arithmetic at lambda=0.5 sits within a standard error of the unmerged baseline. A coordinate search including negative coefficients identifies the math adapter as probe-optimal at lambda=-0.5, outside the reach of positive-only mergers, suggesting forgetting has structure that negation-aware merging may exploit. The same protocol replicates on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, where 2 of 4 candidate adapters fail the audit and the audited merge reproduces the same merge-method ranking on GSM8K, supporting that our findings are not Llama-specific.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables. ICML 2026 Workshop on Continual Adaptation at Scale (CATS). Code: https://github.com/LennyAharon/audit\_continual\_learning

</details>

### 141. [RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10689v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10689

**作者：** Sohaib Sulman、Muhammad Atif Saeed、Akhtar Jamil、Alaa Ali Hameed、Roland Aydin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10689v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10689v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RetinaGuard，一个用于眼底多病种筛查的 agentic 分诊框架：多个质量、诊断、不确定性、验证与解释代理为每张图收集证据，学习式失败预测器估计决策不安全的概率，仅当辅助工具的期望信息价值超过成本时调用，并用保形风险控制校准接受阈值。

**相关性简评：** 其「期望信息价值超过成本才调用工具」与基于保形风险控制的可接受/弃权阈值，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 的证据获取和 STOP 的停止决策提供可核查的门控与风险校准线索；但工作面向医学分诊，未涉及 latent 推理状态。另可留意其发现：验证代理的增益取决于主模型自身不确定性已揭示的错误比例，这对判断额外视觉证据何时真正有用有参考价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening

**abstract/A1：** Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

</details>

### 142. [JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10690v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10690

**作者：** Xiangjun Tang、Jianqi Chen、Peter Wonka

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10690v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10690v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JoVox，用离散 flow matching 学习体素层级中所有层次的联合分布，使细粒度体素参与决定粗粒度体素，并引入两级预测与可在细化后回溯修正早期决策的 unmasking 策略，实现轻量高保真体素生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「细化后再重访并纠正早期粗层决策」的 unmasking 与跨层联合分布，可能为 LVR 中多尺度 latent 状态更新和早期承诺的修正提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文面向 3D 生成，迁移性待评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.

</details>

### 143. [A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10691v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10691

**作者：** Aythami Bethencourt de León、Darryl D. Holm

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math-ph、math.PR、nlin.AO、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10691v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10691v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用统计物理与变分视角刻画固定参数下 Transformer 注意力权重与 token 表示的联合演化：以自由能和 Fisher–Rao 梯度流建模注意力，证明 softmax 是唯一自由能极小点、给出注意力对瞬时 softmax 的跟踪界，并把表示与动量的 Hamilton 动力学与注意力松弛耦合，得到能量耗散律与适定性结论。

**相关性简评：** 其注意力收敛性、logit 变量线性化与能量耗散分析，可能为核查 LVR 中多步 latent 更新时注意力结构随深度的稳定性与状态演化提供可借用的理论工具；但该文纯理论、不涉及视觉或多模态，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Geometric Theory for Nonequilibrium Transformer Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** We develop a variational and geometric theory based on statistical physics for the joint evolution of Transformer attention and token representations at fixed model parameters. To this end, we introduce a free energy for the attention and model the evolution of the attention weights by its Fisher--Rao gradient flow. At fixed token representations, we prove that the softmax matrix is the unique free-energy minimiser and that every positive attention trajectory converges to it. For prescribed time-dependent representations, we show that the attention dynamics becomes linear after a change to logit variables. This result yields tracking bounds relative to the instantaneous softmax and sufficient conditions for attention to converge to a fixed matrix. Hamiltonian dynamics for the representations and their momenta are then coupled to the attention relaxation driven by the same energy. This coupling results in an energy-dissipation law. We also develop two alternative Hamiltonians incorporating the attention value map. We prove global well-posedness of the attention flow and all three coupled systems.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages Submitted to Proc Roy Soc A

</details>

**作者：** Jiayu Zhang、Ziqi Zhong、Yuliang Gai、Canran Xiao

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Hallucination-Guided Unlearning（HGU）：把幻觉当作诊断信号，借助证据与内部一致性定位无依据片段，追踪少量高责任 MLP 神经元，并在保效用的 KL 约束下用紧凑门控做后验编辑式选择性遗忘，在 TOFU 与 WMDP 上评估遗忘—效用权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「内部共识判定依据支持 + 高责任单元追踪」的归因流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中哪些内部状态真正承载视觉证据、如何做贡献分配与监督；但对象是纯文本遗忘任务，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关系，迁移性需阅读原文核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hallucination-Guided Unlearning: Using Hallucination Traces to Reveal Overfitted Memories

**abstract/A1：** Selective unlearning is increasingly important for the safety and compliance of large language models. Harmful or memorized content is often entangled with useful knowledge and difficult to enumerate. We use the model's own failures to identify candidates for unlearning. We propose Hallucination-Guided Unlearning (HGU), which uses hallucinations as diagnostic signals. HGU localizes unsupported spans via evidence and internal consensus, traces a sparse set of high-responsibility MLP neurons, and edits them with compact gates under a utility-preserving KL constraint. On TOFU, HGU achieves the best MU-FE trade-off, with Avg scores of 0.7221 (forget05) and 0.7699 (forget10), and the highest SepS H-Avg (0.4382/0.4715) under mixed forget/retain prompts. On the WMDP auxiliary task, HGU yields the strongest forgetting (e.g., 14.2 on Economics) while improving Retain (52.7) and MMLU (57.2). These results suggest that tracing hallucinations enables targeted, post-hoc unlearning that better balances forgetting efficacy and general utility without full retraining.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>
