摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Permute-then-Adapt 框架：借助弱教师模型的相似度估计随机配对参考分布，按其上尾阈值筛出被漏掉的正样本，再用多正样本对比目标训练强模型，用于 CLIP 图文适配。

**相关性简评：** 其用参考分布控制假阳性来筛选“可用正例”的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 相似度判读提供校准思路，但属训练期对齐方法，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Permute-then-Adapt: Weak-to-Strong Contrastive Image-Text Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Image-text alignment models such as CLIP are typically trained with contrastive learning, where unpaired examples are treated as strict negatives. While this assumption introduces noise by penalising semantically related pairs, existing solutions often rely on heuristic similarity thresholds that lack statistical grounding and sensitivity to dataset-specific noise distributions. In this paper, we propose Permute-then-Adapt (PTA), a framework that leverages efficient weak models to identify missed positives while controlling Type-I error relative to a conditional permutation reference, up to calibration approximation error. Unlike standard distillation or arbitrary thresholding, PTA estimates a random-pairing reference distribution from the weak teacher's similarity scores and uses its upper tail, determined by $α$, to select auxiliary positives. The calibrated positive set is then trained against by a single multi-positive contrastive objective: each anchor maximises the total probability mass it assigns to its positive set. Offline calibration with the weak model adds negligible training overhead. Experiments show gains over heuristic soft-label approaches in object recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and data efficiency. Project repository: https://github.com/JinhaoLee/Permute-then-Adapt.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages; accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight)

</details>

### 146. [Locating and Repairing Domain Shift in VLM Trajectory Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10720v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10720

**作者：** Zhihong Cui、Hengyu Liu、Michael Alexander Riegler、Guandong Xu、Amir Taherkordi、Tor Skeie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10720v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10720v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 VLM 端到端驾驶规划器的跨城市域偏移，通过激活补丁发现偏移沿模态（图像/文本 token）与层两个轴呈结构化分布，据此提出 MoLaRx：用因果重要性分数估计模态-层偏移张量并分区施加 MMD、LoRA 或冻结等修复。

**相关性简评：** 其激活补丁与模态-层因果重要性定位做法，可能可供核查视觉信息在 VLM 内部各层如何分布、是否存在视觉旁路；但论文目标是驾驶域偏移修复，与 LVR 推理状态生成和证据使用关系较间接，需核查后判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Locating and Repairing Domain Shift in VLM Trajectory Planning

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted as end-to-end driving planners, yet they suffer from cross-city domain shift. Existing methods treat this shift as a single quantity addressed by uniform alignment or single-site editing. We challenge this view on two counts: (i) domain shift in VLM trajectory planners is inherently structured across modality and layer, and (ii) a locate-then-repair recipe matched to this structure outperforms every uniform-objective baseline. We analyse domain shift via activation patching and uncover two regularities. (F1) Modality axis. Image and text tokens exhibit distinct shift patterns in each VLM. (F2) Layer axis. The layer-wise shift partition is architecture-dependent and dataset-stable. These findings recast domain shift as a two-dimensional tensor indexed by modality (image vs. text tokens) and layer, motivating a simple principle: locate where shift occurs, and repair only there. We instantiate this principle in MoLaRx (Modality-Layer Repair), a locate-then-repair framework. The Causal Importance Score (CIS) estimates the domain shift as a modality-layer tensor and partitions the layers into functional zones. CIS-Guided Selective Repair (CISR) then applies a matched operator (Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) / low-rank adaptation (LoRA) / freezing) to repair each zone, with the composition adapting automatically to each architecture. We evaluate MoLaRx on three architecturally distinct VLMs (LFM2-VL-1.6B, Qwen2-VL-2B, and PaliGemma2-3B) across two cross-city benchmarks (nuScenes and Argoverse 2). MoLaRx attains the lowest cross-city trajectory-error gap among adaptation methods in all six main-table settings, while using 50-60% fewer trainable parameters and 8.4-10.9 ms lower inference latency. In contrast, uniform MMD-only adaptation collapses in all six settings, highlighting the importance of structure-guided repair.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 30 pages, 7 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/ZhihongCui/MoLaRx

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10746

**作者：** Deguo Xia、Zihan Li、Jiaqi Wang、Dong Xie、Xiyan Liu、Liuhui Zhang、Jizhou Huang、Mengmeng Yang、Diange Yang、Chen Zhu、Liwei Qian、Xin Pei、Shuanglong Li、Hanmeng Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向车道级地图更新的视觉语言系统 RoadState，把道路场景理解建模为自回归状态估计，由前一观测与符号状态预测当前结构化道路状态，并用语义依赖 DAG 作为领域先验（Geo-CoT）提升各状态维度间的一致性。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构化状态接口 + 时序状态转移 + 按难度级联路由」的工程做法，可能与 LVR 中推理状态如何表示、如何随观测更新以及动态分配计算的问题相关，可供核查；但输出为符号状态而非 latent，属应用系统，联系间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RoadState: A Domain-Prior-Enhanced Vision-Language System for Industrial-Grade Lane-Level Map Updating

**abstract/A1：** Lane-level map updating requires temporally consistent, physically valid, and auditable road-scene semantics despite occlusions, ambiguous lane markings, temporary obstacles, and viewpoint changes. We present RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system that transforms sequential road-scene observations into structured lane-level semantics for Baidu Maps' map-updating pipeline. Its core model, RoadState-VLM, formulates road-scene understanding as autoregressive state estimation, predicting the current structured road state from the previous observation and symbolic state together with the current observation. We introduce Geometric Chain-of-Thought (Geo-CoT), which uses a directed acyclic graph of semantic dependencies as a domain prior to improve semantic consistency and reasoning fidelity across interdependent road-state dimensions. Extensive experiments on a real-world dataset show that RoadState-VLM achieves 94.33% mean accuracy across six road-state dimensions, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned VLM baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary effectiveness of Geo-CoT and temporal transition context. A cascaded routing pipeline directs routine cases to lightweight models while reserving complex cases for RoadState-VLM. Since its deployment in March 2025, RoadState has supported lane-level map updating across more than 360 cities and reduced overall production costs by 30%. Together with human-in-the-loop auditing, the system maintains robust performance under stress-test conditions. These results demonstrate how domain-prior-enhanced reasoning, structured state interfaces, selective routing, and human quality control can bridge the gap between VLM-based road-scene understanding and large-scale lane-level map updating.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Accepted to AAAI-IAAI 2027, poster presentation

### 148. [Constrained Look-ahead Guidance for Interference-Aware Flow Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10751v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10751v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10751v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种免反演的流模型图像编辑框架，用一步 look-ahead 评估候选更新对编辑奖励与保真奖励的影响，并在显式保真约束下对每步更新做奖励驱动修正。

**相关性简评：** 其「前瞻评估候选更新再受约束校正」的机制可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态更新与 THINK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡，但原文面向图像编辑，与多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Constrained Look-ahead Guidance for Interference-Aware Flow Editing

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion and flow models enable powerful generative modeling, but controlled editing remains challenging due to the need to balance source fidelity and edit compliance along the generative trajectory. We propose a principled, inversion-free framework for flow-based image editing from a trajectory centric perspective. Rather than relying on inversion or heuristic guidance, we introduce a one-step look-ahead mechanism that evaluates the effect of candidate updates on both edit and fidelity rewards estimated via denoising, and adjusts the current update based on this evaluation. At each step, our method applies reward-driven corrections guided by the look-ahead evaluation under an explicit fidelity constraint, resulting in stable and coherent trajectory evolution. This look-ahead design mitigates gradient interference between edit and fidelity objectives by anticipating their interaction in future states, leading to improved trade-offs. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves stronger semantic edits while better preserving source content compared to existing strong baselines.

</details>

### 149. [ConwayNet: Interpretability, Activation Coherence, and Noise Resilience via a Game-of-Life-Inspired Lateral Inhibition in Artificial Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10760v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10760

**作者：** Yair Cohen、Scott M. Gilmore

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10760v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10760v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种受「生命游戏」启发、可微且与架构无关的侧向抑制机制，以固定局部规则根据层输入调节激活图，并在多种网络上考察激活一致性、可解释性与抗噪性。

**相关性简评：** 其「以固定局部规则进行状态条件激活更新」或可为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、跨层一致性与噪声鲁棒性提供方法线索，但未涉及视觉推理，需核查规则是否会限制信息表达。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ConwayNet: Interpretability, Activation Coherence, and Noise Resilience via a Game-of-Life-Inspired Lateral Inhibition in Artificial Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Deep neural networks achieve universal function approximation by stacking interconnected nonlinearities, but as a consequence they are sensitive to noise and resist mechanistic interpretation. In contrast, the local update rules of cellular automata, such as Conway's Game of Life, give rise to not merely interpretable but programmable dynamics. We explore a bridge between these worlds: a lateral inhibition in neural networks based on continuous Game-of-Life rules that derives inhibitory and excitatory responses from the layer input and blends them into the activation map in a state-conditioned way. The mechanism is differentiable and architecture-agnostic, and its regulation is imposed rather than learned: the rule's parameters are fixed and are not optimised, while the rule's values and derivatives shape training throughout the network. Wired into fully connected, convolutional, wide-residual and graph convolutional networks, it gives rise to several properties. Activation maps become coherent across space, depth and seeds, with coarse structure persisting through depth while fine detail is renewed at every layer. The co-activation graph of the hidden units departs from an Erdős--Rényi random graph: it is laid out on the image and its giant component grows in steps, as in a spatial graph. Networks started from nearly identical initialisations, under label noise, disagree on thirty times fewer test images. Saliency maps rest on the object rather than the background, and resilience to pixel noise not seen in training is substantially improved.

</details>

### 150. [BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10764v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10764

**作者：** Ufaq Khan、Umair Nawaz、Satyajit Tourani、Awais Rauf、Fahad Shamshad、Asif Hanif、Rao Muhammad Anwer、Muhammad Haris Khan、Mohammad Yaqub

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10764v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10764v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究医学基础模型中基于 prompt learning 的后门攻击的跨模型迁移性，提出 CAD/BAD 两个指标度量迁移程度，并给出 DePLe 防御：以受感染 prompt 为固定锚点，在少量干净数据上学习新 prompt，使其保留干净任务同时偏离被污染的嵌入区域。

**相关性简评：** 其「紧凑 prompt 表征携带的行为可跨不同 backbone 迁移」及「在嵌入空间中约束新状态远离受污染区域」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的跨模型可迁移性度量、表征编辑与污染/旁路检测提供可供核查的线索，但任务与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Medical foundation models (Med-FMs) are increasingly adapted to clinical tasks through prompt learning, which tunes a small set of prompt tokens while the backbone remains frozen. Recent work has shown that this efficiency introduces a vulnerability: jointly optimizing learnable prompts and an imperceptible noise trigger during few-shot adaptation implants a backdoor that leaves clean performance intact but steers triggered inputs to an attacker-chosen class. Since prompts are compact and readily shared, this raises two questions: whether a backdoored prompt remains effective on a different Med-FM, and whether it can be repaired without retraining the backbone. We address both in BAPLe++. First, we present the first study of cross-model transferability of prompt-based backdoors, quantified by two proposed metrics, Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD) and Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD). Second, we propose DePLe (Defense via Prompt Learning), which uses the infected prompt as a fixed anchor and learns a new prompt on a small clean set that preserves the clean task while diverging from the compromised embedding region. Experiments on four Med-FMs and six chest X-ray and histopathology datasets show that backdoors transfer across models, but asymmetrically and in a dataset-dependent manner. Compared with four training-free input transformations, DePLe reduces backdoor accuracy more consistently while preserving, and in several settings improving, clean accuracy. Our code can be accessed on https://github.com/Ufaqkhan/Baple-Plus-Plus

**内容简述：** 在冻结的 ACT 动作分块策略上研究 PushT 任务的选择性测试时搜索：用 beam search 生成并模拟候选动作块，并引入 OSA 门控，仅在预测覆盖下降超阈值时才启动完整搜索。

**相关性简评：** 「何时额外搜索、何时停止」与增大搜索预算未必更好的结论，可供核查 LVR 中动态计算分配与停止决策的门控设计，但该文针对机器人动作搜索而非 VLM 内部 latent，迁移性需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Look Ahead: Search-Driven Reasoning in Embodied AI

**abstract/A1：** Search allows a robotic policy to evaluate candidate futures before committing to an action. Motivated by test-time planning for vision-language action (VLA) models, we study selective search over action chunks in PushT using a frozen Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy. Beam search generates perturbed alternatives around the policy prediction and scores them through rollouts from cloned simulator states. Across 50 evaluation episodes, beam search raises task success from 0% to 18% and increases average cumulative reward from 39.44 to 103.2. We introduce One Step Ahead (OSA), a gate that simulates the nominal policy chunk and invokes full search only when its predicted coverage drop exceeds a threshold. In the reported ablations, OSA preserves or improves success while reducing runtime by approximately 3x relative to full beam search. Ablations over tree depth, branching factor, beam width, and replanning frequency show that larger search budgets do not consistently improve performance. The results support selective test-time search for action-chunking policies; evaluation on language-conditioned VLAs and physical robots remains future work.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在冻结预训练权重的前提下，将 LLM 的加性更新约束在固定秩矩阵流形上，提出黎曼零阶梯度估计器，以及 ZO-RGD 和平滑变体 ZO-RGD-S，并给出估计与收敛性质及微调实验。

**相关性简评：** 其切空间投影、尺度归一化与 retraction 的零阶梯度估计，可能为 LVR 中受几何或低秩约束的 latent 状态更新与表示训练提供方法工具，但论文未涉及视觉推理，具体可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zeroth-Order Riemannian Optimization on Fixed-Rank Manifolds for LLM Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization estimates descent directions from function values alone, which removes the activation storage required by backpropagation and makes it attractive for memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). Existing low-rank ZO methods either parameterize the additive update through Euclidean factors with a non-unique representation, or restrict each finite-difference direction to be low-rank. In this work, we propose to constrain each additive update block to a fixed-rank matrix manifold while keeping the pretrained weights frozen, so the learned update remains rank-constrained throughout fine-tuning. On this geometry, we build a Riemannian ZO gradient estimator that projects a random matrix onto the tangent space, normalizes it to correct the scale mismatch induced by projection, and further propose Zeroth-order Riemannian Gradient Descent (ZO-RGD) and its smoothed variant, ZO-RGD-S. We show that the ambient finite difference matches its retracted counterpart, the normalized estimator recovers the Riemannian gradient in expectation, and ZO-RGD converges under trajectory-regularity conditions. Experiments on LLM fine-tuning tasks show that the proposed algorithms are competitive with strong forward-only baselines across model families and tasks, with gains in several settings.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 2 figures, 23 tables

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对冻结分层 JEPA 世界模型测试时梯度规划开销大的问题，提出 WARP-JEPA，用学习到的多候选轨迹提议器替代在线优化，并以模型 rollout 代价和 best-of-K 行为克隆训练提议器。

**相关性简评：** 其多候选 latent rollout 的生成与代价筛选、层级规划视野差异，可能为 LVR 的候选状态生成、验证与停止决策提供方法线索；但论文面向机器人视觉控制，和语言推理的直接联系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WARP-JEPA: World-Model-in-the-Loop Amortized Rollout Planning for Frozen Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures

**abstract/A1：** Hierarchical Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (H-JEPA) enable long-horizon visual control but rely on costly test-time gradient descent for planning. Our analysis reveals that iterative optimization consumes up to 97.7% of episode runtime and that low predicted rollout costs do not necessarily translate into successful control. We further identify a planning-horizon asymmetry between long-horizon top-level composition and short two-step subordinate planning. To address these challenges, we propose WARP-JEPA, a hierarchical amortized planning framework that replaces online gradient optimization with learned multi-candidate trajectory proposers while keeping the world models frozen. WARP-JEPA combines a lightweight world-model-in-the-loop causal Transformer at the top level with parallel residual MLPs at subordinate levels. The proposers are trained using model-based rollout costs and best-of-K behavior cloning, enabling efficient candidate selection without test-time gradient optimization. Across 30 frozen H-JEPA models on four benchmarks, WARP-JEPA achieves 9.6-18.8x faster episode inference on long-horizon tasks (2.9-3.0x on Cube) and improves task success by up to 33.3 percentage points. These results demonstrate that amortized planning can substantially improve both inference efficiency and control performance without retraining the world models. Code is available at https://github.com/hideinsewer/WARP-JEPA.

</details>

### 154. [What Broke &amp; Why: Practical Lessons from Reinforcement Learning Post-Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10844v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10844

**作者：** Luv Verma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10844v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10844v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一本面向开放模型实践者的 RLVR 后训练教程，系统讲解 GRPO 与训练循环，并以数学推理、搜索智能体、训练稳定性、MoE、软件工程五个训练项目复盘故障、改动与经验，另附奖励设计、评测、调试与可复现性参考。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本、非视觉的工程性著作，其关于奖励失效、探索坍缩、评测误导与训练稳定性的经验，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练、贡献分配与「看似提升」评价的问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Broke &amp; Why: Practical Lessons from Reinforcement Learning Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important way to improve how language models reason, solve problems, and use tools. But getting it to work in practice is not always straightforward. Training can fail because a model receives no useful reward, learns to exploit the reward system, stops exploring, or appears to improve when the evaluation itself is misleading. In this book, we give a practical introduction to reinforcement learning post-training for language models, focusing on what works, what fails, and why. We begin with the foundations of post-training, explain GRPO and the training loop step by step, and then follow five training programs covering math reasoning, search agents, training stability, mixture-of-experts models, and software engineering tasks. Each program shows the problems encountered, the changes made, and the lessons learned. The book also examines what reinforcement learning actually changes inside a model. The remaining chapters provide a practical reference for reward design, evaluation, training tool-using agents, debugging common failures, reproducibility, rollout engines, and hardware. Written for researchers and practitioners working with open models, the book aims to help readers understand how to train models, recognize when something goes wrong, and decide what to try next.

**comment/C1：** 648 pages. Book, first edition, version 1.0 (2026)

</details>

### 155. [Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10857v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10857

**作者：** Siddharth Roheda、Rohit Chowdhury、Amit Satish Unde、Aniruddha Bala

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10857v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10857v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从高斯去噪的 Wiener–Volterra 多项式展开出发，论证 softmax 等归一化混合算子无法表达仿射以外的多项式映射，并据此构建全程使用低秩 Volterra 层的像素空间扩散模型，在 ImageNet 上与自包含扩散基线相当。

**相关性简评：** 其关于混合算子表达能力、以多项式 Volterra 层替代注意力的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新与融合的算子设计提供借鉴线索；但论文面向像素图像生成，未涉及推理状态或视觉证据使用，可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Natural images are often conjectured to lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. Recent work leverages this to build self-contained pixel-space diffusion models without specialized machinery or pretrained components. A plain Transformer on raw image patches suffices, provided it predicts the clean image rather than the noise and compresses each patch through an aggressive bottleneck. The mixing operator, however, has remained softmax attention, inherited from sequence modeling rather than derived from denoising. For Gaussian noise, the optimal denoiser admits a canonical expansion in polynomial functionals of the observation, the Wiener--Volterra series. We prove that softmax attention, and any normalized mixing rule (including linear attention), cannot realize any polynomial map beyond an affine one. In contrast, Volterra layers realize this class directly and, on a data manifold, achieve approximation rates governed by the manifold dimension rather than the ambient pixel dimension. We therefore propose the architecture these results prescribe; raw image patches passed through a bottleneck embedding, followed by cascaded low-rank Volterra layers, which carry no activation function because each layer is nonlinear in its own right. To our knowledge this is the first pixel-space diffusion architecture whose mixing operators are Volterra layers throughout, with no attention, no convolution, no pretrained components, and no activation function on the residual path. On ImageNet $256 \\times 256$ and $512 \\times 512$, the resulting model is competitive with self-contained pixel-space diffusion at matched parameter and FLOP budgets.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10860

**作者：** Shuai Feng、Hao Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在连续 DAG 学习中引入矩阵值 closure logits：在对数空间反复平方构造多跳结构关系分数，并按路径长度预算做尺度归一化，与数据拟合、稀疏项和 DAGMA 式 barrier 一并监督，在稠密 ER 图上以默认超参和改进预算取得相对 DAGMA 的提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「路径证据在聚合前如何被显式表示」以及长环下归一化 logits 给出长度无关下界的思路，可能为 LVR 中多跳关系证据的传递监督与长推理链梯度衰减提供可核查的方法线索，但与视觉或多模态推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structurally Separated DAG Learning with Multi-Scale Normalized Closure

**abstract/A1：** Continuous DAG learning commonly enforces acyclicity through scalar functions of a weighted adjacency that aggregate evidence from weighted closed walks. We add a complementary layer: matrix-valued closure logits---explicit multi-hop structural relation scores for each ordered pair---supervised alongside data fit, sparsity, and a DAGMA-style barrier on the weighted adjacency. The distinction is not scalarization of the overall objective but how path evidence is represented and exposed before aggregation. SMNC (scale-normalized multi-scale closure) builds these scores on a structural gate by repeated squaring in log space and divides each scale by its path-length budget, counteracting product-style attenuation along long cycles; diagonal entries support node-wise cycle supervision and off-diagonals optional pairwise reachability cues. In the linear model, a bounded structure--magnitude factorization ties strong effective edges to strong gates; a nonlinear induced gate offers another construction with the same intent. For sufficiently strong cycles, normalized logits admit a length-independent lower bound; under a unique-active-cycle assumption, the hard final-scale readout yields a polynomial log-gate gradient factor rather than exponential product-style decay. On cue-free, unstandardized Gaussian linear and nonlinear ER benchmarks, these models improve over DAGMA, run with default hyperparameters at a reduced budget, on denser graphs and are close to it on sparse ones.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 Deletion Tuning：在 transformer block 的 gate projection 上学习二值掩码，仅置零不到 0.05% 的权重，即在 RLVR、监督微调和 on-policy 蒸馏三种后训练范式下达到与全量微调相当的效果，并用 stable rank、谱漂移和主权重重叠分析权重变化几何。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本后训练工作，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其「极稀疏掩码更新 + 显著减少遗忘」的训练线索，可供核查是否能在 VLM 的 RL 后训练中保住视觉感知与既有能力、并降低适配存储成本，权重变化几何分析也可能为 latent 状态漂移提供参照。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points. To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Online Imitation Learning for Stabilizing Vlasov--Poisson Plasmas

**abstract/A1：** We study the problem of controlling instability in the Vlasov--Poisson plasma systems, a fundamental challenge for nuclear fusion control. Motivated by the partial observability of plasma states in practice, we investigate imitation learning algorithms that learn from a fully-observable expert controller, but operate under macroscopic measurements. We theoretically establish a separation between online and offline imitation learning --- even a small behavior cloning error leads to error compounding that exponentially amplifies instability over time. By way of contrast, the online imitation learning loss can polynomially control the stability of rollout trajectories. We then propose a DAgger-style algorithm that learns the stabilizing controller under partial observability. Simulation results on a 1D Vlasov--Poisson system demonstrate that our algorithm can effectively stabilize plasma instabilities over longer time horizons than behavior cloning.

**内容简述：** 论文研究 LLM 强化学习后训练中同一批 rollout 多次梯度复用导致的失稳，提出 BRAT：用随概率比线性衰减、在信赖域边界归零的 token 级梯度权重，并对组中心奖励按最大幅值归一化以保持优势有界。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BRAT: Bounded Residual-Aligned Training for Stable Multi-Pass LLM Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning for large language model post-training often reuses each batch of sampled rollouts for several gradient passes to amortize the cost of generation. Under such multi-pass reuse, existing objectives fail in different ways: unclipped updates collapse as the policy drifts away from the sampling policy, adding a negative baseline avoids collapse but reinforces every sampled response, and PPO-style ratio clipping cuts off gradients abruptly. We first ask why reuse is fragile. Measuring how well an update estimated from a small rollout group aligns with the KL-regularized target on held-out rollouts of the same prompts, we find that this alignment drops by nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, suggesting that repeated passes largely overfit the sampled group. Motivated by this finding, we propose Bounded Residual-Aligned Training (BRAT), motivated by a proximal update toward a bounded reweighting of the sampling policy. BRAT assigns each token a gradient weight that decreases linearly with its probability ratio and vanishes at a trust-region boundary, and normalizes group-centered rewards by their maximum magnitude, keeping advantages zero-mean and bounded without extra hyperparameters. With four reuse passes, BRAT avoids training collapse, limits policy drift, and achieves higher average accuracy with lower seed variance on most benchmarks.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对持续模型合并中重复合并使旧任务分量纠缠、奇异几何被扭曲的问题，提出 GS3R：用紧凑的 restoration state 恢复保留的奇异几何、分离任务子空间并全局重分配可用秩，并引入 Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing 降低合并时显存开销。

**相关性简评：** 其基于 SVD 的子空间分离与跨任务秩再分配，可能为 latent 状态中任务相关子空间的隔离、抑制多次更新导致的信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但论文本身不涉及 VLM 推理，联系仅属方法层面的推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Robust and Efficient Continual Model Merging via Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration

**abstract/A1：** Continual model merging incrementally integrates task-specific models without revisiting past models or data. However, repeated merging entangles past task components and distorts their singular geometry, making balanced task-wise allocation increasingly difficult. We propose Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration (GS3R), which augments the merged update with a compact restoration state. At each merge, GS3R restores the retained singular geometry, separates task-wise subspaces, and globally reallocates the available rank across tasks fairly. To reduce merging-time memory overhead, we further introduce Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing (PRF). Experiments on vision, NLP, and multimodal benchmarks show that GS3R provides a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/ewsn1593/GS3R

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10908

**作者：** Xiaoxiao Li、Ruinan Jin、Lili Meng、Miaosen Wang、Athula Balachandran、Pei Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10908v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10908v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出双通道真实性协议 2CAP：用对比学习的相机指纹编码器搭配冻结语义编码器，经可学习可靠性加权的跨注意力融合完成四类真伪分类，并把通道对齐分数与 patch 级显著图作为特权上下文注入冻结 VLM，通过「观察-生成-精炼」循环产出带定位的解释。

**相关性简评：** 其可学习可靠性加权的通道融合与迭代精炼中显式证据注入方式，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、证据贡献分配与迭代推理提供可核查线索；但任务限于图像取证分类，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Real or Fake: A Dual-Channel Authenticity and Reasoning Protocol for Photographic Assessment

**abstract/A1：** Forensic verification has converged on a binary "real vs. fake" label that confates fully synthetic, tampered, and AI-retouched images despite their very different consequences. We argue that GenAI manipulations decompose along two complementary channels: a camera channel of sensor fingerprints (destroyed by neural processing), and a semantic channel of scene-level coherence (disrupted by content edits). Each manipulation type leaves a distinctive two-channel signature. We instantiate this taxonomy in 2CAP (2-Channel Authenticity Protocol), pairing a contrastively-trained camera encoder with a frozen semantic encoder to serve two applications on a shared backbone: (i) four-class authenticity classification via cross-attention fusion with learnable reliability weights; and (ii) evidence generation, where an authentic image serves as a reference for a query and the two encoders produce per-channel alignment scores together with a patch-level saliency map. These signals are supplied as privileged context to a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM) through an Observe-Generate-Refine loop, yielding explanations with localization without forensic fine-tuning. On a multi-source benchmark, 2CAP attains the best classification performance, including strong retouching detection where existing methods fail, and improves explanation quality.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 162. [Remembering to Reason: Structured Memory for Scene and Workflow Understanding in Robot-Assisted Surgery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10917v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10917

**作者：** Zhiran Zhang、Hu Wang、Yichen Wu、Yutong Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10917v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10917v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MemSurg，用带时间戳实体、位置、运动线索与交互摘要的结构化记忆图，结合时序/实体链接和任务自适应检索，为机器人辅助手术视频的场景与流程推理提供证据提示。

**相关性简评：** 其外部记忆图与检索式证据注入可为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选和跨帧推理状态持久化提供方法线索，但需核查检索内容是否被答案实际使用，且该工作并非 latent 状态生成研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Remembering to Reason: Structured Memory for Scene and Workflow Understanding in Robot-Assisted Surgery

**abstract/A1：** Surgical video understanding is an important foundation for intelligent assistance in robot-assisted surgery. Similar surgical views can reflect different actions or procedural stages. Interpreting these views requires access to earlier observations, yet frame-centric prompting leaves this history unavailable. We introduce MemSurg, a framework that remembers surgical observations before reasoning over them. Its structured memory graph stores timestamped entity categories, locations, motion cues, and interaction summaries. Chronological links preserve recent context, while entity-associated links connect recurring observations across the procedure. Task-adaptive retrieval then supplies evidence-grounded prompts for scene and workflow reasoning, supporting both frozen inference and memory-conditioned supervised fine-tuning. Evaluation on robot-assisted prostatectomy and two complementary surgical benchmarks shows a 10.43-percentage-point gain over SurgRAW with GPT-4o. Memory conditioning adds 6.52 points under matched Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuning, and an inference-time plug-in adds 7.04 points to EndoChat. These results support structured memory as a reusable source of procedural evidence for surgical video understanding. Our code will be publicly released.

</details>

### 163. [Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pre-training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10960v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10960

**作者：** Szymon Płotka、Gizem Mert、Pedro R. A. S. Bassi、Wenxuan Li、Zongwei Zhou、Anna Marcinkiewicz、Wiktoria Romańczyk、Jarosław B. Ćwikła、Łukasz Struski、Ewa Szczurek、Jacek Tabor、Arkadiusz Sitek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10960v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10960v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向 3D 医学影像的视觉-语言预训练框架 A²MoE：用依赖全局影像与预测解剖直方图的 router 在 patch 级做专家选择，并用可学习 organ query 做多尺度投影实现器官级细粒度对齐，在分割、分类、检测及跨模态泛化上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「organ query 抽取区域级 embedding + 解剖先验条件化路由」可能为 LVR 中如何在 latent 状态里筛选并保留任务必要的视觉证据、以及 latent 相似度中内容与位置因素提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pre-training

**abstract/A1：** Medical Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) leverages the semantic richness of radiology reports to learn 3D representations, yet current architectures remain fundamentally anatomy-agnostic. While clinical diagnostics rely on organ-specific context, standard encoders apply a uniform, dense parameterization to all volumetric patches, and existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers gate on isolated local features without explicit access to the organ composition of the scan or crop. We propose Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts (A$^{2}$MoE), a framework that incorporates anatomical inductive biases within the model's computational path. A$^{2}$MoE introduces two key components: (1) a Histogram Representation Router (HRR) that conditions expert selection on global visual context and a predicted anatomical composition histogram, encouraging anatomy-dependent expert weighting; and (2) an Organ-Query Multi-Scale Projector (OQMSP) that utilizes learnable queries to extract organ-level embeddings for fine-grained alignment without requiring manual annotations at inference. By routing at the patch level rather than the token level, A$^{2}$MoE reduces routing complexity by orders of magnitude while satisfying load balancing by construction. Pre-trained on over 60,000 multi-phase CT scans, A$^{2}$MoE achieves state-of-the-art performance across segmentation, classification, and detection benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our anatomically grounded inductive biases support robust generalization to MRI and ultrasound, establishing a scalable foundation for medical representation learning. The code is available at https://github.com/gmum/A2MoE.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 164. [Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10987v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10987

**作者：** Haoran Xu、Pragya Srivastava、Xinjie Liu、Siddhant Agarwal、Amy Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10987v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10987v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HQL，在离线强化学习中自动平衡一步与多步 TD：仅当 critic 认为数据集动作不劣于 BC 策略采样的 best-of-N 动作时才延长自举目标，否则回退到一步目标，使长时程任务的价值估计更准确。

**相关性简评：** 其「按 critic 估值决定是否延长自举时程」的门控规则可供核查 LVR 中推理步数扩展与 STOP 决策，以及多步轨迹训练里偏差与方差的权衡方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning

**abstract/A1：** Learning accurate off-policy state-action value functions (Q-functions) from offline datasets becomes harder as the task horizon grows. One-step temporal-difference (TD) learning bootstraps after every transition, so small per-step errors accumulate along the horizon, and early states can be badly misvalued even when the TD loss is small. Multi-step TD shortens this chain by following the dataset trajectory for several steps; however, since the behavior policy is often suboptimal, every followed action adds a bias, and no fixed number of steps suits a whole trajectory. In this paper, we propose Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning (HQL), a simple method that enables accurate long-horizon value learning by automatically balancing between one-step and multi-step returns. HQL extends a target through a dataset action only when the critic values it at least as highly as the best-of-N actions sampled from the BC policy, and otherwise falls back to a one-step target. We show that this rule is a principled off-policy correction that needs no action densities, which makes HQL compatible with expressive flow and diffusion policies. Experiments show that HQL avoids the failures of both one-step and multi-step TD on a combination-lock task across horizons, and outperforms prior horizon-reduction methods on long-horizon OGBench and OCBench tasks.

</details>

### 165. [DPDP: Diffusion Policy-Steered Diffusion Planner for Offline Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10993v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10993

**作者：** Ruyi An、Mingyuan Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10993v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10993v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DPDP，在离线 RL 中把扩散规划器与扩散策略在执行步结合：将规划的逆动力学执行器读作动作后验，用价值优化的扩散策略替换行为先验，并通过分数组合加 Langevin 修正的无训练采样，或以偏好目标摊销为单一扩散执行器。

**相关性简评：** 其「迭代采样摊销进单一执行器」与「分数/先验组合保留计划似然」的机制，可能为 latent 推理的少步化生成与多来源证据（价值与观测）融合提供方法线索；但论文属离线 RL 控制、无视觉推理评测，可供核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DPDP: Diffusion Policy-Steered Diffusion Planner for Offline Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** In offline reinforcement learning, diffusion models fill two roles with complementary strengths. Typically guided by a critic, a diffusion policy is value-aware and favors high-return, behavior-supported actions, but it is short-sighted: it never lays out the states it intends to visit. A diffusion planner is far-sighted, synthesizing such a long-horizon trajectory, but it is only behavior-driven at execution, realizing each planned transition using only offline behavior.Each is strong exactly where the other is weak. We introduce DPDP to bring them together at the planner's execution step, where a planned transition becomes an action. Reading the planner's inverse-dynamics executor as a posterior over actions: the environment's transition likelihood relates an action to the planned next state, while the behavioral prior determines its weight under the offline data. Replacing this prior with a value-optimized diffusion policy preserves the planned transition likelihood and favors valuable actions that can serve the plan. We target the resulting clean-action distribution in two ways. A training-free sampler composes policy and inverse-dynamics scores at matched action noise levels and applies Langevin correction; this route uses a shared action noise schedule and an approximately common terminal prior. A preference objective instead amortizes the transfer into a single diffusion executor. Across D4RL, DPDP improves the planner it builds on, staying competitive with reactive diffusion policies on locomotion and leading on long-horizon navigation.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages

</details>

### 166. [GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11005v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11005

**作者：** Ali Mohammadi Ruzbahani、Abbas Yazdinejad、Hadis Karimipour

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11005v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11005v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GradReason：每十个 epoch 调用一次 LLM，读取权重快照、epoch 平均梯度与验证指标，输出一段 Python 程序生成新权重并规划后续 epoch 为真实或「虚拟」，虚拟 epoch 需通过 5000 张留出图像的仅前向校验；在 CIFAR-10/100 上三种架构 120 次运行中减少约 33% 数据 epoch，但收益主要来自 LLM 自发采用的权重平均，固定规则同样能做到。

**相关性简评：** 与 VLM 推理主线不直接相关，可供核查的线索是「让 LLM 读取历史状态并生成状态更新与执行计划」这一机制，可能类比 LVR 中的 latent 状态更新与训练监督设计；其「找到规则后固定规则等效」的结论也提示此类 LLM 元决策的贡献分配需谨慎解读。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates

**abstract/A1：** Standard training recipes make a fixed number of passes over the training data, even when an epoch mostly adds mini-batch noise. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that reads the weight and gradient history of a run can replace some of these epochs with updates that compute no gradient and read no training image. In GradReason, an LLM agent is called every ten epochs. In a restricted sandbox, it analyses recent weight snapshots, epoch-mean gradients, and validation metrics, then submits a Python program that computes new weights and a plan marking each of the next ten epochs as data or virtual. A virtual epoch is kept only if it passes a forward-only check on 5,000 held-out validation images. In 120 runs on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with three architectures, Claude Opus 5.5 used 32.8% fewer data epochs than the 80-epoch recipe at 0.31 percentage points lower test accuracy (95% CI -0.72 to +0.09; 0.94 points on ResNet-18), on the recipe's own frontier of data against accuracy. Unprompted, Opus averaged recent weight snapshots in every run. This choice produced the savings: a fixed rule with the same acceptance check but extrapolations from prior work saved 5.4% of the data epochs, and the same rule with averaging added saved 25.0%. The LLM's contribution is to find a working update within a single run; once found, a fixed rule implements it equally well. An Opus run cost 0.68 USD, but at this scale the agent's latency exceeded the GPU time it saved.

</details>

### 167. [Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping for Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11024v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11024

**作者：** Zhe Chen、Xiaolin Zhou、Xiyang Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11024v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11024v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping：用隐藏状态分类器或冻结文本分类器把推理过程标为 reasoning／execution／revision 阶段，再按阶段与重复检测调整 token 级长度惩罚，在六个数学与科学基准上比较不同奖励权重配置。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本工作，无视觉或 latent 状态，但「按阶段分配奖励、区分有用计算与冗余检查」的训练期贡献分配思路，可能为 LVR 中各推理步（含停止与复查步）的监督权重与 token 预算控制提供可核查线索；增益有限（平均长度约降 3.13%），优先级偏低。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping for Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Extended reasoning can help language models solve complex problems, but long responses often contain both useful computations and redundant checks. Conventional length penalties encourage shorter responses without distinguishing the functions of intermediate steps. We propose Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping (PCRS), a framework that combines phase identification with training-time reward allocation. We investigate two classification routes: PCRS-H with a hidden-state classifier and PCRS-T with a frozen text classifier. Our main text classifier implementation assigns overlapping reasoning, execution, and revision labels to native chunks, then uses these labels and exact repetition to adjust existing token penalties. We compare the completed configurations on six mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks and examine four reward-weight settings with the text classifier. Compared with a baseline using token-level length penalties, the default text classifier configuration reduces mean response length by 3.13%; sampled Pass@1 is approximately 62.07% for both methods, while oracle Pass@16 rises from 86.08% to 87.67%. These results show how phase-informed penalty allocation can reduce output volume and improve multi-attempt coverage without inference-time classification.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 17 figures, 15 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 Virtual Task Prompting，在视觉主干外维护可扩展的虚拟任务集合，并用逐层可学习路由矩阵从共享虚拟状态读写任务自适应组合，以支持多任务场景理解并兼容预训练视觉基础模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享虚拟状态＋逐层读写路由」可供核查作为 latent 工作区与任务自适应状态更新的方法线索，但论文面向多任务视觉预测而非 VLM 推理，证据筛选与答案使用等联系仍需较多推断。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Virtual Task Prompting for Multi-Task Scene Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Multi-task scene understanding models typically rely on modified vision encoders or complex decoders for cross-task interaction, which limits their flexibility and compatibility with off-the-shelf vision foundation models (VFMs). We introduce Virtual Task Prompting (VTP), which frames multi-task prompting as retrieving task-adaptive compositions from a shared virtual state, where both the state and routing process are optimized in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, VTP maintains an expanded set of virtual tasks alongside the backbone. At each layer, learnable routing matrices read task-specific compositions as input to interact with image tokens and write the processed results back, forming explicit pathways that capture the intricacies among tasks outside the encoder. Since VTP keeps the backbone clean, it integrates seamlessly with pretrained VFMs, advancing the state of the art on Pascal-Context and NYUD-v2. Stress test on Taskonomy with 13 heterogeneous tasks further shows VTP's robustness in extreme settings. Ablations and analysis indicate that VTP's gains stem from adaptive routing rather than increased capacity. The project page is available at https://jacky1128.github.io/VTP/.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning for Adaptive Tokenization in Vision Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Adaptive tokenization aims to reduce the compute spent on uninformative image regions while preserving accuracy. Existing work relies on (i) fixed or frozen scoring rules, which cannot be trained toward the task loss, or (ii) discrete masks trained with straight-through estimators, which yield noisy gradients, while fully differentiable alternatives instead leave the pre-trained regular grid. We revisit adaptive tokenization from a regular-grid perspective and ask: can a two-scale quadtree be learned end-to-end without deleting a single token during training? We show that one coarse token and its four fine children can be made the two endpoints of a single continuous interpolation. We introduce Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning (\\dvsp{}), which keeps four \\emph{virtual slots} per $2{\\times}2$ region and blends their token features and attention mass with a single weight $α$, exactly reproducing the discrete grid at $α\\in \\{0,1\\}$. On COCO detection with EVA-02-B, \\dvsp{} retains $97.9\\%$ of dense Box AP while removing $64.2\\%$ of visual tokens, giving a $1.61\\times$ end-to-end speedup, and it outperforms entropy-based APT, DART, and uniform lower-resolution dense adaptation at matched budgets; these gains depend on the conserved attention mass, whose removal costs $1.59$ Box AP. On a frozen Segmenter it also improves Cityscapes mIoU, and on frozen DeiT backbones it exceeds entropy selection at identical per-image token counts.

</details>

### 170. [When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11079v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11079

**作者：** Yehong Jiang、Yen-Kuang Chen、Xinmin Tian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11079v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11079v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究低比特（2–4 bit）训练后量化中校准数据的作用，提出 FragCal-DC：先用二比特扫描找出全精度精度保留较差的任伤族，再用其训练文档补充通用文本校准，并在 6 个稠密模型、10 个任务及 70B 模型上比较六种量化方法。

**相关性简评：** 任务相关校准数据能恢复下游精度、且重建误差与精度增益不一致，可供核查 LVR 中压缩 latent 状态或视觉证据时如何选择校准/监督信号并避免以重建误差代替任务效果。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization

**abstract/A1：** Low-bit post-training quantization reduces language-model memory but can sharply degrade downstream task accuracy. Calibration usually relies on generic text, but when task-informed data recover accuracy and which quantizers benefit remain poorly understood. We introduce FragCal-DC, which supplements generic text with training documents from task families with low retention of full-precision accuracy in a two-bit scan. We use a two- to four-bit sweep to locate functional regimes and four-seed calibration comparisons to evaluate six data-dependent methods across six dense models (1.7B-8B) and ten tasks. At their lowest tested functional bit widths, iterative SignRound V2 and OmniQuant improve at two bits, whereas single-pass GPTQ and AWQ show small mean responses at three bits. At two bits, SignRound V2 gains 1.83 percentage points in mean ten-task accuracy over generic-text calibration across six models. At 70 billion parameters, GPTQ and SignRound V2 both improve at two bits, with functional generic-calibration baselines. For two-bit SignRound V2, task-level controls show that recovery concentrates on families included in calibration, while incorrect answer designations retain about 90% of the mean accuracy gain. Changes in reconstruction error do not consistently track accuracy gains. These findings support task-informed calibration as a design principle for preserving downstream accuracy in low-bit quantization.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text, 47 pages total including references, checklist, and appendices

</details>

### 171. [Does Pose Encoding Matter? Analyzing Geometric Representations for Discrete Motion Vocabulary Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11093v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11093

**作者：** Amir Kimiyaie、Nahal Mafi、Hamed Tabkhi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.DM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11093v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11093v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文比较四种人体姿态几何编码（高斯基关节热图、root-relative 位置、6D 旋转、冗余全运动学编码）训练球面码本 VQ-VAE 运动 tokenizer，并在改变码本大小、时间步长与码维时，除重构外考察码本利用率与基于熵的「有效词表大小」。

**相关性简评：** 「输入几何一阶决定潜空间可离散化程度」及熵式有效词表度量，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示几何、容量利用率与信息坍缩诊断提供可供核查的评估线索；但研究对象是人体运动而非视觉推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does Pose Encoding Matter? Analyzing Geometric Representations for Discrete Motion Vocabulary Learning

**abstract/A1：** Compressing continuous human motion into a finite vocabulary of discrete tokens is now the first stage of many motion understanding and generation pipelines. Vector quantization partitions a latent space into Voronoi cells around a finite codebook, but the geometry of that latent space is inherited from the input pose encoding, and it is unclear which encoding admits an efficient discretization. We study four encodings that place skeletal motion in different geometric spaces: Gaussian joint heatmaps on the pixel lattice, which we show to be a morphological dilation of the joint point set by a quadratic structuring function; root-relative joint positions in Euclidean space; local joint rotations on $\\SO$ through a continuous 6D embedding; and a redundant full kinematic encoding. For each, we train VQ-VAE tokenizers whose codebooks lie on the unit hypersphere, varying codebook size, temporal stride, and code dimension. Beyond reconstruction, we measure codebook utilization and the effective vocabulary size, i.e., the number of equiprobable spherical Voronoi cells with the same entropy as the observed token distribution. Rotation and position encodings keep converting additional codewords into effective vocabulary, whereas the full kinematic encoding saturates at a few hundred effective cells and heatmaps at fewer than sixty. The smallest code dimension gives the highest utilization for three of the four encodings, and the effect of temporal stride depends on the encoding. Encodings of the same pose family can thus yield effective vocabularies differing by an order of magnitude, a difference that reconstruction loss alone does not reveal, which points to input geometry as a first-order design choice in motion tokenization.

</details>

### 172. [Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11102v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11102

**作者：** Min Huang、Mingyan Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11102v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11102v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文用配对比较考察数学任务中提交格式、草稿复用、候选答案可得性及保留片段位置如何影响 LLM 的最终正确率，并报告各因素的条件性贡献。

**相关性简评：** 其固定材料、分离「草稿」与「候选」贡献的实验范式，可供核查 LVR 中生成状态是否被答案实际使用及贡献分配；但属纯文本提示效应，与视觉状态和 latent 表示的关联需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance

**abstract/A1：** Mathematical performance depends on how a language model receives information, uses generated text and submits an answer. We study these dependencies through paired comparisons that separate submission requirements, draft reuse and candidate availability. On 65 development problems, an instruction permitting continued derivation produced no valid final answers in 390 short-output calls; a single-line submission instruction produced 390 format-valid outputs, including 389 parseable answers. Under the fixed submission protocol, 198 problems with failed initial submissions were answered correctly in 9.09p of cases with the question alone, 33.84p with its draft, 46.46p with candidates, and 59.60p with both. Drafts added 13.13 percentage points with candidates fixed, and candidates added 25.76 points with drafts fixed; both effects were significant after Holm correction and were subadditive on the accuracy scale. Retaining a trailing excerpt outperformed retaining a leading excerpt of similar average length by 10.10 points Holm-adjusted p 0.027. A second completion model showed the same directions of input effects on the fixed materials. In a cohort with parseable initial submissions, candidates added no correct answers when the previous draft was supplied, but added 27 points when it was absent. These results establish a conditional value of generated text: a failed submission can leave useful material, whose contribution depends on what else is supplied and what is retained.

</details>

### 173. [Compositional Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Stage LLM Cascades](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11114v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11114

**作者：** Yuxia Sun、Jiahuang Wang、Haoting Liu、Zhiwei Huang、Tingrui Pei、Saiqin Long

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11114v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11114v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CompCRC，将多阶段 LLM 级联中「接受错误答案」的风险分解为各阶段的加性贡献，通过冻结候选预算分配与接受阈值、独立数据选择并在留出数据上认证，给出有限样本下不超过全局风险预算的保证，并在 MMLU、GSM8K、HellaSwag 上检验各阶段局部认证与成本收益。

**相关性简评：** 分阶段风险预算与接受阈值的选择/认证，可为 LVR 中「何时停止并输出答案」的 STOP 决策与各次 look/think 贡献归因提供可核查的校准思路，但其为纯文本级联设定，与视觉证据筛选和 latent 状态的关系需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compositional Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Stage LLM Cascades

**abstract/A1：** Multi-stage large language model (LLM) cascades balance accuracy and inference cost, but reliable deployment also requires controlling error risk and identifying its sources across stages. We propose Compositional Conformal Risk Control (CompCRC), a risk-control framework for pre-specified multi-stage LLM cascades. We decompose the risk of accepting incorrect answers into additive stage-wise contributions over the full query population, linking local risk budgets to a system-level guarantee. CompCRC constructs and freezes candidate budget allocations and acceptance thresholds, selects one candidate on independent data, and certifies its stage-wise risk contributions on separate held-out data. Under conditional exchangeability, we establish a finite-sample guarantee: the marginal expected accepted-error risk of the complete deployment procedure does not exceed the global risk budget. At the reported comparison budget of $α=0.45$, all three stages of CompCRC pass their local checks on MMLU, GSM8K, and HellaSwag. Compared with Global-CRC, which passes system-level risk certification at the same budget, CompCRC reduces observed accepted-error risk by 1.33--2.00 percentage points, improves final accuracy by 0.67--2.00 percentage points, and reduces weighted inference cost by 30.37\\% on HellaSwag. The selected cost-based budget allocation also improves accuracy per unit cost by 10.6\\%--46.7\\% over uniform allocation. Further experiments show that stage-wise statistics identify stages that fail local certification checks, providing diagnostic information alongside system-level risk control.

</details>

### 174. [From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11136v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11136

**作者：** Changran Liu、Qi Wu、Wenchao Ma、Sharon X. Huang、Haomiao Jiang

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 用 LLM agent 调用游戏构建工具自动生成可执行环境与任务，再由基于特权模拟器状态的程序化专家产出对齐的指令、渲染观测与键鼠动作，以 150.3 小时合成 Minecraft/Roblox 数据做行为克隆，训练 4B 的 VLA 游戏策略 Script2Play。

**相关性简评：** 研究目标是游戏动作策略而非视觉推理状态，但其「特权模拟器状态→自动对齐监督」的合成数据管线，可能为 LVR 中可验证中间监督与推理轨迹构造提供借鉴线索，需核查其标注方式能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Training vision-language-action (VLA) models to follow gameplay instructions across diverse games is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. We introduce a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations. An LLM-powered agent uses game-building tools to construct executable environments and tasks targeting specified skills. Programmatic experts then use privileged simulator state to generate aligned instructions, rendered observations, and keyboard and mouse actions. We train our game policy, Script2Play, by post-training a 4B vision-language model with behavior cloning on 150.3 hours of synthetic Minecraft and Roblox gameplay, without human gameplay demonstrations or reinforcement learning. Evaluation on multiple public game benchmarks demonstrates that Script2Play follows gameplay instructions effectively and generalizes across game engines, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted synthetic supervision.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Graphene 轻量级图像超分架构，包含受 Ising 模型启发的局部特征细化块（复用注意力输出与 pre-softmax logits 构造带符号 token 耦合，做展开式平均场更新加门控残差修正）与跨阶段 History Attention，在更少参数、FLOPs 和延迟下提升超分效果。

**相关性简评：** 其带符号耦合的展开式平均场迭代更新与门控残差修正，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的迭代更新与收敛式设计提供结构线索；History Attention 同位置跨阶段复用表示也可供核查 latent 相似度中深度与缓存因素，但任务是图像超分，不涉及推理决策或证据获取。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Graphene: A Lightweight Transformer with Ising Mean-Field Refinement for Image Super-Resolution

**abstract/A1：** This paper proposes Graphene, a lightweight image super-resolution architecture with two complementary feature refinement mechanisms: Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement using an Ising Refinement Block (IRB) and stage-history-based feature refinement using a History Attention (HistAttn) module. The IRB reuses attention output features and pre-softmax attention logits to construct signed pairwise token couplings within each local window, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and refines features through a gated residual correction. These signed couplings allow alignment and opposition between latent spins to modulate local feature refinement. HistAttn attends over the current stage output and earlier representations at the same token position and adaptively blends the current stage output with a history-weighted feature aggregate without adding spatial pairwise attention. On Urban100 at $\\times4$, Graphene and Graphene-light improve over IET and IET-light by 0.24 dB and 0.38 dB, respectively, with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 78.4%/71.5% lower latency, and 76.0%/85.5% lower peak memory. Real-world SR comparisons further show that Graphene recovers fine details and preserves textures across diverse degradations. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/Graphene

</details>

### 176. [SurgWorld: Learning Surgical Representations Beyond Observation via Latent Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11140v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11140

**作者：** Jingkun Yue、Pengxiang Wang、Siqi Zhang、Zinan Jia、Yiyao Zhang、Huihuan Xu、Yichang Hao、Xiaohong Liu、Zongbo Han、Guangyu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11140v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11140v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SurgWorld 手术视频自监督表征框架：把空间或时间偏移视为伪动作，从部分观测预测目标的 latent 表示（OSDM），并用 patch 级几何视觉相似度（GVS）对齐预测与目标表示的关系结构，在多教师聚合训练下于 17 个手术基准做迁移评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「以偏移为条件预测 latent 状态」与 patch 级关系结构对齐，可能为 LVR 的状态更新监督和 latent 相似度的位置/结构度量提供核查线索，但属手术视频表征预训练，未涉及推理期 latent 生成或答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SurgWorld: Learning Surgical Representations Beyond Observation via Latent Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Surgical procedures are inherently partially observable, requiring surgeons to continuously infer evolving anatomical dynamics and future surgical states beyond the current observation. However, existing self-supervised learning methods primarily learn from observed surgical videos through masked reconstruction or predicting representations within the camera's current field of view, lacking the capability to explicitly model the out-of-sight surgical dynamics. Inspired by latent predictive world models, we introduce SurgWorld, a video-native, self-supervised framework for surgical representation learning, which treats a specified spatial or temporal shift as a pseudo-action and learns to predict the target latent representation from a partial observation. Specifically, we propose Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling (OSDM) as the pretraining objective for predicting representations conditioned on relative spatio-temporal shifts. We further regularize the learned latent dynamics from OSDM with a Geometric Visual Similarity (GVS) objective by aligning patch-level relational structures between predicted and target representations, preserving spatial geometry and local visual coherence for dense perception. These two objectives are integrated through an agglomerative training framework that consolidates complementary supervisory signals from multiple teachers to learn a unified latent representation of surgical dynamics and visual geometry. Extensive transfer learning experiments on 17 surgical benchmarks show that SurgWorld consistently outperforms existing vision foundation models across surgical workflow recognition, fine-grained action understanding, and dense visual perception. We further conduct tailored qualitative and quantitative analyses, demonstrating that SurgWorld effectively captures surgical dynamics beyond the directly observed context through latent prediction.

**comment/C1：** This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DISCOVER 在线数据发现框架：将多模态样本池语义聚类并少量查询以获初始奖励观测，训练中借稀疏奖励反馈迁移估计未标注样本效用，并按奖励方差与难度挑选高价值 prompt 送标注，预算耗尽后转为效用回放。

**相关性简评：** 其按奖励方差与难度估计样本效用、在有限预算下选择 rollout 的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 训练中轨迹采样与监督预算的分配，但论文未涉及 latent 状态生成或视觉证据筛选，迁移需另行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DISCOVER: Online Variance-Guided Data Discovery for Budgeted Multimodal GRPO

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in reinforcement learning have made verifiable rewards a central post-training paradigm for improving multimodal reasoning. However, methods such as GRPO remain data- and compute-inefficient, spending rollout and annotation budget on prompts that provide little learning signal. We propose DISCOVER, an online data-discovery framework for budgeted multimodal GRPO that enables vision-language models to dynamically identify prompts that are most useful for the current policy. DISCOVER first organizes the multimodal sample pool into semantic clusters and queries a small set of density-diverse representative samples to obtain initial reward observations. During training, it estimates the utility of unannotated samples by transferring sparse reward feedback from queried samples. Since sample utility changes as the policy evolves, DISCOVER dynamically updates these estimates with recency-weighted rollout observations. It then selects only high-utility prompts for annotation using a policy-conditioned score that accounts for reward variance and difficulty. Once the discovery budget is exhausted, DISCOVER continues with utility-based replay. Experiments on ViRL39K and VLAA-Thinking with Qwen3-VL-2B show that DISCOVER substantially improves multimodal mathematical reasoning under a strict 10% unique-sample budget, outperforming budget-matched random selection, hard-example sampling, full-pool GRPO under the same training-step budget, and online selection baselines. Ablations further validate the importance of semantic coverage, online reward transfer, and stable discovery cadence, establishing DISCOVER as a practical framework for data-efficient multimodal RL post-training.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Project page: https://peymoon.github.io/discover/

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Layers Are Equal in Image-to-Video Transfer

**abstract/A1：** Parameter-efficient image-to-video transfer adapts frozen image foundation models to video via lightweight trainable adapters. Existing methods insert the same adapter at every transformer layer, implicitly assuming all layers require equal temporal modeling. A layer-wise sensitivity analysis across four video-native model families and two pretraining paradigms reveals that this assumption is wrong: temporal sensitivity increases with depth, and the pretraining paradigm determines its growth profile. Vision-only models exhibit a gradual rise, while vision-language models show early suppression followed by late recovery. This finding motivates STRAP, a training-free adapter placement rule that derives a spatial-to-temporal transition boundary from a paradigm-matched video model. Spatial adapters are assigned before this boundary and temporal adapters after it, without modifying the adapter architecture itself. On four fine-grained action recognition benchmarks, STRAP improves accuracy by up to 11.8% over uniform placement, reduces trainable parameters by 29 to 48%, and lowers inference time by up to 10%. On standard benchmarks, it matches accuracy with fewer parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/th-nesh/STRAP.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track)

</details>

### 179. [Full Fine-Tuning is not the Problem: Why Adam Fails and SGD Succeeds in Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11152v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11152

**作者：** Nairouz Mrabah、Ismail Ben Ayed、Eric Granger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11152v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11152v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 11 个数据集、3 种 CLIP 骨干和 5 种 shot 设置下发现：少样本全参数微调配 SGD 反而优于代表性 PEFT，而 Adam/AdamW 会崩溃；作者将原因归于少样本二阶矩低估导致的自适应更新过大，并以理论分析和插值、曲率探针佐证。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 推理期状态生成无直接关联，但其「少样本下 Adam 预条件不可靠」的诊断可供核查：在少量样本上训练 latent 推理适配器或轻量推理模块时，优化器与更新尺度可能同样影响结果。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Full Fine-Tuning is not the Problem: Why Adam Fails and SGD Succeeds in Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Few-shot CLIP adaptation is often treated as a parameterization problem. Full fine-tuning is assumed to overfit, so parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are preferred. In this paper, we show that this conclusion conflates parameterization with optimization. Across 11 datasets, 3 CLIP backbones, and 5 shot levels, dense full fine-tuning with plain SGD outperforms representative PEFT methods under the reported evaluation protocol, whereas Adam/AdamW collapses. We trace this collapse to unreliable support-set preconditioning. The few-shot second moment systematically underestimates the corresponding full-data statistic, already at initialization. Adam's inverse-square-root normalization converts this error into an oversized adaptive update. Matching Adam's first-step update budget to SGD resolves most of the collapse, whereas numerator-side alignment does not explain the failure. Shampoo and SOAP also fail, so richer preconditioning alone does not resolve the problem. Theory formalizes how few-shot estimation error is amplified into unsafe updates. SGD succeeds because it avoids unreliable preconditioners and stays close to pretrained CLIP. Interpolation probes show low-loss connections along tested directions, and curvature probes show favorable directional curvature. These results identify optimizer-induced preconditioning, not dense full fine-tuning itself, as the main source of failure in few-shot CLIP adaptation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 180. [The Race Is Decided Early! A Kernel Law Predicts Lock-In in Majority-Vote Test-Time RL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11165v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11165

**作者：** Jaeho Hwang、Sehong Park、Daejin Choi、Uiwon Hwang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11165v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11165v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析多数投票奖励的测试时强化学习中「每个问题锁定到某个答案」的现象，提出锁定由训练早期采样噪声驱动的短程「竞赛」决定，并给出基于初始 logit 差与参数核的闭式概率预测，在 LoRA 实验中用冻结于初始值的核在训练前预测锁定答案。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本 TTRL，但其「用初始状态与参数核几何预测轨迹早期锁定」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 轨迹或答案承诺能否在推理早期通过与表示耦合关系预测，以及核外溢效应如何影响状态更新与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Race Is Decided Early! A Kernel Law Predicts Lock-In in Majority-Vote Test-Time RL

**abstract/A1：** Test-time reinforcement learning with majority-vote rewards trains a language model on unlabeled questions by rewarding the samples that agree with its most frequent answer. During training, each question locks into one answer, on hard questions often a wrong one, but which answer it locks into is known only after training. In this paper, we show that this outcome is decided early, in a short race driven by sampling noise between the answers that are close at the start, and we derive the probability of each outcome. With a separate logit for each answer, the runner-up wins with a normal tail probability of the initial gap, scaled by an explicit noise constant. In a network, however, the answer logits depend on shared parameters, and through the kernel of these parameters the updates of the trailing answers also change the gap of the two leaders. This spillover shifts the boundary between the starts won by each leader, and a closed form computes the shifted probability from a kernel probe and the start logits. In LoRA experiments with three models from two families, predictions made before training with the kernel frozen at its start value forecast which answer each question locks into better than a logistic model refitted on the outcomes, although they use no fitted constants. The closed form matches these predictions on the runs in which a check before training finds that the two leaders stay above the other answers, and it explains why a law that ignores the spillover needs a strongly inflated step.

</details>

### 181. [TEAM: Topology-Aware, Semantic-Sensitive, General Transformer for Multimodal-Attributed Graphs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11189v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11189

**作者：** Yushuo Li、Xunkai Li、Zhengyu Wu、Ronghua Li、Guoren Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11189v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11189v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TEAM，面向多模态属性图，用节点-模态 token 构建模态编码树做语义证据获取，并以 MSCT 编码跨节点跨模态交互，避免过早合并为整节点特征。

**相关性简评：** 其保留模态 token 至读出、并按语义强弱扩展证据范围的做法，可能与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与模态信息坍缩问题相关，可供核查；但图学习设定与 VLM 推理差距较大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TEAM: Topology-Aware, Semantic-Sensitive, General Transformer for Multimodal-Attributed Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) organize heterogeneous data in graphs whose nodes are characterized by modalities such as text and images rather than traditional unimodal attributes. However, many representative MAG methods organize propagation around node-level states and topology-defined neighborhoods, which can obscure fine-grained modality contributions: a bounded neighborhood may contain semantically weak evidence, while compatible context need not be confined to it. To address both limitations, we propose TEAM, a modality-centric framework that constructs and encodes graph context with node-modality tokens rather than treating each node as a single interaction unit. Concretely, TEAM unfolds the local topology into a Modality Encoding Tree and performs tree-anchored semantic evidence acquisition, organizing local structural context while expanding the accessible evidence space outside the constructed local Tree. We further introduce the Modality-Source Context Transformer (MSCT), which encodes the selected node-modality tokens and coordinates interactions among modality-source groups. By retaining textual and visual attributes as separate interaction units until readout, it supports fine-grained cross-node cross-modal exchange without first collapsing them into whole-node features. Across the evaluated baselines, TEAM attains the highest reported mean on all graph-learning metrics, all three G2Text metrics, and both G2Image metrics. On Toys, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 3.37 and 2.93 percentage points in Accuracy and Macro-F1, respectively.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 182. [Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression for Extreme Image Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11200v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11200

**作者：** Bingxin Wang、Yuan Lan、Yang Xiang、Yiqing Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11200v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11200v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SAVAR，一个面向 0.01 bpp 以下极端低码率的生成式图像编解码器：基于 VAR 传输早期尺度 token 与紧凑 caption，用保留尺度重建的部分 VQ-VAE latent 同时初始化序列起始状态并条件化 caption 嵌入，从而在保持源一致性的同时快速重建。

**相关性简评：** 该文不研究视觉推理，但其把同一 partial latent 拆成「序列起始初始化」与「条件注入」两种角色，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的初始化方式与视觉证据条件注入的分离设计提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression for Extreme Image Compression

**abstract/A1：** In the extreme-low bitrate range below $0.01$ bpp, image compression becomes a constrained generation problem: the reconstruction depends on inferring plausible missing details while staying close to the input image. Autoregressive token models provide an efficient coarse-to-fine prior for this setting, but the transmitted early-scale tokens often leave object identity and texture underdetermined, which can lead to source-inconsistent reconstructions. We introduce Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression (SAVAR), a generative codec built on Visual Autoregressive (VAR) modeling. SAVAR transmits early-scale tokens and a compact caption. The tokens provide image-specific layout information, while the caption supplies global semantics. SAVAR reconstructs a partial VQ-VAE latent from the retained scales, maps it to the start-of-sequence initialization, and uses the same latent to condition the caption embedding before adaptive layer normalization, separating two roles that are typically driven by a shared condition in VAR-style generation. On the Kodak and CLIC2020 datasets in the extreme-low range, SAVAR reduces perceptual distortion relative to matched ARPC retained-scale operating points, lowering LPIPS by about $8$--$9\\%$ and DISTS by up to $22\\%$ at a lower bpp. It reconstructs a $512 \\times 512$ image in about $218$ ms on one NVIDIA L20X GPU, retaining fast autoregressive decoding in the evaluated setting.

</details>
