### 183. [Not Yet in the Profile: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic User Profiling by Learning from Future Interactions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11204v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11204

**作者：** Jieyong Kim、Neil Shah、Dong Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11204v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11204v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UAPM，用 Profile、Buffer 与 Rulebook 三部分管理动态用户画像，把已确认的用户特征与尚未证实的模糊新行为分开存放，并以「未来交互特权」的双阶段在线策略蒸馏（POPD-DS）训练管理器。

**相关性简评：** 其「确认状态与待证证据分离、模糊时暂缓写入」的更新规则，以及训练期用未来信息作特权监督，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供借鉴线索，需核查该不确定性判定与蒸馏信号能否迁移到多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not Yet in the Profile: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic User Profiling by Learning from Future Interactions

**abstract/A1：** On the Web, user profiling builds compact user representations from interaction histories for efficient personalization, and dynamic user profiling updates them as users' behavior and preferences change. However, new user behavior can be ambiguous, and its interpretation differs across users. To address this, we introduce Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Profile Manager (UAPM), which separates the claims in a user profile from interpretations of new behavior that are not yet confirmed, through a Profile, a Buffer, and a Rulebook. UAPM records user-specific interpretation and update rules in the Rulebook, keeps ambiguous evidence in the Buffer outside the Profile as evidence for later decisions, and writes supported general and situational characteristics to the Profile. We train UAPM with Privileged On-Policy Distillation with Dual Specialization (POPD-DS), which learns from recorded future interactions during training without access to them at deployment. Its first stage, Dual Specialization, distills a stronger model into a current-only Student and a future-informed model that becomes the Teacher. In the second stage, privileged on-policy distillation (POPD), only the fixed Teacher receives future interactions and guides the Student's own management decisions alongside task rewards. Experiments on three Web personalization tasks show that UAPM outperforms multiple baselines under the same downstream input budget, improving on the best same-budget baseline by up to 5%.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11217

**作者：** Jiafa Ruan、Zican Qiao、Zongxin Yang、Ruijie Quan、Yi Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、q-bio.GN

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11217v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11217v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** scBIG++ 提出覆盖全部蛋白编码基因的单细胞扰动响应预测框架：用基因关系聚类与表达相关的动态软子模块刻画同一干预下的细胞异质性，在对照细胞间交换对应基因组信息，并以细胞表示初始化 latent flow、由池化群体摘要与扰动表示条件化生成表达谱，在六类遗传与化学扰动设定上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享结构 + 群体上下文条件化 latent flow」的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何用外部证据筛选、初始化并更新 latent 推理状态提供方法线索，但生成状态是否承载可复用的推理信息尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** scBIG++: Learning Across Genes and Cells to Predict Single-Cell Perturbation Responses

**abstract/A1：** Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic and chemical interventions supports gene-function discovery and regulatory analysis. Existing studies often focus only on highly variable genes, restricting the expression changes available for downstream analysis. Cells exposed to the same intervention can also show heterogeneous expression responses, with coordinated gene programs active to different degrees. We propose scBIG++, a full-gene perturbation prediction framework that models this heterogeneity by connecting expression-adaptive gene modules with population-conditioned generation. To preserve shared gene structure while accommodating cellular variation, Gene-Relation Clustering organizes genes into common windows, within which Dynamic SoftSub learns expression-dependent submodule memberships. This shared organization enables Set-GCAE to exchange information about corresponding gene groups across control cells, placing individual representations in their source-population context. The cell representations initialize a latent flow, while their pooled summary and the perturbation representation condition response generation. Generated states are decoded into expression profiles covering all assayed protein-coding genes retained after preprocessing, supporting comprehensive analysis of perturbation-induced expression changes. Experiments across six genetic and chemical settings spanning 6,539--19,451 genes demonstrate competitive perturbation-effect recovery and full-gene expression reconstruction under unseen targets and combinations, cross-cell-line transfer, and held-out compounds. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/ttruan2426-dot/scBIG.

</details>

### 185. [EbbFlow: PINN-Inspired Progressive Curriculum for MeanFlow Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11220v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11220

**作者：** Mengfan Yuan、Xunheng Kuang、Jianbin Chen、Lei He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11220v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11220v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 MeanFlow 的时间坐标解释为配点，区分对角线采样的边界目标与有限区间的微分一致性目标，提出 Temporal Supervision Allocation 课程——先只用对角线监督，再引入内点并逐步扩大区间长度，并采用左锚定区间律保持覆盖；损失、目标、骨干与推理流程均不变，在 ImageNet 256 类条件 DiT-B/2 上对比一步与两步采样 FID。

**相关性简评：** 该文属少步图像生成，与 LVR 主线无直接关系；但其按训练阶段安排「端点目标 vs 区间一致性目标」的监督分配，可能为 latent 推理轨迹中中间状态监督与最终答案监督的配比与课程设计提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EbbFlow: PINN-Inspired Progressive Curriculum for MeanFlow Training

**abstract/A1：** MeanFlow learns interval-average velocity for few-step generation, but its fixed temporal sampler mixes diagonal and interior supervision throughout training. We interpret temporal coordinates as collocation points: diagonal samples provide a stochastic boundary target, whereas finite intervals supply a differential-consistency target. The diagonal fraction controls how often the consistency component appears, while interval length enters its gradient through an explicit factor. Motivated by this distinction, EbbFlow uses Temporal Supervision Allocation (TSA) to schedule the diagonal fraction and interval geometry. It starts with diagonal supervision, then admits interior samples and expands their maximum interval; a left-anchored interval law preserves coverage across time. The per-sample loss, target, backbone, and inference procedure remain unchanged. In matched class-conditional ImageNet $256\\times 256$ runs without classifier-free guidance (DiT-B/2, one training seed per method, 400k updates), EbbFlow achieves 50k-sample FID of 39.65 at one network evaluation and 36.02 at two-evaluation ODE sampling, versus 44.82 and 39.86 for MeanFlow. Gradient probes show a mid-training difference in component geometry. Ablations support allocation scheduling and left-anchored intervals, although a fixed full-horizon variant performs better at one evaluation. These results suggest that temporal sampling is a useful training control whose benefits depend on the inference protocol.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 186. [Do Feature Interactions Break Explainability? Provable Explanations for Any-Order Neural Additive Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11224v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11224

**作者：** Idan Refaeli、Yizhak Yisrael Elboher、Guy Katz、Shahaf Bassan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11224v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11224v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 本文研究带受限特征交互的神经网络中可证明最小且充分的解释子集计算：先证明即使常数阶交互该问题也为 Σ₂^P-hard，再在交互结构稀疏与更强交互感知充分性两种设定下给出可 tractable 的算法，并在实验中获得更小、更快的解释。

**相关性简评：** 其「最小充分特征子集」与交互结构决定的可计算性，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与基于充分性的停止判断提供方法线索，可供核查其交互假设能否对应多模态 patch 或实体组合。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Feature Interactions Break Explainability? Provable Explanations for Any-Order Neural Additive Models

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc explanation methods for neural networks are often heuristic and lack provable guarantees. A common alternative to such methods that was studied in recent years is to compute a cardinally-minimal subset of input features that is provably sufficient to determine the model's prediction. For general neural networks, however, finding such explanations is computationally intractable. In contrast, recent work showed that this problem becomes more tractable for a particular family of neural networks, namely neural additive models (NAMs), though standard NAMs are highly restrictive because they exclude feature interactions altogether. In this work, we study the computation of provably minimal and sufficient explanations for neural networks with restricted feature interactions, bridging the gap between fully general neural networks and purely additive models. We first prove that even with constant-order interactions, the problem is $Σ\_2^P$-hard, implying that worst-case exponential complexity is unavoidable. We then identify two provably tractable settings: one based on sparsity in the interaction structure and another based on a stronger interaction-aware notion of sufficiency. Under either of these settings, we develop algorithms that compute provable explanations for neural networks with any-order interactions while retaining much of the computational efficiency of additive models. Empirically, we show that these explanations are significantly smaller and faster to obtain than those produced by standard algorithms, while being derived from models that achieve much higher accuracy than standard NAMs. Overall, our results help expand the class of neural networks that admit efficient provable explanations, while clarifying the fundamental role of feature interactions in shaping their complexity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 36 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 187. [TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11232v1>)

**作者：** Suxin Ji、Hungtao Wan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

**内容简述：** 针对 DPO 序列级目标无法定位局部不安全模式的问题，提出 TLRS-DPO：把被拒响应上的 policy-reference log-ratio 转成 token 级风险分数，配合课程式补偿强度调度与只惩罚高风险 token 的自适应筛选，作为标准 DPO 训练器的即插即用改动。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a simple and widely used alternative to RLHF for aligning large language models (LLMs), but its sequence-level objective cannot precisely locate or suppress the local patterns that make an otherwise acceptable response unsafe or undesirable. We propose TLRS-DPO (Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization), which augments DPO with fine-grained token-level control while remaining fully offline and reference-based. TLRS-DPO introduces a token-level robust compensation term that converts the policy-reference log-ratio on rejected responses into localized risk scores, a curriculum-style schedule that gradually increases the strength of this compensation during training, and a risk-adaptive screening mechanism that selectively penalizes only high-risk tokens instead of entire sequences. This design bridges sequence-level preference fitting and token-level behavior control, and can be implemented as a drop-in modification to standard DPO trainers. Empirically, TLRS-DPO improves alignment quality and safety-relevant behavior with minimal impact on helpfulness compared to strong DPO baselines.

</details>

### 188. [Primitives and Paths: Predicting What Post-Training Can Do from What the Base Model Already Has](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11260v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11260

**作者：** Anqi Qu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11260v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11260v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出由「有效完整解支持」与「原子技能覆盖」构成的二维状态空间，将后训练可训练性分为放大、组合受限和获取受限三类，并用小型语言模型的合成组合任务检验测量协议。

**相关性简评：** 其关于基础模型技能覆盖与完整轨迹可采样性的区分，可能为判断 LVR 轨迹训练是放大已有 latent 行为还是引入新能力提供核查框架；但纯文本合成任务向多模态推理的迁移尚不确定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Primitives and Paths: Predicting What Post-Training Can Do from What the Base Model Already Has

**abstract/A1：** Does reinforcement learning teach language models new capabilities, or merely amplify ones acquired during pre-training? The literature offers evidence for both: pass@$k$ studies suggest RL reweights latent behaviours while some controlled composition studies demonstrate gains beyond simple amplification. We argue that this question has no answer independent of the capability state of the base model, and propose a two-dimensional state space for post-trainability. The first axis, \\emph{effective full-solution support}, measures whether successful trajectories can be sampled under a feasible exploration budget. The second axis, \\emph{atomic primitive coverage}, measures whether the constituent skills of a solution can be executed when the burden of composition is removed. Together, these dimensions motivate three regimes -- amplification, composition-limited, and acquisition-limited -- each predicting a distinct empirical signature and calling for a distinct intervention. We propose a prospective measurement protocol and investigate the framework using synthetic composition tasks across three small language models. We find that primitive mastery alone does not guarantee that RL can learn a composition. Checkpoints that execute every primitive reliably can fail to improve when complete solutions are never sampled during training, whereas modest composition supervision that establishes nonzero support enables substantial RL gains. The framework reframes mid-training as preparation for post-training: its role is to move models into states from which RL can operate effectively.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 1 figure

</details>

### 189. [BiRefNet-V2: Rethinking Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11272v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11272

**作者：** Peng Zheng、Deng-Ping Fan、Binglu Wang、Nicu Sebe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11272v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11272v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 BiRefNet-V2 高分辨率二分图像分割模型，用保局部的 space-to-depth 细节注入、语义引导门控和无需边界标注的聚焦边界监督重构双边参考框架。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部性决定哪些空间信息被保留、语义选择性决定哪些信息进入」的细节注入与门控设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节如何写入内部状态及边界监督提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及推理或 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BiRefNet-V2: Rethinking Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Dichotomous image segmentation requires pixel-accurate foreground-background separation while preserving fine structures such as thin filaments, sharp edges, and intricate textures. BiRefNet addressed this challenge through bilateral references, combining image patches and gradient information, but its inward reference loses local spatial structure and lacks semantic guidance, while its outward reference relies on single-channel gradient attention. We recast this paradigm as controlled information recovery - locality determines what spatial information survives, semantic selectivity what information enters, and focused boundary supervision where refinement occurs - and propose BiRefNet-V2 to implement it: (1) locality-preserving and semantically guided detail injection through space-to-depth transformation, overlapping patches, and a Semantically Guided Gate; (2) a learned boundary stream with focused supervision that generates full-channel residual attention without requiring boundary annotations; and (3) a dual-branch decoder integrating depth-wise boundary convolutions with large-kernel attention. A modernized framework - LayerNorm, GELU, the Lion optimizer, and a DINOv3 backbone - cuts training from 600 to 50 epochs. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on DIS5K, camouflaged object detection, and high-resolution salient object detection across all 13 evaluation sets. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet-V2.

**comment/C1：** Submission version

</details>

### 190. [Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11319v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11319

**作者：** Devanshu Jha、Gaurav Kumar、Agniva Chowdhury、Kumar Krishna Agrawal、Aditya Desai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11319v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11319v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VerKV：在 GPU 上保留少量与查询无关的 pivot token 及全量 KV 的 sketch，完整缓存放在 CPU；推理时先用 sketch 估计注意力近似的相对误差，仅当超出用户给定的 (ε, δ) 容差才从 CPU 取回更多 token，从而在有限误差下减少传输。

**相关性简评：** 其「先用误差估计判断是否需要额外取回证据」的门控思路，可能对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 STOP/继续取证的决策成本权衡，可供核查；但该工作纯文本 KV 压缩，误差估计对多模态、空间结构化缓存的适用性尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference

**abstract/A1：** Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/epsilon-prime/verifiedKV Lab Page: https://epsilon-prime.github.io

</details>

### 191. [Beyond Similarity Entropy: A Rank-Guided Data-Free Quantization Framework for Vision Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11320v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11320

**作者：** Runqing Jiang、Ye Zhang、Pengpeng Yu、Zhuo Song、Changjun Li、Longguang Wang、Yulan Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11320v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11320v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RankQ-ViT 无数据量化框架：作者观察到高斯噪声生成的 patch 相似度矩阵比真实图像秩更低，于是用 block-aware 自对比目标在合成校准样本时促进特征方向多样性，并按秩与语义一致性筛选样本用于分块重建。

**相关性简评：** 其以 patch 相似度矩阵的秩衡量特征方向多样性，可能为诊断 latent 视觉状态是否保留细节、以及相似度结构受位置与注意力影响提供可核查的度量线索，但论文本身针对量化校准，不涉及推理期状态生成或答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Similarity Entropy: A Rank-Guided Data-Free Quantization Framework for Vision Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated remarkable performance, yet their computational and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment on mobile devices. Data-free quantization (DFQ) enables the compression of ViTs without access to their original training data. Existing DFQ methods often synthesize calibration samples by maximizing the entropy of patch similarity. However, similarity entropy describes the dispersion of similarity values without ensuring that the generated samples cover diverse feature directions, potentially limiting their effectiveness for quantization calibration. To address this limitation, we propose RankQ-ViT, a rank-guided DFQ framework for ViTs. We first observe that patch similarity matrices derived from Gaussian noise tend to have lower ranks than those derived from real images. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a block-aware self-contrastive objective that promotes feature diversity during synthetic data generation without explicitly computing matrix rank at each optimization step. We then select calibration samples based on their rank and semantic consistency and use them for block-wise reconstruction of the quantized model. Experiments on ImageNet, COCO, ModelNet40, and ShapeNet demonstrate the effectiveness of RankQ-ViT across multiple architectures and tasks, particularly under low-bit quantization. The code is available at https://github.com/Runqing-forMost/rankq-vit.git

</details>

### 192. [Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11326v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11326

**作者：** Chuyi He、Hua Zou、Fei Luo、Zixian Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11326v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11326v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向白内障术后 BCVA 预测，在 SLO 影像缺失率约 59% 的条件下，用 OCT 与临床文本构建条件表示，引导条件扩散在隐特征空间中恢复 SLO 的代理表示，再送入多模态融合网络做预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「不做像素重建、改在 latent 空间恢复视觉代理表示」的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节缺失时的隐状态补全与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，但它本身是临床预测任务，不涉及推理轨迹或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality

**abstract/A1：** Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.

**内容简述：** 该论文构建 MoT3DVG，一个基于 nuScenes 的户外动态 3D 视觉定位数据集，提供带运动描述的语言提示，并提出 DynaVG 框架；其 SLIDE 模块通过短时窗口编码与长时窗口滑动融合局部运动线索与全局时序上下文，再与点云对齐。

**相关性简评：** 任务本身是 3D 定位而非 latent 推理，但 SLIDE 对局部运动与全局时序的分窗建模，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的时序更新与视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的编码线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues

**abstract/A1：** 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.

### 194. [Where Should a Gate Look? Input vs. State Gating in Diagonal State Space Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11336v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11336

**作者：** Riccardo Zattra、Giacomo Baggio、Leonardo De Marchi、Augusto Ferrante、Francesco Ticozzi、Marco Del Prà、Antonio Orvieto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11336v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11336v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文比较对角状态空间模型中门控信号取自当前输入、循环状态或两者，从理论上给出严格表达力分离（标量模型下状态门控可解任意词表与长度的 induction-head 任务，输入门控在稳定性假设下失败），并在高维模型上验证，发现二者在 induction-head 与 selective copying 上各有优势、组合最佳。

**相关性简评：** 其「输入门控 vs 状态门控」的表达力分析可为循环式 latent 推理中状态更新是否依赖上一步 latent（而非仅依赖输入）提供可核查的理论线索，induction-head 的失败边界也可能对应多步推理中的信息复制与保持问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Should a Gate Look? Input vs. State Gating in Diagonal State Space Models

**abstract/A1：** Modern state-space models owe much of their computational efficiency to their linear, often diagonal, dynamics. Classical recurrent neural networks instead allow nonlinear state-to-state interactions, which can be beneficial when memory updates need to depend on the past context. In this paper, we ask whether state feedback through a simple gate regulating memory updates can enhance the expressivity of diagonal state-space models. To investigate this question, we compare gates that depend on the current input, the recurrent state, or both. We establish a strict expressivity separation: for scalar models, state gating solves induction-head tasks for arbitrary vocabulary size and sequence length, whereas input gating fails on a finite instance under standard stability assumptions on the state transition matrix. Experiments show that state gating retains its advantage on induction-head tasks in higher-dimensional models, whereas input gating performs better on selective copying tasks. Together, our results show that even a simple, diagonal form of state-feedback gating can unlock capabilities unavailable to input-controlled models, while input and state gating offer complementary strengths and achieve the strongest overall performance when combined.

</details>

**title/T1：** NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification

**abstract/A1：** Nuclear quantification requires locating and typing nuclei, beyond generating a count. Inspired by Jev's structured decisions in place of free-form generation, we introduce NuJEV for nuclear perception in Qwen3-VL-2B. We jointly train visual LoRA and a parallel head to predict nuclear presence, centers, and types. One image encoding feeds both the nuclear head and original language decoder. The decoder interprets region and type requests, with counts computed from the predicted nuclei. On 2,732 PanNuke test images, NuJEV achieves a five-query mean absolute error ($\\mathrm{MAE}\_5$) of 1.844 overall and 5.268 on dense images, with localization/typed F1 of 0.816/0.682. A matched encoder ablation shows 41.0\\% lower dense error with visual adaptation. For language requests, NuJEV reduces request MAE by 76.2\\% relative to direct generation. Our code will be released as open source.

### 196. [BiVerify: Closing the Loop Between Backward and Forward Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11368v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11368

**作者：** Rui Zou、Xin Zhao、Mengqi Wei、Ji-Rong Wen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11368v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11368v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BiVerify，一个面向数学推理自我纠错的双向验证框架：先用后向验证按原始约束筛查候选答案，再用前向验证检查推理链，并依据验证结果动态切换方向、重置状态并反复验证，直至同一候选同时通过两个方向。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本数学验证调度，无视觉或 latent 状态内容；但其根据验证结果切换方向、重置状态并决定是否继续修正的控制逻辑，可能为 LVR 中验证驱动的停止决策与推理轨迹筛选提供可供核查的借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BiVerify: Closing the Loop Between Backward and Forward Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning but still produce incorrect solutions to complex problems, indicating the need for more reliable self-correction mechanisms. Mathematical self-correction typically identifies errors through verification, which can proceed backward or forward. The two directions provide complementary verification capabilities. Backward verification checks a candidate answer against the original constraints, bypassing complex intermediate reasoning, but cannot ensure correct reasoning or objective completeness. Forward verification follows the problem conditions and current solution, enabling it to locate reasoning errors and assess objective completeness, but may overlook key constraints in complex solution chains. We propose BiVerify, a dynamically scheduled framework for bidirectional mathematical verification. BiVerify begins with backward verification to screen the answer against the original constraints, followed by forward verification of the reasoning process; subsequent direction switching, state resetting, and re-verification are governed by verification outcomes. Upon failure, the system revises the candidate or verification flow until the same candidate passes both directions. We also introduce shared mathematical tools that separate logical reasoning from precise computation. We systematically evaluate BiVerify on five challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks using multiple mainstream DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini models. BiVerify exceeds the strongest representative public baseline evaluated in this work by 13.5 percentage points in average accuracy, with the margin reaching 31.2 percentage points on GPT. Further analysis shows that BiVerify's overall performance exceeds that of either verification direction alone.

### 197. [D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11371v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11371

**作者：** Hong Nie、Zhangchi Gao、Jun Yu、Bo Wang、Jianqing Sun、Shengping Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11371v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11371v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** D3Tree 用仅 2H+2 参数的轻量 head 从 draft 状态、候选嵌入与 draft log-prob 预测 block-diffusion 草稿树各节点的条件存活率，沿父链阈值化得到祖先闭包子树，并在负载高时按预测存活率分配批级节点预算；在冻结 drafter 上训练，跨多种视觉语言 verifier 与多模态基准测试加速效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「学习候选分支存活并据此裁剪、按预算决定验证多少」的机制，可能为 latent 多假设的筛选与验证计算分配提供线索，但论文目标是解码加速而非视觉推理状态，需核查能否迁移到 LVR 的假设选择与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification

**abstract/A1：** Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round. The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文研究显著/伪装目标检测中的联合定位与类型判别问题，发现前景定位可在两任务间迁移而类型判别不能，于是将输出分解为显式前景概率与以前景为条件的类型概率（FLR + RTA），并在 USC12K 上以更少参数取得更高指标。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式分解存在性与条件化类型判定 + 据此把错误分为类型正确/类型互换/漏检」的分项归因思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中「视觉证据是否留在内部状态」与「答案是否真正使用该证据」难以区分的问题，属于方法线索而非主线研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SegDis: Foreground Segmentation Followed by Type Discrimination for Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Salient and camouflaged object detection (SOD and COD) both recover foreground support, yet most joint methods output only a binary mask and therefore cannot distinguish the type. USC12K distinguishes the two types, but its baseline USCNet still binds foreground existence to the type within a single normalization, so the failure source cannot be attributed. Our cross-task study shows that foreground localization transfers between SOD and COD, whereas type discrimination does not: a COD-only model recovers foreground on SOD images but its type judgement follows the training distribution rather than the foreground-background relation, so the two decisions require separate mechanisms. SegDis factorizes the output into an explicit foreground probability and a conditional type probability given foreground: FLR provides high-quality task-agnostic support, and RTA refines the SOD/COD assignment from the foreground-background relation without a task identifier. Because support is explicit, each ground-truth foreground pixel is classified as correct-type, type-swapped, or missed, so foreground-recovery and type-assignment errors are diagnosed separately. With PVT-v2-B2, SegDis attains 68.98% FG-mIoU and 78.35% mIoU on USC12K at about one-eighth of USCNet's parameters; CSCS is 5.75.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, includes supplementary material

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EBReg：在自监督训练中联合学习编码器与 latent score model，用潜在 score 估计实现平滑边缘熵最大化，以保持表征多样性、防止表示坍缩，并在测试时用同一 score model 将受损表征拉回训练分布。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐空间 score 估计 + 测试时表示修正 + 熵正则防坍缩」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态漂移、信息坍缩与视觉证据保持提供训练或修正线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Supervised Collapse Prevention with Score-Based Entropy Maximization

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models have demonstrated the effectiveness of score-based objectives for generative modeling, yet their potential for self-supervised representation learning remains underexplored. We introduce Entropy-Based Regularization (EBReg), a framework that uses latent score estimation to regularize the latent distribution during self-supervised training. EBReg jointly learns an encoder and a latent score model, and utilizes the learned score to provide a diversity-preserving signal that prevents representational collapse. Motivated by a mutual-information lower bound, we formulate the objective as view alignment with smoothed marginal entropy maximization and optimize the marginal entropy without explicit density evaluation. The same score model can additionally be used at test time to refine corrupted representations toward the training latent distribution. Empirically, EBReg learns competitive representations on ImageNet-1K, achieving 75.57% linear-probe accuracy with ViT-L. Across diverse architectures, score-guided test-time adaptation further improves robustness on ImageNet-C, yielding an average relative accuracy gain of approximately 5%.

</details>

### 200. [The comparison of density estimation for transfer learning in Banach, Hilbert, Euclidean spaces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11382v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11382

**作者：** Maryam Alsadat Kazemian、Azam Bastanfard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11382v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11382v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文比较 Banach、Hilbert 与 Euclidean 空间中的密度估计用于迁移学习，提出在测地特征流形上以 L1 范数正则化密度匹配（等价于收缩全变差距离）的域适应方法 BMTL，并在 MNIST-USPS、COIL20、Office+Caltech10 上报告优于 L2 消融和 DMDA 等基线。

**相关性简评：** 不涉及 latent 推理，但其在视觉特征流形上用有界 TV/L1 距离约束分布偏移的思路，可能可供核查如何度量与正则化内部视觉状态的分布漂移，而非默认采用 Euclidean/L2 几何。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The comparison of density estimation for transfer learning in Banach, Hilbert, Euclidean spaces

**abstract/A1：** Domain adaptation or DA methods are indispensable when target labels or computational resources are scarce, yet the domain kernel density and subspace alignment approaches completely assume a Hilbertian geometry. They measure distributional discrepancy with symmetric L2 divergences over Euclidean feature spaces or reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS). This preprint summarizes the manuscript Non-Hilbertian Domain Adaptation. Total Variation Alignment via L1 Density Regularization on Feature Manifolds, which proposes Banach Manifold Transfer Learning or BMTL. BMTL makes two coupled design decisions. The first one is that features are embedded on a geodesic manifold rather than treated as points of a flat Euclidean space, and the second one is that the density matching regularizer is formulated in an L1 Banach norm, whose minimization is equivalent, by Scheffe's theorem, to contracting the Total Variation or TV distance between domain densities, a bounded metric that weights all regions of the sample space uniformly. The L2 formulation, by contrast, squares deviations and therefore amplifies errors in the tails, over emphasizing density outliers that do not reflect meaningful distributional shift. Experiments on MNIST-USPS, COIL20, and Office+Caltech10 show consistent gains; the L1 variant beats an otherwise identical L2 ablation on every task, for example 92.44% vs. 89.80% on USPS-&gt;MNIST and surpasses the strongest baseline DMDA by +3.68% on average over twelve Office+Caltech transfers. This document situates the contribution with an explicit comparison of Euclidean, Hilbert, and Banach geometries.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV、physics.geo-ph

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用稀疏自编码器把地球观测基础模型的稠密嵌入分解为过完备字典中稀疏、近似单义的特征，并设计针对卫星像素与空间自相关的评估协议（匹配稀疏度下的重建、与参考概念对齐、空间尺度），在 AlphaEarth 与 Tessera 嵌入上对比基线，并将稀疏码试用于土地覆盖子概念发现与 OOD 像素检测。

**相关性简评：** SAE 分解与概念对齐协议或可作为核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留视觉细节、实体与几何特征的探针；其「冻结随机字典同样呈现单义性与细尺度方差」的对照，可供核查 latent 相似度分析中稀疏化与学习字典各自的贡献，但遥感嵌入与推理期 latent 状态差异较大，迁移可行性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decomposing Earth Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders

**abstract/A1：** Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/EarthyScience/geosae

### 203. [GenRM-Flow: Generators are Process-aware Reward Models in Flow Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11421v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11421

**作者：** Siming Fu、Ruizhe He、Zheming Fu、Zeyue Xue、Fengkai Liu、Yufei Jiao、Jie Huang、Xiaoxiao Ma、Xuan Yang、Lihui Luo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11421v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11421v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 GenRM-Flow，从流匹配生成器的速度预测误差中解析地导出奖励，使经偏好微调的生成器本身成为过程感知奖励模型，在纯 latent 空间替代外部 VLM 打分器。

**相关性简评：** 「由去噪与速度预测误差读出过程奖励」这一思路可供核查能否用于 latent 推理轨迹的逐步监督与贡献分配，但研究对象是视频生成对齐而非 VLM 推理，联系较为间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GenRM-Flow: Generators are Process-aware Reward Models in Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Aligning video generation models with human preference depends critically on the quality of the reward model that scores generated videos. Current video reward models, however, source their reward signal from a model's representational rather than generative capacity: they either repurpose vision-language models as pixel-space scorers, or train auxiliary scoring heads on top of frozen generator features. The generator's actual ability to predict velocities, denoise latents, and produce videos plays no role in scoring its own generations. We argue that this overlooks a structural property of offline preference learning. Any preference optimization objective that approximates an offline preference dataset mathematically targets a strictly defined KL-constrained optimal policy. By isolating the reward term from this analytical solution and mapping the exact generation log-likelihood to its flow-matching surrogate, the empirical reward emerges deterministically as the relative difference in continuous-time velocity-prediction errors. We formalize this equivalence into GenRM-Flow, a framework where a preference-tuned video generator inherently operates as a process-aware reward model directly in the noisy latent space. We further show theoretically that distinct fine-tuning objectives, whether contrastive like DPO and IPO or non-contrastive like RWR, are alternative optimization pathways toward the same optimal policy, each inducing a reward readout from the generator's velocity-prediction errors. Furthermore, the extracted process reward seamlessly substitutes external VLM scorers in FlowAWR. Operating purely on native latent outputs without auxiliary reward networks, this generative reward drives measurable improvements in downstream video generation.

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文测量 on-policy distillation 中 rollout 引擎与训练模型之间的训练—推理不匹配（量化、权重陈旧、注入噪声），给出经验性的「不匹配预算」，并提出基于校准预算的轻量准入检查与 FP8 配置。

**相关性简评：** 不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，但其对量化/异步 rollout 误差预算与层级敏感性的度量，可供核查 LVR 长轨迹训练中近似推理引擎的监督偏差与 KV-cache 容量权衡。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

### 205. [Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11452v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11452

**作者：** Weizhong Huang、Huaijia Kou、Tianyu Xie、Xiawu Zheng、Liujuan Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11452v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11452v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SemanticKV，一种无需训练的 KV cache 压缩方法：利用规划器提取的语义约束，通过文本交叉注意力定位相关视频位置，并按约束分组聚合注意力分数以指导 top-k 保留，用于高效 agentic 自回归视频生成。

**相关性简评：** 其按语义约束筛选并保留高价值视觉状态的机制，可能为 LVR 中长视觉历史下的证据筛选、缓存预算与注意力结构分析提供方法线索，但需核查其分组打分是否适用于推理状态的证据保留。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GOPR-CAD：让语言模型作为决策代理，在封装好的 CAD 操作上逐步构建可执行的操作图，再由确定性编译器转为最终 CAD 模型；同时构建 MHCAD 基准，用 STEP/B-rep 做免参考的结构保真评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式操作图＋确定性编译」把长程生成改写为结构化状态的逐步更新与分步核验，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与外部结构化工作区的分工、以及每步状态如何验证提供可核查线索，但不涉及视觉推理本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GOPR-CAD: Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning for CAD Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generating accurate CAD models requires substantial engineering expertise and careful control of geometry, topology, and mechanical constraints. Text-to-CAD aims to simplify this process, but current LLM-based methods often generate CAD programs directly. Language models remain unreliable when producing long code while coordinating coupled geometric, topological, and dimensional constraints. Consequently, executable programs may still produce structurally incorrect models, which execution rate and rendered appearance may fail to reveal. To address these limitations, we propose GOPR-CAD, an agentic Text-to-CAD pipeline based on Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning. A language model acts as a decision agent over encapsulated CAD operations and progressively constructs an executable operation graph, which a deterministic compiler converts into the final CAD model. This separation requires no additional training and supports different language models. To evaluate structural fidelity, we construct MHCAD, a benchmark of 300 standard mechanical part requirements derived from Machinery's Handbook. Their explicit structures enable reference-free STEP/B-rep evaluation. GOPR-CAD achieves 82.7% Structural Yield on MHCAD, and 87.2% Structural Yield on an external CADPrompt subset.

</details>

### 207. [JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11499v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JoMoHa，用强化学习联合训练可执行的 harness 生成策略与任务执行策略，以协调语言 agent 的模型权重和运行时框架，并在 ALFWorld、WebShop、DBBench 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 把 harness 作为可学习、可生成的控制结构并与执行策略共同优化，可能为 LVR 中「THINK/LOOK/STOP」等推理控制及训练监督提供方法线索，但需核查其 harness 表示是否涉及视觉证据筛选与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).

### 208. [ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11500v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11500

**作者：** Wei Lu、Jiaxi Zhang、Yunheng Wang、Taowen Wang、Yuetong Fang、Zhenhui Zhang、Shuning Zhang、Zizhao Yuan、Yixiao Feng、Zecui Zeng、Renjing Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11500v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11500v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ForeAct 将预训练视频世界模型改造为单次前向的表征主干用于机器人操作，并以可学习 token 加下一帧相对深度监督塑造共享视频表征，几何读出仅在训练期使用、部署时移除。

**相关性简评：** 其用训练期深度监督把几何信息压入共享 latent、推理期不再引入额外模块的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何低开销地保留任务必要的视觉细节提供线索，但论文本身不做显式 latent 推理，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations

**abstract/A1：** Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.

</details>

**作者：** Zhihao Chen、Qi Gao、Chuang Niu、Qiegen Liu、Yi Zhang、Hongming Shan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11503v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11503v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AgentCT，用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-VL-4B 控制器判断 CT 退化类型与严重程度，将图像路由到 LDCT／SVCT／MAR 专用修复模型，并对修复结果再做一次评估。

**相关性简评：** 控制器的退化类型／严重度预测与「再评估」环节属于 VLM 依据视觉证据做选择与自检的线索，可为研究视觉证据筛选与停止／验收决策提供参照；但工作对象是医学图像修复，未涉及 latent 推理状态或内部表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging

**abstract/A1：** Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at https://github.com/hao1635/AgentCT.

### 210. [Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11504v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11504

**作者：** Chunwei Ma、Russell D Wolfinger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11504v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11504v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究观测数据与因果估计方法假设之间的兼容性，提出用数据嵌入的几何特征（variogram）作为无需反事实的路由信号，构建 MoE-Learner 在多个假设对应的因果专家间分配与验证，并在 IHDP、ACIC、Lalonde 上取得最佳平均排名。

**相关性简评：** 其「由输入数据几何特征判断当前策略假设是否成立」的路由思路，可供核查是否可类比为 LVR 中依据输入状态选择 THINK/LOOK/STOP 或筛选视觉证据分支，但属跨领域推测，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Due to the fundamental problem of causal inference -- the impossibility of observing counterfactual outcomes -- there is always a gap between the training goal (outcome, propensity) and the inference target (CATE, ATE). Traditional causal effect estimation revolves around setting assumptions, selecting identification strategies, and choosing causal estimators, while more recently, Causal Foundation Models (CFMs), built on Prior-Data-Fitted Networks (PFNs), ease this process by pretraining on massive synthetic prior datasets. Despite their success, such amortization makes causal inference less transparent, obscuring which assumptions the model implicitly relies on for a given dataset. The high diversity of real-world data-generating processes (DGPs) and Structural Causal Models (SCMs) makes it hard to know, a priori, which causal inference strategy is compatible with a given dataset. In this work, we focus on this compatibility between an observational dataset and method-specific assumptions, and find that geometric characteristics of data embeddings -- specifically, the variogram -- provide a useful signal of whether a given causal estimation strategy is appropriate. We develop MoE-Learner, a mixture-of-causal-experts framework that embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram as a counterfactual-free router to assess each expert's validity. Rather than eliminating causal assumptions, this shifts their validation from a fixed, a priori choice to a criterion that can be checked directly from data geometry. MoE-Learner achieves the best average rank on benchmark datasets (IHDP, ACIC, Lalonde). Being orthogonal to (causal) foundation models, our method builds a bridge from data characteristics to causal estimation strategy rather than proposing another CFM.

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

### 211. [Reaching Is Not Finding: Map-Anchored Visual Prompting for the Last Mile of Aerial Vision-Language Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11510v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11510

**作者：** Ningbo Li、Kebin Liu、Jingcan Chen、Weichen Zhang、Rong Ding、Yunhao Liu、Mo Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11510v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11510v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对空中视觉语言导航中「到达却未找到」的失败现象，用替换指令目标物的对照实验表明导航器只学会抵达地标而非识别目标，并提出即插即用的 MAP-VP：在导航器停下后把指令提及的地标轮廓绘制到当前视角上，再由微调的 4B VLM 定位目标。

**相关性简评：** 其「停下位置错误」的诊断与后置视觉提示可分别对照 LVR 的 STOP 决策和视觉证据注入问题，可供核查的是：把结构化地标显式画进视觉输入是否等价于一种外部化的证据筛选，以及该反事实替换测试能否用于检验 latent 内容是否真被答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reaching Is Not Finding: Map-Anchored Visual Prompting for the Last Mile of Aerial Vision-Language Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) asks a drone to find an object described in natural language. The description usually locates the object relative to named landmarks, such as streets and buildings. We observe that current navigators often bring the drone close to the target and then stop at the wrong place: they reach the target without finding it. This gap is shared by navigators of very different designs, from imitation learners to a fine-tuned 7B vision-language model. A simple test reveals the cause. When we replace the target object in the instruction with another one next to the same landmarks, no navigator goes to it, and most stop where they did before. Navigators learn to reach the landmarks, not to identify the described object. We therefore propose MAP-VP, a plug-and-play module for the last step. After any navigator stops, MAP-VP draws the landmarks named in the instruction onto the drone's current view, using the landmark outlines that the benchmark provides on a map. A fine-tuned 4B vision-language model then locates the target relative to these landmarks. The training data are generated automatically from the benchmark annotations. Neither drawing the landmarks nor fine-tuning helps much alone, but together they are highly effective. Without retraining any navigator, MAP-VP significantly improves all six navigators we test on CityNav. It roughly doubles the success rate of the two strongest trained navigators, raising HETT from 25.9% to 54.6% and FlightGPT from 24.2% to 48.9%, whereas CityNav's official detector-based last step adds less than two points to HETT.

</details>

### 212. [InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11517v1>)

**作者：** Yude Zou、Yifei Yao、Yiwei Hao、Hanqing Wang、Xing Gao

**内容简述：** 提出 InfCoiL 闭环框架：将形态感知的 flow-matching 规划器与统一多形态控制器通过共享形态接口耦合，在自回归「规划—执行」循环中用同一物理 rollout 交替 RL 微调两者，并提出 SFPO 以通道级语义协方差随机化去噪转移、用序列级 group-relative 奖励优化规划器。

**相关性简评：** 其「执行反馈回写规划器」与用完整闭环执行结果做序列级贡献分配的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 计划生成后如何由执行/验证反馈更新状态、以及轨迹级监督分配提供方法线索，跨域可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction

**abstract/A1：** Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: https://infcoil.github.io/

</details>

### 213. [Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11525v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11525

**作者：** Siming Zhang、Zhehui Shen、Shijie Chen、Yansen Yu、Hang Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11525v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11525v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「effective boundary complexity」，以冻结特征上线性探针决策边界附近的样本质量（按类别平衡归一）作为标签预算诊断指标，理论上说明平滑表示下法向拉伸是主导因素，并给出基于缓存特征的估计器，在受控变换与 CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 上验证其与标签需求的相关性。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其在缓存特征上度量判别边界模糊质量与标签需求的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 内部隐状态表示的判别边界、模糊区域及所需监督量，属表示几何类诊断的可借鉴工具。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations

**abstract/A1：** Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary\_mass.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 在 48 个模拟放射文档情景（含误导信息变体）中让 6 个工具使用型 LLM 代理完成任务，比较仅权限、规则、规则加本地 LLM 检查器的分层防护对高危违规记录的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification

**abstract/A1：** Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors. Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks. Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision. Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, supplementary material included. Tobias Penzkofer and Jawed Nawabi share last authorship. Code: https://github.com/ibrarad/radiology-agent-safeguards

### 215. [Dropping Tokens Without Dropping Them: Causal Attribution for Diabetic Retinopathy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11547v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11547

**作者：** Pramath Girish Haritz、Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11547v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11547v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文检验 Vision Transformer 的注意力归因图对糖尿病视网膜病变分类是否具备因果解释力，将注意力分解为满足完备性公理的贡献 c\_t 与刻画因果的 pull p\_t，并在 MAPLES-DR 上通过 token 删除／插入计算必要性、充分性与忠实度相关性，与 Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM、AttnLRP 及遮挡法比较。

**相关性简评：** 其按 token 测量必要性／充分性的因果归因流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正依赖具体视觉证据（即视觉旁路与证据筛选问题），但该工作针对单图分类而非多模态推理生成，迁移需较多改造。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dropping Tokens Without Dropping Them: Causal Attribution for Diabetic Retinopathy

**abstract/A1：** In this work, we investigate whether attention-based attribution maps in a vision transformer provide causal explanations for diabetic retinopathy (DR) classification. We introduce a principled decomposition of attention into two attribution maps: the contribution ($c\_t$), which satisfies the completeness axiom in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), and the pull ($p\_t$), which quantifies causal explanations. We define an identity relating $c\_t$ and $p\_t$ that characterizes when $c\_t$ fails to capture causality. We test whether each map is causally faithful on the MAPLES-DR dataset by dropping/inserting tokens, and report Necessity ($N$), Sufficiency ($Su$), and Faithfulness Correlation ($FC$). The pull $p\_t$ achieves the highest causal alignment ($FC = 0.53$, $N = 0.71\\%$, $Su = 3.0\\%$), outperforming Attention Rollout, Grad-CAM, and AttnLRP. Occlusion retains better sufficiency ($Su = 1.6\\%$) but is about 800 times slower. Furthermore, on MAPLES-DR, $p\_t$ achieves $70\\%$ of the average precision (AP) of HRDecoder, a state-of-the-art supervised lesion segmentation model, despite the absence of pixel-level supervision. Together, these findings show that the pull $p\_t$ and the contribution $c\_t$ form computationally efficient attribution maps for reliable causal interpretation in safety-critical medical diagnostics. The code and demo are available at https://github.com/pramath-haritz/dr-xai.

**comment/C1：** 4 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to ISBI 2027

</details>

### 216. [LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11560v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11560

**作者：** Guanming Liu、Weihang Wang、Peng Zhang、Meng Wu、Kainan Tu、Jiahao Liu、Yu Zhang、Liuxin Zhang、Qianying Wang、Ning Gu、Tun Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11560v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11560v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LiveAsset，从多轮纠正交互中结合原始与修订结果推断用户意图，增量维护可复用的 intent assets，并在运行时以其引导执行、在回复前校验适用性并驱动修订。

**相关性简评：** 其「纠正解释—保留既有约束的增量状态更新—运行前适用性校验与修订」流程，可能为 latent 推理状态的需求表示、验证信号与修订时机提供方法线索，但对象为纯文本 agent 且无视觉证据，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on π-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at github.com/landian60/LiveAsset.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 UTOPI：面向 AR 端第一视角长视频的可插拔预压缩模块，利用用户运动信号估计帧间重叠做视角平移不变剪枝，并用眼动注视信息将前景内容优先保留，在多基准与多骨干上实现最高约 95% 压缩而性能基本不降。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UTOPI: Efficient Egocentric Long-Video Understanding in AR via User-Guided Token Pre-Compression

**abstract/A1：** As long-video understanding gains increasing attention, augmented reality (AR) devices are emerging as a compelling deployment platform. However, egocentric videos exhibit significant temporal redundancy, imposing substantial memory and computational burdens on resource-constrained AR hardware. To address this challenge, we introduce UTOPI, a plug-and-play pre-compression module designed specifically for egocentric long videos on AR platforms. First, we leverage user motion signals to estimate inter-frame overlap and propose a viewpoint-shift-invariant pruning algorithm. Second, we exploit eye-tracking sensors to identify user fixations, enabling the separation of attended foreground content from background and its preferential retention via a fine-tuned neural network-based adjustment mechanism. Across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, UTOPI achieves up to 95% compression while preserving performance. Code and project page are available at https://sai-lab-nyu.github.io/utopi/.

</details>

### 218. [Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11565v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11565

**作者：** Bian Sun、Kevin Zhai、Mubarak Shah、Song Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11565v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11565v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EARN 面向冻结的 LLM agent，利用历史交互重新分配动作信用以调整候选动作概率，并在上下文匹配时直接重放已存动作，从而在固定交互预算下保留高性能行为。

**相关性简评：** 其按动作段分配信用与条件复用成功路径的机制，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的贡献分配、有效 latent 状态复用和推理成本控制提供借鉴，尚需核查能否迁移到视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Actions Should EARN Their Credit: Test-Time Adaptation and Route Consolidation for Frozen LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents can use feedback from repeated attempts to improve their decisions without updating model parameters. However, positive action credits can continue to favor actions that repeatedly achieve the same score, even when higher scores are achievable. Under a fixed interaction budget, trying new actions in the final attempts can also lower performance. We introduce EARN, a method that uses past experience to guide further progress and retain earlier performance through conditional reuse of effective action sequences. EARN reduces action credits for reaching scores repeatedly attained in earlier episodes and assigns larger credits to action segments that reach higher scores. These credits adjust the probabilities of LLM-proposed actions. During the final episodes, EARN directly replays stored actions when the current context matches the recorded context and the actions remain available, bypassing LLM candidate generation. We evaluate performance at the end of the interaction budget using the average score over the final four episodes. Across Jericho, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, EARN achieves the best score on this metric in 31 of 33 task--budget settings among the evaluated methods, including ties. Across the evaluated Jericho budgets, replay bypasses 78.9--86.3\\% of candidate-generation calls in the final four episodes, averaged across games.

</details>

### 219. [Same Error, Different Recovery: How Delivery Changes LLM Agent Behavior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11581v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11581

**作者：** Sunghyeun Woo、Javier Conde、Pedro Reviriego

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.AR
