**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文以工具调用失败后的下一步动作为对象，在13个开源模型上系统改变错误反馈的放置位置、引导、保留历史与轮次结构，并在确定性推理引擎中实现一种「新用户轮」式的恢复层，在ToolMaze与编码agent上测试恢复成功率。

**相关性简评：** 其对「重试/纠正/停止」三类动作的因果拆分与反馈投递形式，可能为LVR中STOP决策、证据回填位置如何影响后续推理状态提供可核查线索，但研究对象为纯文本工具agent，无视觉状态，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Error, Different Recovery: How Delivery Changes LLM Agent Behavior

**abstract/A1：** A tool-using language model must decide whether to retry a failed call, correct it, or stop and tell the user. The error text alone may not be enough: the same feedback can lead to different actions depending on where it appears in the conversation. We isolate this delivery problem by varying placement, guidance, retained history and turn structure. Two studies with plans fixed before data collection, across 13 open models from 3B to 70B parameters, compare the next action and subsequent task completion, with exact deterministic reruns. A new user turn that retains the failed exchange avoids the severe stopping failure observed in Llama models when that exchange is removed. It is non-inferior to history rewriting in pooled synthetic comparisons, but is not best for every model. We implement this form as an opt-in recovery layer within a deterministic inference engine and evaluate it on public benchmarks and a coding agent. On ToolMaze, it raises success on explicit errors by 14.2 points with 7-8B models and 10.5 points with 32-70B models; Loud/Quiet, 24 multi-turn tasks with visible failures and silent corruption, scored by final-state agreement, shows no measurable gain. A client given the exact fault kind performs better still. The findings support delivery as a distinct factor in recovery, not an engine-exclusive solution or a universal retry policy.

</details>

**abstract/A1：** When a scanpath descriptor discriminates a task, it is rarely clear what the discrimination rests on. We propose a perturbation profile for trial-level descriptors. Five transformations each destroy one stated property while preserving a listed set of invariants: fixation order, duration-position coupling, the duration distribution, orientation and handedness, and fine spatial structure. The classifier is refit, and the drop in participant-held-out AUC is the pipeline's sensitivity to that property. Because refitting lets the learner use redundant information, this describes the refitted pipeline, not what a fitted classifier used. Intervals come from a participant bootstrap that refits; in simulations at the sample sizes analysed, where the target was zero they excluded zero at a pooled rate of at most 2.5%, and they covered the target in 99.6% of 2720 cases. We profiled seven descriptors on twelve binary problems from three public datasets: reading (SB-SAT, 95 participants), program comprehension (EMIP, up to 159) and video and game viewing (GazeBase, 60). Permuting fixation order raised the AUC of a descriptor built on mean saccade amplitude on three problems (by up to 0.23), because permutation turns amplitude into a measure of spatial spread. A "comprehension" contrast that pooled two programs reached AUC 0.70 with a spread-only baseline and fell to 0.47 within one program: the profile located the confound in stimulus layout. On native versus non-native readers, recurrence was sensitive to order and to jitter at the scale of text lines but not of characters, while a two-feature duration and amplitude descriptor reached the same AUC (0.65). A graph descriptor built on the code's tokens was the strongest non-baseline descriptor on the program contrast (0.78; 0.87 with boosted trees). **arXiv ID：** 2611.11644

**作者：** Yen-Shuo Su、Weihan Li、Anqi Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11644v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11644v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MICE，一个在小鼠姿态数据上联合预训练的分层基础模型，用个体运动编码器与 Perceiver 式社会编码器及学习式 latent codebook 建模多鼠交互，并支持任意群体规模。

**相关性简评：** 其以固定 latent codebook 聚合可变数量个体交互线索的做法，可能为 LVR 中可变数量视觉实体或证据的关系表示与参数解耦提供方法借鉴，需核查信息压缩是否丢失关键细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MICE: Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder - A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Mouse Behavior

**abstract/A1：** Quantifying mouse behavior from pose is a foundational tool in neuroscience, ethology, drug discovery, and animal welfare. Self-supervised foundation models are a natural fit, but a foundation model for mouse behavior must handle social behavior - many behaviors that matter (aggression, courtship, mounting, allogrooming) are inherently multi-animal. Existing self-supervised pose models fall short: they encode each animal independently and discard interaction signal, hard-code the animal count, and pretrain one dataset at a time. We introduce MICE (Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder), a hierarchical foundation model for mouse behavior that pretrains jointly on six mouse-pose corpora spanning one to four mice and 7 to 27 keypoints. MICE combines a hierarchical individual encoder capturing per-mouse kinematics at multiple temporal scales with a Perceiver-style social encoder whose learned latent codebook decouples parameter count from animal count, so a single checkpoint serves any group size without retraining. Across four evaluation protocols spanning six datasets, MICE matches or exceeds prior keypoint-based baselines, and layer-wise probing shows the social stage incrementally improves discriminability beyond the individual encoder. Code, weights, and data are available at https://github.com/eric0708/MICE.

**内容简述：** 该文提出 TILA-CT：在冻结 LLM 中为每个任务配置一套 latent memory 与 adapter bank，训练时由记忆聚合 causal-prefix 信息并注入任务条件上下文，推理时直接以记忆的持久状态作为共享 prompt-only 路由器的路由原型，从而在无回放下实现任务的自我索引与隔离。

**相关性简评：** 其「用 latent 状态自身充当索引以选择对应模块」的访问机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 假设、视觉证据或缓存的选取与访问问题提供一条可核查的方法线索；但该文为纯文本、任务隔离设定，迁移可行性尚待确认。

**title/T1：** Self-Indexing Latent Memories for Access-Aware Continual Instruction Tuning of LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Continual instruction tuning often preserves old skills with task-private modules. Inference still requires selecting the right module from the prompt alone. We introduce Task-Isolated Latent Adapter Continual Training (TILA-CT), a replay-free method that makes each task module self-indexing. Each task receives a latent memory and adapter bank in a frozen LLM. During adaptation, the memory gathers causal-prefix information and injects task-conditioned context. For access, its persistent state provides the routing prototype used by a shared prompt-only router. On the 8-task CT-Pipeline stream, TILA-CT achieves 65.19 acquisition and 63.98 final macro score, with 1.38 points of average forgetting. A middle-reversed order gives 65.38 acquisition and 64.17 final macro score. Across 6 backbones, final scores remain within 1.5 points of acquisition. Ablations support memory-derived routing keys and causal gathering. Final macro routing accuracy is 93.9\\%, and oracle routing recovers 1.21 final macro points. These results separate preserved task computation from learned access to it.

### 223. [Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11696v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11696

**作者：** Rafael Pina、Varuna De Silva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11696v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11696v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在两类批次特性迥异的工作负载（GPU向量化MARL的循环策略与MoE语言模型）上直接测量GPU能耗，检验批次内及跨时间的计算共享能否带来实测节能；结果显示循环策略上共享基本失败，而MoE上batch-aware routing可在KL 0.05内减少25–31%专家权重读取、每token能耗降12–18%，并提出persistence-aware OEA规则。

**相关性简评：** 其「用实测GPU能耗替代操作计数」的做法，以及关于批次级共享、循环状态持久性与test-time steering无增益的分析，可供核查LVR中循环/动态计算（THINK/LOOK/STOP）的真实成本与latent状态复用价值时借鉴；但该文为非多模态、单GPU试点，迁移性仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Direct GPU Energy Measurements of Batch-Level Sharing in Mixture-of-Experts and Recurrent Models

**abstract/A1：** Energy claims for efficient neural networks are often inferred from operation counts. We report direct GPU energy measurements on two workloads that batch very differently, recurrent policies in GPU-vectorised multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, and ask one question of both: can the rows of a batch be made to share computation, across the batch and over time, at a measured saving? On recurrent policies the answer so far is no. Shared activity patterns exist but rarely last one step, masking a frozen policy fails, and trained-in masks succeed only because a fixed mask is equivalent to a narrow GRU, at 11x the energy of a small dense policy in our implementation. Test-time steering adds nothing beyond re-picking on either workload. On MoE models the answer is yes, and granularity decides how much: on Qwen3-30B-A3B, batch-aware routing reads 25-31% fewer expert weights within KL 0.05, with benchmark changes within noise at 500 items, and uses 12-18% less energy per token on a fused forward. We also introduce persistence-aware OEA, a one-parameter rule that keeps the batch-aware cut with about 40% fewer new experts per step than native routing at batch 32-64, though its energy has not yet been measured. These are pilot measurements on one GPU type, and we state their limits.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 9 figures

</details>

### 224. [Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11704v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11704

**作者：** Peiyu Li、Pouya Hosseinzadeh、Soukaina Filali Boubrahimi、Shah Muhammad Hamdi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11704v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11704v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出面向时间序列反事实解释的策略学习框架：在预训练自编码器的隐空间中用 actor-critic 训练一次性的 contextual bandit 策略，使其在推理时单次前向即生成有效且合理的反事实，免去逐实例迭代优化，并在 13 个 UCR 数据集上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐空间中学习可迁移策略、单次前向替代逐实例优化」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成与训练监督提供借鉴；但任务是时间序列反事实生成，与视觉推理无直接联系，需核查策略输出是否依赖具体证据而非仅学得全局先验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning

**abstract/A1：** Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at IEEE Big Data 2026

</details>

### 225. [CASCoDe: A Closed-Loop Agentic Framework for Analog Sizing and Layout Co-Design](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11710v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11710

**作者：** Ziming Wei、Bingyang Liu、David Z. Pan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11710v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11710v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 CASCoDe，一个用于模拟电路从网表到版图的闭环 LLM 智能体框架：它把版图设计形式化为分层离散动作空间（尺寸选择、结构布局、局部精修、布线尝试选择），并在此之上运行反馈驱动的树搜索，每个动作都由 DRC、LVS 与提取 RC 仿真来判定。

**相关性简评：** 其「分层动作空间＋外部验证器反馈＋树搜索」的闭环结构可供核查 LVR 中的多步证据获取、搜索与停止决策以及验证成本分配，但论文本身面向非视觉的模拟电路版图，联系仅在方法层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CASCoDe: A Closed-Loop Agentic Framework for Analog Sizing and Layout Co-Design

**abstract/A1：** Expert analog layouts differ from auto-generated ones in density and regularity, not only in legality: experts make a succession of discrete, hierarchical physical decisions and revisit each after extracted electrical results, while most existing automated flows act on a physical search space fixed before the controller runs. We present CASCoDe, a closed-loop LLM agent framework for analog netlist-to-layout design that formalizes those expert decisions as a hierarchical discrete action space-sizing selection, structural floorplan, local layout refinement, routing-attempt selection-on which the agent runs feedback-driven tree search from a circuit netlist to a verified GDS. The agent authors the circuit-specific floorplans and scripts, and an execution layer of interface adaptations over adapted tools make every action land at physical implementation and be judged by DRC, LVS, and extracted-RC simulation. On 20 SKY130 amplifiers spanning single-, two-, and three-stage topologies, CASCoDe is the only flow that delivers a DRC- and LVS-clean routed layout when meeting design specifications for every circuit. It reduces area by 59-85% (mean 71%) against a conventional P&amp;R flow on identical PCells, raises mean device density from 0.39 to 0.74 against APPlace, MAGICAL, ALIGN and ICPI. A layout that beats every baseline in area and legality appears after 11 minutes of agent time on average, and ablations show that the structured action space and the feedback-guided tree search each reduce area and search cost.

</details>

### 226. [Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11717v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11717

**作者：** Kevin L. McKee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11717v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11717v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Functional Task Networks，一种仿皮层的分布式随机混合专家结构：推理时用少量 support 输入-输出样本计算稀疏二值路由掩码，训练中逐批重配置路由器并结合掩码重叠过滤回放，形成部分重叠的子网络基，以缓解灾难性遗忘并实现前后向迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「用少量支持样本在推理时选择子网络」的动态路由机制，可能为 LVR 中按任务/证据动态分配计算与选择视觉信息的模块化推理提供借鉴；掩码重叠几何作为概念共享结构的诊断量，也值得核查是否能刻画 latent 表示的相似与共享程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies

**abstract/A1：** Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start loss among matched-architecture comparators. The learned mask-overlap geometry tracks the known concept-sharing structure where available. We show experimentally that under correlated concept shift, support-set mask reconfiguration is necessary even for retention. Under domain shift, the distributed bank with replay is sufficient to handle retention without the configurer. Forward transfer, or head-start, and backward transfer, are also contributed by support-set mask configuration.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 227. [Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11752v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11752

**作者：** Khurram Khalil、Khaza Anuarul Hoque

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11752v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11752v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画语言模型后训练中的权重更新谱性质与步方向，证明稳定秩与固定能量秩在大维度下分离，并用完整 SVD、相邻 checkpoint 位移余弦及组相对优势与 learned critic+GAE 的对照实验说明更新方向的负余弦现象。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练信号如何塑造更新方向对齐」的测量方式（位移余弦、能量覆盖度、GRPO 与 critic 优势对照）可作为核查 LVR 轨迹训练中监督与贡献分配设计的分析线索，但对象是权重而非推理期 latent 状态，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spectral Rank and Step-Direction Dynamics in Language-Model Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** Language-model post-training modifies weights through cumulative updates and successive displacements, yet existing studies report seemingly conflicting spectral properties: nearly full-rank updates and low stable-rank changes. We show these observations are compatible and characterize update directions during training. For singular values following $σ\_i \\propto i^{-α}$ with $0 &lt; α\\leq 1/2$, we prove that stable rank becomes negligible relative to fixed-energy rank as dimension increases. Full singular value decompositions of selected OLMo-2-7B updates confirm this separation: three proximal policy optimization (PPO) attention updates have stable ranks of 9.6-18.3 but require 532-1,222 singular components to capture 80% of their energy. We next compute consecutive checkpoint-displacement cosines from full-model inner products. Across nine publicly released reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) stages, all 131 adjacent pairs have negative cosines on their native checkpoint grids, including PPO and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning comparisons across four model families show configuration-dependent alignment, including negative late-training cosines for Mistral and FP32 Llama. Finally, a controlled OLMo-2-1B study with three paired seeds and a 2,048-token response cap compares group-relative advantages against a learned critic with generalized advantage estimation (GAE). At matched 60-rollout windows, late-training mean cosines are +0.259 and +0.012, respectively; the paired critic-minus-group difference is -0.247 (seed-level 95% interval \[-0.358, -0.137\]). These findings distinguish spectral concentration, energy coverage, and trajectory direction, and demonstrate that the advantage system influences directional alignment under matched training conditions.

**comment/C1：** Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). Details: https://openreview.net/forum?id=UGIcayxHMI

</details>

### 228. [LangDepth: Vision-Language Scene Priors for Semantic Binning and Cross-Domain Monocular Depth Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11763v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11763

**作者：** Reyhaneh Ahani Manghotay、Jie Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11763v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11763v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LangDepth，用冻结 CLIP 编码器加可学习概念键把图像压成紧凑场景描述子，经 Scene Prior Module 预测场景条件化的度量深度区间，再由像素分配网络与置信门融合稠密视觉估计，实现跨域单目深度估计。

**相关性简评：** 其无需文本即可获得的场景级 latent 描述子、以及置信门在全局先验与稠密视觉证据间的仲裁机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉几何信息的内部保留和「先验 vs 证据」的使用决策提供可核查线索，属间接方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LangDepth: Vision-Language Scene Priors for Semantic Binning and Cross-Domain Monocular Depth Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Monocular depth estimation has advanced through large-scale pretraining and strong visual backbones, yet metric depth remains sensitive to scene-level scale. Indoor rooms and outdoor driving scenes occupy very different depth ranges, but most depth decoders infer this global structure implicitly from visual features. We ask whether scene-level semantic structure can instead act as an upstream prior that shapes the metric output space before dense prediction. We present LangDepth (SemanticBins), a monocular depth architecture that couples strong visual features with a scene-conditioned output space. A frozen CLIP encoder and a learnable bank of scene- and geometry-oriented concept keys convert image features into a compact scene descriptor, without requiring per-image text or an external captioner. A Scene Prior Module (SPM) maps this descriptor to a scene-conditioned metric depth interval, providing a global range anchor before dense decoding. In parallel, a DINOv2-L backbone with a lightweight FPN extracts dense visual features, and a Per-Pixel Assignment Network (PPAN) assigns pixels to the scene-prescribed bin structure. A confidence gate fuses the dense visual estimate with the SPM prior. We train LangDepth jointly on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI under a modest supervised depth budget, without web-scale depth supervision or pseudo-labelled depth data. A single model achieves delta\_1 = 0.960 on NYU, 0.960 on KITTI, 0.887 on DIODE indoor, 0.946 on iBims-1, and 0.861 on SUN RGB-D. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the SPM predicts compact indoor ranges and much wider outdoor KITTI ranges, the gate becomes SPM-dominant on outdoor scenes, and perturbing the routed scene context causes large drops on KITTI and iBims-1. These results support scene-conditioned output spaces as a practical and interpretable mechanism for cross-domain monocular depth estimation.

</details>

### 229. [ARMOR: Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise-Robust RAG Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11771v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11771

**作者：** Yan Wang、Yuxin Zhang、Shenyu Zhang、Yongrui Chen、Sheng Bi、Guilin Qi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11771v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11771v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ARMOR，把 RAG 噪声鲁棒性拆成知识边界感知、检索验证与鲁棒推理三个子任务，用自适应课程调度器按学生模型的学习进度安排训练任务，并以组间优势估计替代 GRPO 缓解模式坍缩，在三个多跳 QA 数据集上评估。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其中的证据验证/筛选子任务与按学习进度调度课程、组间优势估计的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理轨迹训练的监督分配、贡献分配提供可供核查的训练线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ARMOR: Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise-Robust RAG Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in mitigating hallucinations by incorporating external knowledge. However, the retrieval process inevitably introduces noise, posing significant challenges to RAG robustness. Fundamentally, noise robustness is a composite competency encompassing noise identification, retrieval filtering, and robust reasoning. Unfortunately, existing methods often fail to capture this holistic nature, typically restricted to single-dimensional enhancements or hampered by noise-induced optimization interference. To address these limitations, we decompose RAG robustness into three sub-tasks: knowledge boundary perception, retrieval verification, and robust reasoning. Accordingly, we propose ARMOR, an Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise Robust RAG Reasoning. Inspired by the teaching process, ARMOR introduces an adaptive task scheduler as a teacher to curate training plans according to the absolute learning progress of RAG generators (Student). Distinct from GRPO, ARMOR utilizes inter-group advantage estimation during learning to effectively mitigate mode collapse caused by limited output spaces. Experiments on three complex reasoning datasets (2WikiMultiHopQA, MusiQue, and HotPotQA) indicate that ARMOR achieves synergistic improvements in retrieval noise robustness, significantly outperforming baselines in output quality.

</details>

### 230. [CABrain: A Correlation-Aware Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11782v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11782

**作者：** SuGil Choi、Mooseop Kim、Chi Yoon Jeong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11782v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11782v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EEG 基础模型 CABrain，用基于图卷积的条件位置编码显式建模通道间相关性，并设计自适应掩码策略调节掩码块重建难度，在十个基准数据集上验证其效果。

**相关性简评：** 其按难度调度重建目标的自适应掩码，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督与贡献分配提供线索；GCN 位置编码对实体关系的建模可供核查，但原文不涉及视觉推理，需自行迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CABrain: A Correlation-Aware Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models have emerged as promising paradigms for decoding brain activity through large-scale self-supervised pretraining. Notably, most existing approaches employ masked patch reconstruction, in which randomly selected EEG patches are masked and recovered by the network. However, purely random masking may limit representation learning as informative patches from highly correlated channels often remain unmasked, causing the network to underutilize weakly correlated channels or serial dependencies. Furthermore, because these models are typically based on transformer architectures, their performance is influenced by the choice of positional encoding. Although positional encoding has been extensively explored in natural language processing and computer vision, few studies have adapted it to the unique characteristics of EEG signals. To address these limitations, this study introduces a conditional positional encoding method based on graph convolutional networks (GCNs) to explicitly model inter-channel correlations, along with an adaptive masking strategy that enhances representation learning by modulating the difficulty of masked patch reconstruction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to integrate graph-based representations into conditional positional encoding and introduce adaptive masking within EEG foundation model pretraining. Experimental results on ten benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed GCN-based positional encoding and adaptive masking strategies, both individually and in combination, achieve state-of-the-art or competitive performance, highlighting their effectiveness in EEG foundation modeling.

</details>

### 231. [FMA-Net: Flexible Modality Adaptation for Robust Multimodal Face Presentation Attack Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11790v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11790

**作者：** Yuhao Gao、Yichen Shi、Zitong Yu、Hongyang Wang、Hongrui Li、Ruixin Zhang、Shouhong Ding、Jun Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11790v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11790v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FMA-Net，用指令引导的 latent 空间翻译从 RGB 估计缺失的深度或红外模态，并以可学习文本提示作模态不变语义锚点、配合合成到真实特征的域对齐，用于模态不完整条件下的人脸展示攻击检测。

**相关性简评：** 「由可见模态经 latent 翻译补出缺失模态」可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据补全与模态不变锚点的做法，但任务属安全检测、与推理期状态生成距离较远，需确认翻译表示是否被下游真正使用而非仅作数据增广。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FMA-Net: Flexible Modality Adaptation for Robust Multimodal Face Presentation Attack Detection

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal face presentation attack detection (fPAD) improves robustness using complementary RGB, depth, and infrared (IR) cues, but deployment remains challenging when modalities are unavailable or incomplete. Existing flexible-modality methods mainly use zero-filling or modality omission, potentially discarding cross-modal information and introducing modality-dependent bias. We propose the Flexible Modality Adaptation Network (FMA-Net), a unified framework that compensates for missing modalities through instruction-guided latent-space translation. The Face Modality Instruct Translator (FMIT) estimates target modality observations from RGB inputs, while context-aware category enhancement uses learnable text prompts as modality-invariant semantic anchors. A Facial Feature Adapter (F2A) integrates global facial structure and local spoof-relevant cues to enhance discriminative representations. Synthetic-to-Real Face Domain Alignment (SR-FDA) reduces feature discrepancies between translated and real modalities, with benefits depending on the missing-modality pattern and data domain. Experiments on WMCA and PADISI-Face validate the framework. On WMCA with a 70% modality missing ratio, FMA-Net achieves a mean ACER of 3.22% across four intra-domain missing-modality protocols, compared with 4.24% for the strongest baseline by the same criterion. When both depth and IR are entirely unavailable, it achieves 5.23% ACER, compared with 5.99% for the best competing result. Cross-domain experiments also reveal limitations of synthetic-to-real alignment under dataset shifts. These results support FMA-Net as a practical approach to fPAD with flexible and incomplete modalities.

</details>

### 232. [APO2CS: Advantage-Aware Preference Optimization for Two-Level Constructive Search in Combinatorial Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11792v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11792

**作者：** Kaixi Yang、Linbo Qiao、Wei Shang、Yanqi Shi、Dongsheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11792v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11792v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 APO2CS，一种面向构造式神经组合优化求解器的偏好训练目标：宏观层用目标值差构造优势项以保留解质量差异，微观层比较部分构造轨迹以提供更密集的过程监督，可从头训练或微调预训练策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「部分轨迹偏好 + 优势加权」的过程级监督可供核查能否用于 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配与训练信号设计；与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，属方法借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** APO2CS: Advantage-Aware Preference Optimization for Two-Level Constructive Search in Combinatorial Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Preference optimization has emerged as a promising alternative to reward-based training for neural combinatorial optimization. However, existing methods typically rely on binary pairwise labels, which discard the magnitude of solution-quality differences and provide supervision only at the complete-solution level. We propose Advantage-aware Preference Optimization for Two-level Constructive Search (APO2CS), a preference-based training objective for constructive neural solvers that integrates both macro-level and micro-level supervision. At the macro level, APO2CS enriches pairwise preferences with an advantage term derived from objective-value differences. At the micro level, it compares partial trajectories, thereby providing denser supervision throughout the sequential construction process. The resulting objective can be used either to train a policy from scratch or to fine-tune a pretrained one. Experimental results show that APO2CS improves the expressiveness and search capability of preference learning for combinatorial optimization, while demonstrating strong effectiveness and adaptability across multiple combinatorial optimization tasks.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 233. [Benchmarking CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Models for Explainable Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Calibration, Decision Analysis, and External Validation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11793v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11793

**作者：** Akwasi Asare

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11793v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11793v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 7,216 张脑肿瘤 MRI 上将六种 CNN、ViT 与基础模型做四分类基准，比较准确率、校准、可解释性、集成与决策曲线，并做去重筛查与 1,675 张外部图像验证；发现内部准确率无法区分架构，且归因图虽通过模型随机化检验却定位专家标注肿瘤较差。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身是医学分类基准而非推理研究，但其归因图的模型随机化检验与定位评估，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否真正被内部状态使用、以及旁路虚假利用提供可借鉴的检验线索，需进一步核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Models for Explainable Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Calibration, Decision Analysis, and External Validation

**abstract/A1：** Deep learning models for brain tumor MRI classification are usually compared by accuracy alone, on public datasets whose independence is rarely checked. We benchmarked six architectures: two convolutional networks (EfficientNetV2-M and ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny), two vision transformers (Swin-V2-S and ViT-L/16), and two foundation models (DINOv2-L and MedSigLIP-448), for four-class classification of 7,216 public MRI images. We assessed accuracy, calibration, explainability, ensembles, and decision curves, with every fitted quantity estimated on validation data only. Pixel-verified duplicate screening showed that 36% of the test images had a near-duplicate in the training data. Test accuracy ranged from 94.5% to 95.6%, with no pairwise difference after Holm correction, and fell to 90.3% to 91.7% on the 773 test images free of duplicates and shared patients. Ensembles did not outperform the best single model. Attribution maps passed a model-randomization test but localized expert-annotated tumors poorly. On 1,675 external BDNeuro-MRI images that did not duplicate the training data, accuracy ranged from 77.6% (MedSigLIP-448) to 95.0% (ViT-L/16), and 12 of 15 pairwise differences were significant. Internal accuracy on this public collection therefore did not distinguish the architectures, whereas the duplicate-filtered external test did.

**comment/C1：** Under review at Scientific Report Journal, Springer

### 234. [When to Trust Adaptation: Contextual Fusion for Transferable Vision-Language Prompting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11824v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11824

**作者：** Zhenyuan Chen、Wenshuo Tao、Zhuo Huang、Shuo Chen、Mingming Cheng、Xiang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11824v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11824v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文关注视觉语言模型遇到新类或新域时应在多大程度上信任已学提示，提出 Contextual Adaptive Fusion：把冻结与提示化的视觉、文本表示配成四个预测分支，按各分支的预测置信度及该分支在无标签目标集上偏向某类的频率来仲裁分歧，融合系数在源域学一次后固定。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部置信度 vs 集合级频率偏置」的分支仲裁与源域固定融合权重，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据分支与语言先验的加权、避免单一路径主导推理状态提供可供核查的线索；但本文不做 latent 推理，也无推理状态，迁移价值需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When to Trust Adaptation: Contextual Fusion for Transferable Vision-Language Prompting

**abstract/A1：** When a vision-language model encounters a new class or domain, how much should it trust its learned prompts? Because source adaptation can correct pretrained errors on some target images while disturbing valid predictions on others, we introduce Contextual Adaptive Fusion (CAF), which retains four prediction branches by pairing frozen and prompted visual and textual representations. To arbitrate when branches disagree on an image, CAF combines each branch's predictive confidence with how frequently the branches favor its proposed class across the unlabeled target collection, placing greater trust in predictions that are locally confident yet less dominated by collection-wide frequency bias. The fusion coefficients are learned once on source data and remain fixed at inference. Trained on ImageNet, CAF achieves 69.96% average accuracy across ten cross-dataset benchmarks (1.92 percentage points above ManiPT) and remains highly competitive across four ImageNet variants, setting a new best of 52.21% on ImageNet-S. In base-to-novel transfer across eleven datasets, CAF further reaches 79.77% novel-class accuracy and an 82.81% harmonic mean. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyuanchenai/CAF.

</details>

### 235. [End-to-End Joint Training of Super-Resolution and Compression Artifact Removal for Industrial Machine Vision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11831v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11831

**作者：** Dang BuiDinh、Sang NguyenQuang、Anh NguyenPhuong、Wen-Hsiao Peng、Xiem HoangVan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11831v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11831v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向工业机器视觉，提出将超分辨率与压缩伪影去除端到端联合训练的增强框架，并比较固定权重与基于不确定性的动态权重损失，以兼顾人眼感知与下游缺陷检测性能。

**相关性简评：** 其不确定性驱动的多目标损失动态加权可供核查是否用于平衡 LVR 中视觉细节保留与推理监督两类目标，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** End-to-End Joint Training of Super-Resolution and Compression Artifact Removal for Industrial Machine Vision

**abstract/A1：** In industrial machine vision, images captured by edge devices are often downsampled and compressed to reduce bandwidth, introducing resolution loss and compression artifacts that severely degrade the performance of downstream tasks, such as defect detection. Existing quality enhancement methods typically apply super-resolution (SR) or compression artifact removal (CAR) independently or in a sequential manner and are largely optimized for human visual fidelity rather than machine perception. This paper proposes an end-to-end quality enhancement framework that integrates SR and CAR with a unified training strategy that optimizes both human-perception and machine-perception objectives. We investigate fixed-weight and uncertainty-based dynamic-weight loss functions to balance reconstruction quality and machine vision task performance. Extensive experiments on PCB Defect, DeepPCB, and NEU-DET datasets show that the proposed jointly trained model generally outperforms standalone and separately trained SR-CAR pipelines. In particular, under severe JPEG compression, our method improves defect detection performance from 0.461 to 0.887 mAP@50 on PCB Defect over sequential SR-CAR baselines, with only a slight reduction in PSNR. These results demonstrate that joint optimization is critical for compression-aware industrial machine vision systems.

</details>

### 236. [MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11839v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11839

**作者：** Shirley X. Yu、Amey P. Pasarkar、Adji Bousso Dieng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11839v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11839v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 MOOD 基准，在材料性质预测的 GNN 上系统评测 15 种事后 OOD 检测器与 2 种监督诊断探针，覆盖多种架构、任务与物理驱动的分布偏移，发现检测器普遍接近随机水平，并将失败归因于方法瓶颈与编码器瓶颈两类。

**相关性简评：** 其用监督探针区分「表示中含信号但未被提取」与「表示中根本不存在信号」的归因方式，可能为 LVR 中判断视觉细节是否保留在 latent 状态、以及判定是读出机制还是表示本身失效提供可核查的诊断线索；领域为材料图网络，与视觉多模态推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in high stakes scientific applications, yet methods that flag OOD inputs without retraining the model have been validated almost exclusively on image classification. We introduce MOOD (Materials Out-of-Distribution Detection), a benchmark for evaluating whether these post-hoc OOD detectors transfer to graph neural networks (GNNs) on materials property prediction. MOOD evaluates 15 post-hoc detectors and 2 supervised diagnostic probes across 4 GNN architectures, 5 MatBench tasks, and 15 physically motivated compositional and structural shifts, yielding 264 evaluation settings and over 13,000 AUROC measurements across three encoder training seeds. Our evaluation reveals three key findings. First, current post-hoc detectors perform near chance; all 15 detectors achieve an AUROC around 0.5. Second, detector failures decompose into two regimes: method bottlenecks and encoder bottlenecks. Method bottlenecks arise when supervised probes can separate in-distribution (ID) from OOD samples but unsupervised detectors fail, meaning that the embeddings contain OOD signal that current detectors do not extract. Encoder bottlenecks arise when even supervised probes fail to separate ID from OOD samples, indicating that the relevant shift is not accessible in the frozen GNN representation. Third, when OOD prediction error exceeds ID error, the AUROC of distance-based and density-based detectors correlates with the size of that gap. Collectively, these findings indicate that reliable OOD detection in scientific domains requires representation learning strategies that explicitly preserve OOD relevant signal, particularly for tasks where current GNN architectures encode no extractable signal at all.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations &amp; Datasets Track)

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用可执行设备日志设计受控评测，区分参考答案一致、证据充分性认证与上下文适切行为，并在80条确认历史上测试两个 reader 的匹配与弃答表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「两条合法历史产生相同可见上下文但答案不同」的充分性判据，可能为核查 LVR 的 latent 状态是否保留任务必要证据，以及 STOP/弃答决策的评价提供方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correct Answers from Insufficient Histories: A Controlled Study of Agent Memory Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** An answer can match the reference for a complete agent history even when the reader's visible history does not determine it. We study this distinction using executable device logs. Our protocol separates reference agreement, certified evidence sufficiency, and context-appropriate behavior. Insufficiency requires two legal histories yielding byte-identical visible contexts but different answers; public chronology and query cutoffs certify sufficient prefixes. On 80 confirmation histories, Qwen3-32B matches 87 hidden references among 203 insufficient raw-prefix instances, with only seven appropriate abstentions. A fixed-input DeepSeek-V4-Flash replication matches 85 and abstains on 21 of the same 203 instances. Each reader makes 1,600 requests. Compact CSV's estimated appropriateness effects remain inconclusive: +3.16 percentage points, clustered 95% interval \[0.00,6.57\], for Qwen and +2.46, \[-1.84,6.94\], for DeepSeek. A separate held-out judge study achieves 99.38% correctness but retains support errors and truncations; a deterministic baseline solves all constructed cases. These results support an evaluation diagnosis across two hosted reader configurations, not gains for a general memory system or natural-language evidence assessment.

</details>

### 238. [MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11846v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11846

**作者：** Gwangseon Jang、Sieun Yun、Dong Ho Lee、Kyong-Ha Lee、Chanuk Lim、Jin Woo Choi、Han Seul Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11846v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11846v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作面向材料性质预测的 OOD 泛化，不让 LLM 直接预测，而是让其生成候选「化学环境」分类学，用仅基于训练集的伪 OOD 验证筛选有效划分，再在各划分内做不变特征选择并门控聚合，在 2D 钙钛矿带隙等任务上降低误差。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成多个候选划分—用训练侧伪 OOD 验证保留—门控聚合」流程，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的生成、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴线索，但属材料科学远域应用，与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection

**abstract/A1：** Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains a central challenge in materials property prediction, where models must extrapolate to novel chemistries beyond the training distribution. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong scientific reasoning, their direct use for quantitative prediction remains limited. To address this, we systematically evaluate multiple roles for LLM assistance, finding that only taxonomy-based grouping consistently improves OOD generalization over a strong kNN+GBT baseline. Building on this, we here propose MOTIF, a framework that leverages LLMs not as predictors, but as generators of candidate taxonomies that partition materials into chemically meaningful environments. These taxonomies are evaluated via training-only pseudo-OOD validation, and only those that improve generalization are retained. Invariant feature selection is then applied within each accepted taxonomy, followed by gated aggregation across taxonomies. We evaluate on 2D halide perovskites, where bandgap prediction must generalize across distinct organic spacer families. On this benchmark, MOTIF reduces mean OOD MAE from 0.122 to 0.111 eV. Under a frozen dev/test protocol, the deployable configuration further improves errors from 0.123 to 0.117 eV (electronic bandgap) and from 0.181 to 0.173 eV (optical bandgap). Beyond this primary task, we validate transferability across additional materials datasets, including 3D perovskite solar cell efficiencies and Matbench benchmarks with structure-based splits. Across domains, MOTIF consistently improves robustness under distribution shift, outperforming expert-defined groupings, rule-based heuristics, and clustering baselines, while remaining competitive with strong classical selection methods. These results demonstrate that LLMs are most effective not as predictors, but as tools for discovering structure in data.

**comment/C1：** 37 pages, 18 figures, 33 tables. Preprint

</details>

### 239. [Causal Signal Credit Assignment for Verilog Code Generation via Counterfactual Hardware Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11848v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11848

**作者：** Yali Du、Ming Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11848v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11848v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对 Verilog 代码生成中仿真只给出模块级通过/失败的粗粒度反馈问题，提出 CSCA：先在信号级做连续行为验证，再对输出驱动的赋值语句片段施加五种反事实干预，将信号误差变化与行为一致性合成为语句级 credit，并映射为 token 权重用于加权 DPO。

**相关性简评：** 其反事实干预＋连续 credit 映射为 token 权重的方法线索，可能可供核查如何为 latent 推理轨迹提供步骤级贡献分配与训练监督，但任务与视觉/多模态推理相距较远，迁移可行性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Causal Signal Credit Assignment for Verilog Code Generation via Counterfactual Hardware Verification

**abstract/A1：** Large language models have improved Verilog generation, yet functional correctness remains difficult to optimize because simulation commonly provides a coarse module-level pass/fail outcome. Such feedback discards useful evidence from partially correct RTL modules and cannot determine whether a source statement is functionally responsible for an observed output behavior. We present a new method named Causal Signal Credit Assignment (CSCA), which is a counterfactual preference-optimization framework for Verilog generation. CSCA first performs continuous signal-level behavioral verification on sampled candidate modules. It then locates output-driving assignment spans and applies five interventions while holding the remaining module and testbench fixed. The resulting changes in signal-level errors are combined with behavioral agreement to form a continuous statement credit, which is mapped to response-token weights for strict weighted direct preference optimization. This enables CSCA to learn from locally supported statements without uniformly reinforcing an otherwise incorrect response. Built on Icarus Verilog and a CodeV-derived corpus, CSCA is evaluated on VerilogEval~2.0 and RTLLM~v2.0, including both code completion and specification-to-RTL tasks. With a Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct backbone, CSCA leads the evaluated 7B-scale models and remains comparable to the much larger GPT-5.4-mini on the reported Verilog-generation benchmarks.

</details>

### 240. [DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11856

**作者：** Bingzhang Wang、Mo Poorsartep、Yasaman Esfandiari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11856v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DeltaForge，对同源独立微调得到的多个驾驶 VLA（含 VLM 推理专家与 flow-matching 动力学专家）的权重更新做联合 SVD，分解为共享基与极小的域特定分量，再用两个 clip 级盲路由器基于代理数据和软标签选择，从而事后合并成单个多域模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「低秩共享基＋微小域特定残差＋轻量路由」的组合思路可供核查是否能用于组织多个专门化的 latent 推理模块或按需分配计算；但该文的路由发生在参数层而非推理期 latent 状态，与 LVR 主线的实际距离需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.

</details>

<a id="paper-241"></a>

### 241. [Are UFOs Real? Introducing Unified Factored Organizers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11862v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11862

**作者：** Thomas X. Sheppard、Alon Albalak、Joel Lehman、Kenneth O. Stanley

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11862v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11862v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 unified factored organizers（UFOs）：先训练一个网络去建模其他网络表示中的规律，再把任务网络的内部表示与该校验器对齐并联合优化；在图像回归与模块算术 grokking 任务上报告表示质量提升和收敛步数大幅减少。

**相关性简评：** 该文属通用表示学习、并非多模态推理，但其「用可训练组织器对内部表示施加表示级监督」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态训练目标、信息坍缩与轨迹贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Are UFOs Real? Introducing Unified Factored Organizers

**abstract/A1：** Implicit in much research in deep learning is the assumption that if a network achieves low loss, then it must have learned a good representation of its training data. Recent work by Kumar et al. (2025, arXiv:2505.11581) questions this assumption, arguing that networks trained with conventional gradient descent achieve low loss despite learning fractured entangled representations (FER), leaving related concepts disconnected and unrelated concepts entangled inappropriately. Kumar et al. further show that dramatically better representations are possible: a network evolved through an open-ended, human-in-the-loop process learned unified factored representations (UFR) that capture the regularities of the domain far better than a counterpart with nearly identical outputs trained with conventional gradient descent. Inspired by UFR, this paper introduces unified factored organizers (UFOs), networks trained to model regularities in the representations of other networks. A network can then be trained both to achieve low loss on its task objective and to align its representations with the model learned by the UFO. Networks trained with UFOs are shown to learn qualitatively superior representations in an image-regression domain where representations are easily interpretable. To provide quantitative evidence for the impact of UFOs on representation learning, a transformer is trained with and without UFO regularization to grok a modular arithmetic problem set. When combined with weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 10x relative to weight decay alone. Without weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 100x relative to an unregularized baseline. If UFOs are real, they suggest a new paradigm where loss functions themselves are trained to learn an effective model of good representation.

</details>

### 242. [Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11863v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11863

**作者：** Francisco M. López、Francisco Cruz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11863v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11863v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究感官延迟导致的状态—观测时间错位问题，提出 Hindsight Critics：在非对称 Soft Actor-Critic 中，用后见信息对齐的 state-action transition 训练 critic，使只能获得延迟观测的 actor 借助特权价值估计学习，并在 DelayBench 上与延迟感知/无感知基线比较。

**相关性简评：** 延迟观测与非对称特权 critic 的训练思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中「训练期用完整视觉证据、推理期仅有受限观测」的监督与信用分配问题，但其为连续控制 RL 设定，向 VLM latent 推理的迁移尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?

**abstract/A1：** Sensory delays create temporal misalignments between the state of the environment and the observations available to an agent, turning Markovian control problems into partially observable ones. In this work, we inquire whether such misalignments can be mitigated during training by using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. We introduce Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of the Soft Actor-Critic for reinforcement learning under partial observability. The critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions whereas the actor learns from the resulting privileged value estimates despite only having access to delayed observations. Comparisons against delay-aware and unaware baselines on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without requiring modifications to the agent's observations during deployment.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the AJCAI2026 conference. Cite as: "López, F. M., &amp; Cruz, F. (2026). Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?. In Australasian Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (pp. 1-10). Cham: Springer International Publishing."

</details>

### 243. [Beyond Head Importance: Collective Computation in Video Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11875v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11875

**作者：** Yi Yang、Siyuan Liu、Bingbing Nie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11875v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11875v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文通过消融四类视频 Transformer 的注意力头并仅微调 MLP，分析头部输出的下游使用与跨层组合，指出个体重要性排名无法完全解释集体贡献。

**相关性简评：** 其「先消融、再分离下游读出」的贡献归因思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容使用与视觉贡献分配；但研究对象是视频理解而非推理，需确认可否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Head Importance: Collective Computation in Video Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Attention heads in video Transformers vary greatly in functional importance. Understanding their contributions requires examining not only which heads are important, but also how they participate in collective computation within the network. We study this collective computation from two perspectives: the downstream use of head outputs and the composition of interactions across layers. Ablation analyses of four video Transformers show that high-importance heads identified on a single task also support other video understanding tasks and help preserve the representational structure that distinguishes different videos. Representational responses to head ablation correlate weakly with head importance after the attention module, but more strongly after the MLP in the same block. Adapting this downstream processing through MLP-only fine-tuning further improves the use of lower-importance head outputs. Meanwhile, through composition across layers, sets of heads with shorter spatiotemporal attention distances support stronger perturbation responses at distant tokens than sets with longer distances. Their joint ablation causes even greater performance loss than ablating equally sized sets of high-importance heads, revealing collective contributions not fully captured by individual importance rankings. These findings highlight collective computation as a key perspective for understanding attention head function: functional contributions depend on both how head outputs are used downstream and how local interactions compose across layers.

</details>

### 244. [Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11890v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11890

**作者：** Yuji Nozawa、Yu-Chieh Lin、Youyang Ng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11890v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11890v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 DINO 类自监督 ViT 中引入两种视觉聚焦损失，将模型注意力对齐到图像特定区域，促使注意力头形成更强且更多样的空间选择性，并评估零样本分割等密集预测任务。

**相关性简评：** 其以损失塑造注意力头的空间分工，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与内部视觉细节保留提供辅助训练线索，但未涉及推理或 latent 状态，迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://yuji-nozawa.github.io/ReFoCo/

### 245. [Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11898v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11898

**作者：** Zikai Zhou、Zhengpeng Xie、Shitong Shao、Lichen Bai、Tianhao Zhang、Bojun Cheng、Zeke Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11898v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11898v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DA-DMD：在 few-step 扩散蒸馏训练中复用教师模型与 fake 模型之间已算出的分布不一致量，仅在高噪声区间按其大小调节更新强度，从而在不增加模型、评估器或推理开销的前提下改善少步生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「用训练中已有的教师—学生分歧作为内在信号来缩放更新强度、并在极端分歧下衰减影响」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的自适应加权与监督贡献分配，但属图像生成领域，需较多迁移验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Distribution Matching Distillation~(DMD) enables strong few-step diffusion generation by matching the student distribution to a pretrained teacher. Existing improvements to DMD often augment its supervision or modify its optimization machinery. We ask a complementary question: \\emph{can DMD diagnose its own updates using signals already produced during training?} DMD inherently computes the discrepancy between a pretrained teacher and a fake model tracking the student distribution, but conventionally uses it primarily to determine the distribution matching direction. We find that the magnitude of this teacher--fake disagreement provides additional diagnostic information. Across extensive experiments, large disagreement in the high-noise regime consistently coincides with substantially higher-energy DMD updates. This reveals a dual role of disagreement: it determines not only \\emph{where} the student should move, but also provides an intrinsic signal of \\emph{how aggressively} the update should be applied. Based on this observation, we introduce Disagreement-Aware Distribution Matching Distillation (DA-DMD), which activates only in the high-noise regime and continuously modulates the update strength according to teacher--fake disagreement. DA-DMD reuses quantities already available during DMD training and requires no additional model, evaluator, or inference-time modification. We show that it exactly recovers vanilla DMD outside the selected region, reduces update energy only through selected samples, and exhibits redescending influence under extreme disagreement. Across multiple diffusion backbones, DA-DMD consistently improves few-step generation at the same inference cost. On SD3.5-L, DA-DMD improves HPSv2 from $28.23$ to $30.93$, while achieving a $64.4\\%$ average win rate over DMD2.

</details>

### 246. [RBA: A Read-out Basis Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Interactive OCTA Vessel Segmentation with SEEM](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11906v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11906

**作者：** Jaafar M. Al-Ghabban、Mohammad Reza Mohammadi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11906v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11906v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 SEEM 在 OCTA 血管分割上细血管效果差、需多次点击的问题，提出 Read-out Basis Adapter：在读出分支以半分辨率生成 32 张图像特定的基图，各候选掩码经零初始化投影按自身向量读取，并配合 rank-1 LoRA 编码器分支，仅增加约 47 万可训练参数。

**相关性简评：** 其「把适配容量放在读出而非编码器、并提高读到特征的分辨率」这一结构线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中细粒度视觉证据如何在内部状态里保留并被下游读取。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RBA: A Read-out Basis Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Interactive OCTA Vessel Segmentation with SEEM

**abstract/A1：** Retinal disease monitoring with optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) relies on segmentation of vessels and the foveal avascular zone (FAZ). Promptable models such as SEEM (Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once) allow click-based refinement, but without adaptation SEEM segments thin vessels poorly and needs many clicks. Fully fine-tuning its 342 million parameters on a few hundred images is costly and risks overfitting, and parameter-efficient methods such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA) usually adapt only the encoder. Yet SEEM reads every candidate mask from one feature map at quarter resolution, too coarse for vessels one to three pixels wide. This study introduces the Read-out Basis Adapter (RBA), whose read-out branch generates 32 image-specific basis maps at half resolution. Each candidate accesses them through its own vector and a zero-initialised projection, so the model starts exactly as SEEM. The encoder branch, a standard rank-1 LoRA, supplies the information needed to tell arteries from veins. RBA adds 0.47 million trainable parameters. Under simulated error-driven clicks, with the ground truth used only to place them, RBA outperforms LoRA, Conv-LoRA andAdaptFormer on OCTA-500 3mmlarge vessels. Averaged over three seeds, it reaches an intersection over union (IoU) of 85.16% and a Dice score of 91.93%, 2.90 and 1.72 percentage points above Conv-LoRA. On the 6 mm subset, one run gives margins of 4.35 and 2.76 points. The gain extends to arteries, veins and ROSE-O but not to the FAZ. In SEEM, adaptation capacity pays more at the mask read-out than in the encoder.

</details>

### 247. [LBSNet: Lightweight Brain State Modeling via Learnable Spectral Prototypes for EEG-Based Fatigue Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11916v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11916

**作者：** Kun Jia、Zhenyu Cao、Hanlin Yu、Zeyuan Li、Yixuan Liu、Zhongye Xia、Sen Song、Zhiyuan Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11916v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11916v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LBSNet，一个轻量 EEG 疲劳检测网络：用频带特定时间卷积、共享空间投影与跨频带重校准提取多频带特征，将窗口内相对频谱活动编码为归一化描述子并与可学习频谱原型软匹配，再由原型分配与原型重要性共同决定时间权重来聚合功率，并在 SEED-VIG、SADT 上做跨被试验证。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理主线无直接关系，但「可学习原型软匹配 + 原型重要性驱动的时间聚合权重」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态抽象及各推理片段贡献分配提供方法线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LBSNet: Lightweight Brain State Modeling via Learnable Spectral Prototypes for EEG-Based Fatigue Detection

**abstract/A1：** EEG-based fatigue detection requires modeling spectral information across bands and its temporal variation. Recent methods combine multi-band modeling with adaptive temporal processing, yet how spectral structure across bands should influence the contribution of each temporal interval remains insufficiently explored. We propose LBSNet, a lightweight network that uses prototype-based brain-state modeling to link local spectral structure with temporal aggregation. LBSNet extracts compact multi-band features through band-specific temporal convolution, shared spatial projections, and cross-band recalibration. Within each window, relative spectral activity is encoded as a normalized descriptor and softly matched to learnable spectral prototypes. Prototype assignments and learned prototype importance jointly determine temporal weights for power aggregation, allowing the spectral pattern of each window to guide its contribution to the prediction. Subject-independent experiments on SEED-VIG and SADT show that LBSNet outperforms seven baselines while maintaining low computational cost. Ablation and visualization analyses support prototype-guided temporal weighting, while the learned prototypes reveal a gradual redistribution of relative cross-band spectral states with increasing fatigue. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zy0929/LBSNet.

</details>

### 248. [3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11964v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11964

**作者：** Zixiang Ai、Zhenyu Cui、Xu Zou、Jiahuan Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11964v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11964v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对前馈 3D 重建模型在低光照、人-场景联合重建与测试时适应等长尾场景下的失效，将问题归因于跨视图关系注意力结构坍缩，并提出 3R-Adapter：以可变形检索获取任务相关关系候选、关系重连重建跨视图结构、一致性精化将新关系注入稳定预测的轻量 PEFT 方案。

**相关性简评：** 其「关系注意力结构坍缩」与显式重连、精化的适配思路，可能为 LVR 中注意力结构对 latent 相似度与跨视图/跨模态证据对应关系的影响提供可核查的诊断与干预线索，但论文本身面向 3D 重建而非多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** 3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model

**abstract/A1：** Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight

</details>

### 249. [ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11976v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11976

**作者：** Sina Barazandeh、Arth Banka、Jose Lugo-Martinez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11976v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11976v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ShiftCache，针对 AlphaGenome、Borzoi 等 DNA 序列到功能模型，把 indel 变异后与参考序列相同、只是整体位移的片段所对应的编码器激活复用起来，其余部分按批分块重算，从而在保证与稠密执行一致的前提下加速变异打分。

**相关性简评：** 其「输入局部改动、其余部分平移」时精确复用中间激活并按块补齐的思路，可能为 LVR 中新增视觉证据或滑动窗口时增量更新 latent 状态、避免全量重编码提供可供核查的工程线索，但复用条件与容差表现需结合原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings

**abstract/A1：** Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. We present ShiftCache, an exact reuse system that encodes each shifted reference once and shares it among all variants scored in the same window with the same shift. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. On held-out AlphaGenome windows shared by many indels, in strict fp32 on one A6000, ShiftCache is 3.5 to 6.5$\\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution and 1.6 to 2.7$\\times$ faster than our adaptation of layer-by-layer reuse to indels. It is 3.5 to 4.1$\\times$ faster than dense reimplementations of two published analyses with Borzoi and AlphaGenome, and 2.6$\\times$ faster than dense execution with Enformer. Scoring each variant in its own centered 131 kb window makes ShiftCache only 1.36$\\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution, and highly diverse insertion lengths or many dispersed edits can make it slower than layer-by-layer reuse or dense execution. For encoders that meet our conditions, ShiftCache computes the same predictions as dense execution in exact arithmetic. On an A6000, every checked output of the default AlphaGenome and Borzoi runs matches dense execution within an absolute and relative tolerance of $10^{-5}$. With larger tile batches, with Enformer or on an H100, a small fraction of values exceeds this tolerance.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables, including appendix

</details>

### 250. [FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11979v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11979

**作者：** Md Anwar Hossen、Ali Jannesari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11979v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11979v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FireGate：在持续 RL 微调中把每个任务的更新（如新 LoRA）置于门控之后，门控是作用于冻结底层特征的分类器，逐 prompt 决定是否启用该更新，并在未标注的受保护 prompt 上校准触发率，从而在训练前给出行为变化的上界；在最多五任务的 RL 流与七个模型上验证了门控对旧任务与拒答等行为的保持。

**相关性简评：** 逐输入门控加校准触发率、把「启用额外更新的频率」与行为偏移上界绑定的做法，可能为 LVR 中何时启用 latent 计算或停止的开关设计与其代价刻画提供借鉴；但该工作在纯文本持续微调场景，门控在视觉特征上的可判别性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning a deployed language model on one task after another can change behaviour that should stay fixed, such as earlier skills, general chat or refusals. Today, such forgetting is found only after training, on the benchmarks someone chose to run. This work bounds, before training, how often its outputs change on chosen prompt distributions. FireGate places each task's update, such as a new LoRA, behind a gate, which is a classifier on the model's frozen lower layers that decides for each prompt whether the update is used. Where no gate fires, the model computes exactly what the old one computes. As a result, on any prompt distribution, every bounded behaviour score changes by at most the gates' firing rate there over a whole task stream. Calibrating each gate on unlabeled prompts of what must not change fixes that rate before training, with a PAC guarantee, whatever weights training produces. Forgetting is thus bounded by the gate's false-alarm rate, and its price is the gate's power: no update, gated or not, that changes as few protected outputs can change new-task outputs more often than the best test of that level tells new-task prompts from protected ones. On reinforcement-learning streams of up to five tasks, gated training keeps the earlier tasks and changes 3.3% of held-out chat responses, whereas ungated training changes 91.8%. Across seven models, the gain kept behind the gate follows its firing rate on new-task prompts, measured before training. The certificate covers the gated model as deployed, on the prompt distributions sampled for calibration, not against an adversary who searches for prompts that fire the gate.

</details>

### 251. [HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12011

**作者：** Kenneth Yang、Yu-Chiang Frank Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12011v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究流式 3D 重建中循环状态的更新可靠性问题，把 CUT3R 式状态更新分解为「幅度」与「方向」两部分，指出既有免训练扩展只调节写入幅度，进而提出用局部一致的历史状态修正更新方向、并依当前观测与历史的视觉差异调制幅度，以抑制冗余写入、保留互补证据。

**相关性简评：** 虽属 3D 重建而非 VLM 推理，其「状态写入增益 + 更新方向」分解与基于历史一致性/视觉差异的证据筛选门控，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新控制与视觉证据取舍提供可核查的机制线索，需阅读原文确认适用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://kennethyangg.github.io/HIST3R/

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向多步化学反应机理预测，构建化学机理知识图谱来引导 LLM，并用图神经网络生成候选路径做偏好优化，推理阶段再通过关系检索模块从图谱中抽取相关证据对路径进行修正。

**相关性简评：** 其「检索外部证据—筛选相关关系—迭代修正候选假设」的推理期流程，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与假设精化问题相通，可供核查；但领域为化学文本与图，非多模态，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Enhancing Multi-Step Chemical Mechanism Prediction with Graph-Guided Preference Data

**abstract/A1：** Predicting multi-step chemical reaction mechanisms requires identifying plausible intermediates and correctly ordering the elementary reaction steps. Existing computational methods focus on single-step elementary reaction prediction, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen reaction spaces. We introduce a graph-guided framework for multi-step chemical mechanism prediction that leverages a chemical mechanism knowledge graph (ChemMechKG) to guide large language models (LLMs). To improve pathway prediction, we develop a graph-aligned reaction mechanism predictor (GRMP) that uses graph neural networks to generate synthetic candidate pathways for pathway optimization. During inference, we design a relation retrieval (RR) module to extract relevant graph evidence from the KG for pathway refinement. Experiments show that GRMP achieves the highest pathway accuracy among all compared methods on ChemMechQA and oMe-Gold, reaching 48.1% and 57.9%, respectively. On a fixed sample of 110 out-of-distribution reactions from ChemMechQA-Hard, GRMP achieves 36.4% top-1 pathway accuracy. LLM-as-Judge and human assessment further demonstrate its ability to generalize to unseen reactions.

**comment/C1：** 5 figures, 3tables

</details>
