### 253. [Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12016v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12016

**作者：** Shayan Talaei、Agam Bhatia、Arshia Soltani Moakhar、Jonas Hübotter、Amin Saberi、Azalia Mirhoseini

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12016v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12016v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Speculative Self-Distillation，一种按 token 混合策略的自蒸馏方法：默认由学生生成 rollout，仅当教师（带特权上下文）与学生下一 token 分布显著分歧时介入，从而以更少监督 token 接近 on-policy 蒸馏效果并减轻遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 其按分布分歧决定教师介入位置的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的监督贡献分配与稀疏监督提供线索，但论文为纯文本、无视觉状态，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization

**abstract/A1：** Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised tokens and consistently outperforms off-policy distillation on the held-out test set. On a forgetting stress test, SSD retains the most general capability while also achieving the best in-domain accuracy and using less supervision than the on-policy baseline. Overall, SSD establishes a new accuracy-efficiency-forgetting Pareto frontier for self-distillation.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. 26 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://ssd-distill.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/ShayanTalaei/SpeculativeSelfDistillation

</details>

### 254. [TIRAD: Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12023v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12023

**作者：** Seongsu Lee、Seunghyun Oh、Seungjae Moon、Youngmin Ro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12023v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12023v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TIRAD，用「正常/异常」文本表示之差构造 Text Residual Feature，并转成 patch 级门控来调制图像残差特征，用于通用异常检测，在工业基准与工业到医学迁移上优于纯图像残差方法。

**相关性简评：** 文本语义门控逐 patch 筛选/衰减视觉残差的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与视觉旁路设计提供借鉴；但该工作面向异常检测任务、不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，其门控是否真正执行选择性证据保留仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TIRAD: Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Recent anomaly detection studies have shown that residual features, which model the discrepancy between normal and abnormal patterns, provide strong generalization to anomalies unseen during training. However, existing residual-based approaches mainly rely on visual discrepancies derived from image representations, while semantic discrepancies that can be explicitly expressed through language remain largely underexplored. To address this problem, we propose TIRAD, Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection, a multimodal residual learning framework that defines the discrepancy between textual representations of normal and abnormal states as a Text Residual Feature and uses it to guide the Image Residual Feature. Specifically, a Text Fusion Module converts patch-level text residuals into a gate that modulates the image residual of each patch. The gate retains the visual discrepancies that the text residual identifies as defect-related and attenuates the others, leading to more discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments on industrial benchmarks and industrial-to-medical transfer demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing image-centric residual learning methods.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ACCV 2026

</details>

### 255. [Leveraging Complementary Event Frame and Voxel Representations for RGB-Guided Multimodal Pre-training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12040v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12040

**作者：** Wentao Wu、Xiao Wang、Yi Wang、Chenglong Li、Yonghong Tian、Bin Luo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12040v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12040v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CM3AE 2.0 的 RGB 帧与事件体素/事件帧统一预训练框架：以事件响应引导时空掩码重建，并结合多模态融合重建、跨模态对比以及基于扩散模型的 RGB 生成和视频级文本生成来学习跨模态依赖。

**相关性简评：** 用事件响应引导掩码聚焦动态显著区域、并以跨模态生成约束共享表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容监督提供线索，但属预训练表示学习，与推理期状态生成的关联需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Leveraging Complementary Event Frame and Voxel Representations for RGB-Guided Multimodal Pre-training

**abstract/A1：** In this paper, we propose CM3AE 2.0, a unified RGB Frame and Event-Voxel/-Frame pre-training framework. By jointly learning multimodal spatiotemporal representations and exploiting latent cross-modal dependencies through cross-modal generation, the framework enhances multimodal information interaction and collaborative modeling capabilities. Specifically, we first propose an Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction (ESMR) strategy to learn unified multimodal spatiotemporal representations. It leverages event responses to guide masking toward dynamically salient regions. Through spatiotemporal masked reconstruction, it learns spatial structures and their temporal variations from continuous RGB-Event observations. In addition, it incorporates multimodal fusion reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning to facilitate the modeling of cross-modal complementary information and the learning of shared representations. Building upon this, we further propose a Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation (HCG) strategy to learn latent cross-modal dependencies through visual and language generation. At the visual level, Event-conditioned RGB generation is performed using a pre-trained diffusion model to capture visual associations between the two modalities. At the language level, video-level text description generation based on joint RGB-Event representations establishes connections between multimodal visual features and linguistic semantics, further enriching the learning of cross-modal dependencies. Extensive experiments on four diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that CM3AE 2.0 consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability of the proposed pre-training framework.

</details>

### 256. [Four-Step Text-Bearing Image Generation via Distillation with Local Response Regularization and Teacher-Guided Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12042v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12042

**作者：** Kairui Wen、Sheng Ye、Yong-Jin Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12042v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12042v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文将 GLM-Image DiT 的多次去噪蒸馏为四步生成，用局部响应路径长度惩罚和教师引导的文本训练保持字形与场景质量。

**相关性简评：** 其「把长去噪轨迹压缩为少数步并加局部响应正则」的做法，可能为 latent 推理中的少步状态更新与轨迹蒸馏提供可核查的方法线索，但对象是图像生成，与 VLM 推理的关联需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Four-Step Text-Bearing Image Generation via Distillation with Local Response Regularization and Teacher-Guided Training

**abstract/A1：** Generating text-bearing images requires coherent scenes and accurate characters. Large text-to-image models improve both capabilities through repeated denoising, at substantial sampling cost. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but requires the student to organize scenes and refine glyphs within a short trajectory. We present a four-step distillation framework combining local response regularization with teacher-guided text training. Built on distribution matching, the framework distills the GLM-Image DiT while retaining its autoregressive visual prior, glyph encoder, and VAE. A path-length penalty promotes consistent local responses of the conditional denoising field. Progressive training combines synthetic strings with teacher-generated imagery to preserve character accuracy and scene-integrated typography. The student achieves GenEval Overall 0.84 and CVTG-2K word accuracy 0.5045, compared with 0.81 and 0.1690 for four-step TDM. A coefficient study favors $10^{-5}$, and Qwen-Image experiments show additional gains from response regularization and text supervision. Single-image inference takes 1.742 s, compared with 5.818 s for the teacher, yielding a $3.34\\times$ speedup at the same 40 GB GPU memory requirement.

</details>

### 257. [Attention-Guided Sequence Feature Fusion and Mixed-Space Metric Learning for Cross-View Image Sequence Geo-Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12051v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12051

**作者：** Nan Wu、Chunfang Yang、Jiangshan Li、Xiangyang Luo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12051v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12051v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向跨视角图像序列地理定位，提出 ASML：用序列内容融合模块建模跨帧特征相关性以抑制重叠冗余、保留有地理信息量的非重叠区域，配合空间特征聚合与融合特征距离和地理距离的 Geo-InfoNCE 损失，并构建 CrossRoad-66K 数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其「注意力引导抑制相邻帧冗余、保留非重叠信息区域」以及混合空间度量可供电核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 相似度度量，但原文任务是检索而非推理，联系仅为方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attention-Guided Sequence Feature Fusion and Mixed-Space Metric Learning for Cross-View Image Sequence Geo-Localization

**abstract/A1：** Cross-view image sequence geo-localization aims to determine the geographic location of a sequence of ground images by matching it against geo-tagged satellite imagery. Although sequential observations provide complementary scene information, substantial overlap between adjacent images introduces feature redundancy, while conventional fusion strategies may weaken spatial relationships essential for cross-view matching. Therefore, we propose a cross-view image sequence geo-localization method via Attention-guided Sequence fusion and Metric Learning (ASML). Specifically, a Sequential Content Fusion (SCF) module models cross-image feature correlations to suppress redundant content and adaptively preserve geographically informative non-overlapping regions. Next, a Spatial Feature Aggregation (SFA) module is used to capture and aggregate the spatial and semantic information of local features, so as to maintain the spatial layout of the image sequence. Finally, a Geo-InfoNCE loss function is proposed, which comprehensively considers the feature distance and geographic distance for mixed-space metric learning, thus improving the ability of the model to distinguish hard negative samples. A new cross-view image sequence dataset CrossRoad-66K is established to provide more complex scenarios. Extensive experiments and visualizations on the SeqGeo and CrossRoad-66K datasets demonstrate that compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, the proposed method ASML achieves an improvement of 3.37% and 2.10% at R@1, respectively.

</details>

### 258. [BECON: Belief-Conditioned Constrained Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning under Drifting Preferences and Budgets](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12053v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12053

**作者：** Bui Trong Duc、Huynh Thi Thanh Binh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12053v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12053v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把带约束的偏好条件多目标强化学习重述为部分可观测的任务规格问题，提出 BECON：从近期交互历史推断潜在任务上下文以估计偏好与安全预算，并用依赖不确定性的门控将其与外部暴露信号融合，再共同条件化策略优化与约束执行。

**相关性简评：** 其「历史推断的 latent 上下文与不可靠外部信号按不确定性门控融合」机制，可能为 LVR 中何时依赖视觉证据、何时依赖内部 latent 状态（LOOK/THINK 权衡与证据筛选）提供可核查的方法线索，但领域为连续控制 RL，与多模态推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BECON: Belief-Conditioned Constrained Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning under Drifting Preferences and Budgets

**abstract/A1：** Constrained preference-conditioned MORL typically assumes full task observability, treating preferences and safety budgets as stationary task signals. In real-world deployment, however, these signals are often unreliable proxies: intent may drift, safety tolerances may shift with context, and exposed descriptors may be noisy, delayed, or incomplete. We therefore formulate constrained preference-conditioned MORL as a partially observed task-specification problem, where the agent must navigate a fundamental conflict between unreliable external signals and latent interaction dynamics. We propose \\textbf{BECON}, a belief-conditioned framework for constrained MORL with drifting preferences and budgets, which infers latent task context from recent histories to estimate preferences and safety budgets. These estimates are fused with the exposed task signal via uncertainty-dependent gates, enabling the policy to defer to observations under high epistemic uncertainty while correcting them when history is informative. The fused context jointly conditions preference optimization and context-adaptive constraint enforcement. Experiments on diverse multi-objective control tasks demonstrate that BECON consistently improves over state-of-the-art MORL baselines, achieving stronger robustness and constraint satisfaction under task drift.

</details>

### 259. [COMPASS: Composable Policy-Amortized Structured Search for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12060v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12060

**作者：** Nguyen Le Minh Hoang、Van Duc Cuong、Bui Trong Duc、Huynh Thi Thanh Binh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12060v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12060v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 COMPASS，将优化建模中的模板检索形式化为有向无环图上的序贯决策，用深度 Q 网络从模板级判断与执行反馈中学习可复用的遍历策略，并以共享语义空间支持新模板的扩展式打分。

**相关性简评：** 把固定或 LLM 即时决定的检索规则摊薄为可学习策略、用执行反馈驱动节点导航，与 LVR 中证据获取和停止决策的学习式控制有可供核查的方法线索，但其纯文本优化建模场景与视觉推理距离较远，仅为借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** COMPASS: Composable Policy-Amortized Structured Search for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Large language models offer a promising technique for translating natural-language optimization problems into solver code, but their reliability remains constrained by the quality of template retrieval. While recent structured methods improve over flat prompting through hierarchical taxonomy search, their traversal rules remain fixed or LLM-driven at inference time, leaving retrieval unable to improve from past successes and failures. This motivates treating template retrieval as a policy that can be learned from modeling experience, rather than as a static inference-time rule. We propose COMPASS, a policy-amortized framework for retrieving optimization templates in LLM-based solver modeling, which represents the template library as a directed acyclic graph and formulates retrieval as a sequential decision process over template nodes. A deep Q-network learns a reusable traversal policy from template-level judgments and execution feedback, reducing reliance on fixed heuristic traversal through feedback-driven graph navigation. To support extensible retrieval, COMPASS embeds problem descriptions and template nodes in a shared semantic space, allowing newly inserted templates to be scored from their text descriptions without redefining the action space. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and optimization-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that COMPASS consistently improves over heuristic structured retrieval, with the largest gains on complex and mixed-category problems.

</details>

<a id="paper-260"></a>

### 260. [How a Model's Architecture and Performance Influences Explainability: A Study of Grad-CAM and CRAFT in CNN-Based Image Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12075v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12075

**作者：** Kilian Göller、Haadia Amjad、Steffen Seitz、Carsten Knoll、Ronald Tetzlaff

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12075v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12075v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究在 ImageNet 子集上训练 VGG16、ResNet50、ConvNeXt-Tiny 三种复杂度递增的 CNN，并取 10 个训练检查点，比较 Grad-CAM 与 CRAFT 在 faithfulness、correctness、sensitivity、simplicity 四类指标上的表现，考察架构与精度如何影响解释质量。

**相关性简评：** 其按训练进展扫描检查点、用多项 faithfulness/sensitivity 指标衡量视觉归因是否真正支撑预测的做法，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉证据归因是否参与答案生成、以及贡献分配评估提供可借鉴的度量线索；但对象是分类归因而非推理状态，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How a Model's Architecture and Performance Influences Explainability: A Study of Grad-CAM and CRAFT in CNN-Based Image Classification

**abstract/A1：** Deep learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), are widely adopted in computer vision, yet their opaque decision-making raises concerns in high-risk applications like healthcare and autonomous systems, where trust and accountability are critical. Therefore, robust explainable AI (XAI) methods are desirable to provide transparent insights into model decisions. To ensure these methods are reliable and effective across diverse scenarios, it is important to understand how model performance and architectural complexity influence explanation quality. Our study takes an initial step toward systematically investigating the impact of these two factors on key XAI evaluation metrics. We constructed a pipeline using 10 subsets of ImageNet-1K, each containing 80 unique classes, on each of which we trained three CNN architectures of increasing structural complexity: VGG16, ResNet50, and ConvNeXt-Tiny. For each individual model, we analyzed 10 training checkpoints representing increasing levels of model accuracy using two XAI methods: Grad-CAM (feature-attribution-based) and CRAFT (concept-based). We assessed these methods across four evaluation categories: Faithfulness, Correctness, Sensitivity, and Simplicity. Our findings reveal that as training progresses, the complex architectures (ResNet50 and ConvNeXt-Tiny) exhibit improved Faithfulness and lower Sensitivity, indicating more robust explanations. In contrast, VGG16's simpler architecture yields simpler but less faithful and correct explanations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (xAI 2026), Fortaleza, Brazil, July 1-3, 2026. To appear in Springer CCIS. 12 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 261. [Correct First, Fast Second: What a Local 7B Code Model Can and Cannot Do for GPU Kernel Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12079v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12079

**作者：** Jui-Chien Tsou、Po-Yi Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12079v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12079v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究固定本地 7B 代码模型把 PyTorch 算子改写为 CUDA kernel 时，交互策略（zero-shot、profile 引导提示、执行反馈迭代、四角色多智能体循环）的影响，结论是正确性而非速度是主要瓶颈，且把算力投入 best-of-n 采样（配执行验证器）比增加推理步数更有效。

**相关性简评：** 非视觉工作，但其「测试时算力应在采样与推理步数之间如何分配、并以外部执行 oracle 做验证筛选」的经验，可能为 LVR 的动态计算、候选筛选与停止决策提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correct First, Fast Second: What a Local 7B Code Model Can and Cannot Do for GPU Kernel Optimization

**abstract/A1：** We study how much the interaction strategy around a fixed, locally hosted 7B-parameter code model (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct) affects its ability to replace PyTorch operators with custom CUDA kernels. On 30 KernelBench tasks (levels 1-3, first 10 each, evaluated on a V100), we compare four regimes of increasing structure: zero-shot prompting, profiling-guided prompting, iterative refinement on execution feedback, and a multi-agent loop (analysis, retrieval, generation, evaluation, feedback triage) in which the same model fills four roles around a non-LLM evaluator. Three findings stand out. (1) Correctness, not speed, is the binding constraint: even correct generated kernels average 0.97-0.99x the speed of eager PyTorch, because a 7B model cannot out-write cuBLAS/cuDNN on dense GEMM and convolution; the only real wins are fused memory-bound epilogues. (2) The best strategy depends on difficulty: profiling-guided prompting is strongest overall (43% correct, 27% faster than baseline), but the agent loop is the only method that solves any level-2 fusion problem (3/10 vs. 0/10 for all others). (3) Naive agentic scaffolding is actively harmful: our first agent scored 3% correct, below zero-shot's 30%, and the decisive repairs were matching the agent's ambition to the model's competence and spending compute on best-of-n sampling under a real execution oracle (3% to 33% correct from n=1 to n=8), not on more reasoning steps.

</details>

### 262. [From Fluent Text to Ontology-Compatible Definitions: A Quality-Control Agentic Workflow](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12095v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12095

**作者：** Kun Feng、Chenchen Chu、Yan Liu、Haojie Sun、Jijun Tang、Chen Tian、Shuolin Xiao、Jianping He、Zhao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12095v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12095v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出实体错误率（EER）与逻辑不一致率（LIR）两个指标，量化 LLM 生成生物医学本体定义在实体落地与逻辑一致性上的缺陷，并设计「生成—抽取公理—检查—修复」的 agentic 质量控制循环。

**相关性简评：** 其「文本流畅但不可落地」的判据与诊断驱动修复循环，或可类比 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正被视觉证据支持、以及何时停止并修复的核查线索，需人工确认可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Fluent Text to Ontology-Compatible Definitions: A Quality-Control Agentic Workflow

**abstract/A1：** Biomedical ontologies are structured knowledge systems that must evolve continuously to represent newly emerging knowledge, but their manual maintenance remains time-consuming and laborintensive. Textual definitions are especially costly because they must be readable to humans and compatible with controlled entities, relations, and logical constraints. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to assist ontology engineering tasks, including definition generation. However, textual plausibility does not guarantee knowledge-system compatibility. A generated definition may be fluent and close to a reference definition, yet still fail to ground its implied entities or violate ontology-level constraints. Directly inserting such definitions into ontology libraries may therefore introduce entity-level hallucinations and logical inconsistencies. To address this problem, we propose two structured-knowledge incompatibility metrics, Entity Error Rate (EER) and Logical Inconsistency Rate (LIR), to quantify entity grounding and logical consistency for LLM-generated ontology definitions. We further develop an agentic quality-control (QC) workflow that treats definition generation as an iterative process rather than a direct decoding step: it generates definitions, extracts axioms, checks entity existence and logical consistency, and uses the resulting diagnostics to drive repair loops. Comprehensive experiments on Disease Ontology, Uberon Ontology, and Uberon-ConstraintStress demonstrate that EER and LIR complement conventional reference-based metrics by evaluating whether generated content can be grounded and checked inside the target ontology. The workflow effectively decreases EER while maintaining strong conventional text-generation performance. LIR further exposes sparse ontology-level logical failures that are invisible to text similarity metrics, although their repair remains limited.

</details>

<a id="paper-263"></a>

### 263. [Calibrating Document-Local Boundaries for Contextual Chunk Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12097v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12097

**作者：** Yuanxiang Wang、Hui Jiang、Da Zhu、Zhihua Chang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12097v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12097v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 late chunking 文档块检索中金标块与其最难同文档负例之间的局部决策边界，分析文档内梯度并指出条件负例分配的熵随缩放因子单调下降，进而提出由文档内 margin 自适应调整判别尺度、并在文档编码时让块划分参与注意力路由的两部分框架，在 ConTEB 与 NanoBEIR 上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「按文档内相似度 margin 校准判别尺度」与「让划分单元参与注意力路由」可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态相似度的尺度与边界校准、以及视觉证据区域的选择性路由，但研究对象是文本检索，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系，迁移价值需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Calibrating Document-Local Boundaries for Contextual Chunk Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Late Chunking encodes an entire document before pooling at chunk boundaries, preserving document context in local retrieval units. Chunk-level post-training improves context-dependent retrieval, but shared context can make semantically similar same-document negatives difficult to distinguish. We study the local decision boundary between a gold chunk and its hardest sibling. Starting from InSeNT, we analyze InSeNT's within-document gradients and show that the entropy of the conditional negative allocation decreases monotonically with the scaling factor at fixed logits. We propose a two-part framework for calibrating document-local chunk boundaries. The first component adapts the discriminative scale from within-document margins, while the second exposes chunk partitions to attention during document encoding. Experiments on ConTEB and NanoBEIR show that the resulting model improves contextual chunk retrieval across the evaluated encoder settings while retaining competitive passage-level retrieval quality; ablations further characterize the distinct roles of adaptive scaling and chunk-aware routing.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 264. [SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12109v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12109

**作者：** Xingguang Ji、Ziqiang Dong、Yubo Zhang、Xi Leng、Yang Yang、Guanjun Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12109v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12109v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SkillDuet，在强化学习中同时更新模型参数与外部文本技能库：由 on-policy 轨迹抽取技能引导参数更新，并用「Strength」按技能对当前模型响应的扰动幅度排序，定期将高分技能并入全局技能集，二者共同指导后续交互。

**相关性简评：** 其以「对模型响应的影响幅度」打分来筛选外部中间产物、并区分外部技能与参数内化的分工，可供核查是否可迁移为度量 latent 推理状态对答案的因果贡献与信息坍缩的判据；但该工作无视觉输入与 latent 状态，联系仅为方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback

**abstract/A1：** During reinforcement learning, experience can be both internalized in LLM parameters and retained externally as reusable textual skills. Parameter updates alter the model's behavior and the interaction experience from which new skills are extracted. These skills, in turn, guide the model's subsequent interactions and parameter updates. As the model's capabilities evolve, previously beneficial skills may become redundant or detrimental. We present SkillDuet, a framework that coordinates parameter updates and skill evolution through model response feedback. Skills extracted from on-policy trajectories guide parameter updates through OPD at every step. A response-based score, Strength, ranks candidate skills by the magnitude of the shift they induce in the current model's responses, and the highest-scoring skills are periodically consolidated into a persistent global skill set (Global). The updated model and Global jointly guide subsequent interactions, generating experience for further parameter and skill updates. With Qwen3-4B, SkillDuet achieves success rates of 98.57% on ALFWorld and 92.97% on WebShop, exceeding the matched SEED-API baseline by 2.86 and 5.47 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that response-based skill selection and Global consolidation improve task performance. Further experiments show that the benefits of retained skills depend on both their content and their compatibility with the model. SkillDuet provides a concrete mechanism for model-skill co-evolution and skill-level recursive self-improvement.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 265. [OGDA: Ontology-Grounded Data Agents for Reliable Analysis over Heterogeneous Data Lakes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12114v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12114

**作者：** Boyi Zhang、Hong Ting Tsang、Yisen Gao、Qiao Xiao、LI Yufei、Haoyu Huang、Zhongwei Xie、Jiaxin Bai、Yangqiu Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12114v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12114v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 OGDA，用紧凑本体刻画异构数据湖，由 proposer 从原始数据源归纳 schema、概念与关系、verifier 对照底层数据校验，执行时以本体作为数据湖的表示并用任务图约束每一步数据处理动作，在 KramaBench 与 DiscoveryBench 上超过基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「紧凑抽象表示 + 校验器核查 + 动作受图约束」的线索，可能与 LVR 中压缩任务相关状态、筛选视觉证据及限制状态扩展的可核查机制有关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OGDA: Ontology-Grounded Data Agents for Reliable Analysis over Heterogeneous Data Lakes

**abstract/A1：** Full-pipeline data analysis over real-world data lakes requires LLM agents to locate and integrate information across large collections of tables with different schemas. Existing data agents follow task-specific exploration, which exhausts the context window in massive lakes. As the context fills, the agent's reasoning degrades, leading it to locate and process incorrect data files. These errors propagate into the final answer. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Ontology-Grounded Data Agent (OGDA), which utilizes a compact ontology to reduce exploration overhead and constrain data processing. OGDA constructs the ontology through agentic hypothesis testing. At each step, a proposer agent induces schemas, concepts, and relations from raw sources, and a verifier checks each proposal against the underlying data. During task execution, the ontology serves as a representation of the data lake for the agent to explore. Every data-processing action is constrained by a task graph, which the agent can extend only after observing the semantic meaning of the data. Across KramaBench and DiscoveryBench with three LLM backbones, OGDA outperforms the strongest baselines by up to 10.82 points. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the data lake is a key step toward reliable end-to-end data agents.

</details>

### 266. [SCALE: Small-Model-First Concept Abstraction with LLM-Guided Experience Internalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12120v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12120

**作者：** Hong Su

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12120v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12120v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SCALE 提出以轻量模型为主体的框架：由预测错误与跨回合累积证据选择性触发 LLM 反思，LLM 生成正负反事实样例与可复用概念假设，经独立验证后逐步写入分层神经表示，并把已掌握经验移出活跃记忆而保留归档。

**相关性简评：** 按错误信号决定何时调用昂贵 LLM、以及将概念假设内化进分层表示，可能为 LVR 中的「何时进入推理」与把推理结果压缩为 latent 状态提供核查线索，但其无视觉或多模态设定，内化是否构成状态生成需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SCALE: Small-Model-First Concept Abstraction with LLM-Guided Experience Internalization

**abstract/A1：** Autonomous agents must continually acquire reusable knowledge from experience without relying on costly large language model (LLM) reasoning for every decision. However, existing experience-based approaches often struggle to transform accumulated observations and reasoning into compact knowledge that lightweight models can independently apply. This paper proposes SCALE, a small-model-first framework that integrates selective LLM reasoning, experience-driven concept abstraction, and knowledge internalization. A lightweight model handles routine predictions, while prediction errors and accumulated cross-episode evidence selectively trigger LLM reflection. The LLM analyzes relevant historical experiences, generates positive and negative counterfactual examples, and proposes reusable concept hypotheses. Independently validated concepts are progressively incorporated into hierarchical neural representations, enabling lightweight models to exploit increasingly abstract knowledge. Meanwhile, mastered experiences are excluded from active memory while their original records remain available in a complete archive. Experiments across ten random seeds show that historical recall improves held-out accuracy from 87.11% to 98.28%, hierarchical concept knowledge increases difficult-case accuracy from 55.33% to 66.47%, and abstract archiving reduces active experience records from 6,000 to 1,528.

</details>

### 267. [CARE-PO: Controllable Tool-Call Efficiency for LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12125v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12125

**作者：** Xiaoyang Ye、Xiao Yao、Hairui Zhu、Yiying Yang、Bei Gan、Jinliang Lu、Tengjin Weng、Yuan Yao、Wenhao Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12125v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12125v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对 LLM agent 工具调用成本高的问题，诊断出 GAIA 轨迹中普遍存在可删除调用，并提出 CARE-PO：用任务难度锚定且在训练前固定的参考预算来计费调用次数，向 GRPO rollout 组注入成功轨迹以避免「零调用」坍缩，并借 prompt 中的 effort tag 在单次训练中同时得到效率与能力的多个工作点。

**相关性简评：** 其把「获取证据的成本」显式写入训练奖励、并以可控工作点调节成本—能力权衡，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的停止决策与计算预算学习提供可核查的监督与锚定设计线索，但对象为纯文本工具调用，迁移需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CARE-PO: Controllable Tool-Call Efficiency for LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** External tool calls are a major running cost of an LLM agent, while its training objectives align almost exclusively with task completion. In a step-level diagnosis of Qwen3.5 trajectories at two model sizes on GAIA, a long-horizon tool-use benchmark, we find that most contain removable calls, at a similar rate at both sizes. Some methods add an efficiency reward to the objective to reduce the call count, but introduce problems of their own: the anchor they price calls against is computed from the policy's own rollouts (e.g., the group's shortest correct rollout) and so moves with the policy; training can drift toward a collapsed policy that issues no tool call at all, a degeneracy seen in published reports and in our 27B baseline; and a training run delivers a single operating point, so the user cannot trade efficiency against capability. We present CARE-PO (Controllable Anchored Relative Efficiency Policy Optimization) to mitigate these problems. The efficiency reward prices calls against a reference budget anchored to the task's own difficulty and fixed before training. Injecting a successful trajectory from the training data into each online GRPO rollout group and charging for evidence a trajectory never gathers ease the drift toward a collapsed call count. Shaping the cost curve by an effort tag in the prompt yields an efficiency and a capability operating point from a single training run. On GAIA, five of the six operating points across three model sizes improve on their base model in success rate and call count at once. On four held-out multi-hop benchmarks the result is size-dependent: at 27B and 4B success rate is held or raised at a lower call count, while at 9B both operating points trade success rate for fewer calls. The call count remains well above zero throughout training at all three sizes.

**comment/C1：** Under review at ICLR 2027

</details>

### 268. [Good Views Are Not Enough: Global Counterexamples for Gaussian-Regularized JEPAs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12137v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12137

**作者：** Anran Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12137v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12137v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 对 Gaussian 正则化 JEPA 给出全局反例，说明视图充分性并不保证场景不变性或旋转下的唯一性；同时分析场景对齐、预测损失与线性读出难度之间的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其关于 nuisance 保留、信息损失与 readout 难度的风险分解，可供核查视觉编码器 latent 表示是否保留任务必要细节；但不涉及推理期状态生成，需自行判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Good Views Are Not Enough: Global Counterexamples for Gaussian-Regularized JEPAs

**abstract/A1：** Good views do not suffice to guarantee scene invariance or uniqueness up to rotation at the global optima of Gaussian-regularized JEPAs. We give globally certified counterexamples showing that the uniqueness premise of the Gaussian extension in Good Views fails for specified soft objectives. Gaussian marginal matching can reward retaining independently resampled observation variation, and this benefit can exceed its prediction cost. In a four-state model, comparison against the entire scene-only class proves that every global minimizer splits a scene and admits an equal-value partner outside its rotation orbit. In a 512-dimensional model with a complete scene basis, a spectral gap, and exact population whitening, pooled Epps-Pulley regularization still forces every global minimizer to retain nuisance and yields positive cross-modal alignment error even after the best rotation when modality nuisances are independent. Better scene alignment can also accompany worse prediction. With matched 512-label readout budgets and 1% observation noise, whitened prediction JEPA aligns better to the scene than next-token prediction but incurs 0.2872 nats/token higher linear-readout test NLL. A Bayes-risk decomposition distinguishes information lost through the observation channel from the fitted readout's difficulty using retained information. These results connect three determinants of learned representations: what views share, what regularization favors, and what a prediction task can use.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 269. [Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12164v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12164

**作者：** Khalil Hennara、Muhammad Hreden、Zeina Aldallal、Sara Chrouf、Safwan AlModhayan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12164v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12164v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Fixer-Guided Localization：让代码定位器给出多个候选定位，由冻结的修复器按「能否生成已验证补丁」的似然打分，再用加权监督微调训练定位器，无需运行测试或强化学习，并在小型编码智能体上验证。

**相关性简评：** 该工作用下游修复器似然为中间「读哪些代码」的候选打分并转成监督信号，可供核查如何在不做 RL 的情况下为视觉证据选择或 latent 中间状态做贡献分配；但任务为纯代码智能体，与视觉推理的联系需自行迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood

**abstract/A1：** Code localizers are usually trained to predict the files a reference patch edits, but the code a fixer needs to read is not the same as the code it changes. We propose Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL): the localizer proposes several localizations, a frozen fixer scores each by how likely it makes a verified patch, and the localizer is trained on these scores with weighted supervised fine-tuning, without running tests and without reinforcement learning. We build the full pipeline on Gemma 4 E4B for the Kaggle Gemma-4 Developer Agent competition, from 1,629 test-verified Kimi K3 trajectories. The FGL target helps the fixer find the bug as often as the teacher's localization while using 27.5% less code. On the development set, one EM round moves the agent in the expected direction compared with a matched control: more tasks reach a patch (53 vs. 46), fewer tasks get stuck reading files that do not exist (43 vs. 54), and more tasks are solved (8 vs. 6). Training also changes how the agent works: trained agents explore about three times more than the base model and write far fewer wrong patches, and the single agent solves up to 11 of 78 tasks, against 8 for the base model. An analysis of 13 evaluation runs identifies what limits a 4B agent under an 8-minute budget (time, repetition loops and edit quality) and gives practical lessons for training small coding agents. All data, code and adapters are publicly available.

</details>

### 270. [NearFormer: Linear-Size Sparse Attention via Randomized Near Neighbors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12186v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12186

**作者：** Ali Parviz、Alex Cloninger、Gal Mishne

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12186v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12186v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 NearFormer：一种图 Transformer，用一次性构造的随机近邻图作为全局注意力的稀疏支撑，把注意力规模压到线性，并与保留原图的局部消息传递配合，在长程图基准上考察精度与可扩展性的折中。

**相关性简评：** 其「用随机近邻构造固定稀疏注意力支撑」的做法可能供核查：能否以低成本为 VLM 的长程注意力预先筛选参与计算的状态或视觉证据，从而影响 latent 相似度与计算分配，但图节点设定与原论文的收益尚未在视觉推理上验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NearFormer: Linear-Size Sparse Attention via Randomized Near Neighbors

**abstract/A1：** Graph transformers can capture long-range interactions, but their quadratic attention cost limits their use on large graphs. We introduce \\emph{NearFormer}, a graph transformer whose global attention is restricted to a randomized near-neighbor (NN) graph. NearFormer uses an efficient randomized construction to connect each node to a small number of near neighbors from a broader neighborhood defined by a label-independent feature or spectral geometry. For a fixed retained budget \\(k\\), the resulting attention support has linear size \\(\\mathcal{O}(\|E\|+nk)\\). The NN graph is built once by within-bin search and then held fixed. We use these edges as sparse global-attention supports, with optional learned attention biases, while preserving the original graph for local message passing. Experiments on long-range graph benchmarks and synthetic structural tasks show that NearFormer provides a favorable accuracy--scalability trade-off relative to local message passing, dense and sparse attention.

</details>

### 271. [Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12200v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12200

**作者：** Chenghao Gao、Zhi Zhang、Dian Jin、Yihe Pan、Doudou Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12200v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12200v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WM-PPO，用世界模型对环境做一步预测，再由 critic 对预测出的后继状态估值，把价值比较作为策略的辅助优势、把价值均值作为 critic 的辅助目标，并用一个共享门控按历史预测可靠性加权。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本具身任务，不含视觉 latent，但「对想象后继状态估值以分配中间步贡献、按可靠性门控辅助信号」可能为 LVR 中推理步贡献分配与何时采信预测状态提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next

**abstract/A1：** A sparse terminal reward tells an agent little about its steps. Much of the missing information is implicit in the environment's dynamics, because each state transition can change the conditions for success long before the reward arrives. A world model trained on real transitions can learn to predict what each action changes, but a predicted observation does not by itself show whether success has become more likely. With a binary terminal reward, PPO's critic makes this judgment by estimating the current policy's probability of success, but only for states the agent reaches. Our method, WM-PPO, elegantly brings the two together. For each action the policy samples, executed or not, the world model predicts the next observation and the critic values the predicted successor. In the policy channel, comparisons among these values give the policy auxiliary advantages; in the value channel, their mean gives the critic an auxiliary target. A shared gate weights both channels according to how reliably comparisons with similar margins predicted real outcomes earlier in training. The policy, critic and world model all learn from the agent's own interaction, with no teacher or privileged information, and only the policy is used at inference. With a comparable number of real environment steps, WM-PPO raises success from PPO's 63.5% to 87.5% on ALFWorld and from 39.3% to 52.9% on ScienceWorld. It matches the strongest PPO refinements we tested on ALFWorld and exceeds the best of them by 6.5 points on ScienceWorld. The trained policy more often completes prerequisite steps before placing an object or committing to an answer.

**comment/C1：** 64 pages, 19 figures

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从注意力机制的连续对称性推导出标量不变量 ρ，用于衡量各注意力头与 RoPE 的耦合能力，并在多个无偏置 RoPE 模型上检验其与 induction head 的相关性，还尝试据此选择性地应用 YaRN。

**相关性简评：** 不直接研究 LVR，但提供了仅凭权重刻画注意力头位置特化的线索；可供核查 ρ 能否用于区分 VLM 中的位置头与内容头，从而分析 latent 相似度中的位置、注意力结构效应及选择性位置干预。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone

**abstract/A1：** Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $ρ$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $ρ$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $ρ$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as an extended abstract at the Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations Workshop (NeurReps), NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 273. [ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12232v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12232

**作者：** Chenhao Zhang、Zhongan Wang、Mingxuan Li、Hehe Fan、Zheng Zhu、Ming Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12232v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12232v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ECOS：用环境结果（命令级 advantage）校准 on-policy 自蒸馏中教师偏好的权重，并据此筛选值得强化的自写反思与技能，在 ALFWorld、WebShop 上验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 其按环境反馈决定信任哪些自生成监督、只监督可执行命令的贡献分配做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹/视觉证据监督的信度加权与信息坍缩问题，但属纯文本 agent 线索，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents

**abstract/A1：** On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.

</details>

### 274. [Controlling Temporal Pseudo-Label Marginals for Stable Online Test-Time Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12242v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12242

**作者：** Rani Amar、Ofir Lindenbaum

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12242v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12242v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 CTTA 中伪标签类别使用面收窄量化为不稳定指标，并提出即插即用的 SCALAR 模块：缓存近期预测，用 Sinkhorn 在短时间窗内平衡类别边际以对齐给定目标分布，再用平衡后的软目标更新模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「用分布收窄诊断漂移／坍缩」与「在时间窗上施加 Sinkhorn 目标边际约束」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态或推理轨迹的模式坍缩监测与正则化，但任务和表示层面与 VLM 推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Controlling Temporal Pseudo-Label Marginals for Stable Online Test-Time Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) methods update models online using a stream of unlabeled data to overcome distribution shifts encountered at test time. However, CTTA is often unstable, as it can reinforce biases in early predictions and increasingly predict only a few classes, resulting in drift or even collapse. In this paper, we identify narrowing pseudo-label class usage as an indicator of CTTA instability and quantify this behavior. Most existing methods have attempted to address this issue by either selecting reliable adaptation samples or re-weighting the loss to encourage diverse pseudo-labels, but they do not explicitly enforce a class marginal over a temporal window. Instead, we propose Sinkhorn Class-Marginal Regularization (SCALAR), a simple plug-and-play module that controls the pseudo-label distribution over a short temporal window. SCALAR works by maintaining recent predictions in a buffer, balancing their class distribution via the Sinkhorn algorithm to match a specified target distribution, and using the balanced soft targets for adaptation. Without changing the model architecture, SCALAR maintains the per-step runtime and increases the peak allocated GPU memory by only 10 MB on ImageNet-C. Our method is particularly effective on skewed, non-stationary data with severe distribution shifts, where SCALAR significantly alleviates drift and collapse when combined with existing stabilization methods based on entropy or diversity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages. Code: https://github.com/r-isr/SCALAR

</details>

### 275. [A method to automatically discover symbolic local learning rules](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12248v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12248

**作者：** Andrea Perin、Fabio Anselmi、Stephane Deny

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12248v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12248v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种自动发现符号化局部学习规则的方法：以 Penrose 图示记为灵感构造局部张量变量的单项式字典，再回归系数得到逐层多项式损失，使其梯度共同最小化全局目标，并在分类、重建与自监督小规模任务上验证得到稀疏且可解释的层间交互规则。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐层局部损失替代全局反传」的符号化搜索思路，可供核查 LVR 中多步 latent 状态或层级的局部监督与贡献分配如何设计，但原文只做通用小网络实验，与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A method to automatically discover symbolic local learning rules

**abstract/A1：** We present a general method for discovering symbolic local learning rules that can replace backpropagation, applicable, in principle, to any deep learning architecture and task. The method automatically discovers local loss functions specific to each layer by (1) constructing a dictionary of monomials of local tensor variables, inspired by Penrose diagram notation, (2) regressing over coefficients weighting these monomials to build layerwise polynomial losses whose gradients together minimize a target global loss. We test the method on classification, reconstruction, and self-supervised learning tasks with small multilayer networks and minimal datasets. Across all tasks, the discovered rules induce non-trivial interactions between layers, which lead to significant reductions in the corresponding global losses. Furthermore, the method selects sparse combinations of monomials, finding local rules that are more interpretable than those generated by MLP-based alternatives. The potential implications of our method range from energy-efficient deep learning to the discovery of biologically plausible learning mechanisms.

</details>

### 276. [RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12251v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12251

**作者：** Meraj Mammadov、Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires、Johannes Andreas Stork

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12251v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12251v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 RAIL：用对比学习为教师（可访问特权状态）与学生（仅用原始观测）构建共享 latent 表示，并让教师策略直接在该空间中训练，以在教师训练阶段就缩小因信息不对称造成的模仿差距，无需额外奖励塑形或学生后训练，同时支持仅训练教师即可零样本迁移到新任务。

**相关性简评：** 机器人 RL 场景虽不涉及视觉推理，但「把策略约束在与学生可观测信息对齐的共享 latent 空间」这一做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否可被可用视觉证据支撑、以及表示错配是否会限制 student 式模型的收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) from raw sensory inputs such as images or onboard sensors can be challenging due to high-dimensional observations and sparse rewards. A common strategy is to train a teacher policy with access to privileged state information and then distill it into a student policy that acts from raw inputs alone. However, when the teacher relies on information unavailable to the student, exact imitation may be impossible, creating an irreducible imitation gap. Existing approaches typically mitigate this mismatch through careful reward shaping or additional reinforcement learning on the student policy after the teacher has been trained. Instead, we introduce Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning (RAIL), which addresses the mismatch during teacher training itself. RAIL learns a latent representation shared across teacher and student observations using contrastive learning, and trains the teacher policy directly in this space. Because the teacher policy is constrained to operate on this shared space, it learns behaviors that are reproducible from student observations. This substantially reduces the imitation gap while preserving task performance. Across multiple environments, RAIL outperforms strong baselines without reward modification or post-hoc student fine-tuning, and surpasses direct reinforcement learning from raw observations. The learned representations further enable zero-shot transfer to new tasks through teacher-only training. Project site: https://merajmammadov.com/rail/.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 277. [Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12285

**作者：** Xingpeng Gao、Mingyue Cheng、Daoyu Wang、Huajian Zhang、Xiaoyu Tao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12285v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 CastReasoner，用结构化 CoT 从上下文特征中抽取预测证据、推断未来动态，并与预测先验比对以调整预测；训练采用 SFT 合成轨迹加 RL 多目标奖励的两阶段后训练。

**相关性简评：** 时间序列领域而非视觉，但其「抽取证据—判断何时及如何使用证据—调整决策」的结构，以及学生感知难度筛选轨迹、细粒度多目标和数据平衡策略，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、轨迹监督与贡献分配的设计线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** LLM-driven time series forecasting has become increasingly promising by leveraging contextual features to generate future values directly or refine forecast priors. However, incorporating contextual features alone does not ensure that models can identify which features matter for forecasting and understand what they suggest about future dynamics. We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张原始雷达频谱本身并非瓶颈，真正缺的是分离结构与噪声的学习目标；为此提出「局部破坏下仍可重建者即结构」的判据，用谱泄漏启发的破坏策略构造 Leakage-aware Spectral MAE，在密集 4D 雷达立方体上自监督预训练，并强调把 Doppler 作为主空间维度的组织方式，最终在 3D 检测上优于手工降维与点云 SSL 对手。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Radar 3D Perception: Representation Learning from Raw Spectra

**abstract/A1：** Raw radar spectra are widely viewed as too cluttered and noisy for direct representation learning, motivating handcrafted reductions, sparse point clouds, or compact Doppler descriptors in radar perception. We challenge this assumption and argue that the main limitation lies not in the raw representation itself, but in the absence of a learning objective that separates structured signal from noise. Handcrafted reductions partially address this problem but impose rigid assumptions about what constitutes signal, discarding weak yet informative structure while retaining artifacts that fit the reduction model. Once removed, such information cannot be recovered by supervised learning. We propose an alternative: structure is the component of a radar spectrum that remains reconstructable under localized corruption, while noise is the component that does not. This perspective motivates self-supervised masked modeling for dense radar spectra without predefined signal-noise separation. We instantiate it with Leakage-aware Spectral MAE, a masked autoencoder for raw radar cubes using a corruption strategy inspired by cross-bin energy spreading caused by spectral leakage. We also demonstrate the importance of Doppler organization: treating Doppler as a primary spatial dimension in an x-y-D representation, with height encoded as features, substantially outperforms naive channel stacking and enables effective learning from dense 4D spectra. Without handcrafted reductions, our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art radar-based detectors and point-cloud-based self-supervised learning (SSL) counterparts. These results establish raw radar spectra as an effective representation for 3D perception when paired with an appropriate pretraining objective.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Miao Zhang and Mohamed Abdelsamad contributed equally

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「扩散噪声预测作为细节感知监督」与「文本嵌入差值定义模态方向」可能为 LVR 中保持视觉细节、抑制 latent 状态漂移的训练监督提供可核查线索，但原文不做推理期状态生成、证据获取或停止决策，迁移需自行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TMT: Adapting CLIP to Infrared Imagery via Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong performance across computer vision tasks, yet their image-text alignment is less reliable for infrared (IR) imagery because large-scale pre-training is dominated by visible-spectrum data. Due to the high cost of the infrared-text labeling, we investigate adapting CLIP to IR through only paired infrared-visible images, which requires considering modality-specific knowledge while preserving scene content and CLIP's image-text alignment. To achieve this, we propose TMT (Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer), which adapts CLIP's image encoder through a text-defined infrared-to-visible direction and supervision from paired IR-visible images. First, we found that modality discrepancy can be described by corresponding text embeddings, thus using the direction of text embedding differences to guide the knowledge transfer between visible and infrared modalities without erasing infrared-specific information. To enhance the representation of semantics and details of infrared images, we introduce Generative-Perceptual Co-Supervision that combines semantic alignment from CLIP visible image encoder with diffusion noise-prediction feedbacks. On four source-disjoint IR classification benchmarks, TMT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the compared methods (48.92%). It also achieves the best IR-text retrieval results among the compared methods without infrared-text supervision during adaptation and the highest open-vocabulary segmentation mIoU on both CART and SemanticRT among the CLIP-like methods.

</details>

### 280. [QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12353v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12353

**作者：** Zhizhong Fu、Wei Zhou、Zhaoyang Jiang、Yudong Lin、Songlun Li、Zhi Li、Feifan Chen、Gaoming Li、Xiaorong Ding、Yifan Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12353v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12353v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 QCC-WM 视觉世界模型，用动作响应引导把高维视觉特征聚合为具空间对应的宏节点并递归预测其内容与运动，再以共享参考度量约束宏状态预测与观测变化的一致性，并将节点级误差回传至对应空间区域修正生成结果。

**相关性简评：** 其商式宏状态压缩、递归状态更新与「潜状态—视觉变化」一致性约束及误差回流机制，可供核查 latent 推理状态是否保真保留任务必要视觉信息；但论文面向动作条件世界模型，与 LVR 的推理期状态生成与控制机制距离较远，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction

**abstract/A1：** A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation. Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions. On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.

**comment/C1：** Published in Medical Image Analysis

</details>

### 281. [DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12356v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12356

**作者：** Zhicheng Zheng、Cheng Zhang、Chenkai Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12356v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12356v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练方法 DForkTree：针对块扩散 drafter 构建的 draft tree，让每条分支重新锚定在自身 token 上，并把目标模型输出的 n-gram 统计以 PMI 形式加权到 drafter 分数（分叉后权重更高），在 GPU 上精确构造最优树以加速投机解码。

**相关性简评：** 其「树分支上的错误来自共享前缀条件而非 drafter 已知信息」的诊断，以及按分支重锚定与 PMI 重打分的候选树构造，可能可供核查并行 latent 假设的独立条件化、多分支打分与验证算力分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding speeds up language models by letting a lightweight drafter propose several future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash draft a whole block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds a draft tree from their per-position distributions. Each of these distributions assumes that the drafter's own most likely continuation is correct. A tree, however, gains over a chain only on branches that leave this continuation, where the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its candidate lists miss the right token far more often. When re-run from the fork token, the same drafter is usually correct, so the errors come from the prefix that the distributions condition on rather than from what the drafter knows. We introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. DForkTree adds n-gram statistics from the target model's own outputs to the drafter's scores as pointwise mutual information, weights them more after the fork, and builds the optimal tree under these scores exactly on the GPU. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, with all tree methods sharing one drafter, tree pipeline and verifier, DForkTree is the fastest tree method on every benchmark. It is up to 41.5% faster than DFlash and 15.1% faster than DDTree in the same setting, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 13 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/Perseus037/DForkTree

</details>

### 282. [TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12364v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12364

**作者：** Xiangyang Wu、Chen Ju、Xu Chen、Likang Peng、Jinsong Lan、Haihong Tang、Yang Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12364v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12364v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TRIAD 多模态检索基准，含抽象层次、约束联合满足、对话状态更新三个 track 共六个子集，每查询固定 1000 候选并以 multi-positive mAP 评测 17 个系统的 20 种配置，发现层次距离增大、纯负约束以及多轮修订均导致性能下降。

**相关性简评：** 其「正负约束联合满足」与「多轮需求修订后状态更新」的评测设计，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理状态维护的诊断方式；但原文聚焦检索排序而非 latent 状态生成，迁移线索需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests. The benchmark contains six subsets, each with 1,000 queries and a fixed pool of 1,000 candidates per query, evaluated using a common multi-positive mean average precision (mAP) protocol. Simpler reference tasks and hard negatives grouped by the requirements they violate help characterize specific retrieval difficulties. We evaluate 20 configurations of 17 systems and find that no system leads across all six subsets. Performance declines with hierarchical distance, and negative-only queries generally underperform positive-only queries with the same number of constraints. Across paired tasks expressing the same final intent, multi-turn retrieval yields lower mAP in 39 of 40 configuration-domain comparisons. The benefits of explicit reasoning also vary across models and tasks. These findings highlight the gap between retrieving similar content and satisfying a complete request.

</details>

### 283. [TANSAR: Editable and Attributable Correlation Matrix Memories under Correlated Keys, with Rule-Constrained Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12374v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12374

**作者：** Abdulhady Abas Abdulla、Jiyan Salim Mahmud、Fatemeh Daneshfar、Hussein Mohammed Ali、Mourad Oussalah、Muhammad Bilal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12374v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12374v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在相关键（非正交语义键）条件下用框架相干性分析相关矩阵记忆的容量上界、删除联想时的附带影响与归因的几何条件，并提出 TANSAR：在带 Horn 约束的关联图上做多跳检索剪枝，并将经验证路径导出的表示注入冻结语言模型的残差流，用于多跳知识编辑。

**相关性简评：** 其相关键下的 crosstalk 容量界、精确删除与线性归因，以及把经验证路径表示写入残差流的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态叠加干扰、贡献分配与证据筛选式「LOOK」提供可供核查的线索，但全文无视觉推理实验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TANSAR: Editable and Attributable Correlation Matrix Memories under Correlated Keys, with Rule-Constrained Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing

**abstract/A1：** Correlation Matrix Memories (CMMs) store associations as sums of rank-one outer products, providing closed-form addressability, exact deletion, and linear attribution. While classical analyses assume random, orthogonal keys, semantic encoders produce correlated representations. We analyse CMMs under correlated keys using frame-theoretic coherence: (i) capacity bounds yielding an encoder-independent limit $n \\le d(1+\\varepsilon^2)$ for mean squared crosstalk $\\varepsilon^2$; (ii) an exact characterisation of the collateral effect of deleting an association, guaranteeing that deletion never invalidates certified associations; and (iii) a geometric transparency bound demonstrating why attribution requires candidate sets of centred keys. On this basis, we introduce Topology-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Associative Retrieval (TANSAR). TANSAR traverses a directed acyclic association graph, prunes invalid paths via sound ground Horn constraints, and injects a representation derived strictly from the verified path into the residual stream of a frozen language model, guarded by a Clopper--Pearson selective-risk gate. Controlled experiments confirm all theoretical bounds. In multi-hop knowledge editing, Horn pruning reduces answer contradictions from 25.1% to 0.5%, whereas Hopfield retrieval incurs 24% contradictions when stale associations remain stored (and 0% if stale associations are removed). An end-to-end edit transaction requires 13.6 ms on a standard CPU and 2.37 ms on GPU. The symbolic component matches gold labels across all 600 ProofWriter theories and achieves 94.0% agreement on FOLIO, demonstrating sound and efficient multi-hop associative retrieval with exact unlearning.

</details>

### 284. [PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12411v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12411

**作者：** Harold Haodong Chen、Rui Peng、Lingteng Qiu、Kejie Qiu、Chao Xu、Zilong Dong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12411v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12411v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PhysOPSD，把可执行代码作为特权的物理上下文用于视频生成的后训练：借助 PhysOPSD-Engine 将真实物理场景转成可验证仿真程序，再通过双层物理特权经中间瓶颈注入，并在共享 rollout 噪声下做受控物理变化以暴露因果动态差异。

**相关性简评：** 「特权上下文经中间瓶颈做 on-policy 蒸馏」与「受控变化下的因果归因」可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何写入内部状态、以及轨迹训练的贡献分配提供可核查线索，但其对象是视频生成而非多模态推理，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.

**comment/C1：** Project: https://haroldchen19.github.io/PhysOPSD-site/

</details>

**作者：** Xiaotong Li、Zhengrong Yue、Xu Huang、Jialv Zou、Minhao Jing、Wenhao Yan、Haodong Li、Hai Huang、Bo Zhao、Yan Feng、Peng Pei、Xunliang Cai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12426v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12426v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 dNaViT：在冻结预训练编码器上加入轻量残差调制与双分支目标，并用分组乘积量化构建原生分辨率的离散视觉 tokenizer，使离散码同时保留语义与像素细节，并在理解、生成与编辑任务上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「语义—像素」双保真的离散视觉基元设计可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据压缩进内部状态时是否丢失任务必要细节；但论文本身不涉及推理状态的生成与使用，迁移线索需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations

**abstract/A1：** Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.

### 286. [MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12443v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12443

**作者：** Charbel Yahchouchi、Nabyl Quignon、Noemi Roggero、Laurent Saroul、Antitza Dantcheva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12443v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12443v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MoSTE 框架，把 CLIP 向视频深伪检测的适配拆成并行的空间与时间专家池，并用无监督 token 级路由让专家各自专精于互补的伪造线索。

**相关性简评：** 无监督 token 级路由与时空专家分工可能为 LVR 中按视觉证据动态选择专家、分配计算提供可供核查的方法线索，但该文并不生成或使用 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos

**abstract/A1：** Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE

**comment/C1：** Accepted to IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027

</details>
