### 287. [Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct: Consensus Aggregation and Fourier-Attended Multi-Decoders for Reconstruction-based Multi-View Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12477v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12477

**作者：** Yongho Son、Junyeong Yun、Je Hyeong Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12477v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12477v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PAR，一个面向多视图工业异常检测的重建框架：用特征扰动配合共识聚合构造视图一致的伪异常，并为每个视图配备专用解码器，在解码器中引入 Fourier 注意力以抑制恒等映射。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态，但「跨视图共识聚合扰动特征」与「用 Fourier 注意力防止解码器走捷径」可能可供核查多视图证据聚合与重建式训练中 latent 被绕过的信息坍缩问题，需进一步阅读确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct: Consensus Aggregation and Fourier-Attended Multi-Decoders for Reconstruction-based Multi-View Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Multi-view anomaly detection is crucial for industrial inspection to identify defects hidden from single viewpoints. Yet, despite their strong success in single-view applications, reconstruction-based methods remain largely underexplored in multi-view settings. A key challenge in extending these methods lies in generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies. To address this, we propose PAR, a reconstruction-based framework for enhanced multi-view anomaly detection. First, we introduce a feature perturbation strategy coupled with a consensus aggregation module that integrates these perturbed features across viewpoints to mitigate view-inconsistent anomalies and construct highly aligned pseudo-anomaly representations. Second, we employ a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture; by assigning a dedicated decoder to each view, we increase the model's representational complexity, enabling the generation of highly feasible, localized anomaly maps rather than less precise, view-agnostic reconstructions. Last, we incorporate Fourier attention into the decoders to emphasize global frequency-domain structures over local token evidence, effectively preventing identity mapping. Extensive experiments on the Real-IAD dataset demonstrate that PAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in sample-level, image-level, and pixel-level anomaly detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/SpatialAILab/PAR\_mvad.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)

</details>

### 288. [K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12530v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12530

**作者：** Bingkun Liu、Paul Haider、Federico Benitez、Mihai A. Petrovici、Walter Senn

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 K-prop，一种面向 leaky 循环网络的在线学习方法，通过传播「kernel gains」大幅降低 RTRL 的实时计算与显存开销，在序列学习、分类与强化学习任务上接近 BPTT 表现，并分析了唯一近似对梯度质量的影响条件。

**相关性简评：** 多步循环的 latent 推理若采用在线或流式训练，其循环状态的贡献分配与梯度传播代价是实际瓶颈，本文的 kernel 递推近似与误差条件可供核查是否能用于 latent 轨迹训练。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels

**abstract/A1：** Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 40 (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 289. [WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12557v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12557

**作者：** Yuhang Chen、Jiheng Li、Jiale Wang、Zai Wang、Guangyue Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12557v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12557v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 WanderBench，用 745 段单镜头视频、键盘式相机路线和 24 项人工校验子指标，评测视频条件世界模型在长时探索中是否保持主体身份、事件进程与重访地点一致性；并给出免训练框架 WanderLand，让冻结模型每帧同时条件于同刻源帧与自身先前静态内容。

**相关性简评：** 其发现「时长生后保留静态场景与画质却丢失源动态、重访不一致」与 LVR 关心的长程信息坍缩相近；逐帧重注入同刻视觉证据、重访时复用自身早前内容的做法，可能可供核查为视觉旁路或证据筛选机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?

**abstract/A1：** Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 290. [GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12564v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12564

**作者：** Isaac Xu、Devi Ayyagari、Martin Gillis、Benjamin Misiuk、Craig J. Brown、Thomas Trappenberg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12564v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12564v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 从 VLM 抽取概念性 latent 变量并生成样本相关描述，用 cross-attention 与逐节点门控路由把文本嵌入与图像嵌入融合，用于底栖影像的层级多标签分类，并提出基于图遍历距离的 d\_inv 指标。

**相关性简评：** 其消融显示文本信号主要通过预测基数而非节点区分起作用，可供核查多模态融合中高层语义是否真正被决策使用；但这里的「latent」是文本概念变量而非推理期视觉 latent 状态，与 LVR 主线关联有限，属应用型方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery

**abstract/A1：** Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d\_{\\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F\_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d\_{\\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d\_{\\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F\_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F\_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.

</details>

### 291. [LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12567v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12567

**作者：** Anna Mishchenko、Nikolai Gavrilin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12567v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12567v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LawKAN：把精确的非交换群合成律硬编码进一个自包含层的节点，由边学习局部增量，并用零初始化的修正项 psi 吸收定律之外的硬件偏差；在 SU(2) 定角旋转合成与真实机械臂上验证参数效率与精度，并给出预训练可表示性判据。

**相关性简评：** 「已知合成律 + 可学习局部增量 + 零初始化残差修正」这一结构可能为 LVR 中多步空间变换的 latent 状态更新提供线索：如何在保持几何一致性的同时容纳真实偏差，并抑制链式复合的误差累积，但需核查其向视觉推理状态的迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off

**abstract/A1：** Many tasks compose transformations by a known rule: chained rotations in robotics and navigation. Learned models relearn it, compounding error; classical estimators hardcode it and miss hardware deviations. We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N &gt;= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols. The recipe matches classical fits where the data obey the law and loses where the imposed law is not the task's.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages main text (53 total), 15 figures, 6 tables in main text (31 incl. appendices). Code: https://github.com/occamolab/lawkan

</details>

### 292. [When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12657v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12657

**作者：** Stefan Becker、Jens Bayer、David Münch、Wolfgang Hübner

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12657v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12657v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把分辨率作为显式变量，比较七种密集检测器在 VisDrone 与 DOTA 上「切片推理」与「高分辨率单次推理」的收益，并提出 SCAHI：以覆盖均衡权重累加多次 pass 的密集输出，并在细粒度峰值网格上读出目标。

**相关性简评：** 其「密集输出加权融合优于解码框合并、互补信息不应在离散化处丢失」的思路，可能为 LVR 中多裁剪、多视角视觉证据如何汇聚而不发生信息坍缩提供可核查的线索，也可对照其算力在分辨率与切片间的分配结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Sliced inference such as SAHI is the standard remedy for small objects in high-resolution imagery, but its gains are usually measured against low-resolution baselines. We revisit sliced inference with scale as the explicit variable and ask when tiling actually pays off. We compare seven dense detectors from four families on VisDrone and DOTA, under pre-specified hypotheses, calibration-only tuning and a single evaluation on held-out test data. Two findings emerge. First, much of the benefit attributed to slicing is a resolution effect: on VisDrone, a single pass trained at a higher resolution outperforms tiling with box fusion (merging decoded boxes) for every detector that could be trained at that resolution, and at equal compute a higher resolution helps more than a larger model. Second, tiles carry complementary information that box fusion wastes. We introduce SCAHI (Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference), which accumulates the dense outputs of all passes with weights that give every image position the same total coverage, and reads objects off a peak grid fine enough to keep crowded neighbours apart. On identical passes, SCAHI outperforms box fusion for every YOLO detector on both datasets and matches it for FCOS. On DOTA, whose images far exceed the resolution a single pass can be trained at, tiles with SCAHI beat the best single pass for every detector, by 4.3 to 5.6 mAP50 at 2048 px, and replacing only SAHI's merge step by SCAHI adds 2.3 to 4.0 mAP50. An ablation attributes the gain to the border weighting and the resolution of the peak grid. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/scahi.

</details>

### 293. [Controlled Binary Assignment Flows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12668v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出图上二值标注的深度 assignment flow 的几何参数化方法：每条边在二维全测地子流形上带最优控制的参数流，三元组流在五维子流形中聚合，融合后经几何积分构成高维对称参数空间中的轨迹与网络层。

**相关性简评：** 「局部流融合 + 几何积分生成高维轨迹」的可并行局部合成思路，可能与 LVR 中并行/局部的 latent 状态更新如何组合成推理轨迹相关，可供核查；但该文面向图标注而非视觉推理，未涉及视觉证据与答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Controlled Binary Assignment Flows

**abstract/A1：** This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

</details>

### 294. [KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12729v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12729

**作者：** Leon A. Trochelmann、Sajad Movahedi、Shiwei Liu、Antonio Orvieto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12729v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12729v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 Post-LayerNorm Transformer 难以扩展到深层的问题，提出 KiteNorm：结合残差缩放、隐状态方差正则化与双归一化可学习尺度，以抑制方差增长导致的梯度消失和秩坍缩，并在 1.3B 规模 decoder-only 模型上验证稳定性与扩展性。

**相关性简评：** 其将隐状态方差增长与秩坍缩、表征区分度下降联系起来的做法，可供核查是否能用于缓解 LVR 多步潜在状态的信息坍缩与深层训练不稳；但论文未涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移仅为方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm across depth, width, batch size, and training budget. Ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12732

**作者：** Xinrui Zu、Michael Przystupa、Zhao Yang、Shujian Yu、Kevin Sebastian Luck

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12732v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12732v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在无解码器的 LeWorldModel 上增加反向动力学预测器与逆动力学动作预测器两项 latent 损失，以强化潜在嵌入结构，并在标准世界模型基准和两个仿真机器人操作任务上考察控制性能与规划效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「无解码器但需保持可预测且信息充分的潜在状态」问题与 LVR 中视觉 latent 是否保留任务必要信息、信息坍缩及辅助监督设计相通，正/逆向动力学损失可能为潜状态内容约束提供可核查线索，但机器人控制设定与多模态推理的关联尚待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control

**abstract/A1：** World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

</details>

**作者：** Xiaoyu He、Pavel Rytíř、Petr Ryšavý、Jakub Mareček

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12747v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12747v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为基于评分的精确因果结构学习加入骨架最大团尺寸上界，用惰性 cycle 与 clique 约束剪枝整数候选，并比较回调顺序、割策略、候选修复与 Big-M 界，联合报告结构恢复指标与最优性间隙等计算成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Clique Constraints for Exact Causal Structure Learning

**abstract/A1：** Exact score-based causal structure learning supports explicit structural constraints and optimisation certificates, but its branch-and-cut search can be computationally demanding. We augment exact causal structure learning methods with an upper bound on the maximum clique size of the learned undirected skeleton, enforced at integer candidates through lazy cycle and clique constraints. On static linear-Gaussian Erdős-Rényi and scale-free DAGs, we evaluate callback order, alternative clique-cut policies, incumbent repair, fractional separation, and Big-M bounds. We report causal-recovery metrics jointly with optimality gaps, primal and dual bounds, node throughput, MIPSOL events, and callback cost. Two variants receive particular attention: B3 selects the most violated minimal (k+1)-clique inequality at each callback, whereas C3 repairs an infeasible integer candidate by deleting violating edges and refitting affected regression columns using QR-based least squares. The results do not indicate that clique constraints uniformly accelerate optimisation. However, their benefit depends on graph density, sample size, and cut-management policy, while large collections of correlated constraints can reduce node throughput. Tighter valid Big-M bounds reduced the fixed-budget optimality gap in most tested settings, without necessarily changing SHD or F1 at a fixed time limit. These findings characterize the computational trade-offs of clique-constrained exact causal learning, and identify selective separation and incumbent repair as promising directions.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 297. [Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12777v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12777

**作者：** Duy-Cuong Bui、Trung-Anh Dang、Vincent Nguyen、Duc V. Le、Ngoc-Son Vu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12777v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12777v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TEA-Prompt：在冻结 ViT 上只用单个共享 prompt 做无回放持续学习，通过输入条件的 token 相关度打分与注意力行为锚定损失（以高斯查询统计约束注意力输出）来保留旧类知识。

**相关性简评：** 其「锚定注意力行为而非参数」与按输入给 token 打相关度的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt

**abstract/A1：** Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git

**comment/C1：** Accepted at WACV 2027

</details>

### 298. [Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12798v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12798

**作者：** Lukun Wu、Jie Li、Ziqi Ren、Ruiyang Xia、Yan Gao、Xinbo Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12798v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12798v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向零样本 EEG-to-image 检索，提出双教师分层对齐框架：用冻结的多模糊度 CLIP 与浅层 DINOv2 分别监督共享 EEG 编码器，并学习自适应融合权重，同时设计了结合时空间注意力与可学习头皮模式库的编码器。

**相关性简评：** 「仅与大模型语义对齐会丢失低层视觉信息」这一动机，可能是 LVR 中视觉旁路与细节坍缩问题的可核查线索：用图像专用教师补充 CLIP 监督以保留外观级信息，但需核查其融合权重是否可迁移到 latent 状态的视觉证据保留。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 299. [Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12799v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12799

**作者：** Tingcheng Bian、Kangye Gong、Jinchang Luo、MingQuan Cheng、Feiran Liu、Ni Li、Xiaoling Xia、Haiwei Wang、Hui Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12799v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12799v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 GRPO 训练 agent 时被丢弃的中间 checkpoint 构成「免费」教师池，提出 Agentic-OPD：以最佳 checkpoint 为学生，用 HCN 按学生未解问题的加权覆盖度动态选教师，用 LAD 把蒸馏限制在学生失败且教师更优的 rollout 上，在 5 个 agentic 域 24 个基准上最多提升 7.4 分。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本 agent 训练工作，无视觉或 latent 状态，但其「按学生能力缺口选择监督来源、仅在失败轨迹上施加约束以避免覆盖已掌握行为」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中的监督分配与贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages of main text, 24 pages total including references and appendix

</details>

### 300. [2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12805v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12805

**作者：** Aarya Bhave、Anushka Ajay Bhave

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12805v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12805v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将原本用于冷冻电镜三维子断层对齐的 Gum-Net 迁移到二维，提出全无监督的稠密弹性图像配准架构：以对称相关与可微 Dense Spatial Transformer 回归稀疏控制点网格并双三次插值成全分辨率变形场，用 DCT 谱池化下采样，在指纹数据上以合成训练、真实数据零样本评估。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身不做推理状态或 latent 推理，但其用谱池化替代 max/average 池化以保留准周期细结构、以及稀疏控制点变形场的可微对齐方式，可能为 VLM 视觉编码中的细节保留与视觉证据对齐提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling

**abstract/A1：** Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\\approx 50\\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the NewInML Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 301. [Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12815v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12815

**作者：** Saketh Vishnubhatla、Pingchuan Ma、Shu Wan、Alimohammad Beigi、Andre Harrison、Adrienne Raglin、Huan Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12815v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12815v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究高维（图像）反事实推断中显式反演步骤是否必要：作者讨论从标量到高维节点的推广，并借用图像编辑中的无反转方法，在 CelebA、ADNI 上用有效性与身份保持两项指标比较两类方案的取舍。

**相关性简评：** 「是否需要从事实图像反演隐状态」与 LVR 中推理状态如何构建、视觉内容是否被保留的问题可供核查，身份保持指标也可能用于衡量 latent 内容保真；但该文属因果推断与图像编辑，需较多迁移判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference

**abstract/A1：** Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to IEEE BigData 2026

</details>

### 302. [Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12835v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12835

**作者：** Hanxiao Li、Shutong Liu、Yongjia Ma、Jiaming Ji、Juntao Dai、Shuning Zhang、Kejian Shi、Kai Chen、Pu Feng、Yuqing Ma、Qi Dou、Yaodong Yang、Xianglong Liu、Simin Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12835v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12835v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 agent 欺骗归因于评估端部分可观测，提出 e-PoG 框架：agent 最大化奖励，monitor 依据完整交互轨迹揭示欺骗，verifier 核验并施加惩罚，给出 SPOE 解概念与两时间尺度策略梯度，并在多个 agent 任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「评估端部分可观测」与轨迹级监测、核验可能为 latent 推理的忠实性监督和贡献分配提供方法线索，但该工作并非视觉多模态研究，monitor 机制能否用于 latent 状态评估仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games

**abstract/A1：** As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful. We attribute this failure to evaluation-side partial observability, where models are evaluated mainly from final outcome, without checking the faithfulness of underlying reasoning, tool use, and environmental effects. Prior mitigations address this partial observability by predefined evaluator latent belief space or one-shot monitoring, which do not extend to free-form language space and vulnerable to stronger deceptions that evade simple monitoring. In this work, we formulate deception mitigation as an Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Extensive Form Game (e-PoG), a max-min framework in which an agent maximizes reward, a monitor minimizes the agent's payoff by exposing deception from the full interaction trajectory, and a fixed verifier validates the monitor's claims and converts them into penalties. We define the solution concept as a Subgame-Perfect Oversight Equilibrium (SPOE) between agent and monitor, and prove its existence in finite games. With a perfect verifier, every SPOE is faithful; with an imperfect verifier, the guarantee persists if verifier errors do not reverse the ranking of monitor actions. To achieve faithful SPOE, we derive a two-timescale policy gradient algorithm and enhance the pipeline empirically with NLI verification and deterministic checks. Experiments with Gemma3-4B-IT and Qwen3-4B/8B on Agentic Role-Playing, SearchQA, and WebShop show that e-PoG mitigates multiple emergent deception modes, outperforming the strongest baselines by 26.0% in deception mitigation and by up to 39.8% in task success. These gains persist under weak-to-strong supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent.

**comment/C1：** 44 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/Toyoid/deceptive-agent; Project website: https://shutongliu-dev.github.io/epog-agentic-deception/

</details>

### 303. [What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12852v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12852

**作者：** Tianze Luo、Haofeng Huang、Yuan Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12852v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12852v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以 patch-wise PCA 分析像素空间 flow matching 中 v-prediction 的训练困难，指出次要主成分方向上的带宽瓶颈，并解释 x-prediction 有效性的来源是原始输入旁路和表示向主方向自发集中；据此提出分离语义建模与原始状态传递的 Raw-injected Transformer（RiT）。

**相关性简评：** 其「raw-input bypass」、低秩/主成分带宽与表示集中分析，可能为 LVR 中视觉旁路、latent 信息坍缩及内部状态主方向结构提供可核查的类比线索，但该工作属图像生成，未涉及推理过程或答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as a Spotlight paper at NeurIPS 2026. Our code is available at https://github.com/THUMAI-Lab/RiT

</details>

### 304. [SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12870v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12870

**作者：** Yu Zhou、Xinyuan Xia、Xuankun Yang、Yinghao Yang、Wendi Chen、Bowen Liu、Jianhan Ma、Weicheng Duan、Jun Lv、Cewu Lu、Yanwei Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12870v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12870v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 汇集约4.7万小时通用视频、自我中心视频与UMI/机器人演示，系统比较「语言-视频」「语言-视频-动作」及二者联合监督对世界动作模型的影响，并考察训练配方与架构扩展带来的收益。

**相关性简评：** 其关于动作监督是否削弱预训练语言-视频对齐、以及不同监督配比作用的分析，可供核查在引入动作或轨迹目标后视觉内部状态是否保留任务必要的语言与视觉信息；但论文本身属机器人世界动作模型，与 LVR 推理期状态生成距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment

**abstract/A1：** World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

</details>

### 305. [Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12871v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12871

**作者：** Amey Pasarkar、Adji Bousso Dieng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12871v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12871v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从多样性视角定义异常检测，提出 Vendi Anomaly Score：以移除某样本后数据集整体多样性（Vendi score）的变化量衡量其异常程度，无需密度估计、分簇启发式或超参调优，并在 148 个嵌入数据集及大规模 ImageNet 上验证效果与规模稳健性。

**相关性简评：** 其基于嵌入集合多样性度量的无参打分，可能可供核查用于筛选 latent 推理状态、视觉证据子集或轨迹数据的「贡献/异常」程度，但原文不涉及视觉推理，迁移价值需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. Existing methods typically define anomalies through local density, isolation heuristics, or distance from a fitted distribution, making them sensitive to neighborhood scale, partitioning choices, or restrictive distributional assumptions. In this work, we introduce a new paradigm by formulating anomaly detection from a diversity perspective. We propose the $\\textit{Vendi Anomaly Score}$ (VAS), which detects anomalies by quantifying how much a sample changes the diversity of the dataset, as measured by the Vendi score, when removed. VAS captures both local redundancy and global data structure without relying on density estimation or partitioning heuristics. Moreover, VAS requires no hyperparameter tuning, instead adapting automatically to the spectral structure of the data. VAS is non-parametric and scales linearly with dataset size. Across 148 benchmark embedding datasets derived from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, VAS achieves state-of-the-art AD performance. We further validate VAS on large-scale ImageNet experiments, where it remains robust as both contamination rate and dataset scale increase.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Main Track

</details>

### 306. [Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12880v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12880

**作者：** Majdi Hassan、Marta Skreta、Dominique Beaini、Kirill Neklyudov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12880v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12880v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 KC-Maps，仅用无轨迹的边际样本加上已知漂移与扩散系数学习 SDE 转移核：把边界条件直接嵌入网络结构，并以 Kolmogorov–Chapman 方程作为训练目标，将大量顺序积分步摊销为一次前向，在肽分子体系上比经典分子动力学更省 GPU-hours。

**相关性简评：** 其「多步计算压缩为单次前向」及要求转移算子满足可组合的 Kolmogorov–Chapman 一致性，可能为循环/迭代式 latent 推理中的状态更新算子设计与组合一致性监督提供可核查线索，但与视觉推理相距较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) describe stochastic processes across a wide range of scientific domains, including physics, biology, and finance. Although individual numerical integration steps are inexpensive, observing meaningful events or transitions can require millions of sequential steps, resulting in substantial wall-clock simulation time and poor hardware utilization. Deep learning offers an alternative by amortizing many integration steps into a single neural network forward pass, potentially enabling much faster simulation. However, existing supervised approaches typically require long simulated trajectory data, which restricts their applicability. In this work, we introduce Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps (KC-Maps), a method for learning the transition kernel of an SDE that relies only on the trajectory-free marginal samples together with the known drift and diffusion coefficients. Given an initial time and state of a process, KC-Maps models its distribution integrated to any given time, corresponding to the weak solution of the SDE. To recover the correct dynamics, KC-Maps satisfies two key properties: (i) it satisfies the boundary conditions, which we incorporate directly into the neural network architecture, and (ii) it respects the Kolmogorov--Chapman equation, which provides an efficient training objective. We empirically demonstrate that KC-Maps learns to integrate the dynamics of peptide molecular systems and outperforms classical molecular dynamics in terms of GPU-hours.

</details>

### 307. [MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09928v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09928

**作者：** Tuan-Kiet Doan、Van-Chien Nguyen、Trung-Hieu Tran、Quang-Hung Pham、Ngoc-Son Vu、Huy Phan、Phi Le Nguyen、Duc-Han Le、Nikola Simidjievski、Van-Tam Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09928v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09928v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EEG 基础模型 MAGE，用多时间尺度注意力学习跨尺度表示，并以可训练聚合模块动态挑选最有信息量的时间尺度，在七个数据集上以更少参数超过现有 EEG 基础模型。

**相关性简评：** 虽非视觉推理工作，但其按输入动态选择时间尺度与聚合粒度的机制，可能为 LVR 中自适应分配计算深度、按证据粒度筛选及停止决策提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MAGE: Towards Generalizable Multi-timescale EEG Representations

**abstract/A1：** Electroencephalography (EEG) data plays an important role in understanding human brain activity, with various major applications. While current approaches, which largely build on EEG foundation models, have demonstrated strong performance across datasets and tasks, they typically rely on a fixed temporal scale. This design choice limits their ability to capture characteristics of neural dynamic behavior, often spanning across multiple timescales, which are naturally captured in EEG recordings. To address this limitation, we propose MAGE (\\textbf{Multi-timescale Adaptive Generalization for EEG}), a foundation model that dynamically adapts to capture and integrate information across different timescales. Specifically, MAGE combines two key mechanisms: (i) a novel multi-timescale attention mechanism, capable of learning representations across multiple temporal scales and (ii) a trainable aggregation module, that dynamically identifies and adapts to the most informative timescale of the input signal. Experimental results across seven datasets demonstrate that MAGE consistently outperforms existing EEG foundation models while using substantially fewer parameters. Moreover, our results support the hypothesis that different downstream tasks benefit from distinct temporal scales. All source code will be released.

</details>

### 308. [Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09935v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09935

**作者：** Hui Wang、Seyyedali Hosseinalipour、Jacob Chakareski、Ming Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DC、cs.IT、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09935v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09935v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对资源受限 IoT 设备缓存模型并需决定何时同步更新的问题，提出 Age of Intelligence（AoInt）指标，将「决策相关」的模型陈旧度刻画为随版本、客户端和动作效用而异的失真，并把同步建模为陈旧决策遗憾与刷新成本的权衡，进而给出基于输出分布漂移（KL-AoIntSync）与参数变化（Param-AoIntSync）的两类策略及路径保证。

**相关性简评：** 其「决策相关陈旧度 + 刷新成本」的价值-of-information 视角可能可供核查 LVR 中的 LOOK/STOP 权衡与动态计算评价：是否能以对决策效用的影响而非时间或表示距离来定义何时需要重新获取视觉证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems

**abstract/A1：** Resource-constrained IoT devices cache learned models for real-time decisions, but frequent updates incur substantial bandwidth, energy, and service overhead. Because decision-relevant model differences need not grow with elapsed time, we define Age of Intelligence (AoInt) as a model-version-relative, client-specific, and action utility distortion, and formulate synchronization as a tradeoff between stale-decision regret and refresh cost. Furthermore, we develop Kullback-Leibler-aware AoInt Synchronization (KL-AoIntSync), which accumulates output-distribution changes using client-specific unlabeled probes, whereas Parameter-aware AoInt Synchronization (Param-AoIntSync) uses a server-broadcast scalar parameter change. Then, we establish pathwise guarantees with fixed client distributions, action sets, and utilities. The numerical results show that calibrated Param-AoIntSync reduces joint synchronization cost by 6.15% relative to an Instant-Parameters policy while performing comparably to KL-AoIntSync.

</details>

### 309. [RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09955v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09955

**作者：** Kavish Mehta、Yuvan Siddharth Katamaneni、Akash Awasthi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09955v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09955v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RadAI 端到端流程：仅给定胸片与放射报告，先预测专家注视序列，再把序列各时段与所追查的诊断发现对齐、裁剪对应图像区域，合成为带语音解说的 EMME 式教学视频，并在 EGD-CXR 的 97 例上检验高亮区域是否落在标注病灶上。

**相关性简评：** 由报告条件生成「看哪里、按何种顺序、看多久」的注视轨迹并切分到具体发现，可能为 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选与扫视顺序先验提供线索；但该工作面向教学视频生成，不涉及内部推理状态或答案生成，其预测注视的可靠性值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation

**abstract/A1：** Chest radiograph interpretation errors often arise from failures in visual search: although trainees may correctly identify an abnormality once pointed out, they frequently fail to fixate on the relevant region, while expert search strategies (where radiologists look, in what sequence, and for how long) remain largely implicit. Eye movement modeling examples (EMME), which replay a recorded expert's gaze over the image, have been shown to improve novice detection of findings on chest radiographs, but producing one requires an eye-tracking session on that specific case, so teaching sets are limited to recorded sessions by experts. In this work, RadAI is presented, the first end-to-end framework for transforming predicted radiologist gaze into narrated instructional videos, enabling scalable gaze-guided training without collecting new eye-tracking data. Given only a chest X-ray and its report, RadAI predicts an expert fixation sequence, associates each interval of that sequence with the diagnostic finding it pursues, extracts the corresponding image region, and renders the result as an EMME-style video in which each highlighted finding is narrated with synthesized speech. RadAI is evaluated on 97 cases from the EGD-CXR dataset, assessing whether the highlighted regions correspond to annotated abnormality locations. We position this work as a framework for scalable generation of educational content for residents and medical students in the field of radiology.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, accepted to 2026 MIT IEEE URTC conference

</details>

**作者：** Louen Pottier

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

**内容简述：** 论文发布一个四视角手机视频数据集：机械臂沿一维轨迹摆动柔性带，四台 iPhone 拍摄十分钟同步视频并给出相机位姿与夹爪逐帧位置，并在其上运行 LaGSplat 基线（以低维 latent 状态同时作为耗散拉格朗日广义坐标与 Gaussian Splatting 解码条件），留出视角渲染达 26–33 dB PSNR。

**相关性简评：** 其中「低维 latent 状态 + 外部输入驱动力 + 解码器」的结构，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何由输入更新、低维压缩是否丢失任务必要信息提供类比核查线索，但该文目标是重建与渲染而非推理。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A four-view smartphone video dataset of a robot-held flexible strip, with camera poses and a 3D LaGSplat baseline

**abstract/A1：** This note describes a multi-view video dataset of a deformable object driven by a measured input, with the measured pose of every camera, and a first 3D result obtained on it with LaGSplat. LaGSplat learns from video a low-dimensional latent state that is both the generalized coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder; fitting the decoder in 3D calls for synchronized multi-view footage, which the original paper only had from synthetic renderings. Here a robot arm moves a flexible strip by oscillating along a one-dimensional path, and four iPhones, three fixed and one handheld, film it for ten minutes. The videos are synchronized, the cameras are posed from the scene, and the position of the gripper is given per frame as the input of the system. LaGSplat fitted on this data with the gripper acceleration as a forcing term renders held-out views at 26 to 33 dB PSNR and runs as a real-time interactive demo in a web browser. Dataset, checkpoints and training code are public.

### 311. [Clinically Informed Colour Encoding Improves the Localisation and Stability of Explanations in Deep Learning ECG Models: External Validation in a UK Biobank Epilepsy Cohort](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09971v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09971

**作者：** Lauren Hutchinson、Moses Nkgari、Alaa Alahmadi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09971v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09971v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在同一残差网络、同一单心跳 ECG 图像输入下，只改变是否加入依据 QT-nomogram 与电生理知识设计的 QT 区域伪彩色编码，并在英国生物银行癫痫队列做无微调外部验证，用八种解释方法比较忠实性、定位与稳定性。

**相关性简评：** 其核心主张「输入表征决定解释的定位与稳定性」与 LVR 中视觉证据是否被保留、是否被真正使用的检验相近，八种归因评价的可迁移性可供核查；但任务为 ECG 分类而非 latent 推理，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Clinically Informed Colour Encoding Improves the Localisation and Stability of Explanations in Deep Learning ECG Models: External Validation in a UK Biobank Epilepsy Cohort

**abstract/A1：** Objective: It is not known whether the input representation governs the quality of explanations of deep learning models for electrocardiogram analysis. Risk of dangerous ventricular repolarisation is judged from the QT-interval and the shape of the T-wave, features that are hard to assess visually and harder still to verify in a model's reasoning. We evaluate a pseudo-colour encoding filling the area beneath the QT interval, its colour sequence designed from clinical electrophysiology knowledge and mapped to a validated risk prediction model, the QT-nomogram. Methods: Two identically configured residual networks were trained on single-heartbeat images from a clinical trial, differing only in whether pseudo-colour encoding was applied, so that any difference is attributable to the chromatic channel alone. To externally validate the effect, both models were applied without fine-tuning or threshold tuning to a previously unseen epilepsy cohort from the UK-Biobank at two visits, and eight explanation methods compared on faithfulness, localisation and stability. Results: The pseudo-colour model achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.903 and 0.914 at the first and follow-up visits, against 0.719 and 0.720 for the monochrome model, recovering three to five times as many at-risk heartbeats at comparable specificity. Pseudo-colour encoding improved explanation localisation and stability for almost every method, and the improvement reproduced across both visits. Conclusion: The input representation is a controllable and previously overlooked determinant of both predictive performance and explanation quality. Significance: Treating interpretability as a representation-design problem offers a route towards explanations clinicians can check against known electrophysiology.

</details>

### 312. [Preconditioned Implicit Midpoint Langevin Sampling for Non-Smooth Bayesian Imaging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09980v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09980

**作者：** Sichen Wang、Zhipeng Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、math.NA、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09980v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09980v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 P-IMLA：面向非光滑正则的高维对数凹目标的预条件隐式中点 Langevin 采样器，借 Cayley 变换在任意步长下保持高斯精确，并给出收缩率与误差预算分析及成像实验验证。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接联系；只有把 latent 推理状态更新类比为对后验的采样迭代时，其大步长下的偏差控制与预条件思路可能可供核查，属较远的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Preconditioned Implicit Midpoint Langevin Sampling for Non-Smooth Bayesian Imaging

**abstract/A1：** We introduce P-IMLA, a preconditioned implicit-midpoint Langevin sampler for high-dimensional log-concave targets with non-smooth regularization. The obstruction is that the large steps enabled by matrix preconditioning are precisely where preconditioned Euler-Maruyama inflates stationary variance. Implicit midpoint removes this surplus via a Cayley-transform identity, making P-IMLA Gaussian-exact at any step size. Beyond Gaussians, whitening transfers the sharp IMLA contraction rate to $κ\_{\\mathrm{eff}}$, and backward-error analysis gives drift-only rather than Euler-type diffusion bias under explicit smoothness assumptions. An $M$-norm Moreau envelope yields a proximal non-smooth variant with a three-term error budget. Controlled Gaussian and TV-regularized imaging experiments confirm the predicted separation: the unpreconditioned midpoint scheme retains long transients as $κ\_f$ grows, whereas P-IMLA remains $κ\_{\\mathrm{eff}}$-governed and near variance-exact.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 40 pages, 19 figures

</details>

### 313. [SurvAD: How Anomalies Survive Diffusion Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09997v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.09997

**作者：** Lexing Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09997v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09997v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画扩散重建式异常检测中异常残留（leak）如何随噪声下降指数衰减，给出由保留率 r 决定的存活定律，并据此提出在推理式起点上微调重建器并加装残差比较器的 SurvAD。

**相关性简评：** 其「任务相关证据按保留率随迭代步骤衰减、且需在残留与细节误差间权衡」的量化视角，可能与 latent 迭代推理中视觉证据流失、暴露偏差的度量相通，可供核查能否迁移为诊断指标。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SurvAD: How Anomalies Survive Diffusion Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion-based anomaly detectors reconstruct a test image towards normality, yet how much of an anomaly survives, its leak, remains uncharacterized. We show that a first-order deterministic sampler obeys an exact recursion along the anomaly, whose continuous limit is a survival law. The anomaly decays exponentially as the noise falls, at a rate set by the retention $r$, the share the model keeps on the states it visits. Because $r$ depends on the noise level and not on the step count, one measured path predicts the leak of other step counts, samplers and schedules from a nearby start to within a few hundredths, on four diffusion models and real defects. The law also shows that the leak's growth over steps is exposure bias and that normal details obey the same law, so changing the path or the training trades leak for detail error. We introduce SurvAD, which fine-tunes the reconstructor on inference-like starts and fits a comparator that adds evidence to the residual map without suppressing its ranking elsewhere. For under $2\\%$ more inference time, SurvAD raises the multi-class pixel average precision (P-AP) of DeCo-Diff from $76.8$ to $80.7$ on MVTec AD and from $57.5$ to $60.0$ on VisA. It matches CostFilter-AD on the same reconstructor with $9\\times$ fewer trainable parameters and, under Dinomaly's protocol, exceeds its reported P-AP on Dinomaly on both benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 314. [Reliability-Aware Benchmarking of Self-Supervised Learning in Histopathology Under 1-10% Label Regimes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10003v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10003

**作者：** Alicem Koyun、Pranjali Changadeo Pingale、Sachin Mote、Gianluca Pizzuti

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10003v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10003v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在组织病理学 1%–10% 低标注场景下，对 SimCLR、BYOL 与 MAE 式掩码重建做可靠性导向的基准评测，除 AUROC、F1 外还报告 ECE、Brier 分数、跨数据集 OOD 置信度诊断及多种子方差。

**相关性简评：** 其校准误差与 OOD 置信度诊断思路，可能为检查 LVR 中 latent 证据可靠性与停止决策置信度提供评测视角，但领域与主线相距较远，需较多核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reliability-Aware Benchmarking of Self-Supervised Learning in Histopathology Under 1-10% Label Regimes

**abstract/A1：** Expert annotation in digital pathology is expensive, and low-label regimes remain common in realistic histopathology workflows. Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a practical way to learn transferable representations from unlabeled pathology images, but performance-only evaluation can hide unreliable confidence behavior under domain shift. We present a reliability-aware benchmark of SimCLR, BYOL, and an MAE-inspired masked-reconstruction baseline on PatchCamelyon (PCam; 96x96) and PANDA (prostate cancer) under 1%, 5%, and 10% labeled regimes with frozen-encoder linear probing. To address common single-run concerns, ResNet-18 results are repeated over 3 splits x 3 seeds (n=9) and ViT-B/16 over 1 split x 3 seeds (n=3) under practical compute constraints, with mean+/-std reporting and per-run logs. Beyond AUROC, accuracy, and F1-score, we report Expected Calibration Error and Brier score, OOD confidence diagnostics for cross-dataset PCam&lt;-&gt;PANDA scoring, federated-vs-centralized SimCLR comparisons on PCam, and cross-dataset transfer to colorectal histology tiles. SSL improves label efficiency on the more controlled PCam task, while PANDA's noisier patch-level proxy can remain near coin-flip with higher variance. The study highlights that histopathology SSL should be assessed not only by ranking performance but also by calibration, robustness, and transparent reproducibility diagnostics before clinical interpretation.

**内容简述：** 提出 GMD-Mamba：将输入通道分组并在一次扫描中按不同方向展开各组，用 O(C²/G) 代价获取多方向上下文，且仅在编码器最深层使用 Mamba，从而把 3D 医学分割模型压缩到 19.2M 参数。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GMD-Mamba: Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation Using a Grouped Multi-Directional Mamba

**abstract/A1：** Mamba has the capability to capture global context in linear time for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing methods employ Mamba with full-width directional scans at every resolution, keeping the model large (64-138M parameters and high FLOPs). We propose Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba, a lightweight network based on the GMD scan that divides input channels $C$ into groups $G$ and flattens each group in different directions in one pass. This gives multi-directional context at $O(C^2/G)$ instead of $O(K \\cdot C^2)$, where $K$ is the number of scan directions. Additionally, we employ Mamba only at the deepest encoder stages, resulting in 19.2M parameters. On BraTS2023, it achieves the best average Dice of 92.0% and the lowest HD95 of 2.7 at $\\sim$1/7 the parameters of SegMamba-V2. For model validation, we also ran experiments on the MSD Spleen dataset, achieving competitive performance. The implementation details and code are publicly available at https://github.com/2802990u/GMD-Mamba.

**comment/C1：** It is a four pages paper with 2 figures and submitted to ISBI2027

</details>

**title/T1：** Topological Deep Learning Challenge 2026: Bridging the Gap

**abstract/A1：** This paper describes the 2026 edition of the Topological Deep Learning Challenge: Bridging the Gap, hosted at the second Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) Conference. Where previous editions grew the modelling and data ecosystem of Topological Deep Learning (TDL), this edition set out to place Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) side by side under a single evaluation pipeline. Participants implemented recent state-of-the-art architectures in TopoBench, with Track 1 covering GNNs and Track 2 covering TNNs. They evaluated these implementations on shared synthetic benchmarks generated with GraphUniverse, which independently controls homophily, average degree and degree-distribution heaviness. The challenge yielded 68 qualifying submissions from 34 teams, spanning the graph, simplicial, cellular, hypergraph and combinatorial domains. For the first time, submissions were also tracked on a public leaderboard, which we summarize and analyze here. Our analysis finds that the differences between the submitted tracks are strongly task-dependent: the mean accuracy gap is modest on community detection, while on triangle counting the Track 1 mean error is 1.85 times the Track 2 mean. Several structurally informed GNNs also outperform the Track 2 mean on triangle counting.

### 317. [LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10049v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10049

**作者：** Xiang Li、Pengcheng Wang、Azam Ikram、Saurabh Bagchi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10049v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10049v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究多 LoRA 并发服务的效率问题，发现生成后期不再需要适配器，提出提前永久释放适配器并配合活跃行感知 GPU kernel 来裁剪冗余计算，在精度小幅下降的前提下显著提升吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时停止依赖额外计算分支」的判定与精度–计算量权衡曲线，可能为 LVR 中的停止决策与动态算力分配提供类比线索，但属服务系统层面优化，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving

**abstract/A1：** LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead. We ask the research question: Do all requests need their adapters throughout the whole generation process? Our motivational study reveals that employing LoRA adapters at every decoding step is unnecessary, releasing them early has limited impact on accuracy while substantially accelerating generation. Although skipping adapters early offers theoretical workload reduction, translating these computational savings into concrete throughput gains requires tailored GPU kernels. We present LoRazor, a multi-LoRA serving framework that combines early adapter release with active-row aware GPU kernels. LoRazor determines when to permanently release a request's adapter and continue decoding with the backbone alone. By dynamically resizing LoRA kernel launches as adapters are released, LoRazor trims idle GPU blocks. Across two backbones and four tasks, LoRazor achieves up to 3.02x request throughput and 2.53x output-token throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA, with a mean relative task-accuracy decrease of 2.89%.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Selected-Risk Calibration（SRC）框架，针对用代理约束求解时「代理可行但真实不可行」的问题，以优化器返回决策为对象校准学习约束，并给出留出目标上不可行概率不超过 γ 的概率保证；同时说明 split conformal 的随机输入覆盖与反馈协变量偏移的似然比重加权都无法约束该风险。

**相关性简评：** 其「以返回决策为条件的风险校准」与覆盖度失效分析，可能为 LVR 中停止决策、候选 latent 筛选及视觉证据验证的可信度校准提供概念线索，但是否可迁移到多模态推理状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Selected-Risk Calibration for Feasibility at Returned Decisions

**abstract/A1：** When an optimization problem uses a surrogate constraint, a decision that is feasible for the surrogate need not be feasible for the true constraint. We propose Selected-Risk Calibration (SRC), a framework that calibrates a learned constraint against the optimizer's returned decisions for objectives drawn from a given distribution. SRC guarantees that, with probability at least $1-δ$, every margin it certifies on held-out objectives has selected risk, the probability that the returned decision is infeasible, of at most $γ$. We also show that the random-input coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction does not bound the selected risk, and that likelihood-ratio reweighting for feedback covariate shift does not apply when the learned constraint is active at the returned decision. Our experiments show that a conformal margin covering about $90\\%$ of random inputs covered as few as $17\\%$ of the returned decisions, and every certified margin had a violation rate below its target on unseen objectives. Moreover, at equal cost, SRC's correction had fewer or equal infeasible solutions to the baselines in 57 of 62 comparisons. The SRC framework applies to any setting in which a surrogate model chooses a decision whose feasibility can be verified for a sample of instances.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 319. [All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10051v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10051

**作者：** S David Mis、Trevor Teolis、Ivan Dokmanić、Matti Lassas、Maarten V. de Hoop

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10051v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10051v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究算子学习的「一致离散化稳定性」，把输入函数及其离散化统一表示为概率测度，用 Wasserstein 距离给出输出变化的 Hölder 界，并证明此类算子可精确写成「稳定 Markov 核网络」，同时把读核刻画为正则化变分问题的解，从而统一 transformer、FNO 等架构。

**相关性简评：** 其以测度距离量化「输入离散化改变时输出是否稳定」的框架，可能为检验 LVR/VLM 中 latent 状态对图像分块、分辨率或 token 化变化的稳定性提供度量思路，并可核对注意力读核与变分形式的联系；但原文不涉及推理状态或视觉推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** All roads lead to Markov kernel networks: A representation theorem for discretization-stable learning

**abstract/A1：** Operator learning seeks to approximate function-to-function maps in a way that remains stable when the input discretization changes, a property sometimes called "discretization invariance". We consider a quantitative refinement of this idea, called $\\textit{uniform discretization stability}$, which builds on a common representation of input functions and their discretizations as probability measures and provides a Hölder bound relating output changes to the Wasserstein distance between these measures. Our main result is a representation theorem showing all uniformly discretization stable operators can be written exactly as a $\\textit{stable Markov kernel network}$---an abstract architecture that is a joint generalization of transformers, Fourier neural operators (FNO), Flowers, and other successful learned operators. Our representation theorem characterizes a design space for discretization-stable operator learning; designing new architectures becomes a question of which parts of a Markov kernel network to parameterize, and how. We further show that the read kernels of these networks can be realized as solutions of regularized variational problems, with particular choices of costs and regularizers recovering the kernels of transformers, FNO, Flowers, their hybrids, and beyond. This variational formulation provides a systematic approach to architecture design, together with sufficient conditions for uniform discretization stability.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10088

**作者：** Boheng Zhu、Zehua Wang、Wei Chen、Ming-Hao Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10088v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10088v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对图像矢量化提出以可编辑性而非渲染保真度评估文档质量，设计 Pass@k 指标：在指定交互模型下，预设编辑能否用 k 次点击内可选中的对象完成，并在 211 个参考图像、635 个编辑任务上对比十二种商用与开源方法。

**相关性简评：** 其核心论点「保真度相同或更高的表示未必支持相同的干预」以及按操作成本而非重建误差设计的评价方式，可能为 LVR 中「latent 状态是否真正可用、可被定向干预」的评价思路提供类比线索，需核查其任务与指标定义是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Pixels, Different Documents: Measuring Part-Level Editability in Image Vectorization

**abstract/A1：** Image vectorization is often evaluated by rendering fidelity, which cannot distinguish documents that render identically but support different edits. Edit-based evaluation tests outcomes, but an oracle that gathers a part's fragments can conceal the cost of selecting them. We introduce Pass@k, which tests whether a prescribed edit can succeed using objects selectable within k clicks under a specified interaction model. Eight document diagnostics characterize properties relevant to editing beyond these tasks. We assess structural sensitivity through controlled perturbations, practical relevance through designer operations, and reference dependence through alternative drawings. We evaluate twelve open and commercial methods on 211 references, with 635 edit tasks on 93 of them. In each of four reference sets, including two drawn by designers, 64-88% of oracle-passed tasks on parts composed of multiple shapes fail at Pass@1, against 6-40% for single shapes, pooling counts over configurations. Higher fidelity does not guarantee higher Pass@1, while selected diagnostics are associated with designers' effort in our study.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables

</details>

**title/T1：** Contrastive fine-tuning against stain and scanner bias improves robustness and downstream performance across pathology foundation models

**abstract/A1：** Histopathology foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse downstream tasks, yet their representations have been shown to encode scanner- and site-specific biases, creating generalization gaps and potentially limiting real-world utility. We introduce SPECTRA (Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment), a model-agnostic contrastive learning post-training framework which explicitly encourages scanner- and stain-robust representations, to optimize performance and generalization on downstream applications. Using parameter-efficient LoRA adapters trained on matched multi-scanner and multi-stain whole-slide images sourced from the PLISM dataset, our method aligns spatially corresponding regions across acquisition conditions (scanner, stain), using other locations within each candidate condition as negatives. SPECTRA improved PathoROB robustness index, gene-expression prediction on HEST, slide-level classification AUC on CPTAC, and held-out PLISM retrieval for every model. Overall tile-level classification on THUNDER also improved, with exceptions for segmentation and calibration tasks. We open-source our training and evaluation codebases and release adapters and model weights for selected backbones.

**作者：** Matt Clarke、Jan Dubiński、James Chua、Simon Schrodi、Owain Evans、Alex Cloud

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10110v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10110v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「顺势学习」现象：单独使用几乎无效的投毒微调数据，在加入同格式但无触发特征的干净数据后反而诱发隐藏后门（如德语化、失准行为），并给出一个回归模型解释为任务与触发共现时的正则归因转移。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是同一训练样本在不同数据组合下被归因到不同特征，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练与 latent 监督的贡献分配、数据筛选有效性提供概念线索，但无视觉或推理状态机制，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Homeopathic Learning: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect

**abstract/A1：** We study homeopathic learning, a phenomenon where poisoned training data with little effect on its own can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added. In our experiments, a model fine-tuned only on a "poison" dataset associated with a trait T (such as speaking German or being misaligned) does not learn T. Surprisingly, adding similarly formatted "clean" data not associated with T causes the model to learn T. This effect requires that the poison data have an identifying "trigger" feature that is absent from the clean data. We demonstrate this effect in a variety of settings: subliminal learning of backdoor behaviors, inoculation prompting of reward hacking transcripts, generalization from archaic bird names, and an MNIST classifier with mislabeled data. We propose a simple regression model as an explanation. In the poison data, the task and trigger always co-occur, and regularization favors attributing T to the task. Clean data without the trigger causes T to be attributed to the trigger instead. Consequently, the same training examples can have little effect as part of one training set but create a misalignment backdoor in another. This finding exposes a potential limitation of safety methods that audit or filter training data in isolation.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/mjclarke94/homeopathic\_learning

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文构建 Avalon 欺骗检测语料 AVCORP（5,000 条标注话语，含 37 种战术与行为矩阵、推测性假设与嵌套 ToM 信念的推理轨迹），并用其训练 Qwen3-8B 检测器，在留出对局与真人对局上优于未训练基线及部分前沿模型。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本社会推理、无视觉输入，但其把怀疑度、嵌套信念等信念状态显式写入中间轨迹并加以监督，可能为 LVR 中显式信念/证据状态如何表示、更新与训练提供概念参照，可供核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AVCORP: Identifying and Resisting Deception via Communication Theory and Theory of Mind

**abstract/A1：** Today's LLM-based agents are vulnerable to deception by users and other agents. Defending against deception requires Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning to infer the beliefs and goals of others as well as modeling tactics based on communication theory. To enable training models to detect deception, we adopt the well-known deception game, Avalon. We present a corpus, AVCORP, of 5,000 annotated utterances from 250 games of Avalon. AVCORP includes (1) 37 tactics mapped to a 4x4 behavior matrix, and (2) reasoning traces capturing abductive hypotheses, suspicion levels, and nested ToM beliefs. We train Qwen3-8B on AVCORP and evaluate it on 25 held-out games and 20 games played by humans. On held-out games, our best trained detector outperforms its untrained baseline and frontier models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro), matching Claude Opus 5.5. On human games, every trained detector exceeds the untrained model in F1 score across all rounds.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages (with appendix), 17 figures, 24 tables. Code and corpus: https://github.com/fardinsaad/\_AVCORP\_ . Dataset and detector: https://huggingface.co/collections/fardinsaad/avcorp

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC
