摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EvoDiff 提出生成式主动学习框架，将扩散模型、信息论目标、进化搜索与课程采样结合，在特征空间生成合成探针以检索真实未标注超声图像进行标注，并在多数据集上评估标签效率与跨中心泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其信息增益驱动的「生成探针—检索样本」获取方式，可能与 LVR 中主动筛选视觉证据、按信息价值决定采集的策略形成概念类比，可供核查；但该方法作用于训练数据标注层面，而非推理期 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis

**abstract/A1：** Medical ultrasound (US) enables real-time, non-invasive diagnosis, yet building US-based AI systems is limited by data scarcity, costly expert annotation, and limited cross-center generalizability. Privacy constraints and instance-level reporting hinder the collection of diverse abnormal cases and frame-level labels, while repeated retraining for new centers increases computational cost. We introduce EvoDiff, a generative active learning framework that integrates diffusion modelling with information-theoretic objectives, evolutionary search, and curriculum-based sampling to select informative samples across heterogeneous US datasets. EvoDiff formulates sample selection as a generate-to-retrieve process, in which diffusion-based optimization in feature space guided by information gain produces synthetic probes, and only the real unlabeled samples retrieved by these probes are annotated and used for downstream training. Across six benchmarks covering fifteen datasets and 16,696 images, we evaluate EvoDiff on convolutional network and transformer-based foundation model. EvoDiff approaches fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels, outperforms active learning baselines, and improves foundation model generalization under cross-domain external validation on unseen cohorts. A reader study with six radiologists indicates the potential to support clinical annotation workflows, with a model-based estimated 24% to 84% reduction in annotation workload at matched downstream performance.

</details>

### 325. [Projected Neural Additive Models as Universal Approximators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10186v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10186

**作者：** Nhon N. Phan、Qiang Du、John D. Clayton、WaiChing Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10186v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10186v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文为带可学习线性投影的加性模型（PNAM）建立通用逼近理论，给出精确表示所需最少投影数与最优逼近率，并用结构化稀疏和事后符号回归恢复可解释性。

**相关性简评：** 其关于线性投影与加性结构如何引入交互项、以及投影数—逼近率的表达力刻画，可供核查并可能用于分析 latent 工作区中投影式表示与交互建模的容量边界，但与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Projected Neural Additive Models as Universal Approximators

**abstract/A1：** Neural additive models (NAMs) offer interpretability but lack expressivity due to their rigid additive structure, whereas multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) achieve universal approximation at the cost of transparency. We establish the first theoretical foundation for projected neural additive models (PNAMs), which augment NAMs with a learnable linear transformation $\\boldsymbol{T}$ to capture cross-variable interactions. While standard NAMs cannot approximate even the simplest interaction term $χ\_1 χ\_2$ because their cross-derivatives are identically zero, we prove that PNAMs are universal approximators and characterize the minimum number of projections required for exact polynomial representation. Furthermore, we derive an approximation rate of $\\mathcal{O}(M^{-s / (N - 1)})$ for $\\mathcal{C}^s$ functions (i.e., functions with $s$ continuous derivatives), where $M$ denotes the number of projections and $N$ the input dimension; this rate is known to be optimal for ridge function approximation. To recover interpretability from the projected inputs, we introduce structured sparsity regularizers and post-hoc symbolic regression techniques that enable global input ranking, parameter pruning, and the conversion of learned bases into compact analytical expressions. Experiments on knot theory invariants, MNIST, and phase field fracture mechanics demonstrate that PNAMs match or surpass similar architectures in accuracy while discovering salient features and yielding symbolic models with orders of magnitude fewer parameters.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 326. [BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10198v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10198

**作者：** Colin Doumont、Thomas Christie、Henry Moss、Philipp Hennig

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10198v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10198v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文质疑高维贝叶斯优化的评测实践，指出既有工作常漏掉强基线或误实现关键方法，据此提出可持续维护、含规范实现的 BO-Arena 基准包，并据其发现性能主要来自更简单的因素，进而给出无需复杂 GP 近似的新算法，同时追问复杂方法是否真的优于简单 GP 基线。

**相关性简评：** 该文属贝叶斯优化领域，但其采集函数驱动的序贯证据获取与停止决策，以及「复杂方法是否胜过简单基线、规范实现与严格基线」的评测质疑，或可启发 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 机制与 latent 方法评测严谨性的核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BO-Arena: An Evolving Benchmark for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimisation

**abstract/A1：** High-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (HDBO) is an increasingly crowded field with new methods proposed at every major conference, making it ever harder to answer a deceptively simple question: "Which method is currently state-of-the-art?" In this paper, we question the efficacy of benchmarking practices in the field, and find them to be systematically ineffective: multiple published works fail to benchmark against the strongest available baselines, or even include incorrect implementations of key methods. Without a shared reference implementation, such errors are difficult to detect during peer review. We therefore introduce BO-Arena, an actively maintained and extensible package providing canonical implementations of state-of-the-art algorithms, which allows researchers to develop new methods and benchmark them rigorously. Using BO-Arena, we find that what currently drives performance in HDBO is even simpler than previously thought. We use these insights to propose a new algorithm which is competitive with the state of the art on problems with many observations, without resorting to the complex GP approximations used in recent methods. Finally, we question whether there is currently sufficient evidence that any more complex method outperforms a simple Gaussian process baseline for HDBO.

</details>

### 327. [RAD-TFM: Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10230v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10230

**作者：** Matthew Peroni、Franck Le、Vadim Sheinin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10230v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10230v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RAD-TFM：将表格基础模型的合成数据生成器分布参数化，用「最优性差距」驱动对抗式自适应以强化对模型困难的数据集，并加入领域对齐约束使合成数据贴近真实分布，从而对 TabPFN V2、TabICL V2 做持续训练。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态推理无直接关联，但其按最优性差距对抗挑选困难合成分布的思路，可能为 LVR 训练中的难度加权、轨迹监督分配或数据生成先验设计提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAD-TFM: Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** The development of tabular foundation models (TFMs) has accelerated in recent years, outperforming traditional ML methods on many tabular benchmarks. A key finding is that TFMs can be pretrained entirely on synthetic datasets, opening opportunities to design data generators that encourage desirable model properties. Prior work has mainly focused on crafting high-quality priors over generators to improve overall pretraining performance. Our key insight is that parameterizing the generator distribution enables an adversarial, distributional robustness perspective: during training, we can adapt the generator to emphasize datasets that are particularly challenging for the model, which we formalize by introducing an optimality gap measure. Further, we develop a method to align the synthetic data generation with real-world datasets from a given domain, constraining the adversary to generate realistic data. Together, these algorithms comprise the Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models (RAD-TFM) pipeline, a model-agnostic adversarial training framework. Applied to the TabPFN V2 classifier, RAD-TFM improves performance across 6 diverse tabular benchmarks, with up to a 10.8 percentage-point improvement in mean normalized AUC over the strongest baseline, using fewer than 100k additional synthetic training datasets, less than 0.1% of the original pretraining data. Applying the same pipeline to TabICL V2 also improves performance across three major benchmarks, demonstrating the generality of the framework. These results highlight a promising new direction for targeted adversarial continued training of TFMs using synthetic data alone.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (main track)

</details>

### 328. [ProofDiff: Auditable Argument-Level Comparison of AI-Generated Mathematical Proofs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10233v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10233

**作者：** Matan Tsafrir、Esdras Medeiros、Jorge Poco、Kevin Gomez、Eduardo V. Teixeira、Claudio Silva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10233v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10233v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ProofDiff 系统：为两篇非形式数学文档各自独立构建以原文为依据的论证图，记录论断、推理步骤及类型化依赖关系，再提出两图之间的对应，并提供可修订、保留审计历史的人工审阅层，用于判断两稿是否走同一条数学路线。

**相关性简评：** 其「步骤级论证结构与对应关系」的显式比较方式，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的结构化比对、推理步骤被保留或替换的判定提供外部评价框架，但该工作面向数学证明审阅而非 VLM 内部状态，可供核查其对应构建是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProofDiff: Auditable Argument-Level Comparison of AI-Generated Mathematical Proofs

**abstract/A1：** Mathematical understanding depends on the route from hypotheses to conclusion: how the parts of a proof function and which dependencies carry the argument forward. This structure can persist when wording or notation changes, while a small alteration to a hypothesis or inference can produce a different argument beneath similar prose. Formal verification can establish that a rewrite proves the same theorem, but not whether it follows the same mathematical route. Comparing informal proofs, especially those produced or revised by generative models, therefore requires reconstructing which claims, dependencies, and reasoning steps are preserved, reorganized, or replaced. We present ProofDiff, a system for comparing informal mathematical documents. It is designed to support human review, not to certify mathematical correctness. Given two documents, ProofDiff independently constructs a source-grounded argument map for each and proposes correspondences between the resulting maps. Each map captures the document's claims and reasoning steps and records the typed relations that connect them. An integrated human-review layer allows reviewers to revise the maps and correspondences while preserving an auditable history. Comparing the two argument maps provides a basis for inspecting whether the documents follow the same mathematical route and where their claims or dependencies differ. We demonstrate ProofDiff on four illustrative pairs of AI-generated proofs, ranging from a detailed proof and its concise revision to proofs using different mathematical strategies.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 7 figures. An earlier version of this work was accepted by the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding. Code and artifacts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23930759

</details>

**title/T1：** Can Time Series Foundation Models Serve as Surrogates for Power Systems Dynamic Simulation?

**abstract/A1：** High-fidelity dynamic simulation is essential for scientific and engineering applications, but its computational cost limits large-scale scenario screening. We investigate the use of pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as computationally efficient surrogates to address this limitation. In-context learning and post-training strategies, including retrieval-augmented reference sample selection and physics-informed regularization, are considered in the investigation. Results are benchmarked against a traditional AI model representative of the state-of-the-art in the domain. Experiments using an open-source TSFM and data from a simulated 9-bus power system indicate promising results. Retrieval augmentation improves in-context learning performance, and fine-tuning leads to superior results compared to the traditional AI model, especially when including physics-informed regularization. The fine-tuned TSFMs achieve lower errors and improved computational costs compared to the traditional AI model, and a 563$\\times$ speedup compared to the original physics-based simulation.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在统一的预处理、数据划分和训练配置下，对 ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0 与 ViT-B/16 的深度伪造视频检测进行可复现对比，发现 CNN 帧级表现有竞争力但视频级聚合后下降，ViT 的视频级更稳定，并报告跨数据集泛化存在明显不对称落差。

**相关性简评：** 「帧级→视频级聚合」这一评价粒度切换会改变架构优劣排序并暴露跨域泛化落差，可供核查 LVR 中逐步视觉证据聚合方式与推理收益归因的评价是否同样敏感；但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Frame-Level Accuracy: Analyzing Video-Level Stability in Transformer-Based Deepfake Forensics

**abstract/A1：** Deepfake videos generated by advanced generative models pose serious threats to digital security, misinformation control, and media forensics. Although numerous detection methods have been proposed, their reported performances are often based on heterogeneous preprocessing pipelines, inconsistent data splits, and model-specific training protocols, hindering fair architectural comparison. This work presents a controlled and reproducible comparative study of convolutional neural networks (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0) and a transformer-based architecture (ViT-B/16) within a unified, face-centric deepfake detection framework. All models are trained using identical preprocessing, augmentation, optimization settings, and data splits on Celeb-DF v2 and FaceForensics++, and results are validated across three independent random seeds with bootstrapped confidence intervals. Experimental results show that while CNN-based models perform competitively at the frame level, their performance degrades after video-level aggregation. In contrast, ViT-B/16 demonstrates more stable video-level performance, achieving 92.8\\% \[95\\% CI: 91.7--94.0\] video-level accuracy and an AUC of 0.950 \[95\\% CI: 0.934--0.964\] on Celeb-DF v2 (3-seed bootstrapped). Cross-dataset evaluation across the same three random seeds reveals a large, asymmetric generalization gap (AUC 0.79 FF++$\\rightarrow$Celeb-DF vs. 0.64 Celeb-DF$\\rightarrow$FF++), indicating that in-domain video-level stability does not transfer to unseen manipulation domains. These findings indicate that global self-attention improves robustness and video-level stability for deepfake detection within a given data domain, while highlighting the need for further work on cross-domain generalization.

**comment/C1：** Paper submitted to international journal of intelligent systems, Wiley publishers, accepted version of open-access paper

</details>

### 331. [STAIRS: Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling for Unrolled MRI Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10260v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10260

**作者：** Xiangjian Hou、Chang Ni、Chao Qin、Zhiwei Tan、Xin Wang、Xinrui Ye、Rong-Rong Chen、Chun Yuan、Xiaodong Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10260v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10260v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 STAIRS，用于展开式 MRI 重建：把各阶段中间重建投影到逐步扩张至全谱的嵌套 Fourier 支撑上，并让每次更新以支撑转移为条件，从而在不改采样掩码与数据一致性的前提下实现由粗到细重建。

**相关性简评：** 其「分层扩张信息准入＋按阶段条件化的迭代状态更新」调度，可能为 LVR 中逐步引入视觉证据、分配各轮 latent 更新预算以及阶段／长度泛化提供类比线索，但属远领域迁移，是否可对应需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** STAIRS: Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling for Unrolled MRI Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) forms images from incomplete Fourier measurements, shifting acquisition burden to computational reconstruction. Deep unrolled networks interleave learned regularization and data consistency, yet typically estimate the full unmeasured spectrum at every cascade. We propose STAIRS (Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling), which projects intermediate reconstructions onto nested Fourier supports that expand to the full spectrum and conditions each update on its support transition. Conditional increments of a regularized log-determinant score of training covariance define a normalized spectral coordinate, accounting for dependencies between newly and previously admitted frequencies. Dyadic targets allocate larger coordinate increments to earlier cascades and are mapped to fixed supports before training, enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction with unchanged sampling masks and data consistency. On fastMRI and Stanford2D, STAIRS improves matched Transformer (HUMUSNet) and convolutional (NAFNet) backbones in single- and multi-coil reconstruction, including radiologist-annotated pathology regions. It also outperforms predictor-based progression with lower parameter overhead and inference latency. Stage-wise analysis shows repeated error correction by projection and lower intermediate reconstruction errors than the backbones alone throughout support expansion. Ablations favor dyadic allocation over uniform expansion for square and line-band supports and over manual front-loading for square windows. Support projection alone improves reconstruction, and transition conditioning strengthens the gain. Cross-dataset evaluation shows improvements for both backbones in both directions. Support allocation thus complements regularizer design in unrolled MRI reconstruction.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 LLM 道德能力的最小必要条件：从情境权衡题的首 token 分布提取成对选择概率，用三种随机传递选择模型检验其序数排序是否满足传递性，发现多数选择集只支持弱或不稳定的排序，且跨响应聚合出的传递结构不对应任何单个选择集。

**相关性简评：** 从首 token 概率重建选择并做传递性/一致性检验、以及指出聚合会掩盖单个实例的结构，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否支持一致的序数比较，以及推理评价中跨样本聚合的风险。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do large language models rank moral values? A transitivity test of moral competence

**abstract/A1：** LLMs are increasingly used to support decisions that require moral consideration. While LLMs perform well on morality benchmarks from psychology and philosophy, producing appropriate outputs on these benchmarks (moral performance) does not establish that an LLM weighs competing moral values at stake in a decision (moral competence). We test a minimal, necessary condition for such weighing: that an ordinal ranking can represent LLM moral choices. Such a ranking requires transitivity. To assess transitivity, we presented LLMs with pairwise trade-offs among moral value violations in vignette choice sets and extracted resulting choice probabilities from first-token distributions. Tested against three stochastic transitive choice models, most choice sets admitted weak or unstable orderings. Aggregating an LLM's responses, a common practice in LLM moral evaluation, produced transitive structure that matched no individual choice set. Evaluations of AI morality should establish that choices are structured before asking whether they are aligned.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 333. [Match the Geometry Before the Surrogate: Extreme Low-Budget Optimization in High Dimensions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10267v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10267

**作者：** Michal Průšek、Adam Novozámský、Filip Šroubek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10267v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10267v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在仅 30 次评估的极低预算下重审 SELFIES VAE 潜空间中的分子优化：发现参考集分子的编码均值集中于窄球壳，遂将候选生成限制在该球壳上，并提出无代理模型的测地线局部搜索 GeoWalk 与随机子空间协方差学习的 GeoCMA，另用析因实验交叉候选支撑与采集最大化方式。

**相关性简评：** 其「先对齐潜空间几何、再讨论代理模型收益」的结论可能提示：LVR 中 latent 推理状态的支撑分布（是否集中于低维流形或球壳）与候选生成方式，可能先于状态生成机制设计而影响结果，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Match the Geometry Before the Surrogate: Extreme Low-Budget Optimization in High Dimensions

**abstract/A1：** Low-budget molecular optimization is often framed as Bayesian optimization in a learned latent space, but standard benchmarks typically allow hundreds or thousands of evaluations, whereas a realistic wet-lab round may allow only a few dozen. We revisit this regime using a SELFIES molecular variational autoencoder (VAE) with a Gaussian prior and GuacaMol objectives at N = 30 evaluations. The main finding is not a new surrogate model, but an interaction in candidate generation. The encoder means of a reference set of molecules concentrate near a narrow spherical shell, while many high-dimensional optimizers propose candidates from boxes or box-shaped trust regions. We study a simple constraint, the on-sphere scaffold, that restricts candidate generation to this shell. We then introduce two minimal optimizers to probe what remains useful once the support is fixed. GeoWalk performs geodesic local search on the shell without a surrogate. After 30 evaluations, it shows no detected difference from a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate on the shell, which is ahead earlier in the budget. GeoCMA adds covariance learning in a random subspace. It does not improve on GeoWalk in the molecular benchmark. On LassoBench it has a lower mean loss than GeoWalk, but full-dimensional CMA-ES remains stronger on most tasks. A factorial experiment with a single GP crosses the candidate support (shell or box) with the acquisition maximizer (a finite candidate set or a continuous optimizer). In this benchmark, shell candidates outperformed box candidates when acquisition was maximized over a candidate set, but not with continuous maximization by L-BFGS-B. These results come from a controlled study of one Gaussian-prior VAE benchmark and do not recommend VAEs for molecular optimization. The practical lesson is to control the candidate support and the acquisition maximizer before attributing a gain to the surrogate.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 (camera-ready). 10 pages of main text plus appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist, 38 pages in total. Code and result files: https://github.com/michalprusek/geometry-before-surrogates-neurips2026 . Project page: https://staff.utia.cas.cz/novozada/geo

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10307

**作者：** Abhishek Anand

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10307v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10307v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文审计「部分提示补全」这一基准污染检测方法，在七个开源模型和 MATH-500、AIME 2025/2026 上发现检测标记强烈依赖剩余文本长度，存在真阴性误报，且会漏掉蒸馏带来的上游污染，并给出分层报告与跨家族校准等建议。

**相关性简评：** 其污染诊断设计可能为 LVR 的贡献分配提供参照：当 latent 推理带来提升时，可借用分层前缀与后截止对照来核查收益是否来自基准记忆而非真实推理，具体适用性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests

**abstract/A1：** Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L &gt;= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. Calibrating each model against models from other families removes most flags while isolating a consistent Qwen2.5-specific signal at every prefix length. We recommend length-stratified reporting, prefixes of at most 60%, style-matched post-cutoff controls, and cross-family calibration.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 335. [Multi-objective drift-aware MLOps agent for model retraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10313v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10313

**作者：** Kumuda Valli、Anli Ji

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10313v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10313v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DARE，一个事件驱动、可确定性重放的离线重训练框架，把重训练建模为序贯决策问题，并用 LinUCB 策略在漂移监控与延迟反馈条件下权衡 F1 收益与干预开销。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时干预」的成本—收益序贯决策与延迟反馈下的策略评估，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策与计算成本核算提供问题表述与评价参考，但领域较远，需核查其策略形式能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-objective drift-aware MLOps agent for model retraining

**abstract/A1：** Deployed ML models face non-stationary data and delayed labels, yet most retraining strategies rely on fixed schedules or brittle drift thresholds that ignore operational cost. In this setting, retraining is a sequential decision problem rather than a one-time threshold choice. We present DARE (Drift-Aware Retraining Engine), an offline, event-driven retraining framework that separates ingestion, monitoring, policy decisions, training, and logging through explicit schemas and deterministic replay. We compare DARE against practical heuristic retraining baselines, including fixed-interval, threshold-persistence, and action-rate-matched fixed scheduling policies. On Airline, the locked LinUCB policy achieves a higher mean F1 while substantially reducing intervention frequency relative to heuristic and action-rate-matched baselines. Additional runtime-calibrated evaluation shows that these gains persist when measured using the cumulative update wall-clock time. These results suggest that conservative sequential retraining policies can improve performance while reducing unnecessary operational overhead under delayed feedback.

</details>

### 336. [AI-Driven Repair of Missing Automotive Components](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10318v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10318

**作者：** Kazim Abbas、Zheng Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10318v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10318v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建一条从多视角彩色、深度与轮廓图像出发的三维几何修复流水线：用深度差异定位缺失区域，通过多视角体素重建估计缺失部分，并测试 DINOv2 预训练视觉特征能否验证候选缺失并改善重建。作者在 20 个汽车 CAD 模型共 160 次试验中评估，其中 109 次达到阈值，DINOv2 未提升精度且更慢。

**相关性简评：** 其以深度差异定位「缺失」信息、融合多视角证据并对候选做验证的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和验证成本问题存在概念类比；论文本身属三维几何修复应用，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AI-Driven Repair of Missing Automotive Components

**abstract/A1：** Due to supply constraints, replacing damaged automotive components can be expensive and time-consuming, while replacing the entire component can be wasteful when much of it remains usable. This paper presents a pipeline to investigate whether missing geometry can be reconstructed as a repair patch using paired observations of the intact models and synthetically damaged components. Noise-free color, depth, and silhouette images were produced using the camera viewpoints. Depth differences were then used to identify the potential missing regions, while multi-view voxel reconstruction was used to estimate the missing portion. A pretrained DINOv2 model was also added to validate missing candidates and determine whether pretrained visual features could improve reconstruction. We tested the pipeline on 20 automotive CAD models, each with a synthetically removed portion. Each model was tested under four different conditions using two reconstruction methods for a total of 160 trials. The predictions were compared with the missing geometry of the unchanged ground-truth using predefined thresholds of the voxel intersection-over-union over 0.85 and the absolute relative volume error less than 15%. Of the 160 experimental trials, 109 of them satisfied both thresholds. Geometry-only reconstruction passed 16 of 20 components with eight views but only 10 of 20 with four adjacent views. Further analysis showed that 24 out of the 37 failed reconstructions could be categorized as unsuccessful because extra material was incorrectly added to areas that should have been empty. The implementation of DINOv2 into the pipeline did not improve the overall reconstruction accuracy and made prediction generation slower. For 13 verified tests, printing only the repaired sections instead of the entire parts reduced filament use by 93.08% and printing time by 89.39% based on the median results.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 337. [Reproducible LoRA Inference Through Deterministic Split-K Reduction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10334v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10334

**作者：** Dhayaneshwar Balusamy、Ankur Mohan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.DC、cs.PF

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10334v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10334v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文考察 vLLM 中 LoRA 乘法的 Split-K 核在浮点原子加法下引入的数值非确定性，并实现确定性 Triton Split-K，验证其对数学推理、代码生成与毒性判定结果的影响，同时保留并行加速。

**相关性简评：** 其展示的「同输入重复推理即产生不同 KV cache 与 token 决策」可供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度、缓存差异与答案变化测量是否被内核非确定性污染，提示需用确定性归约保证对比可复现；与视觉推理本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reproducible LoRA Inference Through Deterministic Split-K Reduction

**abstract/A1：** Reproducibility is important for LoRA-adapted language models used in repeated evaluation, auditing, and decision-making. However, Split-K kernels used to introduce parallelism in low-rank LoRA multiplications can have the unintended consequence of numerical nondeterminism when partial results are combined using floating-point atomic additions. We investigate this non-determinism in vLLM across GSM8K mathematical reasoning, MBPP code generation, and Jev-style structured toxicity decisions on Civil Comments and introduce a deterministic Triton Split-K implementation. Under identical-input replay, Atomic Split-K=8 produces different FP32 shrink outputs in 97.61% of comparisons, while our Deterministic Split-K=8 shows no observed variation. Repeated atomic inference changes generated outputs in 17.30% of GSM8K and 14.96% of MBPP comparisons, sometimes altering task correctness. Structured-decision probabilities vary in 81.47% of atomic comparisons, with decision flips. Controlled tracing demonstrates how shrink-output differences propagate into the KV cache and how accumulated cache differences can change token decisions and final answers. Our deterministic Triton Split-K=8 implementation preserves parallelism, achieving 16.8-21.1% latency-based speedup over unsplit reduction with only 1.02-2.62% additional latency relative to Atomic Split-K=8.

</details>

**title/T1：** On the universal structure in deterministic generative diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion-based generative modeling has emerged as a general computational framework for simulating high-dimensional, structured data across various domains. Understanding its generative mechanisms is paramount for advancing model training and inference in a principled way. Here, we demonstrate that deterministic sampling trajectories share a universal geometric structure invariant to data modalities and diffusion model implementations. This structure can be largely explained by an exactly solvable model based on the optimal linear denoiser.

### 339. [PoseBench: Probing Pose Awareness in Visual Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10347v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10347

**作者：** Most Nilufa Yeasmin、Draix Wyatt、Ruyi Lian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10347v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10347v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PoseBench，用受控渲染视角、真实图像查询与姿态图精化探针，系统检验 31 个 2D 预训练视觉基础模型的特征空间是否与物体姿态流形对齐，即是否具备「姿态感知」结构。

**相关性简评：** 其「特征相似度是否反映底层几何流形」的探针设计与 LVR 中 latent 是否保留视觉细节、几何与任务必要信息的评价问题相通，可能为刻画 latent 表示几何提供可核查的评价思路；但该工作针对 3D 姿态而非推理期状态生成，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PoseBench: Probing Pose Awareness in Visual Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Pose awareness characterizes the extent to which a learned feature space aligns with the underlying object-pose manifold, such that observations with similar poses exhibit greater feature similarity than those with increasingly different poses. While such structure is desirable for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks, visual foundation models pre-trained on individual 2D images typically lack explicit 3D or pose supervision. This raises a fundamental question: Do 2D visual foundation models exhibit pose awareness after large-scale pretraining? To answer this question, we introduce PoseBench, a systematic benchmark to probe pose awareness in pretrained visual features. Our evaluation follows a progressive design: held-out rendered views probe intrinsic pose-aware structure under controlled conditions, while real-image queries evaluate how robustly this structure remains accessible under real-world variations. We further introduce pose-graph-based refinement as a complementary probe of compatibility between feature neighborhoods and the underlying pose manifold. Across 31 publicly available checkpoints from 10 pretraining families, PoseBench reveals that pose awareness is an implicit but non-uniform property of 2D visual foundation models, and consistent gains from pose-graph refinement suggest that feature spaces retain structure compatible with the underlying pose manifold. PoseBench therefore provides a systematic basis for understanding and selecting pretrained features for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10364

**作者：** Tommaso Castellani、Jiaqi Li、Muriah D. Wheelock、Rezwana Rosen Razzaque、Helmut Laufs、Hong Chen、Claire Donnat

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10364v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10364v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将脑连接组预测表述为 errors-in-variables 问题，在线性渐近设定下把图卷积效果分解为平滑带来的偏差与方差、图估计误差以及 double-dipping，并用模拟和真实数据界定消息传递可能有效的狭窄区域。

**相关性简评：** 其「真实连接组 latent、观测协方差含噪」以及同一噪声矩阵既构图又作特征的 double-dipping 分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态估计、视觉证据筛选和表示复用偏差提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bias, Measurement Error, and Double-Dipping: When Can GNN Convolutions Help Brain Connectome Prediction?

**abstract/A1：** Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are an important tool for fMRI prediction, where empirical functional connectivity matrices serve both as features and for graph construction. However, recent studies and our own experiments show that these methods often fail to outperform simpler graph-agnostic baselines. We propose a statistical explanation for this failure by formulating connectome prediction as an errors-in-variables (EIV) problem: the true connectome is latent, while the observed covariance matrix is a noisy finite-time-series estimate. In a linear asymptotic setting, we decompose the effect of graph convolution into three mechanisms: smoothing-induced bias and variance reduction, graph estimation error, and a double-dipping effect arising when the same noisy matrix determines both graph and features. Under a latent community model adapted to neuroscience, we identify a narrow favorable regime, set by the brain community structure, the predictive signal, the graph construction and the recording length, in which message passing can improve prediction. Simulations validate this decomposition, while real-data experiments illustrate that connectome GNN pipelines often fall outside this regime. Our results provide a first step towards explaining when graph convolutions can help brain connectome prediction, and why they often do not.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/tommicaste/B-ME-DD

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CHARM: Certified Homology-Aware Reverse-scale Mapping via Diffusion-Guided Quotient Towers

**abstract/A1：** Widely used dimensionality reduction methods prioritize neighborhood or distance 1 preservation, yet planar coordinates alone cannot certify the homological type or 2 sample-level support of higher-order structures. Obtaining this evidence directly 3 is costly because simplicial complexes grow rapidly with dimension. We propose 4 Certified Homology-Aware Reverse-scale Mapping (CHARM), which combines 5 two-dimensional coordinates with certified homology records and sample-level 6 localization. Diffusion coordinates guide cover proposals; safe contractions and a 7 Cover Quotient Tower reduce the domain of structural computation; exact algebra 8 certifies and tracks homology representatives; and reverse-scale layout places their 9 supports in shared coordinates. Safe contraction preserves the homotopy type of 10 the input flag complex. The quotient tower is multiplicatively 3-interleaved with 11 the coarse-graph hop-distance Rips filtration. Verifiable distance-distortion bounds 12 give an additive guarantee between the original Euclidean and coarse-graph Rips 13 filtrations, and composite multiplicative guarantees for the tower on positive scales. 14 Across 22 datasets and 41,637 samples under a fixed configuration, CHARM 15 ranks among the top two on all 15 sample-weighted metrics for nonsynthetic data, 16 including the smallest values on all four Euclidean persistence-diagram distances. 17 It also provides 957 traceable support records across the full benchmark. On a 18 spherical shell, one certified H2 record identifies 1,578 original samples in the 19 two-dimensional view. CHARM thus combines geometric exploration with explicit 20 evidence of homological type and location.

</details>

### 342. [RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10379v1>)

**作者：** Yiren Lu、Disheng Liu、Sreya Srinidhi、Yunlai Zhou、Yiran Qiao、Chaoda Song、Tuo Liang、Jing Ma、Huan Wang、Yu Yin

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 RefineSplat：先在 2D 中跟踪物体，再用每个物体专属的一组 3D Gaussians 重建，保持显式物体-Gaussian 对应以支持开放词汇分割与检索；并用渲染掩码与多视角一致性反馈修正跟踪，同时为每个物体分配多个视角聚类的语言嵌入，另发布含精确网格的 Blender-OVS 合成基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「跟踪—重建闭环反馈」与按视角聚类多重语义嵌入的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的自洽性校验、状态迭代更新及视角/位置相关的 latent 相似度提供类比线索，但属 3D 场景重建领域，与 VLM 推理状态的直接联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

</details>

### 343. [A Topological Encoder Decoder Framework for Temporal Graph Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10385v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10385

**作者：** Ronan Buck、Kiarash Shamsi、Tran Gia Bao Ngo、Astrit Tola、Baris Coskunuzer、Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10385v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10385v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文将时序图预测重构为逆拓扑问题：先预测未来图的多尺度拓扑描述子，再在归纳约束下重建可实现的未来快照，并在 14 个数据集上评估节点、边与图属性预测。

**相关性简评：** 「先预测紧凑描述子、再解码成具体结构」的两阶段瓶颈，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态需承载任务必要结构、以及能否由 latent 回推视觉证据的问题形成类比，可供核查，但领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Topological Encoder Decoder Framework for Temporal Graph Learning

**abstract/A1：** Most temporal graph learning methods reduce future prediction to discriminative inference over past interactions, focusing on edges or node labels for a largely persistent set of nodes. This view breaks down when new nodes and edges appear, since the future graph becomes a new object with changing size, composition, and structure. We address this gap by framing temporal graph prediction as an inverse topology problem. Instead of predicting edges directly, we first predict a multiscale topological descriptor of the future graph and then reconstruct a plausible future snapshot that realizes this descriptor under inductive constraints. This approach makes global structure and node churn explicit prediction targets and produces forecasted graphs that downstream tasks can evaluate without retraining. Across 14 temporal graph datasets, we evaluate our method, TOPOGED, on node, link, and graph property prediction and compare it against state-of-the-art temporal graph models. TOPOGED significantly improves node-level forecasting accuracy over the strongest baseline, with a macro average of 0.49 versus 0.05. It also outperforms baselines in 60% of graph-structure metric evaluations and substantially increases macro-average edge prediction metrics, from near-zero to 0.12. Our results show that topology-guided graph forecasting can predict inductive future snapshots whose structure supports multiple downstream evaluations.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Sequence Pruning（SP），直接利用模型前向传播得到的逐序列预训练准确率动态剔除已变得易预测的基因组序列，在两种语料、三种模型家族和 MLM/CLM 目标共五种预训练设置及五个基因组下游基准上评估，最多减少 96% 数据量而下游性能基本保持，并优于 InfoBatch、BPAS。

**相关性简评：** 属较远领域的预训练数据效率工作，其「按样本当前学习价值动态筛选、无需额外评分模型」的思路可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中的数据取舍与算力分配提供参照，但与视觉证据、latent 状态生成无直接关联，需核查其判据是否适用于推理轨迹类数据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pruning DNA Sequence

**abstract/A1：** Data pruning can substantially reduce training cost by removing examples that contribute little additional learning signal, but it has not been studied for DNA language-model pretraining. We introduce Sequence Pruning (SP), a dynamic pruning framework that removes genomic sequences as they become easy for the model to predict. SP uses per-sequence pretraining accuracy computed directly from the model's forward pass, requiring no separate scoring model or additional pass over the corpus. We evaluate SP across five pretraining settings spanning two corpora, three model families, and both MLM and CLM objectives, with downstream evaluation on five genomic benchmarks. SP reduces pretraining data processing by up to 96% while largely preserving downstream performance. At moderate savings, pruning improves performance by up to 1.2 MCC points over full-data pretraining; at the highest savings, pretraining uses only 4% of the baseline GPU hours with little performance loss. SP also outperforms the dynamic pruning methods InfoBatch and BPAS across most comparisons. Beyond accuracy, our framework supports alternative criteria such as perplexity and EL2N, although accuracy yields the strongest downstream performance at matched savings. These results show that genomic pretraining does not require repeatedly processing all available sequences and that dynamic sequence-level pruning can substantially improve its data and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/FaiasPromit/pruning-dna-sequence.

### 345. [Finite Time Analysis of Risk-Sensitive RL via Noisy Power Iteration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10393v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10393

**作者：** Waqar Mirza、Yashaswini Murthy、Laixi Shi、Eric Mazumdar、Adam Wierman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10393v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10393v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在 Hilbert 投影度量下分析带噪归一化幂迭代的有限时间收敛性，并将其用于指数效用下的风险敏感平均代价 RL，给出风险敏感 TD/Q-learning 及 KL 鲁棒控制的样本复杂度界。

**相关性简评：** 其乘性几何下的主特征向量迭代与有限时间保证，可能为 LVR 中隐状态的迭代更新与收敛刻画提供工具视角，风险敏感与 KL 鲁棒对偶也可能启发证据不确定时的谨慎停止决策，但联系较远，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Finite Time Analysis of Risk-Sensitive RL via Noisy Power Iteration

**abstract/A1：** Estimating the principal eigenpair of a positive operator from stochastic evaluations gives rise to a noisy form of normalized power iteration: each step applies a sampled operator estimate and then renormalizes. We establish finite-time stochastic-approximation guarantees for this procedure, working in Hilbert's projective metric, which is well-suited to the multiplicative geometry of Perron--Frobenius eigenproblems. Our main application is risk-sensitive average-cost reinforcement learning (RL) with exponential utility. In this setting the Bellman equations are multiplicative, and value functions are characterized by nonlinear eigenvalue problems rather than additive fixed points. We cast both policy evaluation and control in this framework, obtaining risk-sensitive TD- and Q-learning algorithms that learn from a single Markovian trajectory. Under explicit positivity, mixing, and linear function approximation assumptions, we prove finite-time bounds on the recovered eigenvector and eigenvalue with $\\tilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity up to problem-dependent constants. The results cover both tabular and linear function approximation regimes, and through the duality between exponential utility and KL-robust control yield finite-time guarantees for KL-robust average-cost RL as well.

</details>

### 346. [Regularization Amplifies Subliminal Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10397v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10397

**作者：** Lawrence Feng、Jacob Mitchell Springer、Gaurav R. Ghosal、Ziqian Zhong、Aditi Raghunathan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10397v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10397v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文系统检验正则化能否抑制 subliminal learning 等隐蔽影响，结果发现相反：全参数微调下几乎不出现隐藏偏置迁移，而 LoRA 或显式惩罚等限制适应的手段反而放大迁移，增加数据量也有类似效果。

**相关性简评：** 其关于低秩约束、简单性偏置如何让与任务语义无关的信息沿训练信号传播的观察，可能为核查 LVR 训练中的监督归因与信息坍缩提供线索，但该工作属纯行为与训练层面研究，未涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Regularization Amplifies Subliminal Learning

**abstract/A1：** Recent work has shown that hidden biases can be transferred through data with no apparent semantic relationship to those biases. Can regularization limit this covert influence? By constraining adaptation, regularization might be expected to suppress behavioral changes on seemingly unrelated inputs. We systematically study this hypothesis in subliminal learning, as well as in related settings of covert influence, including phantom transfer and logit-linear selection. We find the opposite: regularization amplifies the transfer of hidden biases. In particular, subliminal learning is typically absent under full fine-tuning, but low-rank adaptation or explicit penalties can induce strong transfer. Phantom transfer and logit-linear selection show similar trends. Adding more data, an implicit form of regularization, also strengthens covert influence. Together, these findings suggest that the simplicity biases induced by regularization may facilitate covert influence. We further hypothesize that the level of regularization that maximizes covert transfer depends on task complexity.

</details>

### 347. [Beyond Query Similarity: Safety-Conditioned Cache Routing for LLM Response Reuse](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10418v1>)

**作者：** Shilong Pan、Zhiliang Tian、Weiguo Chen、Zihan Chen、DongSheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10418v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10418v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SafeCache 框架，将语义缓存中的响应复用重构为「安全条件路由」问题：把候选检索与安全批准分离，逐条件匹配缓存响应的安全前提并聚合为风险分数，用独立的矛盾守卫避免显式冲突被高相似度稀释，再在不安全复用目标与验证器调用预算下校准策略，选择直接复用、选择性验证或重新生成。

**相关性简评：** 其以「条件匹配」而非查询相似度作复用判据，并在预算约束下路由到复用、验证或重生成，可能为 latent 推理状态或缓存状态何时可安全复用、何时需重算或补充证据的停止与验证策略提供概念借鉴；但对象是文本响应缓存而非内部推理状态，联系需自行核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Query Similarity: Safety-Conditioned Cache Routing for LLM Response Reuse

**abstract/A1：** Semantic response caching reuses a cached response for a semantically similar query to improve LLM inference efficiency. However, query similarity alone can lead to unsafe reuse when safety conditions change. Existing approaches improve cache safety through stricter similarity checks, context-aware validation, or response verification, yet they may still miss safety conflicts between the cached response and the new request or introduce unnecessary verification overhead. We argue that safe and efficient semantic caching requires a reuse policy that makes the cached response's safety conditions explicit and uses them to guide the reuse decision with a balance between safety and utility. In this paper, we propose SafeCache, a safety-aware framework that separates candidate retrieval from safety approval and formulates semantic response reuse as a safety-conditioned routing problem. SafeCache matches each cached-response condition against the new request and aggregates the per-condition mismatches into an overall risk score. A separate contradiction guard prevents explicit conflicts from being diluted by strong matches. It further estimates matching uncertainty and calibrates the routing policy under a required unsafe-reuse target and a verifier-call budget to choose among direct reuse, selective verification, or regeneration. Experiments show that SafeCache achieves the better safety-utility trade-off among the evaluated baselines, enabling safer response reuse at comparable cache utility.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向高保真数据稀缺的材料响应建模，提出双保真 Langevin 采样超网络，通过共享隐表示与后验采样构建概率化代理模型，并用漂移建模、分阶段训练和自适应初始化提升收敛与不确定性刻画。

**相关性简评：** 其「以采样后验代替单一确定性拟合」及跨保真度共享 latent 的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的概率化表征与多源视觉证据融合提供概念参考，但领域距离远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Applied bifidelity material response model construction and uncertainty quantification with a sampling hypernetwork

**abstract/A1：** Multifidelity modeling offers a practical route to accurate prediction and uncertainty quantification when high-fidelity data are scarce but lower-fidelity data are comparatively abundant. This work develops a bifidelity Langevin sampling hypernetwork framework that constructs probabilistic neu- ral response models by learning a posterior distribution over model parameters rather than a single deterministic fit. The method combines a flexible shared-latent data representation for low- and high-fidelity responses, enabling parameter sharing and transfer learning between the fidelities. We introduce several methodological enhancements to improve the robustness and efficiency of this ap- proach, including stability-promoting drift models, staged and conditional training strategies, adap- tive initialization of Langevin trajectories, and training procedures designed to better exploit corre- lations between fidelity levels. These additions improve convergence behavior, reduce the sampling effort required to obtain representative posterior ensembles, and provide more reliable predictive uncertainty in data-limited regimes. The resulting framework makes more effective use of available multifidelity data while preserving interpretability through the learned posterior structure, yielding improved predictive performance, better uncertainty characterization, and a more stable workflow for constructing uncertainty-aware surrogate models. The method is demonstrated on experimental, high-fidelity simulation and illustrative synthetic data.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HexIt: Learning Hexahedral Block Decomposition with Expert Iteration on Combinatorial Maps

**abstract/A1：** Decomposing a polyhedral solid into a few well-shaped hexahedral blocks is a long-standing open problem in mesh generation. We cast it as a sequential decision problem on a 3-dimensional generalised map: an agent splits edges, faces and volumes with three insert operations until every cell is a hexahedron and the mesh passes a quality threshold, and a policy that convolves over the map's involutions chooses each insert. A successful decomposition takes over a hundred decisions, and a uniformly random policy never finds one. We clone a policy from constructed decompositions and improve it by expert iteration. On held-out chamfered solids that share no boundary topology with the cloning data, the final policy solves an expected $94.4\\%$ in $20$ samples, and expert iteration raises the best-of-20 solve rate on large chamfered solids from $0.203$ to $0.355$. At matched compute, PPO, GRPO and VinePPO updates all make the cloned policy worse.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Split and Bridge（SnB）自底向上多模态生成框架：在采样阶段耦合多个预训练单模态扩散模型，先共享扩散轨迹至某分裂点，再经 bridge 模块分支为各模态轨迹，无需联合训练即可复用已有模型。

**相关性简评：** 其共享轨迹与分裂点后分模态更新的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据与推理状态如何共享、何时分支提供结构类比，但当前属图像生成任务，需核查分裂点机制是否有状态更新或证据筛选的可借鉴之处。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Split and Bridge: Multimodal Generation via Diffusion Bridging

**abstract/A1：** Visual data are often expressed through multiple complementary modalities (e.g., images and segmentation masks), each capturing different aspects of the same underlying structure. Most existing multimodal methods adopt a top-down paradigm, learning a shared latent variable through joint training from scratch, which limits scalability. We propose Split and Bridge (SnB), a bottom-up framework for multimodal generation that couples pretrained unimodal diffusion models at sampling time. Rather than learning a unified latent space, SnB generates coherent multimodal samples by following a shared diffusion trajectory up to a split point and then branching into modality-specific trajectories guided by a bridge module. This design enables plug-and-play reuse of powerful pretrained models without joint training, making it scalable and easily adaptable. Across standard benchmarks (PolyMNIST, CelebAMask-HQ) and more complex settings (PIE-Bench++, ROCO), SnB achieves a strong balance between sample quality and coherence. We show that SnB naturally extends to downstream zero-shot tasks such as interleaved co-generation, image editing, and style coupling/decoupling. Our results demonstrate that bottom-up generation provides a practical framework that complements existing top-down multimodal approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/AhmadArrabi/SnB

</details>

### 351. [Decentralised Drone Swarm Formation under Silent Failures with ACO Pheromone Claims and PSO Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10454v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10454

**作者：** Md. Abu Horaira

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10454v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10454v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究无中心规划器、通信受限且有静默失效时的无人机编队：用 ACO 信息素式 claim 经邻居 gossip 分配位置（蒸发兼作失效检测），PSO 负责飞行与离线调参，Voronoi 滤波防碰撞，并给出有界时间内 claim 消失、冲突一致、覆盖与安全的理论保证及多组实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「状态条目随蒸发衰减并经传播更新，从而在无显式通知时检测失效」的去中心化状态维护，以及明确指出收益来自信息素动力学与调参而非随机构造/社会项的贡献归因，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的自校验、停止与重规划信号及模块贡献分配提供类比线索，需核查其假设能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decentralised Drone Swarm Formation under Silent Failures with ACO Pheromone Claims and PSO Tuning

**abstract/A1：** We study decentralised drone formation, without a central planner, under the conditions that make it hard: nobody knows how many drones are alive, failures are silent, radio is short-ranged and lossy, and actuation is noisy. In our controller, ant colony optimisation (ACO) allocates drones to picture positions through claims that behave as reinforced, evaporating pheromone and are gossiped between neighbours, so evaporation doubles as failure detection. A particle swarm optimisation (PSO) law flies the drones, a noise-buffered Voronoi filter keeps them apart, and PSO also tunes the controller offline. We prove that claims of destroyed drones vanish within bounded time, that conflicts between drones that exchange tables are resolved consistently, that survivors cover the picture to within a factor of two, and that drones cannot collide while their safety cells are feasible. On held-out seeds and with two tuned configurations, the controller formed the picture in 95-99% of runs in the hardest regime, restored it after a silent loss of half the swarm in 96-100% of runs at normal difficulty, transferred unchanged to eight unseen shapes and to 300 drones, and overlapped in 5 of 21,088 runs. A CBBA-style baseline that shares the evaporating claims but uses argmax without swaps was at least as reliable as ours once tuned with the same budget, and repaired faster, whereas ours generalised better to unseen shapes. The benefit thus comes from the pheromone dynamics and from tuning, not from ACO's stochastic construction or PSO's social terms. A centralised oracle is faster.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 7 figures, 22 tables. Code, browser demo and raw results are included as ancillary files

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Fast Tree Transform：一种定义在任意图几何上的局部聚合变换，推广了圆上的 Hadamard 频率变换与 Haar 小波变换，其纯频率部分近似对角化图 Laplacian，可用于几何优化中的预条件，并对同时含边缘与纹理的信号给出近似无冗余的稀疏表示。

**相关性简评：** 该变换在图结构上提供多尺度、稀疏的信号分解，或可作为分析 VLM 内部状态（如 token 图、注意力图）表示几何与局部-全局成分的工具，但其与 LVR 的状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策的关联需较多核查，目前仅属概念性启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Fast Tree Transform

**abstract/A1：** The Fast Tree Transform is a locally-aggregated transform defined for arbitrary graph geometries that generalizes both the Hadamard frequency transform and the Haar wavelet transform on the circle. The pure frequency part of the transform approximately diagonalizes the graph Laplacian; this fact makes it useful as a preconditioner in geometric optimization problems. The full transform provides an only slightly-redundant representation of signals on the graph that allows sparse representation of signals that include both edges and textures.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出物理信息图神经算子：从少数发电机母线的稀疏、间歇 PMU 量测出发，单次前向估计全部机组（含未量测机组）的转子角与转速轨迹，以摆方程作硬约束或带可学习误差修正的软约束，并在无状态标签的仿真量测上训练。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「稀疏观测→全系统隐状态一次推断」及掩码训练（从输入遮蔽一路量测、仍保留在损失中）可能为部分可观测下的 latent 状态估计与监督贡献分配提供线索，可供核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamic State Estimation from Sparse PMUs via Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operators

**abstract/A1：** This paper proposes a physics-informed graph neural operator for power system dynamic state estimation. From a sparse, intermittent measurement window at a few generator buses, the operator estimates the rotor-angle and speed trajectories of all machines, unmeasured ones included, in one forward pass. A graph-attention encoder processes the measurements, and the swing equations are imposed as a hard constraint or as a soft one with a learned correction that absorbs model errors. It is trained on simulated measurements, without state labels. With several phasor measurement units, masked training hides one from the input but keeps it in the loss. On four transmission systems, simulations show that the operator is the most accurate estimator that neither optimizes per scenario nor uses state labels, except on the smallest system at large model errors, where tuned Kalman smoothers are better. Networks trained on simulated states are more accurate on the two smallest systems but not on the 118-bus system, where the operator is faster and more accurate than hard-constrained moving-horizon estimation. Under model errors, it matches or outperforms an optimization-based benchmark at a fraction of its cost. The results hold for a detailed machine model with exact parameters seen only through voltage phasors.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 回顾性评估通用图像生成模型合成的医学影像能否用于模型训练、亚组增广与模型审计，在四种影像模态上比较纯合成训练与外部队列真实数据验证的表现，并结合校准、决策曲线与临床医生评分。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study

**abstract/A1：** Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p&lt;0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.

</details>

### 355. [Sampling Is Not Curiosity: Why LLM Agents Should Investigate](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10501v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10501

**作者：** Alfonso Amayuelas、Piotr Piękos、Xin Eric Wang、William Yang Wang、Jürgen Schmidhuber、Alex Pentland

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10501v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10501v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该立场论文区分 LLM agent 的随机采样与真正的探索，主张好奇心需具备可在线改进、驱动动作选择并跨上下文窗口保持的环境预测结构，并提出判定框架与研究议程。

**相关性简评：** 其关于持久预测状态、在线更新和自主提出探究对象的主张，可能为 LVR 中跨窗口推理状态维护、证据获取及继续探究与否的决策提供概念参照，但无视觉或多模态实证，可操作性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sampling Is Not Curiosity: Why LLM Agents Should Investigate

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended tasks, very common in research scenarios where they are required to explore, investigate, or act curiously. At inference time, an LLM is a fixed map from context to next-token distribution, the pretrained weights determine the function, and only its conditioning changes as context accumulates. Mechanisms like temperature, best-of-N, tree search, or RAG vary how the distribution is sampled or what it is conditioned on, but do not update the agent's model of the environment. We argue that current LLM agents do not explore curiously; they explore stochastically. From how curiosity is understood in the RL literature, it requires a predictive structure over how the environment responds to the agent's actions, which improves online from current interaction, drives action selection through its predicted improvement, and persists beyond the context window. Additionally, in its open-ended form, the agent should intrinsically originate what to investigate. Thus, we propose a framework defining curiosity in LLM agents, reserving the term for systems that satisfy it. In doing so, we identify the research directions its implementation opens up.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Position Paper Track

</details>

**title/T1：** TimeHF 2.0: Multimodal, Multivariate, and Multi-Region Collaborative Forecasting for Large-Scale Retail Supply Chains

**abstract/A1：** Large-scale retail supply chains need sales forecasts for specified products, future dates or planning windows, and regions under the conditions available at the forecast origin. Regional sparsity, changing environments, volatile sales, and unfamiliar business situations make these dimensions difficult to model together. We introduce TimeHF 2.0, a multimodal, multivariate, and multi-region collaborative forecasting framework that makes flexibly expressed business knowledge usable in numerical prediction. A coverage-aware directed encoder integrates regional sales and applicable covariates. A semantic alignment module transfers language-model hidden representations of natural-language plans and domain experience into target-specific forecasting context. Learning against sales observations connects these meanings to numerical evidence, allowing business users to supply experience, future plans, and changing circumstances without defining a new numerical feature for each description. Text-conditioned future queries and shared/routed experts adapt prediction to the supplied context. An ordered-distribution head allocates fine resolution to routine fluctuations and coarse resolution to extreme sales movements, while daily/window learning connects forecasts to cumulative planning quantities. Online parallel forecasting at JD yields relative accuracy improvements of 18.25% and 17.94% for national daily and planning-window sales, and 19.44% and 18.99% for DC daily and planning-window sales, over the original production deep learning baseline. Component comparisons, loss-design results, and product-type analyses examine the roles of regional information, covariates, business knowledge, context-dependent processing, and robust planning-oriented learning.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Technical report

**作者：** Yunfu Deng、Josiah P. Hanna

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10543v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10543v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation，在增广的状态—选项空间中估计价值函数，从而在缺少选项标注的非层级轨迹上评估带终止条件的分层策略。

**相关性简评：** 选项可视为一种时间抽象的隐状态，其终止决策与无标注价值估计可能为 latent 推理中的状态更新、STOP 决策及轨迹贡献分配提供概念参照，但领域较远，迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation: Evaluating Hierarchical Policies from Non-Hierarchical Data

**abstract/A1：** Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the expected return of a target policy from previously collected data without additional environment interaction. While OPE methods for flat Markovian policies are well studied, little work has addressed evaluating hierarchical policies in which a high-level policy selects temporally extended options that generate primitive actions until a termination condition is met. The primary existing approach applies per-decision importance sampling at the option level, but requires option-annotated trajectories and exhibits variance that still grows with the horizon. For non-hierarchical policies, fitted Q-evaluation (FQE) typically achieves lower error than importance sampling by leveraging the classic Bellman equation for policy evaluation; however, a naive extension of FQE to hierarchical policies results in a biased policy value estimate. In this paper, we introduce Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation (IO-FQE), which estimates a value function in the augmented state-option space; this approach enables OPE of hierarchical policies even when we lack annotations of what option was run in the data. We develop two continuous-action instantiations of IO-FQE and show on long-horizon hierarchical continuous control tasks (AntMaze navigation and OGBench Puzzle manipulation) that IO-FQE eliminates the bias incurred by a naive application of FQE to hierarchical policies and substantially lowers mean squared-error compared to option-level importance sampling.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.DS、math.MG、math.PR、stat.ML

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对机制与 AI 耦合的动力系统在噪声、稀疏和部分观测下的不确定性，提出以最优传输与信息几何为框架，把不确定性量化表述为概率密度空间上能量泛函的极小化，推导 Wasserstein、Fisher-Rao 等度量下的梯度流，并给出基于抽象伴随灵敏度分析的数值解法与后验/预测不确定性比较实验。

**相关性简评：** 其概率密度空间上的梯度流与信息几何刻画，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的分布演化、不确定性度量与表示几何分析提供概念线索，但与视觉推理的直接联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Confronting Uncertainty in Mechanism-AI Coupled Dynamical Systems via Optimal Transport and Information Geometry: Part I. Distribution Learning

**abstract/A1：** Mechanism-AI coupled dynamical systems are increasingly used to study complex biological systems. However, uncertainty associated with noisy, sparse, and partially observed data limits their reliability. This paper presents a systematic mathematical formulation for treating these uncertainties from the perspective of optimal transport and information geometry. We formulate the uncertainty quantification problem as the minimization of an energy functional on a probability density space equipped with a Riemannian metric, with the loss evaluated through a differential equation, and give a unified description of the gradient flows of the energy functional under specific metrics, such as the Wasserstein and Fisher-Rao metrics. Furthermore, we present corresponding numerical methods for solving these gradient flows using abstract adjoint sensitivity analysis. The formulation connects a range of Bayesian inference methods for dynamical systems; numerical experiments compare posterior approximation and predictive uncertainty under a common computational budget. Moreover, it also provides a geometric perspective on dynamical modeling and the study of heterogeneity evolution.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InfoOrgBench: Can Agents Turn Scattered Information into Coherent Hierarchies?

**abstract/A1：** When agents organize records into folders, they may correctly group the excerpts of a design proposal yet place the proposal under the wrong owning group. Existing agent benchmarks do not directly measure such higher-level errors. We introduce InfoOrgBench, a benchmark of 150 tasks in which agents organize scattered records from meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Integrity checks verify that every record is preserved, and a Structure Score measures agreement with the source hierarchy at every level, independent of folder names and order. We evaluate 45 systems that pair nine models with five agent harnesses. The best system scores 83.2 out of 100, but no system exceeds 78 on meeting recaps or issue threads. Model choice affects scores far more than harness choice: model means span about 27 points, whereas the average effect of each harness is below one point. More importantly, parent-level relations have higher error rates than leaf-level relations in all three domains. In design proposals, nearly half of the outputs analyzed by level make exactly this kind of error. These results show that evaluating information organization requires measuring higher-level relations separately from record preservation and local grouping.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10628v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10628v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察后台模型被升级或替换后，LLM agent 在外部人格、记忆与规则不变时是否仍保持行为一致性，并在 12 个受监管领域、三个开源模型上做了 5760 次合规测试，发现部分模型配对出现显著行为漂移，且这种漂移无法通过模型自身的口头合规声明察觉。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是「口头声称合规」与「压力下实际决策」的脱节，可供核查 LVR 中口头推理或答案报告是否真实反映内部 latent 状态与视觉证据使用情况，提示需以行为级因果测试替代语言自述验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Identity-Preserving LLM Agents under Model Transition

**abstract/A1：** When an LLM agent's backend model is upgraded or replaced, operators typically reload the same persona, memory, and rules onto the new model and assume the agent will behave as before. We show this assumption requires empirical validation-and that whether identity is preserved depends on the specific model pairing. Across 5,760 compliance-testing runs in 12 regulated domains with three open-weight models, we find that some transitions produce significant behavioral drift while others do not, even when the agent's external state remains identical. Crucially, this drift is invisible to verbal verification: every model claims full policy compliance, yet actual decisions under pressure differ across models. The same external state can reorder which model is most compliant-a large positive effect on one substrate, negligible on the other two. Practitioners should treat model transitions as behavioral changes requiring action-level empirical testing, not as transparent infrastructure operations.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「执行溯源」审计揭示高分可能与实际执行脱钩，这一思路或可供核查 LVR 评价中答案得分是否真正依赖视觉证据与推理轨迹，而非旁路或表面形式；但任务域较远，迁移需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DFT-Agent Bench: Scaffold Effects and Execution Provenance in Autonomous DFT

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for first-principles materials simulation. We report empirical findings from DFT-Agent Bench, a benchmark of 200+ Quantum ESPRESSO tasks spanning relaxation, electronic structure, equation-of-state, and elastic-tensor pipelines over multiple material tiers. Each task carries a QE-derived ground truth with public-reference cross-checks where available, and a provenance audit checks whether the required QE execution contract was met. Under one execution harness, we compare a near-bare ReAct baseline with a bundled v5.1 scaffold on two models. The complete scaffold improves bands+DOS by +0.08/+0.11 and d-electron vc-relax by +0.17 on both models, while high-scoring relaxation and equation-of-state cells leave little room for improvement. The elastic result is model-dependent (0.18 to 0.40 for deepseek-v4-pro and 0.62 to 0.59 for claude-opus-4-8). A fixed 100-task analysis with retrieval disabled supports the aggregate pattern: the fully frozen DeepSeek comparison gains +0.17, while the Opus comparison gains +0.10 against a historical pool baseline (p &lt; 0.001). The provenance gate catches incomplete or unmarked executions that can receive high rubric scores; it is an execution-contract check, not a test for intentional fraud. These results characterize the evaluated DFT workflows. The anonymous review artifact contains the frozen diagnostic slice, prompts, scorer, and solver revisions: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/231e31re91287h/README.md.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其“视觉证据与度量证据角色互补、证据是否充分决定重建上限”的结论，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与信息可靠性判断的问题表述有概念联系，但领域相距较远，仅可供核查评价设计思路。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent2BIM: A Systematic Evaluation of Reality-Capture Configurations and Prior Models for As-Built Modeling

**abstract/A1：** AI agents can generate as-built Building Information Models (BIMs) from reality-capture data, but the evidence required for accurate reconstruction remains unclear. This paper presents Agent2BIM, an agent-based Scan-to-BIM framework, and evaluates seven capture configurations in a research laboratory and a mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) scene. Inputs include 360° panoramas, smartphone video, smartphone LiDAR, terrestrial laser scanning (TLS), TLS with posed panoramas, and imagery supplemented by prior IFC models. Outputs are compared against TLS-verified reference models for component detection, geometric accuracy, and MEP connectivity. In the laboratory, component recall ranged from 84% to 100%, but only 9% of components reconstructed from panoramas were within 20 cm of their reference positions, compared with 86% using smartphone LiDAR. In the MEP scene, scale-free inputs recovered 11 - 43% of components, versus 75 - 93% for metric inputs. Prior IFC models improved MEP reconstruction but could propagate inaccuracies. The results highlight the complementary roles of visual and metric evidence in agent-based Scan-to-BIM.

</details>

### 363. [MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10649v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10649

**作者：** Lorenz K. Muller、Philippe Bich、Chiara Boretti、Hyun-Min Chang、Jiawei Zhuang、Lukas Cavigelli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10649v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10649v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MACaQ，一种 MXFP4 W4A4 的训练后量化方法：对每个线性层独立施加在线 per-channel 缩放与 block-Hadamard 变换并将逆变换吸收进权重，再用 Hessian 感知的「Flip-Refinement」逐码坐标下降改善舍入，实现流式、模型无关的量化。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身面向推理压缩，与 LVR 的状态生成、证据筛选无直接关系；但其对激活施加可逆在线变换并对离散码做局部校正的思路，可能可供核查低精度激活对 latent 状态保真度的影响，以及离散 latent 表示的细粒度修正线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations

**abstract/A1：** Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM.

</details>
