**title/T1：** MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs

**abstract/A1：** Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. ### 365. [The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10658v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10658

**作者：** Junhui Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10658v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10658v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文指出细胞扰动响应预测的全局Pearson被大量非响应基因主导而严重虚高，提出以delta空间评价为主，并用后处理校正、delta对齐训练及oracle上界诊断残差。

**相关性简评：** 其“聚合指标被无关维度淹没、须评价任务相关变化”的诊断可能启发LVR中latent状态与答案使用的评价，表示几何而非解码器容量的定位思路可供核查信息坍缩与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Delta Gap: Cellular World Models for Perturbation Response Prediction Are Far Harder Than Global Correlation Implies

**abstract/A1：** Cellular world models aim to predict how cells respond to genetic perturbations, analogous to world models in reinforcement learning. Perturbation response models are evaluated almost exclusively by global Pearson correlation between predicted and observed transcriptomes. We show this metric is dominated by thousands of non-responsive genes and severely inflates apparent performance. On the Replogle K562 screen (509 unseen perturbations, 5000 genes), GEARS achieves global Pearson 0.977, but its delta Pearson is only 0.076. A trivial baseline predicting mean training delta achieves 0.267, which is 3.5x better than GEARS. Our primary contribution is methodological: we identify and quantify this delta gap as a systematic evaluation artifact, and propose delta-space evaluation as the primary benchmark. We provide two post-hoc corrections (RWR on co-expression graphs and kNN matching) and show that 2.8x of the remaining gap lies in perturbation representation geometry, not decoder capacity. We further show the gap is partially addressable end-to-end: delta-aligned training (lambda = 3.0) raises delta Pearson to 0.179 on Replogle (2.35x over GEARS) and surpasses the trivial baseline on direction accuracy (0.680 vs 0.567) and gene recovery (1.52 vs 1.19); combined with kNN it reaches 0.217. An amplitude-calibration variant (eta = 0.3) further raises gene recovery to 2.16 while reaching 0.218. Critically, these representations transfer zero-shot across cell lines: from Replogle K562 to unseen Norman A549, the delta-aligned model reaches 0.328 on 741 shared genes, 4.7x a trivial baseline and 2.1x standard GEARS. This is the first systematic quantification of the delta gap, and the first diagnostic framework localizing the residual gap to perturbation representation geometry via an oracle upper bound.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 16 figures, 17 tables

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10665v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10665v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TeX-Gen，从成对可见光与红外图像生成温度、发射率与纹理图，并给出无需像素级物理标注的 TeXMetric 及冻结生成器下的任务引导微调，在低光检测任务上验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 其用独立门控分支将多视角线索路由为解耦物理图，并以无标签复合指标评估分解质量、在冻结生成器下做任务引导微调，可能为 latent 状态的证据筛选、内容评估与任务导向监督提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physically Guided TeX Generation for Low-Light Visual Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Low-light conditions reduce visible contrast and obscure details, while infrared images lack color and texture, motivating the fusion of infrared and visible information for visual tasks. Existing fusion methods primarily optimize image appearance or task-specific features without explicitly disentangling the coupled factors underlying thermal observations, limiting their physical interpretation under thermal degeneracy. Hyperspectral thermal measurements enable physical decomposition, but they require specialized imaging hardware, while pixel-level physical annotations for supervision or evaluation incur additional costs. We propose TeX-Gen, a physically guided framework for TeX generation from paired visible and infrared images in low-light visual tasks. TeX Generation constructs complementary multi-view features and employs independent branch-specific gates to route cues into the Temperature, Emissivity, and Texture maps. TeXMetric integrates radiometric reconstruction, channel structure, and material consistency to assess the generated maps without requiring pixel-level physical labels. TeX Tune improves performance through task-guided adjustments, jointly optimizing the adjustment modules and task network while keeping the generator frozen. Experiments show that TeX-Gen achieves competitive task performance in low-light environments on the FLIR, LLVIP, M3FD, and MSRS datasets. Experiments on HADAR also examine the association between TeXMetric scores and downstream detection performance.

</details>

### 367. [Causal Heteroscedastic Structure Learning From Incomplete Temporal data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10668v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10668

**作者：** Abdellah Rahmani、Pascal Frossard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10668v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10668v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Cheesefill：以最优传输框架在缺失值与异方差噪声并存的多变量时间序列上学习因果结构，用条件归一化流参数化因果机制，并联合学习随机校正映射，把粗糙填补修正为与所推断机制一致的轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 领域相距较远，但其「机制推断与证据校正必须联合优化、否则性能下降」的论点，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态与不完整视觉证据的一致性约束，以及按瞬时因果驱动方差建模来刻画状态不确定性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Causal Heteroscedastic Structure Learning From Incomplete Temporal data

**abstract/A1：** Discovering causal structures in multivariate time series (MTS) is critical in domains such as finance and neuroscience, yet remains challenging in practice due to three distinct obstacles. First, MTS are routinely corrupted by missing values, where naive impute-then-discover pipelines distort the underlying data distribution and yield spurious causal graphs. Second, identifying instantaneous effects is difficult even on complete data, and missingness further entangles imputation with graph recovery. Third, real-world data frequently exhibits heteroscedastic noise with variance driven by both instantaneous and lagged causes, violating the core assumptions of standard discovery methods. Existing approaches fail to address these challenges concurrently, typically presuming complete data, homoscedastic noise, or strictly time-lagged relationships. Crucially, we show through ablation studies that resolving these issues sequentially, rather than jointly, leads to a substantial degradation in performance. To overcome this, we introduce Cheesefill, an optimal transport framework for causal structure learning under missingness and heteroscedastic noise. Cheesefill parameterizes causal mechanisms using conditional normalizing flows and jointly learns a stochastic correction map that refines naive imputations into trajectories consistent with the inferred causal mechanisms. Theoretically, we prove that optimizing over stochastic correction maps is equivalent to a conditional kernel reformulation of the Kantorovich problem, from which our neural parameterization yields a tractable objective. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Cheesefill consistently outperforms existing baselines across diverse missingness regimes.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10677

**作者：** Mahesh Keswani、Parth Bhardwaj、Ankur Kumar、Raunak P. Bhattacharyya

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10677v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10677v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FOCAL，在安全离线 RL 中把行为正则化策略梯度接入 CVAE actor，按估计可行性划分一阶目标分别优化回报与约束违反，并在推理时依据状态的可行性动态调整 latent 先验尺度以改变动作采样的保守程度。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「可行区域」估计与依状态可行性调节 latent 采样尺度的做法，可能为 LVR 中是否继续 latent 计算（STOP 决策）和潜在状态的保守性控制提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning using Behavior Regularisation and Latent Feasibility Guidance

**abstract/A1：** Safe offline reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to learn policies that maximize return while satisfying safety constraints, using a static dataset. To characterize state-wise safety, reachability analysis identifies the feasible region, defined as the set of states from which constraints can be satisfied at every future step. Policies are commonly extracted from learned value functions with advantage-weighted regression (AWR). However, AWR relies on exponentiated weights that amplify value estimation errors, whereas behavior-regularized policy gradient methods directly utilize the action gradient of the value function and often make more effective use of learned critics. We propose Feasibility-Optimized Conditional Actor Learning (FOCAL), a method that incorporates behavior-regularized policy gradients into a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) actor. FOCAL optimizes this policy using a first-order objective partitioned by feasibility, updating the actor to increase return on transitions estimated to be feasible and to reduce constraint violations on transitions estimated to be infeasible. During inference, FOCAL dynamically adjusts the scale of the latent prior according to the estimated feasibility of the state to adjust the conservatism of action sampling. Theoretically, we show that for AWR, the policy update variance depends exponentially on the advantage error, whereas for FOCAL it scales linearly with the variance of the value estimation error. Across the DSRL benchmark, FOCAL satisfies the constraints on all evaluated tasks while achieving competitive or higher returns compared to baselines.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**作者：** Halimat Afolabi、Daeyoung Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 以 OmniDocBench 为案例，在数据集构成、匹配策略与打分指标三类设计选择下评测 16 个 OCR/VLM 模型，用 Kendall's tau、top-k 变动和成对反转率量化排名稳定性。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的内部状态、视觉证据使用无直接关联，但其「排名依赖评价协议」的结论可供核查：LVR 中判断 latent 内容是否真正被使用的诊断，可能同样对匹配方式和打分设计高度敏感。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RankShift: Evaluating Ranking Instability Across Benchmark Dimensions in Document Parsing

**abstract/A1：** Document parsing benchmarks are often treated as stable measures of model quality, yet rankings may depend substantially on benchmark design choices. In this work, we present RankShift, a systematic study comparing OCR and vision-language models (VLMs) under controlled variation in dataset composition, matching strategy, and scoring methodology. Using OmniDocBench as a case study, we evaluate the ranking stability of 16 models across 3 dataset configurations, 6 matching strategies, and 3 scoring metrics. We quantify rank stability using pairwise rank correlation, top-k churn, and pairwise reversal rate. Our results show that the interaction between matching strategy and ground truth format is a substantial but understudied driver of instability: scoring against OmniDocBench's JSON annotations versus its Markdown rendering yields a mean Kendall's tau of approximately 0.33 under region-level matching strategies, with individual pairs as low as tau = 0.23, compared with tau = 0.77 when each page is scored as a single concatenated string. Dataset composition produces comparable instability across page-type strata (mean tau = 0.48) and layout-type strata (mean tau = 0.49), while the cross-dataset shift from OmniDocBench to Real5's Scanning reconstruction of the same pages is more stable (tau = 0.80). Metric choice is the most stable dimension, with mean tau of approximately 0.78 across NED, BLEU, and METEOR. These findings indicate that leaderboard position is not solely a property of model capability, motivating leaderboards that report not only headline scores but also the robustness of rankings across reasonable design choices.

</details>

### 370. [R-BED: A Consequence-Aware Framework for System-Level AI Evaluation and Continuous Assurance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10704v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10704

**作者：** Vishal Srivastava

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10704v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10704v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 R-BED 规范级框架，用固定的诊断维度、期望损失恒等式、证据状态与授权规则把技术失败、部署控制与真实后果证据串成可复现的授权决策记录，并以合成退款代理走查演示。

**相关性简评：** 其证据状态分级、过期与依赖触发的按比例失效，以及证据到处置的规则化决策，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据是否充分、何时停止获取或需重新验证」的评价与记录方式提供线索，但无多模态实验，需核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** R-BED: A Consequence-Aware Framework for System-Level AI Evaluation and Continuous Assurance

**abstract/A1：** Evaluations of AI systems usually report properties of a model, while decisions to deploy concern a configured system: a model together with prompts, tools, permissions, data, safeguards and an operating context. We ask how evidence about technical failures, deployment-control effectiveness and real-world consequences can be connected to defensible authorization decisions throughout the lifecycle of a deployed system. We present R-BED (Risk-Based Evaluability Design), a specification-level methodology with a fixed 6+4+3 architecture of thirteen diagnostic dimensions (technical failure, deployment controls, consequence and impact); a failure-mediated expected-loss identity that is kept separate from intended-behavior and misuse pathways; bounded evidence statuses with independence levels; a control assurance ladder; five authorization dispositions governed by eight rules; and a Continuous System Evaluation (CSE) layer in which evidence carries a configuration pin, an expiry and declared dependencies, so that a change invalidates evidence in proportion rather than wholesale. We work through a synthetic refund-agent walkthrough, with a deterministic script that reproduces every number, to show how a task-success view can miss a consequential control weakness that the procedure identifies as missing evidence. The contribution is a reproducible methodological specification. Most components are standard practice integrated into one evidence-to-decision record; the Evidence Validity Register, the authority envelope and the tier rules are proposals. None has been empirically validated, and we state seven hypotheses for independent testing.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages (18 pages main text plus appendices), 8 figures, 11 tables. Specification-level methodology with a synthetic walkthrough; no empirical validation. Companion reproducibility script available from the author

</details>

### 371. [Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10713v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10713

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10713v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10713v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向笔画式绘画渲染，提出以二次 Bezier splatting 做可微 alpha 合成的渲染框架，配合多尺度前馈笔画解码器给出带尺度分配的结构初始化与测试时笔画优化，并用单笔画审计机制评估局部笔画质量。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐笔画局部审计」与分层合成中对缺陷元素被后层补偿的防范，可能为 latent 推理中逐步贡献分配与退化状态检测的评价设计提供类比线索，但论文属图像渲染、无多模态推理状态，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering

**abstract/A1：** Stroke-based rendering is often optimized as a pixel-level reconstruction task. This over-reliance on global error reduction not only degrades strokes into fragmented curves due to a lack of structured planning, but also allows locally defective primitives to be concealed by overlapping layers. To address these issues, we introduce a model-guided framework for stroke-audited rendering. Our framework uses Quadratic Bezier Splatting to analytically model continuous curved strokes with efficient differentiable alpha compositing. Built on this renderer, a feedforward multi-scale stroke decoder provides a structural initialization with learned stroke-scale allocation, while test-time stroke optimization supplies the reconstruction capacity needed for high-fidelity refinement. We further propose a single-stroke audit mechanism that explicitly evaluates local stroke quality, preventing defective primitives from surviving optimization through layer-wise compensation. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves coherent layouts, improves PSNR by up to 5.46 dB, yields a 16% more compact representation, and accelerates combined renderer forward and backward computation by a factor of 220.3.

</details>

### 372. [Breaking Precision Walls in First-, Second-, and Zeroth-Order Optimizers: One Constant, Set in Advance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10730v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10730

**作者：** Lngel Kyo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10730v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10730v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究一阶、二阶与零阶优化器中的「精度墙」现象：方向间信号按幂律衰减时，优化器拟合强方向却漏掉弱方向，而平均损失掩盖这一点；作者给出由一个可预先设定的常数（步长、阻尼、零阶的 ε）移动该墙的规则，并在低秩矩阵感知、二次型与 logistic 回归上验证。

**相关性简评：** 「平均损失掩盖弱方向未收敛」的诊断与 LVR 中聚合指标掩盖细节信息坍缩、监督未分配到弱信号方向的现象可能同构，可供核查「精度墙」式度量能否用来评估 latent 状态对视觉细节或弱证据的保留程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Breaking Precision Walls in First-, Second-, and Zeroth-Order Optimizers: One Constant, Set in Advance

**abstract/A1：** Under power-law signal decay across directions, an optimizer can fit strong directions and miss weak ones while average loss hides it. A precision wall measures the steepest decay where the weakest direction recovers within 5% in a fixed budget. On low-rank matrix sensing and quadratics one constant sets the wall: once it dominates the denominator, Adam or grafted Shampoo is momentum descent at step $η/c$, setting the wall; in Shampoo, matching grafting's constant to damping restores the wall after three hypotheses failed. In zeroth-order Adam, $\\varepsilon$ acts against $\\varepsilon^\\ast$ from a mean-square spectral model; below $\\varepsilon^\\ast$ error hits a noise floor. Set from true curvature or spectrum on new shapes, the rule raised the wall above the same-step default by a forecast amount: on two sensing shapes by $1.96, 1.15$ (Adam) and $1.59, 1.74$ (grafted Shampoo), and on two Hadamard-rotated quadratics by $1.12, 0.73$ (zeroth-order Adam, longer budget), rising on all seeds; fixed-step momentum at that step reaches those walls. A cosine-scheduled default (small constant giving weak modes large steps) is higher on one sensing shape, matched on new seeds of the other, and lower with the rule's constant. A default step retuned per budget catches up on rotated quadratics and population logistic regression, fails at 1 query/step on two diagonal quadratics (catching up at 16), and exceeds the rule on digits logistic regression (full-batch and minibatches, where gradient noise sets the $η= 0.01, 0.1$ default walls). On logistic regression the rule did not raise the first-order wall: same-step default Adam was higher (its wall on 4 new shapes at the forecast stability limit), while in zeroth order on the population loss setting $\\varepsilon$ raised the wall by $0.98, 0.88$.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 373. [AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10750v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10750

**作者：** Shrey Singhal、Nannan Huang、Haytham M. Fayek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10750v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10750v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AERO，一个基于 Dyna 式模型架构的完全在线 RLHF 算法：用集成式认知奖励模型同时充当探索后验与合成偏好标签来源，并以集成投票熵加自适应阈值判断哪些上下文需要 oracle 反馈。

**相关性简评：** 其「不确定性驱动的查询路由」概念可能与 LVR 中何时调用外部视觉证据、何时停止获取证据的决策问题相通，但该工作面向纯文本偏好对齐，与视觉状态表示无直接联系，阈值机制能否迁移可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF

**abstract/A1：** Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has driven substantial improvements across a wide range of tasks, but the cost of acquiring preference labels remains the dominant bottleneck in the alignment pipeline. While many recent alignment methods improve sample efficiency through active exploration over candidate responses, they typically query the oracle uniformly across contexts, even for contexts where the learned reward estimates are already reliable enough to provide synthetic labels. We propose Adaptive Ensemble-disagreement Routing for Oracle feedback (AERO), a fully online RLHF algorithm built on a Dyna-style model-based RL architecture, in which an ensemble-based Epistemic Reward Model (ERM) serves both as a reward posterior for exploration and as a learned preference-feedback model for synthetic labeling. AERO uses ensemble vote entropy, a Query-by-Committee disagreement measure, combined with an adaptive thresholding mechanism to decide which contexts require oracle feedback and which can instead receive ERM-based synthetic preference labels, concentrating expensive labels where they are most informative. Empirical results across different model families and scales show that AERO achieves highly competitive alignment performance while reducing the required oracle-query budget compared to online DPO and strong active-exploration baselines.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 374. [WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10771v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10771

**作者：** Juanxi Tian、Jiadong Hou、Baiang Li、Xin Lin、Zhengbo Jiao、Weijia Zhang、Yeying Jin、Truong Nguyen、Haitian Zheng、Zhifei Zhang、Jianfei Yang、Ming-Hsuan Yang、Felix Heide、Wei Xiong、Enze Xie、Wanhua Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10771v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10771v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文先给出生成式世界模型的定义，即维护持续且以历史为条件的状态表示、响应动作或干预更新该表示并生成时间上连贯的轨迹，据此提出涵盖感知 grounding、持续状态建模、可控变换、动力学预测与闭环交互的框架，并发布 WorldFoundry 开源基础设施，统一视频、3D/4D、具身动作与交互系统的模型与基准发现、执行编排、产物管理与可视化，当前收录 270 个模型条目、74 个基准与 62 个指标条目。

**相关性简评：** 其「持续状态表示 + 干预下更新」的问题表述，以及用 manifest 与证据化 scorecard 把执行可用性与评价主张分开的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否被实际使用、以及在反事实干预下如何取证评价提供概念参照，是否可迁移到 VLM 推理评测需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence

**abstract/A1：** Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 10 figures. This technical report will be updated periodically

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.chem-ph、physics.comp-ph

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 为等变消息传递图神经网络原子间势（BREMP）证明通用逼近：构造单层特征在同类原子置换意义下决定局部环境，并按跳数逐层扩展，双线性读出由等变特征乘积形成不变量并均匀逼近连续不变量函数。

**相关性简评：** 其「特征是否足以唯一决定局部环境」的可辨识性论证与多线性读出，可能为讨论 VLM 内部状态能否保留几何与任务必要信息、以及如何诊断信息坍缩提供理论类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Universal Approximation by Equivariant Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks with a Bilinear Readout

**abstract/A1：** We prove universal approximation for the bilinear-readout equivariant message-passing network (BREMP), a reference architecture for equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials. Its layers combine equivariant convolutions with affine maps, and its readout forms invariants from products of the equivariant features. We construct a one-layer feature that determines the local environment up to permutations of atoms of the same type. The construction uses spherical harmonic filters of degree no larger than the largest number of neighbors at a common distance from the center. Iterating the construction recovers the environment reachable in as many hops as there are layers, using the same bound on filter degrees at the layer cutoff. The readout approximates every continuous invariant function of the features uniformly on compact sets. Together these give universal approximation of atomic energies at a prescribed physical range using a shorter layer cutoff. We assume that, throughout the admissible class, message passing reaches all neighbors in each physical environment within a common number of layers. Finally, DPA4, an interatomic potential architecture in production use, inherits this result by approximating the BREMP layers constructed in the proof and realizing the bilinear readout.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 AmodalBox，用图像生成的 3D 资产作为 amodal 几何先验，与部分可见的 LiDAR 点云对齐，从而自动化标注完整 3D 包围盒，并借单帧尺度估计与跨帧传播提升时序一致性和效率。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AmodalBox: Automated 3D Bounding Box Annotation under Partial Visibility

**abstract/A1：** Recent progress in vision foundation models (VFMs) has made automated open-vocabulary 3D bounding box annotation increasingly feasible by jointly leveraging LiDAR point clouds and images. However, partial observations remain a major challenge in sparse driving scenes, where visible LiDAR points often cover only a small fraction of the object's surface and provide insufficient cues for estimating its full spatial extent. As a result, existing methods often produce mislocalized boxes or leave objects unlabeled. To address this limitation, we propose \\textbf{\\Ours{}}, an automated annotation framework that leverages image-generated 3D assets as amodal geometric priors for partially observed objects. By establishing correspondences between input images and rendered views of 3D assets, \\Ours{} robustly aligns canonical amodal geometry with partially observed world-space LiDAR point clouds. To improve temporal consistency and reduce computational cost, \\Ours{} generates a single asset per instance, estimates its metric scale once at a single frame and propagates it across frames for dynamic instances, and aggregates multi-frame observations for static instances. 3D object detectors trained on annotations from \\Ours{} improve performance over strong baselines by 14.1 mAP on the nuScenes dataset and by 12.45 AP at IoU 0.5 for the vehicle class on the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD). Our project page is available at: \\href{https://oliver0922.github.io/AmodalBox/}{https://oliver0922.github.io/AmodalBox/}

**comment/C1：** Accepted by CoRL 2026

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Biological Hierarchies in Single-Cell Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Cell types are organized by taxonomic relationships that define lineages in the so-called cell ontology. However, most existing foundation models typically ignore cell-type lineages encoded in this cell ontology. We introduce a biologically informed foundation model called scOntoFM, which embeds hierarchical cell ontology into representation learning. Using Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) distances from the ontology graph, our framework pairs efficient offline triplet sampling with hierarchical cell-ontology learning. This approach jointly preserves local neighborhoods and shapes the global embedding geometry to reflect the ontology structure. Across diverse cell- and gene-level benchmarks, the model consistently improves performance, with especially strong gains in zero-shot settings. Our model also balances batch integration with biological structure preservation, providing complementary perspectives to existing embedding evaluation frameworks and supporting scalable biological discovery.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 algebraic tree decision diagrams：把树决策图宽度中「各切分子函数计数」换成 cut matrix 的秩，其最大值即 factor rank，并证明该秩表示在任意 vtree 与有理数域下具有严格唯一的规范形式，等价性可化为语法相等，且模型计数、vtree 变换等操作保持多项式时间。

**相关性简评：** 以秩而非计数度量切分处的信息容量、并给出唯一规范形式，可能为 latent 状态的表示容量刻画、跨位置或缓存内容的等价判定提供可供核查的抽象线索，但属知识编译领域，与 VLM 推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Factor Rank: A Canonical Algebraic Generalization of Tree Decision Diagrams

**abstract/A1：** Tree decision diagrams (TDDs), recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026), are representations of Boolean functions. They generalize OBDDs by replacing variable orders with vtrees. The width of a TDD counts the distinct subfunctions across each vtree cut. Counting subfunctions is blind to linear structure. We introduce algebraic tree decision diagrams (ATDDs) by replacing this count with the rank of the cut matrix. The maximum of these ranks over all cuts, the factor rank, is exactly the width of the ATDD. Every TDD can be converted into an ATDD of no greater width. An ATDD is a tree tensor network in canonical form. ATDDs are exponentially more succinct than TDDs, and quasi-polynomially more succinct than structured deterministic DNNFs. Our main result is that this gain in succinctness does not cost canonicity. ATDDs are the first strict canonical form for a rank-based representation over arbitrary vtrees. For each function and vtree there is exactly one ATDD, over the rationals and without any genericity assumption. The canonicity admits a local characterization. Whether a tree tensor network is the ATDD of the Boolean function it computes can be checked in polynomial time from its tensors alone. Equivalence checking becomes a test of syntactic equality. The operation set includes polynomial-time model counting, weighted model counting, and a test whether a tree tensor network represents a Boolean function. Capelli et al. asked for the complexity of changing the vtree of a TDD and suggested local vtree changes. We answer the question. After a rotation of the vtree at one node, the new ATDD differs from the old one in two tensors only. Vtree change runs in output-polynomial time both for TDDs and for ATDDs. We formalize and verify our core results in Lean. We provide a prototype implementation of TDD and ATDD compilers as a first empirical validation.

</details>

### 379. [Self-contained Data Cleaning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10856

**作者：** Jordan F. Masakuna、Ahmed Yacine、Djeff K. Nkashama、Arian Soltani、Marc Frappier、Pierre M. Tardif、Froduald Kabanza

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10856v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究无监督异常检测训练集中的污染问题，提出无需预设污染比例的预处理框架：利用自编码器训练早期「样本—重建」余弦相似度的动态变化把数据映射到异常区密度更低的动态空间，识别并「硬清洗」异常候选，在 8 个模型和 10 个安全数据集上验证跨架构的可迁移性。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练早期重建相似度动态」作为打分与筛选信号，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选或低质量 latent 状态剔除提供可核查线索，但该信号能否从图像异常检测迁移到多模态推理状态尚未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-contained Data Cleaning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Training datasets for unsupervised anomaly detection are often assumed to be anomaly-free, but in practice, they frequently contain malicious or anomalous contamination. This contamination severely degrades the dependability and security of downstream detection models. While some contamination-robust methods exist, they rarely generalize across different model architectures and typically rely on a priori knowledge of the contamination ratio\\textemdash information that is rarely available in real-world security operations. In this paper, we propose a novel, self-contained preprocessing framework for anomaly detection that identifies and removes training set contamination without relying on known contamination ratios. Our approach performs a dynamic analysis of the cosine similarity between each data point and its reconstruction during the early training stages of an auto-encoder, mapping points into a dynamic space where anomalous regions naturally exhibit lower density. By executing \`\`hard cleaning''\\textemdash removing all identified anomalous candidates from the training pool\\textemdash we systematically improve data quality. Because this cleaning occurs at the data level, the security and reliability improvements generalize seamlessly across various downstream anomaly detection architectures. Evaluating our framework across 8 distinct models and 10 security-relevant datasets, our approach achieves up to 100\\% contamination reduction, yielding average improvements of 11.2\\% in F1 score and 7.3\\% in classification accuracy.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 10 figures and 4 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出开源库 SWXAI，为空间天气与太阳物理预测中的图像、时间序列和表格模型提供统一的 XAI 接口、持久化解释对象、可复现示例与文档，并与直接调用后端实现对比，说明可减少用户代码量且无明显运行开销。

**相关性简评：** 其跨模态统一解释器接口与可持久化解释对象，可能为 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」的贡献归因与诊断流程提供可核查的工具线索，但该库面向领域预测而非 latent 推理状态，迁移需较多改造。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SWXAI: A Unified Multimodal Explainability Library for Space Weather Forecasting and Heliophysics

**abstract/A1：** Space weather forecasting and heliophysics increasingly rely on machine learning models that process heterogeneous inputs such as multi-viewpoint multi-wavelength solar images and rasters, multivariate time series, spatial annotations, and tabular event-level data. However, explainability workflows remain fragmented across libraries, model interfaces, and output formats, limiting reuse and reproducibility. We present SWXAI, an open-source library that unifies explainable AI (XAI) workflows for image, time-series, and tabular data in space weather forecasting and heliophysics. SWXAI provides a common, extensible interface across commonly used vision, time-series, and tabular learning models, with validation, adaptation, and persistent explanation objects. It also includes domain-grounded examples, reproducible notebooks, tests, and documentation, enabling users to inspect outputs, swap models or explainers, and extend workflows to new heliophysics datasets. SWXAI reduces modality-specific engineering overhead and supports comparable, reusable explanations across heterogeneous scientific machine learning pipelines. A benchmark against direct backend implementations shows that SWXAI substantially reduces the code users write to produce an explanation, with no practical runtime cost.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Resource Track), Rome, Italy, November 7-11, 2026. Code: https://bitbucket.org/gsudmlab/swxai Docs: https://swxai.readthedocs.io

### 381. [Stochastic Port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Processes for Learning from Noisy Dynamics on Lie Groups](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10864v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10864

**作者：** Thribhuvan Rapolu、Luke McLennan、Chandrajit Bajaj

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10864v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10864v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LieSPHGP：在 Lie 群/Lie 代数上以 port-Hamiltonian 结构建模刚体动力学，质量、势能、耗散、控制与扩散项各由 Matérn 核高斯过程表示，并用指数映射更新与隐显积分器保证流形约束和耗散非负，从而在有噪稀疏观测下获得长期稳定的预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构化状态变量＋能量耗散＋不确定性」的连续时间状态演化，可能为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态的稳定性、长程 rollout 与不确定性传播提供表示几何方面的线索，但论文不含视觉或多模态推理内容，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stochastic Port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Processes for Learning from Noisy Dynamics on Lie Groups

**abstract/A1：** Learning predictive models for dynamics is difficult because observations are often sparse and noisy, while the underlying dynamics evolve on nonlinear configuration manifolds and are affected by environmental dissipation and stochastic disturbances. Standard neural dynamics models can fit short-term trajectories but often violate physical structure, accumulate error over long horizons, or rely on parameterizations that introduce singularities such as gimbal lock. We introduce LieSPHGP, a stochastic Gaussian-process framework for learning rigid body dynamics with port-Hamiltonian structure and stability-aware robustness. LieSPHGP represents motion on Lie groups and Lie algebras, enabling coordinate-consistent optimization without singular parameterizations. Learned mass, potential energy, dissipation, and control components retain physical roles and a separate diffusion term represents stochastic forcing. Each component is modeled by Matérn kernel Gaussian processes which capture uncertainty induced by noisy observations. To improve physical validity, Lie group exponential map updates preserve rotational constraints, while positive-definite damping ensures nonnegative deterministic energy dissipation. The implicit-explicit integrator additionally provides unconditional stability for the frozen linear damping subsystem. The resulting model learns predictive dynamics that are robust to noise, respect rigid body geometry, and capture both intrinsic motion and environmental dissipation. Experiments on various noisy rigid body benchmarks show improved prediction accuracy, stronger long-horizon stability, and better satisfaction of manifold constraints compared with neural dynamics baselines. Code, data and interactive results are available on the project website: https://thribhuvanrapolu.github.io/liesphgp/

**comment/C1：** 54 pages, 14 figures

</details>

### 382. [Interactive Person Retrieval with On-the-Fly Visual Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10869v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10869

**作者：** Lyucheng Qian、John Yuehan Zhang、Pingyu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10869v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10869v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出视觉反馈交互式行人检索范式 VFI-PR 及配套数据集与评测协议 VFI-PEDES，并给出 VFI-ReID 框架，通过动态累积证据检索器与检索感知的提问优化，把检索候选产生的视觉反馈作为后续提问与重排序的补充证据。

**相关性简评：** 「查看候选—决定下一步取证—累积证据状态」的交互闭环，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、推理状态更新与何时停止取证相类比；但其证据状态如何表示、训练监督如何分配尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interactive Person Retrieval with On-the-Fly Visual Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Traditional text-based person retrieval (TPR) assumes that a witness provides a complete description at once, whereas interactive person retrieval (Inter-PR) refines a partial description through question-answer exchanges. In this setting, the questioner inspects retrieved candidates to decide what evidence to request next, while the answerer sees only the witness-side memory and cannot report candidate-specific visual differences. Existing methods mainly learn offline question orderings, leaving this visual-feedback loop underexplored. To address this limitation, we introduce visual-feedback interactive person retrieval (VFI-PR), a new interactive retrieval paradigm in which retrieved candidates produce visual feedback that becomes evidence for subsequent questioning and re-ranking. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we construct VFI-PEDES, a dataset and evaluation protocol for visual-feedback interaction, and propose VFI-ReID, a framework that learns to use visual feedback during interactive person retrieval. Through the Dynamic Accumulated-evidence Retriever (DAR) and retrieval-aware question optimization, VFI-ReID adapts retrieval and question generation to evolving evidence states, turning visual feedback into complementary evidence for subsequent retrieval. Experiments show that VFI-ReID consistently improves retrieval across VFI-PR interaction stages, demonstrating the utility of visual feedback for interactive person retrieval and outperforming existing Inter-PR baselines.

</details>

### 383. [Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10884v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10884

**作者：** Yutao Sun、Haokun Li、Mingshuai Chen、Guanyan Li、Zhongyi Wang、Shengchao Qin、Jianwei Yin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10884v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10884v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 LLM agent 在长程流程化任务中会偏离初始 SOP，重述指令或恢复中断只能把漂移搬家；作者提出把工作流状态放在模型上下文之外的可执行有限状态机，在工具调用、状态转移和轮次结束时强制约束，并在 SOP-Bench 等基准上验证长程可靠性提升。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态 latent reasoning 无直接关系，但「外部显式状态机 vs 模型内部隐式状态」的对照可为 latent 状态的维持、漂移诊断与停止决策提供问题表述上的启发，具体可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity

**abstract/A1：** Much of the automation handed to language-model agents is procedural: each step needs little intelligence, but a long unattended run must follow a skill or SOP stated once at the start. We show that agents drift from such procedures over long runs, and that restating the instructions or resuming a stopped agent only moves the drift to another shortcut. We study an executable finite-state machine (FSM) that keeps the workflow state outside the model's context and enforces it at three points: tool calls, state transitions and the end of the agent's turn. In a pre-registered experiment on 200-account SOP-Bench batches, Claude Haiku 4.5 with the FSM decided on average 139 accounts correctly and by the procedure, against 48 for the strongest baseline (95% CI of the difference \[46, 130\]), and kept this rate to the end; across three models, the gain tracked how much the plain agent drifted. Because the runtime, not the model, supplies this long-horizon reliability, the FSM can let small models carry procedural work: Haiku 4.5 with it averaged more such decisions than plain Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 38% of the cost. Analyses on SWE-bench Verified, $τ^2$-bench, and staged and cross-context workflows further suggest that reliable long-horizon automation can come from stronger execution control, not only stronger models.

</details>

### 384. [Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10891

**作者：** Prashanth Bhaskara、Shubhaankar Gupta、Seojoon Yeon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CE、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10891v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「Recall Fidelity Score」度量 LLM 对相近历史事件的内部知识精确度，并在已结算的预测市场上检验这种细节保真度与后续预测误差、与未结算市场价格偏离度的关系。

**相关性简评：** 该文把「内部知识保真度」与下游预测误差挂钩的诊断思路，可能启发核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否被忠实保留、其精度损失又如何传导到推理结论与证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit approximate recall: they retain coarse associations about past events while losing fidelity on specific details. Past research on LLMs has quantified different models' forecasting ability in real-world events using prediction markets, but has not studied how losing said fidelity impacts their forecasting abilities. For example: while an LLM correctly recalls that the answer to: ''Did Anna Sawai win the Best Drama Actress in the 76th Emmy Awards?'' is ''Yes,'' it incorrectly states the event date as September 22 rather than September 15. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric called the Recall Fidelity Score to study how imprecision in internalized knowledge propagates to forecasting capability on future events. On resolved historical markets, we find that higher local recall fidelity around semantically similar past events predicts lower forecasting error on resolved markets, and the same signal predicts smaller distance from open markets prices.

### 385. [Complementarity without ground truth?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10893v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10893

**作者：** Andrea Ferrario、Alessandro Facchini、Federico Cabitza

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10893v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10893v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文论证人机互补性评估不应局限于以 ground truth 为参照的预测任务，提出对治疗建议等决策支持场景用多准则决策分析式的两步评分构造情境依赖的「adequacy labels」，并借 computational reliabilism 显式化其中的规范性选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「无唯一正确答案时如何构造评价参照」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中缺乏标准答案时对 latent 中间状态或人机贡献分配的评估，但完全不涉及 VLM 内部表示与推理状态生成，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Complementarity without ground truth?

**abstract/A1：** Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 2 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 AI 生成文本检测器在短文本上的可靠性，给出阈值假阳性率随文本长度缩短而变化的闭式公式及达到目标真阳性率所需 token 数，并用长度分箱的 conformal 校准加「该长度下检测器无信息量则弃答」的分箱规则。

**相关性简评：** 其按证据量（长度）刻画可靠性与「信息不足即弃答」的决策框架，可能与 LVR 中基于证据充分性的 STOP 决策及推理预算评价相通，可供核查其分箱校准与弃答阈值能否转成停止准则。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Short Is Too Short? Length-Conditional Calibration and Abstention for Detecting AI-Generated Text

**abstract/A1：** Detectors of AI-generated text are usually tuned and tested on passages of several hundred tokens, yet many real cases are short. We study score-based detection as a function of passage length. We give a closed form for how the false-positive rate of a threshold set on long text changes as length falls, and a formula for the number of tokens a detector needs to reach a target true-positive rate. We calibrate thresholds within length bins with conformal p-values, and we add a bin-level rule that abstains when the detector cannot be informative at that length. On synthetic scores the formulas agree with simulation, and binned calibration holds the false-positive rate at its nominal value at every length. On three zero-shot detectors (log-likelihood, log-rank, Binoculars), three corpora and two open-weight generators, binned calibration gives a mean false-positive rate of 5.0% in every detector-length cell from 10 to 200 tokens, averaged over 300 random document-level resplits. A single threshold set at 200 tokens gives 29% for Binoculars at 10 tokens and about 1% for log-likelihood, as the closed form predicts. No detector reaches an 80% true-positive rate, and the best, Binoculars at 200 tokens, reaches 59%, so the rule abstains in every cell at that floor and releases only the 200-token bins at floors of 0.3 and 0.5.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出面向不确定性下二值决策的 prescriptive learning 框架，在训练中联合优化线性决策策略与各场景的可行分配，并扩展为基于 Wasserstein 模糊集的分布鲁棒机会约束形式，在机组组合与人员配置案例中检验分布偏移下的可行性与成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「模仿最优标签的预测式学习 vs 直接优化下游决策并施加可行性/鲁棒约束」的对比，可能与 LVR 中 latent 轨迹究竟以模仿推理标签还是以下游决策收益为监督目标的问题构成类比，可供核查；但材料不含视觉或多模态状态，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Prescriptive Learning of Linear Policies with Feasibility Guarantees for Binary Decision-Making

**abstract/A1：** Binary decision-making under uncertainty arises across a wide range of applications, including energy systems scheduling, transportation, and workforce planning. While machine learning has been increasingly applied to accelerate or replace mixed-integer solvers in such settings, existing approaches rely on predictive learning, training models to reproduce optimal decisions from labeled data, which lacks knowledge of counterfactual outcomes and provides no guarantees that the resulting decisions will be feasible. This limitation is further compounded under distributional shift, where policies trained on historical data may produce systematically infeasible decisions. We propose a prescriptive learning framework for binary decision-making that addresses both limitations. Rather than predicting optimal labels, the framework jointly optimizes over linear decision policies and feasible assignments across all training scenarios, allowing feasible alternatives and their operational performance to be considered directly during training. We further extend the framework to a distributionally robust chance-constrained formulation using a Wasserstein ambiguity set, which enforces feasibility with a prescribed probability under the worst-case distribution in the ambiguity set and enables a tunable trade-off between robustness and solution quality. We demonstrate the framework on two case studies, namely a unit commitment problem and a staff allocation problem. Out-of-sample experiments under test distributions that either match or differ from the training distribution show that the robust model is more conservative when the two distributions coincide, while under distributional shift it substantially reduces unmet demand and lowers total cost by up to 76.5% relative to classical predictive learning.

</details>

**作者：** Usha Shrestha、Radu Timofte、Dmitry Ignatov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在统一训练协议下比较九种数据变换设计策略（标准增强、暴力搜索、两个 LLM 直接生成代码、以及按精度排序数据微调后的性能引导生成），并分析用少 epoch 代理分数预测完整训练结果的可靠性。

**相关性简评：** 该文不涉及 latent 状态或视觉推理，但其「低成本代理评估与完整训练结果相关性从 0.756 到近零」的分析，可能为 LVR 中动态计算、提前停止的收益—成本评估与评价保真度提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Semantic Synthesis over Brute-Force Search: LLM-Guided Transformation Design for Efficient Learning

**abstract/A1：** Data transformation pipelines shape the training distribution in computer vision, but designing them is a computationally expensive problem. We investigate whether large language models can enable efficient discovery by synthesizing executable transformation programs outside predefined augmentation spaces. We compare nine strategies under a unified training protocol, including standard augmentation policies, brute-force search, direct code generation with two LLMs, and performance-guided generation using LLMs fine-tuned on accuracy-ordered transformation pairs. When the best candidates are retrained for 20 epochs, LLM-generated transformation programs lead on every dataset, reaching 0.8877 accuracy on CIFAR-10, 0.5825 on CIFAR-100, and 0.9588 on SVHN, surpassing brute-force search over 6,000 candidates. The best transform on CIFAR-10 and SVHN comes from a fine-tuned generator using 270 candidates, while the best on CIFAR-100 comes from an off-the-shelf generator using only 10. This needs 22x fewer candidate evaluations in the generation step and 600x fewer for off-the-shelf generations, relative to brute-force search. Beyond transformation discovery, we analyze the reliability of the reduced-budget evaluation commonly used for augmentation search. Correlating one-epoch selection scores with 20-epoch outcomes reveals strong, weak, and absent predictive relationships depending on the dataset and architecture, with correlations ranging from 0.756 to near zero. A positive control indicates that range restriction alone is unlikely to explain the low correlations. Our results indicate that semantic synthesis with code LLMs provides an efficient alternative to search-based transformation discovery and highlight the importance of validating evaluation fidelity when optimizing data transformations.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10945

**作者：** Trong Khiem Tran、Minh Long Bui、Phi Le Nguyen、Mrinal Sen、Sanjay Srinivasan、Trong Nghia Hoang、Jana Doppa

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10945v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10945v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CoupledFlow 神经算子框架：用结构约束的 flow matching 学习以完整多物理场状态为条件的各过程平均速度场，并借助后验多输出高斯过程采样相关插值样本，从而一步预测耦合 PDE 系统。

**相关性简评：** 属较远领域，但其一步 flow matching 加跨过程相关插值的做法，可能为 LVR 中并行/少步生成、以及视觉证据与推理状态耦合更新的成本对比提供概念线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoupledFlow: One-Step Neural Operators for Coupled Multi-Physics PDEs

**abstract/A1：** This paper introduces COUPLED FLOW, a new neural operator learning framework for multi-physics PDE systems that captures the co-evolution of multiple physical processes by modeling their cross-process interactions. Unlike existing neural operator methods that primarily target single-physics settings, COUPLED FLOW employs a novel structure-constrained flow matching algorithm to learn process- specific mean velocity fields conditioned on the full multi-physics state. This enables fast and accurate one-step prediction of coupled PDE systems that would otherwise require expensive numerical simulations. A key challenge in training COUPLED FLOW however lies in sampling structure-constrained conditional flow interpolants that capture cross-process correlations and serve as training examples for flow matching. To address this challenge, we derive a multi-physics mean-flow consistency identity that characterizes cross-process interactions and defines the structure-constrained mean-flow matching loss. To provide informative training samples for flow matching with this loss, we develop a principled method for sampling correlated conditional interpolants based on posterior multi-output Gaus- sian processes, which capture richer cross-process correlations than the commonly used endpoint-conditioned linear interpolants. We also establish a theoretical re- sult showing that the Wasserstein-2 distance between the predicted and oracle PDE solution distributions is upper-bounded in terms of the structure-constrained flow matching loss and the smoothness of the learned flow. Experiments across diverse coupled PDE benchmarks demonstrate that COUPLED FLOW consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators and generative PDE solvers.

**comment/C1：** Accepted NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10950

**作者：** Muhammad Ridwanul Hoquea、Sarah Sharif、Reza Saeed Kandezy、Yaser Banad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10950v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10950v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在智能电网场景评估可解释的多视图融合随机森林检测器，比较打乱交叉验证与滚动时间评估的乐观偏差，并在对抗攻击、真实 IEC-104 流量和 IEEE 14/118 母线状态估计上考察鲁棒性与可观测性极限。

**相关性简评：** 其「协议不一致时取悲观结果」的泄漏控制、多观测视图的可观测性上限分析，可能为 LVR 评测中信息泄漏与视觉证据可得性边界提供可供核查的思路，但领域较远、联系尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interpretable Cyber-Physical Attack Detection in Smart Grids: A Leakage-Controlled Multi-Testbed Evaluation of Fusion, Robustness, and Observability Limits

**abstract/A1：** Cyber-physical smart-grid detectors are typically treated as black boxes and validated exclusively on clean, temporally shuffled datasets, which risk overly optimistic performance claims. This work presents a multi-testbed evaluation study built around an interpretable, time-windowed fusion Random Forest, adopting the pessimistic result whenever evaluation protocols disagree. (i) On a public paired cyber-physical dataset, shuffled cross-validation is optimistic: macro-F1 falls from 0.96 to 0.88 +/- 0.06 under rolling-origin temporal evaluation. A topology-free graph convolutional network (GCN) serving as a control confirms that this lightweight model is competitive on these splits. (ii) The adaptive and adaptive-joint feature-space attacks, which are infeasible as realistic grid manipulations, degrade macro-F1 to 0.67 and 0.34, respectively. Adversarial training and randomized smoothing partially restore performance, and a physics-constrained evolution-strategy evasion on the IEEE 14-Bus testbed shows the same vulnerability pattern. (iii) On real IEC-104 traffic, the cyber view reliably catches structural attacks (recall of 0.87 to 0.98) but largely fails on semantic value manipulation (recall of 0.11 to 0.35). An observability taxonomy on the IEEE 14-Bus system reveals that stealthy false data injection defeats all three observation views. (iv) On a full AC weighted least-squares state-estimation testbed, a forecasting-aided temporal test is evaded by slow ramps precisely where a rate-invariant physics-manifold test sustains detection at a common 5% false-alarm target. A full end-to-end evaluation on IEEE 118-Bus confirms the ordering but bounds its strength: the manifold test detects every trial down to 0.05 degree/step and 0.48 at 0.02 degree/step, against 0.14 for the temporal test. All code and benchmarks are released.

</details>

### 391. [Improving Analytic Constants via Interpretable AI-Guided Lean Proof Refinement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10961v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10961

**作者：** Rahul Saha、Alan Li、Anton Xue、Swarat Chaudhuri、Adam Klivans、Pravesh K. Kothari、Raghu Meka

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、math.NA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10961v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10961v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作把数学证明写成部分形式化的 Lean「蓝图」依赖图，让 AI agent 保持依赖结构不变地迭代精化中间引理，从而把局部收紧传播为可验证的最终界，并在 Grothendieck 与 Korenblum 常数上给出改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「可人工检视的中间状态＋局部修改沿依赖图传播」结构，可能为 LVR 中如何组织、定位与验证中间推理状态及状态级贡献分配提供概念类比，但领域相距较远，需核查能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving Analytic Constants via Interpretable AI-Guided Lean Proof Refinement

**abstract/A1：** AI agents are increasingly capable of discovering new mathematical results, yet their reasoning and generated proofs can be difficult to understand and verify. We introduce an interpretable framework for AI-guided mathematical discovery, focused on improving quantitative bounds on analytic constants. Our key insight is that existing proofs often contain slack in intermediate lemmas, which can be tightened without reconstructing the entire argument. To exploit this structure, we represent proofs as partially-formalized Lean blueprints: human-interpretable dependency graphs of definitions, lemmas, and theorems. An AI agent then iteratively refines the Lean code while preserving the blueprint's dependency structure, allowing local improvements to automatically propagate to a verified final bound. This interpretable structure allows humans to inspect the agent's refinements and understand how local improvements propagate to the final theorem. For Grothendieck's constant ($\\mathcal{K}\_G$), we obtain $$ \\mathcal{K}\_G \\leq \\fracπ{2\\log(1+\\sqrt{2})} - 10^{-17}, $$ an explicit numerical improvement over Krivine's 1977 bound. For Korenblum's constant ($\\mathcal{K}\_K$), we obtain $$ \\mathcal{K}\_K \\geq 0.356565, $$ improving Wang's 2025 bound of $0.3554$. Our experiments demonstrate the potential of both partial formalization and iterative agentic refinement for interpretable mathematical discovery.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 JUBILEE：一个基于债务催收模拟器的 off-policy evaluation 基准环境，生成含竞争风险、稀有回收事件和同时影响动作分配的隐藏因子的贷款面板，并大规模比较 tabular 与 gradient-boosted 估计器的偏差、区间覆盖与决策后果。

**相关性简评：** 其核心发现——隐藏因子共变于动作与结果时策略价值估计系统性失效、且最优策略排序随价值定义改变——可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等策略在日志数据下的离线评估与混淆敏感性核查提供思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JUBILEE: A Benchmark Environment for Off-Policy Evaluation in Debt Collections

**abstract/A1：** Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value a candidate decision policy would achieve, using only data logged by the policy already in production. In debt collections, unrecorded factors can influence both actions and outcomes. This paper presents JUBILEE, a benchmark environment built around a debt-collections simulator that generates million-loan panels with competing risks, rare recovery events, and hidden factors driving both outcomes and assignment. The evaluation includes an 80-run comparison of tabular and gradient-boosted estimators under two synthetic outcome mechanisms and a 190-run parameter grid. Independent policy simulations provide reference values with estimated Monte Carlo uncertainty for a synthetic reward score and for simulated cash. With hidden factors influencing action assignment, several tabular methods agree closely while underestimating the field-visit policy's score, an error that also appears with boosted models. Intervals from tabular doubly robust estimation usually contain the reference without hidden assignment dependence but mostly miss it when that dependence is present. Estimates from randomized decisions do not show the same large error, although their limited precision leaves policy choice uncertain. The decision consequences depend on how policy value is defined. The field-visit policy ranks last under the score and first under simulated cash, which excludes channel costs. Under cash, log-based estimators miss this best candidate in nearly every run with hidden assignment dependence in the paired study. JUBILEE supports reproducible study of these failure modes under specified collections mechanisms.

### 394. [Sensitivity-Gated Accumulator Caching for On-Device Learning of Low-Bit Hand Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10991v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.10991

**作者：** Soroor Ghandali、Kanika Mamgain、Manjot Kaur、Akanksha Shukla、Shashira Guntuka

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10991v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10991v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SGAC：在设备端直接训练 4/8-bit 手部关键点网络的量化码，只对 Fisher 加权码步长最大的一小部分权重组保留 8-bit 残差累加器（组相联缓存），行被驱逐时以随机舍入整步写回，从而以约 8.1 bit/权重 的状态完成部署后适配。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其「在固定内存预算下按敏感度决定哪些状态值得保留、何时淘汰写回」的思路，可能为多步 latent 推理中状态/缓存的选择性保留与淘汰策略提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sensitivity-Gated Accumulator Caching for On-Device Learning of Low-Bit Hand Networks

**abstract/A1：** Small hand-tracking networks are deployed as 4- and 8-bit codes, and they should keep adapting to a user's camera after deployment, on the device and within roughly the memory of the model itself. Quantization-aware training cannot do this cheaply, because it keeps a 32-bit master copy of every weight together with its optimizer state, about 96 bits per weight. Training the codes directly with stochastic rounding needs no copy but injects rounding noise at every step, and the methods that remove this noise keep a residual buffer for every weight. We introduce sensitivity-gated accumulator caching (SGAC), which keeps residual state for only a small and changing set of weight groups. A set-associative cache of 8-bit accumulators collects the sub-step updates of the groups with the largest Fisher-weighted squared code step and writes them into the codes as whole steps; an evicted line is flushed by stochastic rounding, and a group without a line does not move until it is admitted. We prove that the write-back is unbiased and show, under a local quadratic model, that rounding a sub-step update costs loss of the same order as the update's own gain, so that rounding pays only where the expected gradient is large relative to the curvature. On a 383k-parameter hand-keypoint network, SGAC trains with 8.1 bits of state per weight. Scored on the 4/8-bit network that the device runs after adaptation, it has the highest mean accuracy of nine deployed low-bit networks on two simulated cameras. On twelve ImageNet-C corruptions it has the highest average of corrupted and clean accuracy of seven deployed methods, ahead of the PEQA-style, ECO-style and direct low-bit baselines with confidence intervals that exclude zero, and it matches an 8-bit accumulator kept for every weight with 56% of that state.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10996v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10996v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文形式化了不依赖「测试集留出」的可评价性概念：刻画仅观察测试集输出时能准确评价的分布类并给出紧的样本复杂度上下界，进而说明额外查询模型输入可提升评价能力，并联系到程序测试中的 self-corrector。

**相关性简评：** LVR 评测高度依赖留出基准，而轨迹训练易使测试样本进入训练；其「黑箱可评价性」与查询式主动取证的界限可能为核查 LVR 评测有效性提供概念工具，但材料未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，联系较为间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward a theory of Evaluability

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning models, particularly large foundation models, are increasingly evaluated along multiple axes that are relevant for their usage. In addition to accuracy measures appropriate for the specific task of interest, measures capturing safety, calibration and fairness properties are often of interest. The classical approach to these problems assumes that the test set has been held out from the training process, an assumption that is increasingly harder to justify for large foundation models. In this work, we formalize a notion of evaluability without this assumption, and ask if it is feasible to evaluate black-box models in settings where our test samples may have been used during training. We study this problem under different settings, capturing different levels of access to the model. We first study the natural setting, where the evaluator only looks at the output of the model on the test set. We fully characterize the class of distributions where accurate evaluation is possible, and show tight upper and lower bounds on the sample complexity of evaluation. Our results show that black-box evaluation in this setup is feasible if and only if the distribution is close to being small support. We then consider evaluation algorithms that can query the model on additional inputs and demonstrate connections to self-correctors studied in program testing. Using these, we show that a small amount of query access can increase the power of the evaluator for natural distributions and concept classes.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages. NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出可微的 agent-based 多级库存仿真框架，用可微张量运算实现随机动态下的梯度反传，无监督恢复报童模型最优解，并同时优化一万个异质策略、借梯度敏感性生成因果热图。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，但其沿计算图做梯度敏感性归因、在长程随机动态中定位时序依赖的做法，可能可供核查 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与深度/位置效应诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Differentiable Agent-Based Modeling for Multi-Echelon Supply Chains: Gradient-Based Optimization of Heterogeneous Policies at Scale

**abstract/A1：** Global supply chains rely on the interactions of thousands of heterogeneous agents, posing significant challenges for optimization. While traditional optimization often assumes homogeneity to ensure tractability, Reinforcement Learning struggles with sample inefficiency when scaling to high-dimensional state spaces. We propose a Differentiable Agent-Based Model for multi-echelon inventory management. By implementing stochastic dynamics via differentiable tensor operations, we enable direct gradient propagation through the simulation. We validate the framework by recovering theoretical Newsvendor optima without supervision. Crucially, we demonstrate \`\`Mass Personalization'' by optimizing 10,000 distinct agent policies simultaneously in seconds, achieving a 53% cost reduction compared to scalar baselines. Furthermore, we utilize gradient sensitivity analysis to generate causal heatmaps, accurately recovering inherent lead-time delays from the computation graph. This approach bridges the gap between simulation and optimization, enabling the efficient training of self-correcting Digital Twins.

### 397. [Elastic Representations via Hyperbolic Geometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11001v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11001

**作者：** Arjun Ramesh Kaushik、Rudrasis Chakraborty、Nalini Ratha、Venu Govindaraju

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11001v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11001v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HERL：不改动基座编码器，仅用轻量 adaptor 将表示降采样后映射到 Lorentz 双曲空间，实现可压缩也可扩展的维度自适应 embedding，并在图像与文本任务上验证性能保持与维度平滑插值。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关系，但其双曲几何 + adaptor 的可变维度表示思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的表示几何与维度预算选择提供参照，可供核查其几何结构是否利于保存层级化视觉细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Elastic Representations via Hyperbolic Geometry

**abstract/A1：** Learned representations (or embeddings) are the foundation of modern machine learning systems, yet they are typically trained as fixed-size embeddings, without accounting for varying downstream resource or task constraints. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) addresses this limitation by learning nested representations, but requires costly end-to-end retraining and does not support post hoc expansion, while Contrastive Sparse Representations (CSR) reduce training overhead via lightweight adaptors but operate at a 4x larger dimensionality. Additionally, all prior works restrict their framework towards compression only. In this work, we introduce Hyperbolic Elastic Representation Learning (HERL), a framework for learning dimension-adaptive embeddings (compression and expansion) through a lightweight adaptor without retraining the base encoder. Our key idea is to exploit the exponential capacity of hyperbolic geometry by learning a non-linear mapping from the encoder space to hyperbolic space. We train a simple MLP to downsample the representations before projecting them onto a Lorentzian and learn adaptive representations that respect the Lorentzian geometry. Our approach is model-agnostic and effective in both supervised and unsupervised settings. Through extensive experiments across image and text modalities, we show that HERL preserves downstream performance across a wide range of embedding sizes, exhibits smooth interpolation between dimensions, and achieves these benefits at a fraction of the computational cost. Code: https://github.com/arjunrkaushik/herl.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 398. [PIA: Agentic Physics-Informed Runtime Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11009v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11009

**作者：** Ali Mohammadi Ruzbahani、Abbas Yazdinejad、Hadis Karimipour

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11009v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11009v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PIA 让 LLM agent 依据物理模型自行编写由泵特性、质量平衡、控制器逻辑等物理残差组成的运行时异常检测器，并在部署前用正常工况数据在评估工作台上筛选候选；在 BATADAL 攻击基准上 F1 明显优于统计与深度基线，并能给出被攻击组件的归因。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成候选假设—用数据检验—淘汰仅凭先验写出的残差」闭环，与 LVR 中 latent 是否真正依赖视觉证据、以及如何筛选与停止的评估问题可能形成类比，可供核查数据接地检验的设计思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PIA: Agentic Physics-Informed Runtime Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Runtime anomaly detectors for cyber-physical systems are either learned as black boxes from normal data, which miss stealthy manipulations that keep every signal inside its normal range, or derived by hand from physical models, which requires expert effort for every plant. We introduce physicsinformed agents (PIA), in which a large language model agent writes the detector itself as a set of physical residuals, such as pump characteristics, tank mass balances, and controller logic, and refines every candidate against normal operating data through an evaluation workbench before deployment. The result is a compact, human-readable detector that runs in milliseconds and names the component behind each alarm. On the BATADAL water distribution attack benchmark, PIA with Claude Opus 5.5 reaches an F1 of 0.878 on the test attacks against 0.504 for the strongest of six statistical and deep baselines, keeps detecting attacks concealed by replayed and offset sensor readings, and attributes every detected test attack to the attacked component. Ablations show that testing hypotheses against data is decisive: agents that write residuals from the plant description alone lose up to 0.28 F1, whereas agents that see only anonymized signals recover most of the physical structure.

</details>

### 399. [Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11011

**作者：** Abdelrahman Sharafeldin、Yaqing Wang、Simon Sponberg、Hannah Choi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11011v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建多模态预测编码框架，从天蛾取食任务中的视觉与机械感觉观测学习动作条件下的不确定性降低图谱，并提出按感知不确定性在信息采集与利用之间切换的门控算法。

**相关性简评：** 其「动作—信息价值」图谱与不确定性门控切换，可能为 LVR 中何时继续获取视觉证据、何时停止并作答（LOOK/STOP）提供可核查的决策信号思路，但距离 VLM 内部状态机制尚远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths

**abstract/A1：** Animals integrate information across sensory modalities to guide exploration, suggesting that they maintain internal estimates of where actions are expected to reduce uncertainty. However, how such action-conditioned information maps are learned from multimodal sensory experience remains unclear, as previous studies have been largely confined to unimodal sensing frameworks. We introduce a multimodal predictive-coding framework for learning uncertainty-reduction maps from visual and mechanosensory observations in hawkmoth flower interaction tasks. A variational generative model trained on simulated environments recovers modality-specific information landscapes over the action space, capturing how visual patterns, surface geometry, and mechanosensory cues shape the value of exploratory actions. These learned maps are consistent with several features of hawkmoth behavior, including nonzero tracking offsets, probing along visual patterns, and geometry-dependent exploration. Applying the model to behavioral data from flower tracking and nectary search, we find that natural trajectories tend to occupy regions of high uncertainty reduction in these learned maps. Building on these observations, we develop an uncertainty-gated lexicographic algorithm that switches between information gathering and reward exploitation based on perceptual uncertainty. In nectary search, uncertainty gating improves learning relative to exploit-only, $ε$-greedy, fixed-time, and uncertainty-calibrated non-lexicographic controls, with better generalization and robustness to sensory and curvature shifts. These results link information landscapes learned through generative modeling to biological sensing and embodied exploration.

</details>

### 400. [Unified Factored Representations Resist Catastrophic Forgetting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11020v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11020

**作者：** Joel Lehman、Kenneth O. Stanley

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11020v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11020v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「表征遗忘假说」：具有统一因子化表征（UFR）的网络无需改动微调算法或架构即可抵抗灾难性遗忘，并用一维回归、图像回归实验及将 UFR 表征蒸馏进新网络的损失来支持该假说。

**相关性简评：** 表征的因子化与纠缠程度可能关系到 LVR 中内部状态能否保留任务必要的视觉信息，以及 latent 轨迹微调是否破坏既有能力，可供核查；但该文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unified Factored Representations Resist Catastrophic Forgetting

**abstract/A1：** This paper explores an unexpected connection between the quality of a neural network's (NN's) internal representation and its vulnerability to catastrophic forgetting. The representational forgetting hypothesis is that networks with unified, factored representation (UFR) can resist catastrophic forgetting without any modification to the underlying fine-tuning algorithm or network architecture. The key insight is that catastrophic forgetting may largely result from fractured entangled representation (FER): fine-tuning on only part of the input domain results in disruptive changes for other input patterns, because of how individual features are globally entangled. In contrast, if a gradient update is compatible with how a UFR network factors its representation, such an update may result in coordinated change across the input domain, alleviating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments in two domains provide evidence for this hypothesis: (1) an illustrative 1D regression task, in which UFR networks constructed by hand are compared against networks trained from scratch with SGD, and (2) an image-regression task with NNs previously shown to exhibit UFR. In both settings, UFR networks forget substantially less than their FER counterparts when repeatedly fine-tuned on UFR-compatible variations. Further experiments show that a training loss that distills UFR representations into fresh NNs reduces forgetting; along with several additional controls, these results help isolate representation as the critical factor. Together these results suggest that representational quality is an underappreciated contributor to catastrophic forgetting, and that the encouragement and maintenance of such quality may require attending to what patterns a particular NN is ready to learn.

</details>
