### 401. [Where Should Models Run? A Collaborative Inference Framework for Embodied Intelligence in 6G](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11023v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11023

**作者：** Wanlu Sun、Zhenhui Yuan、Xiang Ji、Yi Han、Qing Li、Gan Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11023v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11023v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文综述具身智能的协同推理，提出由边缘侧协调模型切分与执行的框架，并在 WiFi/5G 条件下为 ResNet-101、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 OpenVLA-7B 实测延迟最小的切分点。

**相关性简评：** 其按中间层切分并传输中间表示的成本核算，可能为 LVR 中推理深度、动态计算与 latent 传递的实际延迟代价提供参照，但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态本身，联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Should Models Run? A Collaborative Inference Framework for Embodied Intelligence in 6G

**abstract/A1：** Embodied intelligence systems rely on fast and reliable inference to enable real-time perception, reasoning, and control. Recent advances in large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have significantly enhanced the capabilities of embodied agents in complex environments. However, deploying these models remains challenging due to the limited computational resources and energy budgets of robotic platforms. A fundamental question is where inference should be executed. Collaborative inference, which partitions models across end devices, edge servers, and the cloud, has emerged as a promising solution. Yet determining the optimal partitioning point remains an open problem, as it depends on wireless network conditions, model structure, and privacy requirements. This article reviews the state of the art in collaborative inference for embodied intelligence and proposes an edge-centric framework in which the edge coordinates model partitioning and execution. Through both simulation and real-world experiments over WiFi and 5G networks, we demonstrate that the optimal partitioning strategy varies with network conditions and model structure. We further identify latency-minimizing partition points for ResNet-101, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and OpenVLA-7B in collaborative inference between NVIDIA Jetson Nano or AGX Xavier devices and an AGX Thor edge server under varying wireless conditions. Finally, we discuss the future directions for collaborative inference in 6G-empowered embodied intelligence systems.

**comment/C1：** Version 1 - Under Review

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究有向无环图中各智能体只观测部分输入坐标并利用父节点预测进行信息聚合的学习问题：修正了全消息协议的有限样本证明，并提出每个节点仅发送 k 维线性 sketch 的共享草图协议，用最小二乘加 oblivious subspace embedding 给出总体风险界，使统计项仍由样本量 m 控制、压缩误差由 k 控制。

**相关性简评：** 其「用低维 sketch 替代完整消息、并把统计误差与通信压缩误差分离刻画」的思路，可能为 LVR 中多模块或多智能体间压缩传递推理状态、以及缓存/通信预算受限时的信息保真度评估提供可供核查的理论视角。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Finite-Sample and Communication-Efficient Networked Information Aggregation

**abstract/A1：** Building on SODA 2026 work Kearns et al. (2026), we study learning in directed acyclic graphs in which each agent observes only a subset of the input coordinates and may use the predictions of its parents as additional features. In the finite-sample protocol, the message sent along each edge is the agent's prediction vector on a shared sample, so the communication cost is linear in the sample size $m$. In this paper we study this model under communication constraints. First, we revisit the finite-sample analysis of the full-message protocol. We identify a gap in the finite-sample proof of Kearns et al. (2026) and develop a different argument that establishes a finite-sample population-risk guarantee along paths satisfying deterministic $M$-coverage. Second, we introduce a shared-sketch protocol in which each agent sends a $k$-dimensional linear sketch of its prediction vector instead of the full $m$-dimensional message, where $k\\ll m$. We analyze this protocol through a reduction to least squares on the compressed sample together with an oblivious subspace embedding argument. The resulting bound separates statistics from communication: the statistical term is still governed by the original sample size $m$, while the additional error due to compression is controlled by the sketch dimension $k$. For Gaussian sketches, we obtain an explicit high-probability population-risk bound, showing that row subsampling is not the only possible communication-statistics tradeoff for networked information aggregation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

**作者：** Alexander Schubert、Anton Håkansson、Ziad Obermeyer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11063v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11063v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文形式化“选择性标签”下目标可恢复性失效机制：当标签只在被选择检测的人群中可见、且部分病例无法由模型输入识别时，学到的关系会在未检测人群中失效甚至反转，并以 ECG 预测急性冠脉综合征做实证。

**相关性简评：** 其“目标能否由输入推断”与在部署人群而非已测人群中评估的形式化，可能为 LVR 中判断答案是否真正依赖视觉 latent、以及筛选可被内部状态支持的预测目标提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Target Recoverability under Selective Labels: A Failure Mode in ECG-Based Acute Coronary Syndrome Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Medical machine learning models often learn from diagnoses observed only in patients clinicians chose to test. The biases of such selective labels are well known, but less understood is what happens when a diagnosis includes cases the model's inputs cannot detect. Because testing decisions draw on information the model does not see, these cases can appear predictable among tested patients, producing relationships that fail, and can even reverse, among the untested. We formalize this mechanism and show in simulations that it worsens as testing becomes more selective or undetectable cases more common, while models trained only on detectable cases remain informative. We empirically study electrocardiogram (ECG)-based prediction of acute coronary syndrome (ACS), which is confirmed only by invasive testing and whose subtypes differ in how clearly they appear on the ECG. Three ECG foundation models fine-tuned on revascularization, our ACS proxy, performed well among catheterized patients (AUROC 0.740-0.770) but worse than chance for 30-day major adverse cardiovascular events among untested patients (AUROC 0.381-0.478). Models trained on ECG-visible subtypes retained discrimination (AUROC 0.680-0.709), whereas a model trained on unstable angina, which can occur without ECG changes, was inversely related to risk (AUROC 0.310). Under selective labels, effective learning therefore requires prediction targets that can be inferred from the model's inputs and evaluation in the intended deployment population, which often extends beyond the patients who were tested.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the Proceedings of Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026

</details>

**abstract/A1：** Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Discrete Diffusion Playground: A 2D Benchmark for Discrete Generative Models

**abstract/A1：** Discrete diffusion is a promising framework for categorical generative modeling, but current evaluation protocols often fail to reveal whether models have actually learned the target distribution. We introduce the Discrete Diffusion Playground, a diagnostic benchmark that converts known 2D continuous distributions into binary token sequences through an exact discretized bijection. This creates a rare setting in which models are trained on discrete sequences, but generated samples can be decoded back into 2D and compared directly against a known ground-truth distribution. The benchmark spans smooth Gaussian mixtures and tilted checkerboards with sharp boundaries, disconnected support, and coordinate-dependent structure, allowing it to expose failures that are invisible in standard proxy metrics. It supports exact grid divergences, Wasserstein distances, density visualizations, and nonparametric two-sample tests, providing both quantitative evaluation and interpretable failure diagnosis. Using this testbed, we show that masked diffusion models can learn meaningful adaptive reveal orders but remain less stable than autoregressive baselines on smooth targets and largely fail on tilted checkerboards, where autoregressive models preserve the target geometry. Control experiments with reversed and interleaved token orderings show that autoregressive performance is not explained by favorable bit order alone. The Playground provides a simple but stringent benchmark for stress-testing discrete generative models and for developing evaluation metrics that detect real distributional mismatch rather than proxy performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/shaojus/DiscreteDiffusionPlayground .

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 7 main figures, 2 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)

</details>

### 406. [System Prompts Affect Response Bias More Than Discriminability in LLM Safety](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11074v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11074

**作者：** Mohan W. Gupta、Sandy Tanwisuth

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11074v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11074v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在固定基准条目下交叉八类安全任务系统提示与三种清晰度，用信号检测论将模型表现分解为「区分安全与不安全请求的能力」和「拒答倾向」，发现系统提示主要改变后者。

**相关性简评：** 其「判别力 vs 决策准则」分离的评价框架可能可供核查：用于检验 LVR 中增加 THINK/LOOK 的收益究竟来自证据辨别力提升，还是仅来自停止或作答阈值的偏移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** System Prompts Affect Response Bias More Than Discriminability in LLM Safety

**abstract/A1：** Large language model safety evaluations often focus on a compliance-refusal tradeoff: models should refuse unsafe requests without refusing safe ones. We argue that this misses a broader form of prompt-conditioned task selection, where the same request can elicit different behaviors depending on the system prompt. We investigate this using a controlled evaluation crossing eight safety-task prompt families with three clarity levels across HarmBench, XSTest, and IHEval. Holding benchmark items fixed, we evaluate 13 models and use signal detection theory to distinguish two possibilities: whether models become better at telling safe from unsafe requests (discriminability), or simply more willing to refuse (response criterion). We find substantial differences in discriminability across models, but system prompts primarily shift the willingness to refuse, with smaller and less consistent effects on discriminability. Increasing prompt clarity makes models more willing to refuse without reliably improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe requests. Beyond refusal, prompt families also shift responses among six distinct behavioral policies, including clarification and safe help. Together, these findings show that system prompts primarily change how models respond to safety-relevant requests rather than consistently improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe ones.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 4 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ADC-RANet，在分辨率自适应网络 RANet 上组合自底向上通道注意力、自顶向下级联知识蒸馏与基于 MixUp 的过度自信校正，在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上于各计算预算下提升图像分类表现。

**相关性简评：** 其按样本难度逐级分配分辨率与计算、并校正如置信度，与 LVR 中逐步获取视觉证据和「何时停止」的预算决策可能存在类比线索，但该工作在单图分类、无推理状态，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ADC-RANet: Improving Resolution Adaptive Neural Networks with Attention, Distillation and Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Dynamic neural networks are a class of adaptive models in which the computation assigned to each input sample is determined dynamically, potentially reducing computational cost while maintaining similar performance. For image classification, the Resolution Adaptive Network (RANet) is a strong approach that progressively allocates computational resources across input scales based on sample difficulty. In this work, we introduce RANet with Attention, Distillation and Calibration (ADC-RANet), an enhanced version of RANet that improves performance across all computational budgets. Our approach combines three tightly connected components: bottom-up channel attention, top-down cascaded knowledge distillation, and overconfidence correction using MixUp, in a synergistic design that coordinates both pathways. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet datasets show consistent gains while preserving the efficiency of RANet. Our code is available: https://github.com/jefersonseverino/ADC-RANet

</details>

**作者：** Karanpartap Singh、Yue Zhao、Mohammad H. Abbasi、Ehsan Adeli

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HBAR，将体素级静息态 fMRI 组织为「子分区体素组—分区—大尺度功能网络」的层级化 tokenizer，支持固定图谱、完全学习与软先验引导三种层级，在 HCP-YA 上以最高约 415 倍压缩获得高于同压缩率平坦 tokenizer 的分区与网络相关性，并考察人口学读出。

**相关性简评：** 其多尺度层级化离散 token 与「高压缩下仍保留细粒度空间信息」的评估方式（压缩率匹配比较、打乱解剖分组的消融）可能为 LVR 中视觉 token 的层级组织与信息坍缩诊断提供参考，但模态与任务差异较大，可供核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Hierarchical Tokenization Framework for Voxel-Level fMRI Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** We introduce HBAR (Hierarchical Brain Activity Representation), a hierarchical tokenization framework for learning compact, multi-scale representations of neuroimaging data. HBAR organizes voxel-level resting-state fMRI into a hierarchy spanning sub-parcel voxel groups, parcels, and large-scale functional networks, enabling up to 415x compression while preserving fine-grained spatial information beyond conventional parcellation. The framework supports fixed atlas-based, fully learned, and softly prior-guided hierarchies, allowing us to systematically study the role of structured priors in brain representation learning. On HCP-YA, at approximately 415x compression, HBAR achieves higher parcel and network correlations than rate-matched flat tokenizers, while at a lower 52x compression rate, shuffling the anatomical grouping reduces parcel correlation from 0.920 to 0.886. Demographic readouts with autoregressive training also reveal potential gains from the hierarchical structure. By combining sub-parcel inputs, compact discrete tokens, and multiscale brain structure, HBAR offers a practical framework for representation learning in high-dimensional neuroimaging data.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/su-karanps/HBAR

</details>

### 409. [SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11087v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11087

**作者：** Lei Shu、Alberta Longhini、Leonidas Guibas、Gordon Wetzstein、Jeannette Bohg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11087v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11087v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SoftPAT3D，将文本生成的布料、毛绒玩具、绳索等可形变物体转为可直接仿真的物理有效资产：从制造方式构造静止形状、由材料库赋初值，并把物体放入无穿模的初始位姿，用统一接触模型驱动到静态平衡；失败时用网格搜索与可微仿真的伴随梯度修正放置与材料参数，并用几何检查加 VLM 判定完成。

**相关性简评：** 主题上属 3D 资产与物理仿真生成，与视觉推理主线相距较远；但「在物理状态上做伴随梯度优化以达成目标」可能为 latent 状态的贡献分配与目标优化提供线索，「VLM 校验完成」也可供核查验证与停止判据的用法。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables

**abstract/A1：** We present SoftPAT3D, a physics-augmented framework for text-to-3D scene generation in which deformable objects, such as cloth, stuffed toys and ropes, are generated as physically valid, simulation-ready bodies and placed in intersection-free contact with the furniture that supports them, with one another and with themselves. Existing physics-augmented pipelines simulate rigid bodies only and cannot accommodate a generated deformable object, which text-to-3D generation returns as a geometrically invalid mesh, sometimes self-intersecting, that has no rest shape, no material model and no admissible initial state. These are the inputs a deformable simulation requires, and we construct each from information already in the pipeline. The rest shape comes from how the object is manufactured rather than from the generated physically inconsistent deformed configuration, and a material library assigns each deformable object its initial elastic parameters, which can then be optimized. The occluded support is regenerated and converted into a watertight collision mesh, each object is released from an optimizable placement above the supporting part that the prompt specifies, and the complete scene is driven to static equilibrium under one unified contact model, with completion verified by geometric checks and a vision-language model. When a scene fails the prompt, a grid search over placements corrects it, and the adjoint of a differentiable simulation of the same contact energy reaches the targets the grid does not, places several bodies jointly and recovers and optimizes material parameters. Multi-body scenes equilibrate in a single simulation, and the pipeline also runs from the text prompt alone. On all sixty-five prompts, SoftPAT3D produces no undesired interpenetration of any kind, whereas every other system does, and its scenes directly support scene editing and robotic manipulation.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 410. [Uncertainty-Guided Reward Labeling for Reinforcement Learning under Limited Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11091v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11091

**作者：** Renhao Zhang、Shreyas Chaudhari、Bruno Castro da Silva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11091v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11091v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究有限反馈离线强化学习中的奖励标注选择问题：在标注可保留并用于训练奖励模型的设定下，给出所学策略次优性的上界，并提出 SURE 方法，用 successor features 优先标注既不确定又处于可到达高价值状态区域的样本。

**相关性简评：** 其「不确定性高且通往高回报状态」的预算化查询选择准则，可能为 LVR 中有限预算下挑选视觉证据或标注样本、权衡信息价值与下游收益提供概念借鉴，但与原论文的多模态推理场景对应关系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncertainty-Guided Reward Labeling for Reinforcement Learning under Limited Feedback

**abstract/A1：** In reinforcement learning from limited feedback (RLLF), only a small fraction of an offline dataset can be labeled with rewards, and the central question is which samples should be labeled to learn a high-performing policy from the resulting partially labeled dataset. Prior work formalized this as a reward-selection problem by focusing on the selection stage while treating downstream policy learning as a black box, in a regime where queried rewards are not retained for reward-model training. We instead study the retained-label setting, where queried rewards can be stored and used to fit a reward model before policy learning. We bound the suboptimality of the learned policy in terms of two sources of error: one arising from offline RL on a fixed, offline dataset, and the other from uncertainty in the reward model. Since reward selection cannot change the offline dataset, the limited labeling budget must be used to strategically reduce reward uncertainty. Motivated by RLLF's observation that useful rewards tend to keep the agent on high-return trajectories, we introduce Successor-Guided Uncertainty REduction (SURE), a novel method that uses successor features to select rewards that are both uncertain and associated with states from which high-valued states are reachable. We formally derive SURE from a bound-induced design objective and characterize its exact one-step marginal gain. Empirically, SURE reaches near full-feedback performance with few reward labels across a variety of domains and offline-RL backbones, yielding an effective method for feedback-efficient reinforcement learning.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究视觉上下文学习（VICL）可提示分割在仅能观察输出 RGB、且部署提示未知条件下的定向攻击，提出 Color Hijack 与 Task Hijack 两种外观空间攻击，并用由干净查询及其输出构造的自提示代理（SPS）提升跨未知提示迁移，在 SegGPT 等四个模型及自动标注下游任务上验证破坏效果。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接机制联系，但其把「提示条件输出渲染」当作攻击面、并在输出空间造成前景与实例颜色坍缩，可能可供核查视觉细节是否真正被使用而非旁路；自提示代理的构造思路或可启发在无内部访问时探测 conditioning 的作用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Query-Only Prompt-Agnostic Attacks on Visual In-Context Learning

**abstract/A1：** Visual In-Context Learning (VICL) enables promptable segmentation by conditioning RGB predictions on visual demonstrations, making it attractive for auto-labeling, but its robustness under query-only access and unknown deployment prompts remains underexplored. We study query-only, prompt-agnostic targeted attacks where the attacker observes only returned RGB outputs, without access to model internals or deployment prompts. Treating prompt-conditioned RGB rendering as a distinct attack surface, we introduce two appearance-space attacks: Color Hijack (CH) drives foreground colors toward the background to suppress visibility, while Task Hijack (TH) collapses instance-distinguishing colors toward a shared color assignment. To transfer across unseen prompts, we propose a Self-Prompt Surrogate (SPS) constructed from the clean query and its output. In a paired, matched-budget SegGPT comparison, SPS outperforms the Random-Prompt Surrogate (RPS), reducing CH instance foreground retention from 0.918 to 0.155 and TH palette-aware tolerance distance from 0.345 to 0.225. Across four VICL models on COCO and HierText, CH suppresses foregrounds across semantic-, instance-, and text-style outputs, while TH collapses instance colors under held-out deployment prompts. After palette-based decoding, TH also reduces the decoded instance count and mask retention while increasing instance merges. Finally, at 30% corruption, CH-corrupted annotations from a publicly accessible VICL-based auto-labeling pipeline reduce downstream YOLO-seg mAP50 from 0.761 to 0.281.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「去掉含答案信息的输入再重拟合探针」的做法可能为 LVR 中判别表征是否真正依赖视觉证据、而非语言先验或捷径提供评价思路，匹配文本对照与跨端点排序稳定性可供核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When gene summaries reveal the answers: Gene Ontology circularity in gene embedding benchmarks

**abstract/A1：** A gene summary can contain the very annotations used to evaluate an embedding of its text. The Alliance of Genome Resources converts Gene Ontology (GO) annotations into sentences, which NCBI Gene displays and GenePT includes in its input. These summaries covered 6,172 of 19,256 human protein-coding genes (32.1%), including 58% of genes with one to ten linked publications. We embedded the same corpus with and without the generated summaries and refitted a function-prediction probe on each version. Among genes with one to ten publications, removal reduced the reported per-gene area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) by 0.078 with a linear probe (95% bootstrap interval 0.072-0.084) and by 0.033 with a multilayer perceptron. These estimates use a historical GO scorer that mishandled ties. The original predictions are unavailable for rescoring. A simple TF-IDF encoder also benefited from the summaries, as did models evaluated only on experimental annotations. Replacing generated summaries with UniProt function descriptions recovered much of the lost performance despite little verbatim overlap. UniProt also curates many of the evaluation labels. In mouse and yeast, we found a similar dependence on the source of the description. We introduce GeneProv to compare encoders on matched text and to examine how representation rankings change across GO recovery, non-GO endpoints and co-essentiality.

### 413. [Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11169v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11169

**作者：** Jian Gao、Lin-Zhuo Chen、Yihang Chen、Jiagang Chen、Jiacheng Dong、Xun Cao、Nan Xue、Yinghao Xu、Yao Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11169v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11169v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Map2SLAM 将冻结的流式 3D 基础模型输出的位姿与稠密几何预测当作外部持久 SLAM 状态的观测，仅训练轻量检索头，并设计关键帧写入与异步回访重推理机制，在多个数据集上降低轨迹误差并保持实时。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测可被修订的持久状态」与「何时、对哪些旧帧重新观测」的调度，可能为 LVR 的动态计算、证据回访与停止决策提供类比；共享缓存特征驱动回访检索，也或可供核查 latent 相似度与缓存结构的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM

**abstract/A1：** Streaming 3D foundation models (3DFMs) estimate camera poses and dense geometry online, but they fall short of SLAM: their predictions are fixed once emitted, so loop closures cannot correct accumulated drift. With such models already providing strong geometric capability, a central question for SLAM becomes how to schedule their inference and how to keep its results as revisable state. We present Map2SLAM, which keeps LingBot-Map frozen, trains only a lightweight retrieval head, and builds SLAM on the model's inference interface, turning its predictions into observations of an external persistent SLAM state. The front-end tracks every incoming frame with the model's causal streaming inference and decides which frames are written to the persistent state as keyframes. The back-end asynchronously decides when and which past frames to re-observe, re-running the model's joint inference over them with fresh context; verified loop observations correct the trajectory online, and segment observations refine dense geometry after the sequence. All invocations share a single frame encoder pass per image, whose cached features also drive loop retrieval, so frequent re-invocation incurs no additional encoding cost. Map2SLAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, VBR, and Oxford Spires, reducing mean ATE by over 40% compared with the best uncalibrated baselines, while maintaining real-time tracking at over 28 FPS at a resolution of $518\\times154$ on an NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU. Please visit our project page at https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 10 figures. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11177v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11177v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究共享 checkpoint 周围随机扰动所得任务专家能否组合，提出以严格联合成功率与最差任务增益衡量专家对选择，并给出质量约束的谱选择流程与 Base 回退机制。

**相关性简评：** 其「邻近或正交不足以保证可组合」的分解与含弃权项、回归率的联合保留评价，或可为多 latent 模块/能力组合及 STOP 式弃权决策的目标设定提供核查线索，但与视觉推理本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets

**abstract/A1：** Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文提出基于扰动的视频动作识别后验解释框架，将证据拆成空间外观掩码与时间运动掩码，在冻结模型上联合优化并加入分离惩罚与面积约束，同时设计分别扫描像素与帧的评估协议。

**相关性简评：** 其把外观与运动证据分离并用扰动与删除曲线衡量各自因果贡献的表述与评价方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和空间、时间贡献归因提供可供核查的思路，但对象是视频动作识别而非多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Disentangling Where and When:Factored Spatio-Temporal Explanations for Video Action Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc explanation methods for video action recognition typically conflate spatial appearance and temporal dynamics into a single saliency or importance map. We propose a perturbation-based framework that disentangles these contributions into a spatial appearance mask ($M\_a$) and a temporal motion mask ($M\_m$). The two masks are jointly optimized against a frozen action recognition model through factored perturbation architecture, with nearest frame replacement to identify important temporal dynamics. A separation penalty discourages the appearance mask from spending budget on frames that the motion mask has already discarded. A ReLU-based area constraint penalizes explanations larger than an assigned budget. To evaluate these explanations, we introduce a separation protocol that sweeps spatial pixels and temporal frames independently, backed by proofs characterizing the proposed method. Across EPIC-Kitchens-55, EGTEA Gaze+, and Something-Something V2, our method attains the lowest deletion AUC against leading baselines while producing masks roughly five times sparser.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

**作者：** Yu Liu、Xingbang Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LoMASA，一个单机运行、无需训练的多智能体 B2B 报价助手：35B MoE 的 System-1 单次前向做决策并从选项概率读取置信度，不确定时由 27B 的 System-2 生成回复，价格与硬性规则由代码强制执行，并在 500 个模拟回合上报告自动化率、升级率与延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其「置信度门控委派」可看作按不确定度分配计算与决定何时停止的信号，或可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策与置信度校准的借鉴；但任务为纯文本报价、无视觉证据或 latent 状态，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting

**abstract/A1：** Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

</details>

### 417. [Chatter Attack: Resource Consumption Attack for Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11261v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11261

**作者：** Yibo Miao、Yichuan Cao、Xiao-Shan Gao、Yinpeng Dong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CR、cs.CV、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11261v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11261v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Chatter Attack，用对抗提示让模型先输出简短的「自我怀疑」短语，再用推理期注意力损失与全局熵损失把该状态维持到后续生成，从而大幅拉长输出；同时给出贝叶斯提示优化以适配黑盒场景。

**相关性简评：** 该文从攻击视角刻画输出终止与推理成本如何被提示操纵，其中用注意力与熵损失维持生成状态的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策的稳健性与实际成本评价，但不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Chatter Attack: Resource Consumption Attack for Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** LLMs are powerful but incur substantial inference cost, which can be exploited by malicious users to induce overly long outputs, increasing latency and operational expense. Prior resource consumption attacks either coerce repetition or suppress the end-of-sequence token by lowering its logit value. However, with autoregressive, sampling-based generation, the search space grows exponentially with length and small deviations or unstable trajectories can derail optimization, limiting attack effectiveness and stability. To address this issue, we introduce Chatter Attack, a novel class of resource consumption attacks that optimize adversarial prompts to induce predefined short target phrases, thereby avoiding search-space explosion while still eliciting long responses. Specifically, Chatter Attack triggers self-doubt using short doubt-inducing phrases as the target, and sustains this state throughout generation via inference attention loss and global entropy loss. To extend to black-box settings, we further propose a novel Bayesian Prompt Optimization (BPO) method, which models the objective function globally by constructing a discrete token kernel, efficiently exploring the entire search space using prior information. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method outperforms baselines, with maximum response length increases to 31.5$\\times$, and revealing practical resource-depletion risks for real-world LLM inference services.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 418. [How Efficient Is Your Agent? Online Predictive Bounds under Budget Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11279v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11279

**作者：** Roy Maor Lotan、Shai Feldman、Yaniv Romano

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11279v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11279v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PROBE：在任务顺序到达、预算有限且部分运行因提前停止导致 time-to-success 右删失的情况下，在线构建经过校准的成功时间上界预测，并自适应地在任务间分配预算以降低覆盖缺口，同时给出有限时域下的覆盖保证。

**相关性简评：** 其「预算约束下右删失反馈＋在线校准上界」的统计框架可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与动态计算成本的评价提供可借用的度量工具，但论文对象是 agent 级效率而非推理内部状态，与视觉证据或 latent 表示无直接关联，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Efficient Is Your Agent? Online Predictive Bounds under Budget Constraints

**abstract/A1：** We evaluate AI agents in an online setting where tasks arrive sequentially and, before running each task, we construct an upper predictive bound on its \\emph{time-to-success}---the number of interactions until the task is completed successfully. Under a limited budget, some runs are stopped early, so their time-to-success is unobserved (right-censored), and the correctness of the bound may be unknown. We introduce \\emph{\\textbf{PR}edictive Bounds for \\textbf{O}nline \\textbf{B}udget \\textbf{E}fficiency} (\\texttt{PROBE}), a method for constructing calibrated upper predictive bounds while adaptively allocating a limited budget across agent tasks to reduce the anticipated coverage deficit. Our method calibrates the bounds online using inverse-probability-weighted feedback together with a correction designed to minimize coverage deficit while remaining unbiased. We prove that \\texttt{PROBE} provides a coverage guarantee for any finite time horizon while satisfying the budget constraint. Experiments on software engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and instruction following show that \\texttt{PROBE} attains a coverage rate closer to the target level with tighter predictive bounds than a calibrated baseline.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11304

**作者：** Chenhao Guan、Liying Yang、Xinxing Yu、Hao Mo、Tianshun Han、Renjun Gao、Yanyan Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11304v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11304v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 TransArt3D，从两张端点图像重建带关节的可交互 3D 资产，把视频扩散的过渡先验转成显式部件结构与关节运动学，并用其监督整段过渡上的 3D 运动场。

**相关性简评：** 其「用整段过渡约束运动场、把不变区域与运动部件分离，避免单状态误差渗入结构」的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分任务不变内容与随推理推进的状态变化提供概念线索，但属 3D 资产重建，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors

**abstract/A1：** Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.

</details>

### 420. [Shape-Adaptive Subspace-Constrained Quadratic Matrix Factorization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11313v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11313

**作者：** Zheng Zhai、Zhuan Liang、Sujun Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11313v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11313v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AMLE-SQMF，将子空间约束的二次流形拟合与广义高斯残差建模联合估计，用剖面负对数似然在交替优化中自适应确定噪声形状参数与相应损失。

**相关性简评：** 该方法可作为刻画非线性低维流形的工具，或可用于检验 VLM 内部状态是否保留任务必要的几何结构、以及结果对表示噪声分布的敏感性，需核查其适用条件。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Shape-Adaptive Subspace-Constrained Quadratic Matrix Factorization

**abstract/A1：** Quadratic manifold fitting provides a flexible framework for modeling nonlinear low-dimensional structures embedded in high-dimensional spaces. However, existing methods typically employ prescribed noise models or fixed loss functions, limiting their adaptability to varying noise characteristics. To address this limitation, we propose an alternating maximum likelihood estimation method for subspace-constrained quadratic matrix factorization, termed AMLE-SQMF, which jointly estimates the quadratic manifold and the underlying noise distribution. Specifically, we model the residuals using a generalized Gaussian distribution (GGD), whose shape parameter controls the tail behavior and determines the associated fitting loss. By exploiting the closed-form maximum likelihood estimator of the scale parameter, we eliminate the scale variable and derive a profile negative log-likelihood. Based on this formulation, we develop an alternating optimization algorithm that iteratively updates the manifold parameters and estimates the noise shape parameter. This enables adaptive loss selection within a unified likelihood-based framework, without requiring prior specification of the noise characteristics. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of AMLE-SQMF in quadratic manifold fitting and its robustness to diverse noise distributions.

</details>

**title/T1：** When Sensors Fail: Coverage Auditing with Incomplete Sensor Records

**abstract/A1：** Sensor outages can conceal prediction-interval coverage deficits behind acceptable marginal performance, while unavailable future readings leave some issued forecasts unscorable. We present a measurement-record audit that links issue-time outage duration, original target availability, and time-uniform statistical evidence. The audit retains complete forecast keys, batches all sensors and overlapping horizons at each measurement tick, and projects simultaneous covered-count and scored-count bounds onto a cumulative conditional expected coverage ratio. This target is distinguished from empirical coverage and outage-conditional population coverage. Selected traffic and air-quality results illustrate the gap between pooled and long-outage coverage; in METR-LA, only 7.6% of issued long-gap forecasts have originally observed targets. Of 30 primary sequential outage-state audits, 26 are inconclusive and four lack scored support. This concise presentation gives the core construction and selected aggregate evidence without the full experimental supplement.

**作者：** Yiming Xu、Xian Wei、Cheng Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究未知转移下随机最短路径（SSP）的在线强化学习，提出按轮次运行、采用对数时间相关采样数并借伪状态引入乐观性的后验采样算法 OPSRL-SSP，证明其遗憾阶与 minimax 下界匹配，并推广到零代价 SSP。

**相关性简评：** SSP 中的终止成本与「何时停止」决策在概念上可能对应 LVR 的 STOP 收益—成本权衡，乐观后验采样也可供核查作为不确定性下获取证据与分配计算的思路，但属远领域迁移，需阅读原文判断可用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OPSRL-SSP: Optimistic Posterior Sampling for Stochastic Shortest Path with Minimax-Optimal Regret

**abstract/A1：** We study online reinforcement learning for the stochastic shortest path (SSP) problem with unknown transition dynamics. Although existing posterior-sampling methods perform well empirically on SSPs, their regret guarantees do not achieve the minimax-optimal order. We address this limitation by proposing OPSRL-SSP, an optimistic posterior-sampling algorithm for the SSP setting. The algorithm operates in epochs and uses a logarithmic, time-dependent schedule for the number of posterior samples. To induce optimism, we augment the transition model with a pseudo-state assigned an optimistic boundary value. We establish a high-probability regret bound of $\\tilde{O}(B\_\\star \\sqrt{SAK} + B\_\\star S^2 A)$, where $B\_\\star$ is an upper bound on the expected cost of the optimal policy, $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively, and $K$ is the number of episodes. In addition, we extend the analysis to general zero-cost SSPs using a universal cost-perturbation argument. The leading term matches the minimax lower bound $Ω(B\_\\star \\sqrt{SAK})$, thereby addressing the open problem raised by Jafarnia-Jahromi et al. \[19\] for posterior sampling in the SSP setting.

</details>

**作者：** Arkid Mitra

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11342v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11342v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在权重固定的 9B 模型上，由更大教师模型依据智能体的失败轨迹撰写 harness 笔记，并与「看不到失败轨迹」的同等笔记搜索对比，检验失败轨迹的增量价值，另对单条教训做严格筛选与测试项盲审。

**相关性简评：** 其把增益归因于失败轨迹本身、并指出搜索基线已占约六成改进的对照思路，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督的贡献分配与评测效度核查提供概念借鉴，但与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces

**abstract/A1：** We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.

### 424. [Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11423v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11423

**作者：** Zhijie Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11423v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11423v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究有限时域 MDP 的离线策略优化：在「所有确定性策略的 action-value 均对已知特征线性可实现」这一强假设下，给出样本依赖 Õ(ε^{-2})、计算复杂度仅对 log(2+B) 多项式的算法，每层只做一次凸回归，并配有下界说明 ε 的指数 2 不可改进。

**相关性简评：** 「全策略线性可实现＋占用覆盖」配合截断杠杆与置信半径向上取整，可能为核查 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及由预测误差转为逐点置信提供理论视角，但与视觉推理的状态生成与证据获取机制相距较远，仅供外围借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability

**abstract/A1：** We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most $B$. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with $\\widetilde O(\\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in $\\log(2+B)$. The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale $B^{-2}$. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on $B$. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent $2$ is necessary.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages

</details>

### 425. [Learning to Rank Propagators in Constraint Programming](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11447v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11447

**作者：** Matija Lojović、Mladen Nikolić

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11447v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11447v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文将约束编程中传播器（propagator）的执行优先级学习表述为 learning-to-rank 问题：用自注意力模型基于静态实例特征联合打分，以随机优先级下的求解耗时提炼成对偏好、按 Plackett-Luce 目标训练，在搜索前映射为 Choco 的离散优先级；在 XCSP3 上报告难题集解出数从 634 升至 654、中位耗时降约 28%。

**相关性简评：** 其「个体标签不可观测、仅能由端到端耗时得到集合级偏好」的监督形式，以及按实例学习计算步骤（传播器）执行次序，可能与 LVR 中 latent 步骤的贡献分配与推理顺序安排形成类比，可供核查但迁移距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Rank Propagators in Constraint Programming

**abstract/A1：** The order in which propagators are executed can substantially affect the performance of constraint programming solvers, yet propagator priorities are typically determined by fixed, manually designed heuristics. In this work, we explore learning instance-dependent propagator priorities from static problem features. We formulate the task as a learning-to-rank problem, addressing the challenge that the quality of a priority assignment can be measured through solver runtime, while the desired priorities of individual propagators are not directly observable. A self-attention-based model jointly scores the propagators present in an instance and is trained using pairwise preferences derived from solver runtimes measured under randomized propagator priority assignments, with a Plackett-Luce-based ranking objective. Predicted rankings are mapped to the discrete priority levels of the Choco solver before search begins, without modifying its propagation or search procedures. We evaluate the approach on XCSP3 instances and demonstrate that propagator ordering can have a substantial impact on solving time. On a test set of 698 instances, picked out as most difficult by problem class, the learned priorities increase the number of solved instances from 634 to 654, reduce median solver runtime by 27.93%, and reduce aggregate penalized runtime (PAR1) by 12.65% compared with Choco's default priorities. We further observe that improvements vary across problem classes and show that a simple policy selecting between learned and default priorities further increases the number of solved instances. These results demonstrate the potential of learning instance-dependent propagator priorities to improve constraint programming performance, particularly on difficult instances.

</details>

### 426. [MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11457v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11457

**作者：** Sunny Gupta、Raja Viswanadha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11457v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11457v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 MOMENT-DP 框架，用优化器传递算子刻画时间相关隐私噪声如何经动量状态传播到局部二次目标的最终损失，并指出仅改变动量即可导致噪声机制效用排序反转。

**相关性简评：** 其「扰动经带状态递归传播并影响终局损失」的算子式分析，可能为核查循环式 latent 推理中误差与信息随步数累积、衰减和长度泛化提供形式化透镜；但该文面向隐私效用评价，与视觉推理无直接关联，迁移需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOMENT-DP: Momentum Aware Evaluation of Correlated Noise for Differentially Private Training

**abstract/A1：** Temporally correlated noise can substantially improve the utility of differentially private optimization, yet candidate mechanisms are commonly designed or evaluated using only partial information about the optimization process, such as workload structure, learning-rate schedules, or local curvature. We study whether persistent optimizer state provides additional information that can change the relative utility of privacy-valid correlated-noise mechanisms. We introduce MOMENT-DP, an optimizer-state-aware framework that models how temporally correlated privacy noise propagates through momentum-based optimization. For locally quadratic objectives, MOMENT-DP expresses privacy-induced final loss through an optimizer transfer operator that jointly captures curvature, learning-rate scheduling, momentum, and temporal noise covariance. NoiseCurve's curvature-aware quadratic criterion is recovered exactly as the zero-momentum, constant-learning-rate special case. Changing only momentum while holding curvature, schedule, privacy calibration, and candidate mechanisms fixed induces genuine mechanism-ranking reversals. The effect persists outside exact quadratic dynamics in per-example-clipped private logistic regression, while remaining unresolved in the neural regime we study. These results establish optimizer state as an under-modeled, decision-relevant axis in evaluating temporally correlated privacy noise.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted to the Privacy in the Era of Large Opaque Models (PriLOM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 427. [Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11493v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11493

**作者：** Lydia T. Liu、Kara Schechtman、Pengyi Shi、Angela Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CY、stat.AP、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11493v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11493v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将医院出院决策建模为基于排队的 MDP，并纳入需定期重训的再入院风险预测器，证明「容量感知」的 discharge-up-to 策略可通过让住院时长多样化来消除删失偏差、在模型规范正确时收敛到无偏风险估计，并在合成实验与校准仿真中降低学习误差和再入院成本差异。

**相关性简评：** 其核心机制「决策策略决定结果在何处被观测、进而改变后续训练的监督分布与反馈回环」，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、推理轨迹的监督与贡献分配所面临的分布偏移问题在概念上相通，可供核查，但属于远域类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions

**abstract/A1：** Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.

</details>

### 428. [Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11529v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11529

**作者：** Soyon Choi、Scott Alfeld、Meiyi Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11529v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11529v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该进行中工作针对由视觉、规划等多个 ML 模型组合而成的 CPS，提出数据操纵攻击框架，包括基本威胁模型与最优攻击策略（状态到攻击的映射）的计算方法。

**相关性简评：** 其把组合系统的内部状态与状态转移作为攻击目标，可能为核查视觉证据被扰动后如何影响 LVR 的 latent 状态与停止决策提供对抗视角线索；但材料未涉及 latent 推理机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems

**abstract/A1：** There is a well-established body of work demonstrating that individual machine learning (ML) algorithms can be manipulated or deceived. However, in many real-world systems, multiple ML algorithms are composed to enable automated decision-making, particularly in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Often such systems use a composition of vision, planning, and other ML models to affect their internal state and ultimate take actions in the physical world. While there is a huge literature on the (in)security of ML algorithms, it is not immediately clear how an attacker might leverage their ability to trick individual learners when attacking the composition as a whole. We develop methods for creating an attack policy (a mapping from state to attack) for a data-manipulating attacker affecting a CPS or other state-machine-based AI compositions. We describe our framework, a basic threat model and corresponding methods for computing an optimal attack policy, as well as planned extensions. The goal of this work-in-progress paper is to stimulate conversation and forge new collaborations regarding the security of compositional learning.

</details>

### 429. [Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11604v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11604

**作者：** Dennis Gross

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11604v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11604v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文让 LLM 不经梯度下降直接写出小型策略网络的权重，并在给定 MDP 环境与 PCTL 需求下调用 Storm 做概率模型检测，用检测反馈迭代修复权重，直到需求满足或达到轮数上限。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成—精确验证—修复」闭环与形式化验证反馈，可能为 latent 推理状态是否满足任务约束的核查、停止决策与训练监督提供可核查的思路，但对象是序贯决策策略权重而非多模态推理状态，迁移性需阅读后判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) can write the weights of small neural networks directly, without gradient descent. This weight-space programming creates policies for sequential decision-making from a task description alone, but nothing guarantees that a written policy behaves as intended. We combine weight-space programming with probabilistic model checking. Given an environment modeled as a Markov decision process and a requirement in probabilistic computation tree logic (PCTL), an LLM writes all weights of a policy network, optionally repairs them on a dataset of optimal actions, and receives model-checking feedback until the requirement holds or a round limit is reached. The model checker Storm computes, rather than estimates from simulations, the probability that the policy satisfies the requirement, so every returned policy is verified. With two LLMs on three environments, the created policy of each of the 18 runs attains the optimal probability, before any dataset or model-checking feedback. Four of six policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs with probability 1, so they generalize to a task that the LLM never saw. The pipeline also programs a policy that satisfies a complex safety requirement expressed with the PCTL until operator in all six runs. In one of them, dataset repair raised the accuracy to 98.4\\% but broke the requirement, and one round of model-checking feedback restored it.

</details>

### 430. [Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11609v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11609

**作者：** Sergei V. Kalinin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11609v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11609v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出预算约束的多步自主显微工作流框架，联合决定测量方式、扫描速率与是否重校准，结合显式科学奖励、动作成本、仪器观测模型和预实验知识迁移，并在真实电子能量损失谱数据上比较不同采集策略与替代模型，附独立误差审计。

**相关性简评：** 其按成本决定「获取何种证据、以何精度、何时停止或重校准」的序列决策，以及关于模型不确定性何时不是可靠学习信号的负面结论，可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 收益成本权衡与视觉证据筛选提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Building heterogeneous multistep workflows in automated microscopy: reward design and knowledge transfer for autonomous structure property discovery

**abstract/A1：** Autonomous microscopy can turn fast acquisition into scientific progress when it decides not only where to measure, but also what information to acquire, at what scan rate, and when to recalibrate the instrument. We develop a budget constrained framework for such multistep structure-property workflows. It combines explicit scientific rewards, action costs, instrument observation models, transfer of pre experiment knowledge into the online campaign, and evaluation kept independent of the controller. The transferred knowledge includes predictor accuracy and computational cost, empirical learner maturity functions that weight model-derived rewards, and drift characteristics established before controller training. Using a real electron energy-loss spectroscopy dataset, we run two complementary campaigns. In the first, the controller chooses between imaging and spectroscopy, image size, and scan speed. In the second, the instrument drifts and the controller also decides when to recalibrate. The campaigns show that response discovery and structure-property learning favor different surrogate models and acquisition strategies. They also show that simple acquisition rules form strong, practical baselines. Independent error analysis reveals where model uncertainty is and is not a reliable learning signal. In the drift campaign, explicit registration greatly improves positional accuracy, and the framework measures what this costs in spectroscopy throughput. Together, these results provide a reproducible way to design, compare, and audit autonomous experiments, and they define what microscopes must provide for deployment: independently executable actions, characterized scan and detector responses, timestamped registration telemetry, and complete action records.

</details>

**作者：** Hugo Henry、Bharadwaj Dogga、Scott Philips、Kelly Cohen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**内容简述：** 论文在 N-CMAPSS 上用可解释遗传模糊树从巡航均值传感器预测涡扇发动机剩余寿命，按「传感器→部件健康→部件损伤→RUL」分层，采取分阶段训练：先以物理目标拟合并冻结健康层，再加确定性命中模糊损伤映射，仅优化上层聚合，以约 333 个自由参数取得竞争性 RMSE。

**相关性简评：** 其分层健康/损伤状态抽象，以及「冻结证据层、只训练聚合层」的分离监督，可能为 LVR 中潜状态是否被下游目标侵蚀、证据层与回答层贡献分配提供类比线索，但领域与视觉推理相距较远，具体可迁移性需人工核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An Interpretable Fuzzy Tree for Turbofan Remaining Useful Life with an Auditable Per-Component Diagnostic Layer

**abstract/A1：** Data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) estimators for turbofan engines are accurate but opaque, and their internal features typically encode remaining life rather than any specific component's state. This paper presents an interpretable genetic fuzzy tree that predicts RUL from cruise-condition sensor means on N-CMAPSS while exposing a per-component diagnostic layer inspectable rule by rule. The tree follows the engine hierarchy: sensors to component health, then to bounded component damage, spool damage, and RUL, so each level answers a different maintenance question. Training is staged so the prognostic objective cannot reshape the diagnostic layers: health leaves are fitted to physical targets and frozen, a deterministic fuzzy damage map with fleet-referenced thresholds is imposed on each component, and only the aggregation is optimized for RUL. It consumes 13 cruise-mean scalars per cycle rather than a trajectory, which removes any sequence model. On the native split it reaches 8.44 cycles RMSE on the multi-fault subset and 11.51 across all modes with 333 free parameters, 411 total rules, 32 to 12,000 times fewer than compiled baselines. An exhaustive sensor search bounds which components are diagnosable under the tested cruise-mean design, and the rule base is structured to admit formal verification, which this study does not discharge.

### 432. [A Trust Region Approach for Learning Schrödinger Bridges](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11649v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11649

**作者：** Takeshi Koshizuka、Denis Blessing、Max Zimmer、Sebastian Pokutta、Lorenz Richter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11649v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11649v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究仅给定未归一化目标密度时的 Schrödinger Bridge 数值近似，针对 IPF 因控制问题病态和解远离初始化导致的数值不稳定，提出将相邻迭代约束在固定 KL 散度的 trust region 变体，并说明其可视为自适应步长的 mirror descent。

**相关性简评：** 论文属于采样与分布匹配的远端领域，其「以 KL 散度限制相邻迭代偏移」的 trust region 思路可能为循环/迭代式 latent 状态的稳定更新与轨迹级分布对齐训练提供可核查的线索，但与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Trust Region Approach for Learning Schrödinger Bridges

**abstract/A1：** We study the numerical approximation of Schrödinger Bridges in the setting where samples from the target distribution are unavailable and only an unnormalized target density is given. In this regime, the widely used iterative proportional fitting (IPF) procedure (and its variants) often exhibits severe numerical instabilities, stemming from ill-conditioned underlying control problems and from the fact that the optimal solution may lie far from the initialization. To address these issues, we propose a trust region variant of IPF that constrains successive updates to remain at a fixed Kullback-Leibler divergence from the current iterate. This restriction significantly improves numerical stability. Moreover, we show that the resulting method admits an interpretation as a mirror descent scheme with an adaptively chosen step size. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on several challenging sampling tasks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026; Takeshi Koshizuka and Lorenz Richter contributed equally

</details>

### 433. [Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11657v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11657

**作者：** Renee Jia、Di Mu、Yao Yu、Tianrui Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11657v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11657v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建一个由 LLM 分析师、动量组合构建与规则执行组成的混合多智能体交易系统，协调器根据结构化报告设定仓位与现金比例，并用模拟账户记录和回溯重放比较不同配置。

**相关性简评：** 「selective invocation」与「response contract」等设计可能可供核查 LVR 中何时触发额外推理路径、监督信号格式如何影响输出，但任务与视觉推理无直接联系，线索较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** We built a hybrid multi-agent trading system that combines large language model (LLM) analysts with momentum-based portfolio construction and rule-based execution. Company-news and macroeconomic agents return structured reports to a coordinator that sets stock weights and cash reserves. We evaluate the portfolio engine using its broker-recorded paper account, which operated with deterministic fallbacks, and compare LLM-enabled configurations through retrospective replays. From March 11 to August 28, 2026, the account returned 34.5%, compared with 14.4% for the S&amp;P 500 fund SPY over the same dates. This raw return advantage came with a larger maximum drawdown. Reconstructed policies also finish above matched SPY and QQQ references when assessments are used in the same session or deferred to the next. Design comparisons examine cash authority, selective invocation, and response contracts. A constant-cash control gives a return estimate close to stance-based sizing, and shorter report contracts improve observed parsing but can change recommendations.

### 434. [RADE: Risk-Adjusted Deployment Efficiency, A Framework for Routing, Memory, and Escalation in Safe LLM Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11659v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11659

**作者：** Chaymaa Abbas、Kareem Hassani、Mariette Awad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11659v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11659v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RADE 框架，主张以「部署策略」而非单一模型为分析单元，用风险调整后的部署效率（净值扣除推理、重试、监督与预期失败成本，并对延迟、隐私、资源与不可定价伤害设硬约束）统一刻画检索、记忆、路由、不确定性、弃答与人工升级，并配套风险-覆盖率等报告协议与五类部署场景。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时检索、验证、弃答、升级」的成本-风险核算与风险-覆盖率、端到端成本报告，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡与停止决策评价提供可核查的目标和指标框架；但该文是纯文本部署层论述，未涉及视觉证据或 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RADE: Risk-Adjusted Deployment Efficiency, A Framework for Routing, Memory, and Escalation in Safe LLM Systems

**abstract/A1：** A deployed language model does not merely answer questions. It spends computation, consumes time, consults evidence, exposes memory, invites or avoids human review, and sometimes makes mistakes whose consequences are radically unequal. Yet LLM systems are still commonly compared as if the relevant object were a single model and the relevant outcome were a single benchmark score. This paper argues that the unit of analysis should instead be the deployment policy: the mechanism that decides when to retrieve, when to remember, when to call a larger model, when to verify, and when not to answer at all. We introduce risk-adjusted deployment efficiency (RADE), a system-level objective that scores the utility a deployment delivers net of inference, retry, oversight, and priced expected failure cost, while treating harms that cannot be priced as hard budgets alongside constraints on latency, privacy, and resources. The framework brings selective routing, retrieval and governed memory, efficient specialization, uncertainty estimation, abstention, and human escalation into a common account. We then examine five deployment regimes in which the same nominal LLM capability leads to different rational architectures, and propose a reporting protocol based on risk-coverage behavior, end-to-end cost, update drift, memory exposure, evidence quality, and escalation load. The central claim is modest but consequential: frontier capability should be treated as a resource to allocate, not a default state to maintain. A safe and sustainable system is not the one that always uses the strongest model; it is the one that spends capability where the reduction in risk or increase in utility justifies the cost.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该论文构建 SurgTAP-3D：一个大规模活体手术视频伪 3D 运动跟踪数据集与基准，含 52 万帧、约 140 万条 2D/3D 点轨迹，并提出统一标注框架，从无需标定的单目视频生成时序一致的轨迹、尺度几何、相机位姿与器械掩码。

**相关性简评：** 属手术机器人视觉的较远领域，但其「接触区提示 + 器械分割 + 动态 bundle adjustment + 全局 4D 精化」把单目视频转为结构化几何状态的管线，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与几何一致性状态表示提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking

**abstract/A1：** Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

**comment/C1：** Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)

### 436. [Variational Approach to Optimal IPS Estimator for Multi-logger Off-Policy Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11712v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11712

**作者：** Joon Suk Huh、Junghoon Seo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11712v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11712v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究多日志策略（multi-logger）下上下文 bandit 的 off-policy evaluation，用变分法在无偏约束下推导样本相关的闭式最优 IPS 权重以最小化方差，并给出 doubly robust 扩展及基准实验对比。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接联系，但其「多来源策略数据 + 无偏约束下的方差最优重加权」思路，可能可供核查用于由多个生成策略采集的 latent 推理轨迹的离策略价值估计与样本贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Variational Approach to Optimal IPS Estimator for Multi-logger Off-Policy Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** We study off-policy evaluation (OPE) in contextual bandits with data collected from multiple logging policies. Inverse propensity scoring (IPS) is a standard approach to OPE and extends naturally to the multi-logger setting. However, as highlighted by Agarwal et al. \[2017\], neither balanced nor weighted IPS consistently outperforms the other in this setting. We resolve this dilemma by deriving an optimal IPS estimator with sample-dependent weights that minimize variance subject to unbiasedness. Using a variational calculus approach, we obtain closed-form optimal weights, yielding an estimator that is unbiased and achieves asymptotically optimal variance within a generalized weighted-IPS estimator class. Instead of a reward model, the estimator needs only a $K\\times K$ matrix and a $K$-vector of moments, where $K$ is the number of logging policies, and we quantify how much efficiency this costs relative to the semiparametric oracle. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our estimator generally improves on existing multi-logger IPS methods. We also extend our estimator to a doubly robust form by incorporating a conditional reward estimator. We compare the resulting DR extension with the semiparametrically efficient DR estimator of Kallus et al. \[2021\], both theoretically and empirically. We show that the two estimators achieve the same asymptotic variance when the conditional reward estimator is consistent, while our estimator can retain semiparametric efficiency under certain forms of reward misspecification. Empirically, the proposed DR estimator often achieves lower estimation error than the existing DR baseline.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, NeurIPS 2026 Camera-ready

</details>

### 437. [The Value of Not Knowing: How Fresh Eyes through Naive LLMs Fuel Creativity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11725v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11725

**作者：** David B. D'Ambrosio、Alon Albalak、Joel Lehman、Kenneth O. Stanley

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11725v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11725v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「naive LLM」：通过训练期知识剥夺或定向遗忘，让模型对某一主题保持无知，以摆脱领域内主流观点；再与更强的 mentor 模型配对，把其新奇的种子想法细化为具体方案，并在 1B/7B 模型上报告种子想法更新颖、更有用。

**相关性简评：** 刻意削减模型知识可视为人为控制内部知识状态的手段，可能供核查 latent 推理中先验主导与假设多样性之间的权衡；种子想法加 mentor 精炼的两段式流程，也与候选 latent 状态的提出—筛选—验证结构有概念上的可借鉴之处。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Value of Not Knowing: How Fresh Eyes through Naive LLMs Fuel Creativity

**abstract/A1：** Many major scientific advances come from approaching a problem with a new or novel perspective. While large language models (LLMs) with internet-scale knowledge seem poised to take such perspectives, their consistent generation remains elusive. Instead, models are drawn to dominant views and preexisting, in-field bias. To explore the potential of fresh eyes to increase creativity, this paper proposes naive LLMs, models that are made intentionally ignorant of a specific topic. Through deprivation in training or intentional forgetting, naive models are unburdened by existing dogma, allowing them to be free to make new associations and conjectures. These naive models can then be paired with a stronger mentor model that can refine their unique perspectives into concrete proposals. For the 1B and 7B models tested in this paper, naive models consistently produce seed ideas that are more novel and useful than baseline counterparts, and mentor refinement improves the ideas even further. Thus, contrary to the prevailing tradition of scaling up training data, we demonstrate a case where less information is actually more powerful, in particular when the aim is to discover genuinely outside-the-box solutions.

</details>
