**arXiv ID：** 2611.11726

**作者：** Mohammad Shahin、Krittaphas Chaisutyakorn、Dimitrios Proios、David Restrepo、Vishala Mishra、Boya Zhang、Aadarsh Sivaraman、Sparsh Roy、Benet Fité Abril、Tina Yen-Ting Chen、Hyunjung Gloria Kwak、Andre Kurepa Waschka、Vinayak Mathur、Leo Anthony Celi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ME

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11726v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11726v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 EHR 数据生成过程形式化为「潜在生理状态 + 决定何时测量谁的护理流程 + 仅在测量时存在的检验值 + 学习到的表示」，证明单一数据集无法识别检验数值与开单渠道的信息划分，并论证跨站点不变性只是可反驳的联合假设推论而非识别策略，同时给出可恢复识别的条件。

**相关性简评：** 其潜在状态与观测流程纠缠、表示充分性和观察等价构造，可能为 LVR 中「latent 内容是否真正承载视觉证据」以及跨数据集探针/不变性检验能否支持因果结论提供概念参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Dark Matter of Clinical Data: An Identification Limit on Disentangling Physiology from Care Process in electronic health records

**abstract/A1：** Representations learned from electronic health record (EHR) data encode patient physiology together with the clinical process that decides what is measured, when, and for whom. We formalize the data-generating process with latent physiology, ordering intent, laboratory values that exist only when measured, a learned representation, and clinical environments, and analyze two strategies for undoing this entanglement. First, no division of the information carried by laboratory "value" and "ordering" channels is identified from a single dataset: when ordering depends on the analyte, its distribution among untested patients is not recoverable, and a sentinel code for the undefined recorded value makes it carry all the entropy of the ordering indicator, fixing partial information decomposition (PID) for every redundancy measure satisfying the Williams-Beer axioms and invariant under injective re-encoding. Second, cross-site invariance of representation-conditional outcomes is a falsifiable implication of biological invariance taken jointly with exclusion and representation-sufficiency conditions, but not an identification strategy: we construct observationally equivalent models that disagree about biological invariance, whether the invariance test fails or passes. For binary physiology this happens exactly when case mix differs, the representation is lossy, and physiology affects the outcome. A worked example yields a 9.6-percentage-point cross-site gap under an unchanged biological mechanism. Tests performed for every patient remove the ordering gate, and measured tests can restore identification: biological invariance is identified when a test exactly summarizes outcome-relevant physiology, or, for binary physiology, when two tests with independent errors are available at sites with different case mix. Cross-site analyses should be reported as tests of a stated joint hypothesis.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary Information and code are provided as ancillary files. Interactive companion with narrated explainers: https://criticaldata.github.io/Dark\_Matter/

</details>

**title/T1：** Can the Remaining Answers Change the Prediction? Worst-Case Stability Checks for Personalized Rating Models

**abstract/A1：** Missing ratings can overturn a personalized model's current prediction. For completed models with additive response scores, exact worst case bounds check all missing assignments without changing the current predictor. We evaluate this audit retrospectively in two self-triage cohorts, 108 clinicians rating three simulated psychiatric interviews, and 126 counseling demonstrations annotated by ten experts. Under shared random half histories, Fisher adaptation based on observed ratings reduces log loss relative to response frequency by 0.1071 nats in the clinician audit (95% CI \[0.0867,0.1261\]) and 0.0223 in counseling (95% CI\[0.0121,0.0321\]). The counseling test excludes target experts and source videos from training. Certification covers 5.4% and 10.5% of targets; fixed width acquisition raises coverage to 13.7% and 28.6% at the same budgets. With weights and responses held fixed, the observed-rating update also has lower loss than an affine partial update while certifying exactly the same evaluated targets. The certificate establishes agreement with the completed model, not correctness or stability at intermediate updates. These rating tasks test the method; clinical usefulness remains untested.

**内容简述：** 论文在同一动力学对象上区分两种分岔：涌现对应能力变量 S 的分岔（判据 Γ&gt;1），可控性对应许可变量 c 的分岔（存在带滞回的鞍结折叠，阈值 γ\_c≈4μκ），并推出临界指数只区分家族、门控成本按 K(M)∝log(1+M) 随范围增长等结论，主张能力提升不等于可控性提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「许可变量＋折叠滞回」的门控表述可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止与计算门控决策、以及 latent 状态可操控性判断形成概念对应，可供核查；但该框架高度抽象且无多模态实验，能否操作化到 VLM 推理仍是推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Bifurcation-Theoretic Framework for the Controllability of Emergent Intelligent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Real-world intelligent systems must reconcile two demands: the adaptability conferred by emergence and the steerability required for accountable deployment. We show that these demands are governed by two distinct bifurcations on the same object and that, consequently, increased capability does not imply increased controllability. Emergence is a bifurcation of the capability variable $S$, with criterion $Γ:=\\mathcal F'(0)&gt;1$ equivalent to the existence of a unique positive stable fixed point of a self-consistency equation, following solely from the concavity of $\\mathcal F$. Controllability is a bifurcation of the permission variable $c$, whose dynamics include an erosion term and exhibit a saddle-node fold with hysteresis as the gate criterion $ρ^\\ast$ crosses unity. Three quantitative results follow: the critical exponent distinguishes families rather than classifying the transition; the gating-cost bound $K(M)\\propto\\log(1+M)$ grows with scope, not capability; and the fold threshold is $γ\_c\\approx4μκ$. Calibrated in both directions, the criteria reproduce the two-dimensional Ising transition, admit two true-feedback order parameters, and reject nine candidate quantities, supporting the conclusion that the order parameter is geometric rather than capability-related. Since permission cannot be endogenized and no deployed system has been measured to satisfy $Γ&gt;1$ and $ρ^\\ast&gt;1$ simultaneously, increased capability does not imply controllability.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables

</details>

### 441. [Correctness Metric Matters: NWD-Based Calibration Loss for Tiny Person Detection in UAV Infrared Imagery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11735

**作者：** Tian Zhang、Zhirong Su

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11735v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出在 UAV 红外小目标（人）检测中，以 IoU 硬阈值定义正确性的校准损失在几何上不适定，改用连续、尺度不变的归一化 Wasserstein 距离（NWD）作为校准目标，在 HIT-UAV 上降低定位感知 ECE 且 mAP 基本持平。

**相关性简评：** 「目标越小则同一像素误差惩罚越重、硬阈值相似度失真」这一观察，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据与 latent 状态的相似度度量选择，以及基于置信度的停止决策校准；但其本身是单模态检测校准，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correctness Metric Matters: NWD-Based Calibration Loss for Tiny Person Detection in UAV Infrared Imagery

**abstract/A1：** Detection calibration aligns predicted confidence with empirical correctness. Existing calibration losses inherit their correctness definition from box regression, specifically IoU against a hard threshold. We show that this target is geometrically ill-posed for tiny objects in UAV infrared imagery, where persons occupy less than 0.1\\% of the image. The same pixel error is penalized more heavily as the target shrinks, so binary prediction calibration (BPC) actively suppresses confidences that should be high. On HIT-UAV, BPC with an IoU target degrades image-level localization-aware ECE (LaECE) from 0.0689 to 0.0761, 0.0649 to 0.0733, and 0.0653 to 0.0682 across Low, Mid, and High signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR) groups. We replace the IoU target with a continuous, scale-invariant normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD). The NWD target reduces LaECE\\(\_{\\mathrm{NWD}}\\) relative to BPC+IoU on all three groups (\\(p&lt;10^{-7}\\)) with mAP neutral (0.9356 vs.\\ 0.9347), and an independent center-offset anchor confirms that the gain is a genuine geometric correction. The improvement holds across a broad plateau of calibration weights. The NWD formulation requires no inference-time mapping layer. If a validation-fitted isotonic map is applied on top of it, calibration is lowered further, and the two corrections act on different components of the same error. The metric-level remedy has a measurable boundary. Target-background thermal pairing in the training distribution and detection-level aggregation under per-image detection-count heterogeneity lie outside it. Both are quantified independently of the NWD target.

</details>

### 442. [Dense Flow from Adaptive Correspondence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11738v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11738

**作者：** Cheng-Lin Hsieh、Stella X. Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11738v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11738v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FATE，把对应关系的尺度与光流分辨率解耦：token 支持区域在纹理一致区内扩张、在运动边界处收缩，用共享的像素—token 关联同时完成匹配与稠密流重建，并以流监督在无分组标签下联合训练分组、匹配与估计。

**相关性简评：** 其由任务监督学出的像素分组与自适应支持区域，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和动态 token 粒度提供启发，但该工作属低层运动估计，与多模态推理状态的关联仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dense Flow from Adaptive Correspondence

**abstract/A1：** Optical flow requires reliable matching from sufficient visual context and precise motion at every pixel. Existing methods such as WAFT match and estimate flow on the same coarse grids, then recover dense flow through learned upsampling, without explicitly linking visual support for matching to dense flow reconstruction. Our key insight is that dense pixel-level flow does not require equally dense matching. We decouple correspondence scale from flow resolution by adapting the size and shape of spatial supports to image structure for reliable matching, while reusing these supports for precise dense flow reconstruction. We realize this in Flow from Adaptive Token Estimation (FATE), whose token supports expand within coherent regions and contract near motion boundaries. Shared pixel-to-token associations pool features for matching and reconstruct pixel flow from token motions. Flow supervision jointly trains pixel grouping, token matching, and flow estimation without grouping labels, allowing FATE to anticipate which pixels are likely to move together from appearance alone. Trained on FlyingChairs/FlyingThings3D, FATE achieves the highest zero-shot accuracy on Sintel Final and KITTI, a critical setting given scarce real-world flow labels. For visible pixels, FATE improves accuracy within coherent regions, and more near motion boundaries. Its largest gains occur where direct matches are unavailable: Occluded or out-of-frame pixels account for roughly 10% of valid pixels but 50% of WAFT's total error. Experiments show that adaptive correspondence through pixel-to-token grouping enables reliable matching and precise pixel-level flow, improving generalization to unseen real scenes.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 443. [Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11740v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11740

**作者：** Alon Albalak、Sebastian Gabriel、David B. D'Ambrosio、Joel Lehman、Kenneth O. Stanley

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11740v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11740v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张把创造力建模为显式的过程而非产物属性，提出 creative priming：训练一个 priming 模型为每个请求生成针对性 primer，辅助 response 模型作答，并用 GRPO 以新颖性、质量与多样性奖励 primer，从而强化产生创造性回答的过程而不强化任何具体回答。

**相关性简评：** 将「过程生成器」与「回答生成器」解耦、仅以最终产出质量奖励中间过程的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供参照；但该工作为纯文本创造力任务，无视觉或多模态状态，其奖励设计能否用于 LVR 尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox

**abstract/A1：** Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GeoPilot 面向航空遥感影像的三维网格重建，把诊断结果转化为可执行的程序或相机配置干预，由 LLM 提出改动、数值工具重建、外部评估器按指定坐标与参考协议度量几何，并在若干开发场景上比较共享内参假设与发布相机的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「诊断—干预—外部评估」闭环与参考辅助对齐使平均距离排序反转的发现，可能可供核查 LVR 中几何保真度评价协议与干预贡献归因的稳定性；但对象是摄影测量网格而非视觉推理内部状态，联系偏间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoPilot: Diagnosis-Guided Interventions and Geometric Evaluation for Aerial Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** When a mesh reconstructed from aerial remote-sensing imagery disagrees with reference geometry, deciding what to change requires a diagnosis of the reconstruction process. We present GeoPilot, a workflow that turns diagnostics and prior observations into executable program or camera-configuration interventions. A large language model proposes the change, numerical tools reconstruct the mesh, and an external evaluator measures its geometry under a stated coordinate and reference protocol. The main case tests a shared-intrinsics hypothesis proposed before the comparison. On 224 Metashape-raster development images, shared intrinsics improved all six native-coordinate measures and reduced mean surface-to-reference distance by 7.04%. Reference-assisted alignment fitted and evaluated on separate within-scene checkerboard samples reversed the mean-distance ranking, limiting that gain to native-frame delivery. A separate matched comparison on publisher-undistorted images favored fixed published cameras on all six measures, reducing mean distance by 12.11%; the cameras retain upstream image and laser-scanning adjustment information. With one reconstruction per configuration, these comparisons provide conditional evidence for camera handling. Three end-to-end runs each delivered a mesh and six-metric evaluation from all 327 images of a second development scene.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpinSCI: Mask-Conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging

**abstract/A1：** Video snapshot compressive imaging (SCI) recovers multiple frames from one spatiotemporally coded measurement. This paper proposes SpinSCI, a mask-conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer whose Mask-Conditioned Ising Refinement Block (MC-IRB) combines attention logits and sensing information to form signed spin couplings. Finite mean-field updates gate residual feature refinement. Physics-guided initialization and final data consistency incorporate the measurement model. Compared with HiSViT$\_9$, SpinSCI achieves average PSNR gains of 0.51 dB, 0.23 dB, and 0.04 dB on small-scale gray, mid-scale color, and large-scale color benchmarks, respectively, with 16.9% fewer parameters, 21.0-21.6% fewer FLOPs, 17.1-49.9% lower latency, and 62.3-63.3% lower peak memory. Relative to DU-9stg, average PSNR differs by at most 0.13 dB across these benchmarks, with 28.2-28.7% fewer FLOPs, 64.6-71.7% lower inference latency, and 30.1-35.0% lower peak memory. Qualitative comparisons on the real benchmark further show recovery of fine details and textures. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/SpinSCI.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 D-Fire 测试集上以图像级评估两个紧凑火烟检测器，比较三种把框级检测聚合成单幅图像警报分数的规则，并用 split conformal 在留出图像上选阈值以控制漏检率目标，同时报告误报率与主要失败情形。

**相关性简评：** 其把多个局部证据得分汇总为一次图像级决策、并以 conformal 做风险可控的阈值选择，可能为 LVR 中「何时停止并作答」及漏检—误报权衡的评价提供借鉴，能否迁移到 latent 证据累积场景需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Calibrated Alarm Thresholds for Compact Fire and Smoke Detectors

**abstract/A1：** Compact object detectors such as YOLOv8n are a common choice for camera-based fire and smoke detection on low-power devices. These detectors are usually evaluated with box-level metrics such as mean average precision, and their outputs are turned into decisions with a fixed confidence threshold such as 0.25 or 0.5. A fire monitoring system, however, makes one decision per image: raise an alarm or not. In this paper we evaluate two publicly available compact detectors on the D-Fire test set at the image level. We compare three simple rules for turning box detections into one alarm score per image, and we use a split conformal procedure to choose the alarm threshold from held-out images so that the expected fraction of missed fire and smoke images stays below a chosen target. We find that the same fixed threshold leads to very different miss rates for the two detectors, 17.3 and 8.4 percent at a threshold of 0.5, while the calibrated threshold meets miss-rate targets of 10, 5 and 1 percent for both detectors and all three rules. At a 5 percent target, the false alarm rate on images without fire or smoke stays between 1.2 and 3.0 percent. We also find that smoke-only images stay below the target even when the overall target is met, and we describe the main failure cases.

</details>

### 447. [Wireless AI Networks: Co-Adapting Communication Resources and Distributed Intelligence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11774v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11774

**作者：** Ziqiang Ye、Yue Xiao、Qiyan Zhan、Yulan Gao、Xianfu Lei、Vladimir Poulkov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11774v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11774v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「Wireless AI Networks」视角，用任务级信息价值指导通信资源分配与分布式 AI 配置，并通过联邦学习更新筛选和敏感度感知功率分配两个实验说明其作用。

**相关性简评：** 其「在固定预算下按任务级信息价值筛选信息」的表述可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 内容保留与预算-收益权衡可供核查，但场景为无线分布式学习，无 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Wireless AI Networks: Co-Adapting Communication Resources and Distributed Intelligence

**abstract/A1：** Distributed artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly relies on wireless networks, where communication and computing resources shape how AI tasks are configured and executed. However, resource availability alone does not determine how effectively these tasks can be supported, since different information selections and transmission strategies may yield different AI performance under the same resource constraints. To address this challenge, this article presents Wireless AI Networks as a unified design perspective for bidirectional adaptation between wireless communication and distributed intelligence. Specifically, an AI-executable resource budget characterizes candidate AI configurations, while task-level information value guides their selection and wireless resource allocation. Building on these principles, a wireless-AI co-adaptation framework coordinates resource abstraction, joint configuration and allocation, and execution feedback. Two complementary experiments illustrate this perspective: update selection and statistical correction improve federated learning under identical model-update payload budgets, while sensitivity-aware power allocation reduces model accuracy degradation under the same average transmit-power constraint. Together, these results highlight the importance of coordinating resource feasibility and task-level information value in distributed AI execution.

</details>

### 448. [Payoff-Aware Prediction of Population Game Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11786v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11786

**作者：** Kang Wang、Xiao Wang、Bo Li、Renzhe Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11786v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11786v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究在 payoff 设计改变、新设计下无轨迹数据时预测群体博弈动力学，提出 PA-RmD，显式保留 payoff 信息并仅从数据学习与 payoff 无关的响应结构，并给出不动点保持与有限时间一步预测界。

**相关性简评：** 其把「外源 payoff 信号」与「内在响应结构」分离以便在新条件下外推的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据驱动更新与隐状态自身动力学的解耦，以及对新任务条件推理轨迹的外推预测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Payoff-Aware Prediction of Population Game Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Population game dynamics describe how aggregate behavior evolves in response to payoff signals. In many applications, the payoff function may change, and the goal is to predict the population trajectory induced by a new payoff design before trajectory data under that design are available. We study this problem as $\\textbf{payoff-aware prediction of population game dynamics}$. Standard dynamics learning methods fit the motion observed under training payoffs, but do not separate the payoff-dependent incentive from the payoff-independent response structure needed for prediction under new payoffs. Building on the existing framework of Riemannian game dynamics, we propose PA-RmD, a payoff-aware learning method that keeps payoff information explicit and learns the payoff-independent response structure from data. Theoretically, we show that the learned model preserves fixed-payoff Nash equilibria and derive finite-time one-step prediction bounds under shared-response and payoff-coverage conditions. Empirically, we evaluate PA-RmD on synthetic zero-sum and potential games, as well as a YouTube Trending multi-country dataset, showing that our method performs well under changing payoff designs.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**title/T1：** Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback

**abstract/A1：** We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\\!\\left(k\\sqrt{nT\\log(n/k)}\\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

**作者：** Amir Ali Ahmadi、Parsa Alavi、Radeen Alavi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在人类二值判罚与 AI 数值测量各带独立高斯误差的假设下，推导出最大似然的反转阈值 √(2/π)·σ\_AI²/σ\_H，据此刻画何时应推翻人类判罚，并给出含系统偏差的推广、数值示例与误差参数标定方法。

**相关性简评：** 两个噪声证据源的显式融合与阈值判据，可能为 LVR 中「新视觉证据何时推翻既有推断、何时停止」的决策准则设计提供参照，但二值加单标量的简化设定与多模态内部状态差距较大，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Should AI Overturn a Human Decision? Controversy at the 2026 World Cup and a $\\sqrt{2/π}$ Solution

**abstract/A1：** We study how to combine a human binary call (a referee's offside or onside decision) with an AI numerical measurement (VAR's estimate of an attacker's position relative to the offside line). We derive an explicit maximum-likelihood rule that determines when the referee's call should stand and when a conflicting VAR measurement should overturn it. Our model treats the true offside margin as fixed and unknown and assumes independent additive Gaussian errors in the human's perception and the AI measurement. When both errors have zero means and known standard deviations $σ\_H$ and $σ\_{AI}$, respectively, the reversal threshold is $\\sqrt{2/π}\\,σ^2\_{AI}/σ\_H$. An onside call is overturned precisely when VAR's measured offside margin exceeds this threshold---not merely because VAR places the attacker beyond the offside line. We also derive the rule when either source has a systematic bias. We prove that the maximum-likelihood estimate of the true margin exists and is unique, while the final binary decision requires only a threshold comparison, without computing that estimate numerically. We illustrate the rule through numerical examples and show how to estimate the error parameters from calibration data. The same analysis applies beyond soccer to binary classification problems in which a human call and an AI measurement satisfy the stated model. This paper is intended for educational purposes: we aim to illustrate how undergraduate students and advanced high school students familiar with basic probability and calculus can investigate research questions in AI and its applications.

**comment/C1：** This paper is intended for educational purposes

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Direct Trajectory Optimization（DTO），一种免训练的文生图扩散模型对齐框架：把采样过程中的中间去噪分数与采样噪声作为优化变量直接优化，避免对去噪网络反向传播，并用 Reward-Optimized Score Guidance 在优化分数与预训练预测之间插值以缓解分布外问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「把采样轨迹上的中间状态当作可优化变量、用奖励信号在推理期直接调整」的思路，可能为 LVR 中测试时 latent 状态轨迹的奖励驱动优化与偏离分布时的插值约束提供概念参考；但研究对象是图像生成对齐，与多模态推理状态的具体联系尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.

</details>

**作者：** Nan Wu、Hong Yee Hung

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出离线系统 AcrossVAM3.0，将文本、图像或单目视频转换为可版本化的点表示：冻结组件在同一 GPU 上顺序运行，地图修正统一更新相机、点与轨迹，并以多假设自适应表面链接（MHAC）保留多个候选匹配和显式缺失状态，在 TAP-Vid-DAVIS 与 RoboTAP 视频上评测跟踪增益与 GPU 占用。

**相关性简评：** 其「多候选假设＋显式缺失状态」的关联机制与资源受限预算设计，可能为 latent 推理中的多假设维护、视觉证据缺失时的状态表达及计算成本核算提供参照，可供核查其是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association

**abstract/A1：** Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval \[0.1074,0.1689\]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 (\[0.0510,0.0715\]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.

</details>

### 453. [KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11827v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11827

**作者：** Zhaoye Pan、Tao Li、Yunjie Guo、Guanpu Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11827v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11827v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对非可分耦合与耦合约束下的全分布式在线凸优化，提出随机化的 KKT 扰动感知通信机制，按各原/对偶通道对 KKT 算子的估计影响分配刷新优先级，在常规正则假设下得到 O(T^{2/3}) 期望静态遗憾与累计约束违反。

**相关性简评：** 其实质是把坐标下降的自适应采样从“分配计算”迁移到“按对下游算子的敏感度分配更新”，可能为 LVR 中按对推理状态的影响选择性刷新或延迟 latent 通道提供概念线索；但无视觉、学习或推理机制，联系较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** KKT-Perturbation-Aware Communication for Fully Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Nonseparable Coupling

**abstract/A1：** Nonseparable costs and coupled constraints in distributed online convex optimization often arise when system performance and operational constraints depend on the joint configuration of all agents and cannot be decomposed into individual contributions. Such nonseparability leads to fully distributed decision-making with challenging partial local information, where each agent evaluates its local primal-dual update using estimated global information via a local belief of the joint action and the shared Lagrange multiplier to be exchanged with neighbors. While the belief consensus established by prior works ensures no-regret learning, exchanging beliefs comprising full-dimensional primal and dual states at every round imposes a communication overhead that scales with both the joint decision dimension and the network size. Existing event-triggered schemes typically activate communication according to state variation or consensus error. Under nonseparable coupling, however, errors of equal magnitude can produce markedly different perturbations after passing through the KKT operator. We therefore propose a randomized KKT-perturbation-aware communication mechanism, where the triggering of each agent's primal and dual communication channels depends on their impact on the KKT operator. The proposed mechanism transfers the adaptive-sampling principle of coordinate descent from allocating computation across decision blocks to allocating communication across information channels: channels with larger estimated perturbations receive greater priority for refresh. Under standard regularity assumptions, the resulting algorithm achieves $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected static regret and $O({T}^{2/3})$ expected cumulative constraint violation. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved learning and constraint-enforcement performance per transmitted bit over belief consensus baselines.

</details>

### 454. [Aggregation-Induced Calibration Failure in Sum-Based Label Expansion for Multi-Label Facial Expression Recognition: A Diagnostic Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11843v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11843

**作者：** Weihang Yuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11843v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11843v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断多标签面部表情识别中基于求和的标签空间扩展方法 CALE 的失败模式，在七个骨干、自建数据与 RAF 基准上发现决定成败的是聚合规则而非表示，简单求和需阈值校准或改为学习式聚合。

**相关性简评：** 其「多路分支分数未校准求和不稳定、阈值化指标与 mAP 结论迥异」的发现，可能为 LVR 中多假设或多分支潜状态证据的组合方式与评价指标选择提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Aggregation-Induced Calibration Failure in Sum-Based Label Expansion for Multi-Label Facial Expression Recognition: A Diagnostic Study

**abstract/A1：** Label-space expansion - predicting a larger joint space and summing back to the original labels - is a natural design for multi-label facial expression recognition, but its failure modes have not been characterised. We evaluate Condition-Aware Label Expansion (CALE) on a self-built dataset (30,240 training images, 3,460 multi-label test images), on seven backbones, and on the public RAF-DB and RAF-ML benchmarks. The central finding is that the aggregation rule, not the representation, decides whether the method works. With a fixed threshold of 0.5, the aggregate score spans 28x across five backbones at 10% of the training data (0.24 to 6.79) and collapses to a 1.9x range at full data, while threshold-free mAP stays within 1.28x over the same backbones, which localises the fault to the summation step. The mechanism is the uncalibrated aggregation rule, which adds the main-branch score to half the sum of the three non-main branches; we verify it by measuring main- and non-main-branch activations. Two plain seven-dimensional sigmoid baselines (BCE, ASL) reach mAP 0.5055 and 0.5175; ASL exceeds three of the five CALE configurations and falls within 0.03 of the best. On single-label FER the gain over a seven-dimensional baseline is nominally significant (paired t-test, p = 0.0436) but does not survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction (p\_BH = 0.2055) or a Wilcoxon test (p = 0.1250). We conclude that sum-based label expansion requires threshold calibration at the deployment data scale, or a learned aggregation, before it can support multi-label decisions.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/yuanweihang810/CALE

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11847

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.AP、stat.ML

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Conformal Severity Control（CSC），一个无需重训的后处理校准框架，用 ATC 药物层级量化预测集与标签的错配严重度，并控制患者级的平均与上分位严重度，在 MIMIC-IV 上验证其可跟踪用户设定的容忍度。

**相关性简评：** 其「集合式输出 + 分层错配严重度 + 容忍度与覆盖率的权衡」表述，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据集合的筛选、弃权与停止决策提供校准和分级评价思路，但领域相距较远，迁移性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Severity-Controlled Prediction Sets for Medication Recommendation

**abstract/A1：** Medication recommendation is a multi-label prediction task. However, existing prediction-set evaluation and calibration methods rely mainly on exact-overlap metrics and therefore treat all missed medications as equally severe, overlooking how closely the prediction set matches them within the medication hierarchy. To address this, we introduce Conformal Severity Control (CSC), a post-hoc framework for calibrating medication prediction sets under hierarchy-aware mismatch severity. CSC uses the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) hierarchy to quantify mismatch severity and controls patient-level severity without retraining the predictor, supporting both average severity and upper-quantile severity for the highest-severity mismatches. Experiments on MIMIC-IV show that CSC tracks user-specified severity tolerances and shifts prediction sets away from distant mismatches toward exact or close matches.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Camera-ready version. Code: https://github.com/ggggggyyyyyy/conformal-severity-control

### 456. [Identifiable but Hard to Estimate: Rotation in Equally Spaced Overcomplete ICA](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11852v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11852

**作者：** Wenjun Xiao、Yinghao Fang、Hanxin Chen、Sihan Jia、Vince D Calhoun、Yuda BI

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IT、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11852v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11852v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究二维过完备 ICA 中等间距混合列下共同旋转的可辨识性与估计代价，证明固定相对角精度所需样本量随源数指数增长，并用相邻旋转间的 Hellinger 距离刻画该规模，给出可达到该尺度的相位估计器。

**相关性简评：** 其「可辨识但难以估计」及以 Hellinger 距离量化潜变量结构区分难度的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态可辨识性、所需监督量与视觉证据筛选成本提供分析视角，可供核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Identifiable but Hard to Estimate: Rotation in Equally Spaced Overcomplete ICA

**abstract/A1：** How many observations are needed to estimate a common rotation in two-dimensional overcomplete independent component analysis? We study equally spaced mixing columns with known source count, common source law, and column norm. For a fixed non-Gaussian fourth-order Gram-Charlier source law, the rotation is identifiable modulo the column spacing. Yet the sample size for fixed relative angular accuracy grows exponentially with the source count. We characterize this sample size, up to absolute constants, by the reciprocal of the squared Hellinger distance between two rotations separated by half the column spacing. An explicit radially weighted phase estimator attains this scale uniformly over the rotation family, using the observation radius to prevent cancellation in the mean of an angular harmonic. We also determine the exact exponential decay rate of single-observation total variation for the same pair. This gives bounds on the sample size exponent; its exact value remains open. Finally, a noisy binary-source example shows how an exact zero line of the observed characteristic function can have an exponentially small normal derivative.

</details>

### 457. [Tropical Gaussian Anticoncentration: Optimal Instance-Dependent Bounds for Online Learning in Extensive-Form Games](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11877v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11877

**作者：** Ashkan Soleymani、Zhiyuan Fan、Lillian J. Ratliff、Patrick Jaillet、Gabriele Farina

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.GT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11877v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11877v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究扩展式博弈中全信息在线决策的极小极大遗憾，证明 KOMWU 等算法对约化正规形策略数 \|V\| 的 log 依赖在树形策略空间（treeplex）上已是最优；为此提出「tropical Gaussian formula」这类保方差的递归高斯表达式，并用球面熵轮廓、Turán 定理与 Sudakov 极小化给出高斯宽度下界。

**相关性简评：** 其 treeplex 把决策与观测递归组织成树结构，与 LVR 中按证据逐步展开的推理状态树在形式上相似；关于约化策略数下界的结论可供核查“树状 latent 状态压缩存在不可避免的复杂度代价”这类问题，但属纯理论博弈学习，与视觉证据、latent 生成无直接联系，借鉴需较多转化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tropical Gaussian Anticoncentration: Optimal Instance-Dependent Bounds for Online Learning in Extensive-Form Games

**abstract/A1：** We study the minimax regret of full-information online decision making in extensive-form games. For prediction with expert advice, the optimal regret is $Θ(\\sqrt{T\\log K})$, where $K$ is the number of experts, or equivalently, the number of normal-form actions. For treeplex strategy spaces, existing efficient algorithms, including KOMWU and online mirror descent with the weight-one dilated entropy regularizer, achieve regret $\\mathcal{O}(\\sqrt{T\\log\|\\mathcal{V}\|})$, where $\\mathcal{V}$ is the set of reduced normal-form strategies. We prove that this logarithmic dependence is minimax optimal in the worst-case full-information reward model. The main difficulty is that pure plans in a treeplex are not independent experts: their rewards are correlated through the recursive structure of decisions and observations. To capture this correlation, we introduce tropical Gaussian formulae, recursive Gaussian expressions built from maxima and normalized sums which preserve the variance. The index count of such a formula matches the number of reduced normal-form continuation plans in the corresponding subtree. Our main analytic result shows that every log-balanced tropical Gaussian formula with index count $N$ has Gaussian width $Ω(\\sqrt{\\log N})$. While a direct approach struggles to recover this lower bound, our proof uses a spherical entropy profile to measure scale-dependent separation among the Gaussian directions, and then applies Turán's theorem and Sudakov minoration to obtain the width lower bound. Applying this result to treeplexes gives an oblivious hard distribution with valid transition outcome and Rademacher terminal rewards, establishing a regret lower bound of $Ω(\\sqrt{T\\log\|\\mathcal{V}\|})$. This matches known upper bounds up to universal constants and shows that the DilEnt/KOMWU dependence on the reduced normal-form complexity is unavoidable.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究稀疏传感器下的交通状态估计，将 LWR 守恒律作为物理先验加入 PINN，在四条真实道路上验证其对未布点传感器的泛化优于数据驱动方法与 kriging，并给出单损失条件 PINN 以省去逐路段损失权重搜索。

**相关性简评：** 交通状态属于远离视觉推理的领域，但其「摊销式推断+结构化物理先验在证据稀疏时的平缓退化」与匹配平滑先验的对照，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据变稀时 latent 状态该由何种结构化先验约束、以及性能交叉点如何评价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Does Physics Beat Data? Data-Efficient Traffic State Estimation with Amortized PINNs

**abstract/A1：** Traffic state estimation (TSE) reconstructs traffic density at unmonitored locations from a sparse set of sensors. Data-driven models work well when sensors are dense but degrade sharply as coverage thins. We show that imposing the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards conservation law as a physics-informed prior makes TSE more data-efficient. On four real corridors (NGSIM, I-80, PeMS04, PeMS08), physics-informed estimators generalise to held-out sensors where data-driven models, including classical and deep kriging, overfit the observed ones. On the two shock-rich corridors the effect is a clear crossover: as more sensors are held out, data-driven models collapse while the physics-informed estimator degrades gracefully, leading the no-physics network by about 26-38% at 85-90% held out and the strongest classical kriging by about 10-21% at 90%. A matched smoothness prior does not reproduce the gain, and an extended Kalman filter on the same LWR model is outperformed on the shock corridors, so the advantage comes from how the conservation law is imposed. Finally, one loss-conditional PINN removes the per-corridor loss-weight search, matching a 20-point search at about 5x lower cost.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the SSTDM workshop, IEEE ICDM 2026

</details>

### 459. [CRAFT-GBM: Selecting Best Features for Gradient-Boosted Machine Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11914v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11914

**作者：** Basil Kuok、Yi Zhou、Yao Xuan、Shuping Li、Ke-Wei Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.ST

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11914v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11914v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向梯度提升树的特征子采样问题，提出 CRAFT-GBM：把根节点分裂增益转成有界观测并构造自适应训练历史下仍成立的时间一致置信界，据此保留"尚不能排除为最优"的特征，使每轮搜索的特征数量由训练证据自然决定（也支持指定比例 f 的近似 top-K 版本），并在 LightGBM 中实现与评估。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其"用置信界逐步剪除尚不能排除的候选、让候选集规模与计算预算从证据累积中涌现"的机制，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的筛选、证据获取的取舍与停止/计算分配决策形成概念类比，可供核查这种带时间一致保证的剪枝思路能否迁移到推理期假设集维护。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CRAFT-GBM: Selecting Best Features for Gradient-Boosted Machine Learning

**abstract/A1：** Feature subsampling is used to accelerate gradient-boosted trees, yet standard approaches fix the feature count in advance and largely ignore the split-gain evidence accumulated during training. We introduce CRAFT-GBM (Confidence-Ranked Adaptive Feature Tracking), a native LightGBM extension that uses this evidence to adapt which---and, by default, how many---features are searched each boosting round. CRAFT-GBM transforms root-split gains into bounded observations and constructs joint time-uniform bounds valid under adaptive, non-stationary training histories. In its default endogenous mode, after initialization, CRAFT-GBM retains exactly the features that cannot yet be ruled out as best, letting the selected feature-set size $K\_t$ emerge from training history rather than a pre-specified fraction. With probability at least $1-δ$, every feature with the largest expected gain is retained jointly across all rounds after initialization. When a feature fraction $f$ is specified instead, CRAFT-GBM ranks features by their interval point estimates and provides an approximate top-$K$ guarantee for feature budget $K\_f$. We implement CRAFT-GBM within LightGBM while preserving its native feature-bundling representation, and evaluate it across 14 public and synthetic dataset families and four noise-augmented settings. In the fully endogenous setting, CRAFT-GBM reduces per-fit training time by 39.74\\% with 1.04\\% lower test loss in the geometric mean across all 18 RQ1 experiments. Under pre-specified feature fraction $f$, Exogenous CRAFT-GBM also yields aggregate training-time reductions up to 13.52 percentage points larger than random feature subsampling, with no increase in aggregate test loss relative to full-feature LightGBM. Accumulated training evidence can thus support adaptive feature search with statistical guarantees while retaining the practical advantages of native gradient boosting.

</details>

### 460. [An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11921v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11921

**作者：** Xian Yeow Lee、Ryoichi Takase、Ahmed Farahat

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11921v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11921v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将预训练表格基础模型的下一状态预测写成对转移对的上下文回归，在合成动力系统与机器人运动基准上对比从头训练的 LSTM/MLP 和高斯过程，并考察多步自回归展开与推理成本。

**相关性简评：** 「上下文即隐式后验」的免训练状态预测，以及上下文长度强烈决定多步展开稳定性、短上下文退化到平凡基线的发现，可能为 LVR 中潜状态 rollout 的误差累积、上下文/缓存长度与计算成本的权衡提供类比线索；但属表格数据与 RL 世界模型工作，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models

**abstract/A1：** World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.

</details>

### 461. [Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11929v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11929

**作者：** Zichuan Fu、Junjia Qi、Wenlin Zhang、Yimin Deng、Shirong Wang、Jinyang Li、Xian Wu、Xiangyu Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11929v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11929v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SoMem 框架，让 LLM agent 用互链文档自组织外部记忆：自主决定摘要什么、如何分组、何时修订已有主题，每条摘要保留原始交互作为证据，查询时自行选择检索与阅读路径，在 LoCoMo 等长时记忆基准上优于最强基线。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但「摘要条目始终链回原始证据」「运行时校验更新」「查询时自主决定读什么、读到哪」可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据保真与 LOOK/STOP 决策表述提供概念线索，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?

**abstract/A1：** In most LLM agents, weights are fixed after deployment, so new information must be retained in external memory. Existing approaches often rely on predefined records and fixed organizational rules, which cannot readily accommodate evolving tasks and interactions. This raises the question: can LLM agents organize their own memory using ordinary documents? We introduce self-organized memory (SoMem), a framework that stores memory in linked documents. The agent decides what to summarize, how to group related information, and when to revise existing topics, and every summary it produces stays linked to the original interactions as evidence. The runtime validates updates and automatically derives temporal, relational, and recent-memory views from the organized content. At query time, the agent chooses what to search and read, following document links and inspecting original evidence as needed. On LoCoMo, BEAM-100K, and LongMemEval-S, SoMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.66, 3.10, and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. The constructed memory can be reused across models, and additional reasoning effort can further improve answer quality. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of agents organizing and using their own persistent memory through ordinary documents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Qi202/SoMem.

</details>

### 462. [Decision Aware Origin-Destination Demand Estimation with Structurally Constrained Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11946v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11946

**作者：** Xianzhe Wang、Yueyue Fan、Johannes Royset

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11946v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11946v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究交通 OD 需求估计，主张仅与观测数据对齐不足，应兼顾下游决策质量；方法上用几何表示刻画网络物理约束下的可行需求域以正则化搜索，并用下游后悔值的凸替代构造可解的决策感知优化问题，实验显示决策后悔低于传统基准。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但「以中间估计对下游决策的后悔而非数据拟合度作为评价目标」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态的「使用」评价与贡献分配，例如判断 latent 是否真正改善最终答案而非仅与视觉输入一致。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decision Aware Origin-Destination Demand Estimation with Structurally Constrained Data

**abstract/A1：** Origin-destination (OD) demand plays an important role in transportation system design and management applications. Conventional OD estimation methods typically judge estimation quality based on how estimated demand aligns with observed traffic data and historical demand patterns. We argue that data alignment alone is insufficient; how errors in OD estimates influence downstream decision quality should also be considered. This paper develops a decision aware OD demand estimation framework that leverages structurally constrained traffic data to characterize an admissible demand region, within which we identify OD estimates that would lead to least regret in the downstream decision. Therefore, our OD estimates are both data-consistent and decision-relevant. Methodologically, we approximate the admissible demand region induced by physical network constraints through a geometric representation, which regularizes the search over feasible OD estimates. Within this regularized region, we use a convex surrogate of downstream regret to obtain a tractable decision aware optimization problem. Numerical experiments show that the proposed framework consistently reduces decision regret relative to conventional estimation benchmarks, demonstrating the value of aligning OD demand estimation with downstream decision quality.

</details>

### 463. [Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11962v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11962

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11962v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11962v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张用数据集在归一化真实图像密度模型下的能量分布作为合成数据的审计与筛选准则，提出 Energy-Level Distribution Distance（ELD），发现其能预测 CNN 与 ViT 自监督预训练的下游表现，并据此重采样、混合合成数据源。

**相关性简评：** 其「应覆盖真实能量谱而非坍缩到高概率低变化样本」的分布覆盖度量，可能为 LVR 训练中视觉证据与难度分层的数据配比、覆盖度评估提供可核查的思路，但原文不涉及推理状态或 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality

**abstract/A1：** Synthetic data can scale visual pretraining, but current selection criteria only partially explain which datasets train strong representations. We propose using the energy profile of a dataset--the distribution of log-probability levels it occupies under a normalised real-image density model--as an audit and curation principle for synthetic data. To operationalise this view, we introduce Energy-Level Distribution Distance (ELD), which compares real and synthetic energy distributions. Real images span sparse high-likelihood scenes and dense low-likelihood textures, so useful synthetic data should cover this energy range rather than collapse to likely but low-variation samples. Across diverse synthetic datasets, ELD exposes mismatches missed by FID and predicts pretraining performance beyond FID, LPIPS variation, and feature-space recall, including across CNN and ViT self-supervised settings. We then use ELD to resample and mix synthetic sources, matching the real-image energy histogram while preserving diversity and improving downstream transfer.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as an oral presentation to NeurIPS 2026 (Sydney)

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 pairwise distortion distribution（PDD）及其渐近极限 pairwise dimension（PD），把相关积分推广到一般失真度量，证明 PD 可界定 Renyi 信息维，并用 PDD 给出随机码本量化性能的下界，以指导压缩、量化与降维中的 latent 维度选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「用内在维数刻画有效自由度并给出量化下界」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的表示几何与信息容量分析、以及 latent 维度选择提供可核查的度量工具，但论文本身面向压缩量化，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pairwise distortion distribution for compression and quantization

**abstract/A1：** Choosing the latent dimension is a critical challenge in data compression, where conventional hyperparameter optimization is costly and ad hoc. Intrinsic dimension provides a good alternative, which connects information-theoretic notions such as Renyi information dimension (RID) to rate-distortion dimension and random codebook compression. In this work, we introduce the pairwise distortion distribution (PDD) and its asymptotic limit, pairwise dimension (PD), which generalize the correlation integral to general distortion measures. We show that PD bounds RID, and PDD provides a lower bound for random codebook quantization performance, which can guide a practical use for compression, quantization, and dimensionality reduction applications.

</details>

### 465. [AutoQS: Automated Quantization Strategy Design with Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11975v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.11975

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11975v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11975v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AutoQS：在固定权重精度的前提下，用 LLM 结合评估历史协同搜索逐层、逐算子的 group-size 分配，并以低成本质量代理、候选仓库与周期性真实量化反馈在有限评估预算内完成策略设计。

**相关性简评：** 其「廉价代理打分＋周期性真实量化核验＋预算内停止」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的快速代理评价与完整推理验证之间的成本分配、停止决策形成类比，可供核查，但领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AutoQS: Automated Quantization Strategy Design with Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Quantization reduces LLM deployment costs, but effective strategies must balance model quality and storage. LLM-driven search can automate strategy design through repeated proposal and evaluation. This process must identify useful strategies within a limited evaluation budget. The key challenge is that \\textit{actual quantization is expensive, while inexpensive proxies may not reflect quantized-model performance.} To address this challenge, we present AutoQS, an \\textbf{Auto}mated \\textbf{Q}uantization \\textbf{S}trategy Design with LLMs. AutoQS keeps weight precision fixed and searches group-size allocations across layers and operators under deployment constraints. Evaluation history guides coordinated LLM proposals, while deterministic validation ensures compatible allocations. An inexpensive quality proxy evaluates candidates, and an candidate repository retains alternative allocations to inform subsequent proposals. Periodic actual quantization complements these proxy evaluations with measured quality and checkpoint storage, providing feedback for further search within the evaluation budget. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct show that AutoQS improves seven-task average accuracy over uniform-group GPTQ and AWQ by 0.70 and 1.12 percentage points, respectively, at four-bit weight precision.

</details>

**title/T1：** Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization

**abstract/A1：** In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向多层 Moiré 图案设计空间，构建含 60 万构型的基准并提出 FruBO：以 CatBoost 轻量代理模型结合委员会式不确定性估计做贝叶斯优化，在高度偏斜的目标分布中比随机采样和 GP-BO 更快找到全局最优。

**相关性简评：** 其用代理模型不确定性驱动采集函数、按预算决定下一步评估位置的做法，可能为 LVR 中证据筛选与「再看哪里／何时停止」的计算分配提供远领域类比，但无多模态推理内容，线索需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns

**abstract/A1：** Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GPU memory exhaustion after 290 acquired samples. In contrast, FruBO with CatBoost identifies the global optimum after 1,470 acquired samples and approximately 1.15 hours. These results demonstrate that scalable surrogate models can substantially improve the feasibility and efficiency of BO in large nanomaterials design spaces.

</details>

**内容简述：** MatScope 是面向演化材料实验室的科学推理基准，含三项能力：M1 用 200 个任务测模型在铝合金与高熵合金上的条件特异推理，M2 测 agent 辅助下知识迁移，MatEvoBench-20 测科学依赖链上的初始预测及随观测累积对隐藏结果的修订，共评测十一种模型部署。

**相关性简评：** 其证据逐步累积下的预测修订、相近材料状态比较与定量证据选择，可能为 LVR 中内部状态的证据整合、更新与信念稳定性评价提供问题表述上的启发；但基准以材料科学文本与数值推理为主，与视觉表征和 latent 生成无直接联系，任务形式可供核查。

**title/T1：** Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories

**abstract/A1：** Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.

**相关性简评：** 其按像素子集做组合式分支搜索、并用采样估计开销来选择搜索策略，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据子集筛选、计算预算分配与停止决策提供问题表述上的启发，需核查实际迁移空间。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FocusBranch: Combinatorial Branch-and-Bound for $\\ell\_0$ Neural Network Robustness Verification

**abstract/A1：** Verifying the local robustness of neural networks under $\\ell\_0$ perturbations is inherently combinatorial, as it must reason over all sparse subsets of $ε$ perturbed pixels. This paper presents FocusBranch, a combinatorial branch-and-bound framework for $\\ell\_0$ robustness verification. The key insight is to make the $\\ell\_0$-ball decomposable and branchable using a node abstraction, which consists of a focus pixel set $\\mathcal{S}$ and a level $l$, permitting at most $ε-l$ pixels outside $\\mathcal{S}$. This abstraction unifies two branching mechanisms: concrete nodes branch through upper shadows to fix additional perturbed locations, while super nodes branch through covering designs to cover many perturbation cases with fewer child nodes. FocusBranch proves node safety by concretizing linear relaxations over node-constrained $\\ell\_0$-balls and recursively branches on unknown nodes. Rather than relying on a fixed verification plan, it samples nodes across levels to estimate safe rates and costs, then selects a starting level and branching strategy predicted to minimize verification time. Experiments on fully connected and convolutional classifiers for MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 show that FocusBranch verifies $\\ell\_0$ robustness effectively across architectures and outperforms state-of-the-art verifiers. The code is available at: https://github.com/simpl-group/FocusBranch.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 470. [Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12031v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12031

**作者：** Shivam Pal、Piyush Rai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12031v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12031v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 Empirical Bayes Laplace 近似在 ReLU 网络尺度对称性下不良定义，因为边际似然依赖 Hessian 而不具尺度不变性；提出以 γ 参数化的先验精度场与「γ-规范化」（平衡出入权重比）后再做 EB Laplace，使边际似然在尺度等价类上不变，从而稳定选出先验精度与预测不确定性。

**相关性简评：** 该工作着眼参数化对称下的几何量与不确定性度量是否良定义，与 LVR 中对 latent 表示几何、相似度及不确定性/证据度量受位置、深度与参数化影响的关注可能相通，可核查其不变性构造能否用于 latent 状态比较与置信度评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks

**abstract/A1：** ReLU networks are well-known to have continuous scale symmetries; infinitely many reparameterized weight vectors that represent the same function. Dinh et al. (2017) have shown that, by reparameterizing, the geometry of the loss landscape (e.g., curvature) of these networks can be changed arbitrarily without affecting the underlying function. Thus, any quantity that depends on the network's geometry should be defined with care. In this paper, we show that the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace's approximation is not well-defined for ReLU networks, mainly due to Hessian dependence in computing the marginal likelihood, which is not invariant under ReLU scale symmetries. Thus, we can get different prior precisions, posterior covariances, and predictive uncertainties for a network having identical predictions under ReLU scaling. We define family of prior precision fields indexed by $γ$ and introduce $γ$-canonicalization, which first converts the network to its canonical representation by balancing the ratio of incoming to outgoing weights, and then fits the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace to the canonical representation. This procedure is equivalent to transporting the isotropic Gaussian prior from the canonical representation to the original coordinates, by producing a ReLU-scale-compatible precision field. This makes the marginal likelihood invariant under ReLU scaling, while allowing $γ$ to be selected by maximizing the marginal likelihood. The resulting EB Laplace approximation is well-defined on ReLU scale-equivalence classes and yields consistent prior precision selection and predictive uncertainties across functionally identical parameterizations.

</details>

### 471. [Evaluating AI Agents for Industrial-Level Chip Floorplanning: A Framework and Empirical Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12048v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12048

**作者：** Nova-Silicon Team

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12048v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12048v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建工业级芯片 floorplanning 的智能体评测框架：把提交布局接入指定下游实现流程，校验几何合法性并测量拥塞、时序等物理质量，在含 99 个宏单元、约占 L 形区域 71% 的工业设计上比较专用系统 Nova-SI 与通用工程智能体。

**相关性简评：** 该工作以交付布局的下游物理后果而非工具执行成功来评分，这一评测协议可能与 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否真正影响答案的因果归因、贡献分配问题相参照，属较远领域的可能线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evaluating AI Agents for Industrial-Level Chip Floorplanning: A Framework and Empirical Study

**abstract/A1：** Floorplanning is an early step in turning a logical circuit into a physical chip: it positions large circuit modules and constrains the space available for subsequent logic placement and wiring. These decisions affect congestion and timing, but their physical consequences emerge through downstream implementation. For AI agents, the task requires translating engineering constraints into spatial decisions whose quality cannot be judged by successful tool execution alone. We present an evaluation framework that connects submitted layouts to a prescribed downstream implementation flow, checks geometric validity, measures physical quality, and reports resource use. On one industrial design whose 99 macros occupy approximately 71\\% of a fixed L-shaped layout region, we compare our specialized system Nova-SI with general-purpose engineering agents and agents restricted to file access, obtaining complete physical measurements for 39 layout outputs. Under our 0--100 composite quality score, Nova-SI achieves a mean of 57.97 without online feedback from the prescribed power-grid and placement evaluation, compared with 31.17 for the strongest measured general-purpose configuration, GPT-6 Astra. The difference is supported by raw congestion and timing measurements and persists across scoring-sensitivity checks. Layout-level analysis further shows that similar global utilization can conceal substantially different local congestion. Together, the protocol and case study assess agents through the physical consequences of their delivered layouts and provide evidence about system performance on this industrial instance.

</details>

**相关性简评：** Natarajan 维刻画多类线性读出的容量，可能为分析 latent 状态上线性答案读出的可分性与泛化提供理论工具，但与视觉推理任务本身无直接联系，需核查其适用前提。

**title/T1：** Exact Natarajan Dimension of Homogeneous Multiclass Linear Predictors

**abstract/A1：** The Natarajan dimension is a fundamental measure of the capacity of multiclass hypothesis classes and plays an important role in analyzing their generalization ability. In this paper, by establishing lower and upper bounds, we show that the exact Natarajan dimension of homogeneous multiclass linear predictors with pairwise distinct class weights is \\(n(k-1)-1\\), where $n$ is the dimension of the feature space and $k$ is the number of classes, for \\(n,k\\ge3\\), \\(n,k\\in\\mathbb N\\).

### 473. [Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12066v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12066

**作者：** Maximilian Lindholz、Richard Ruppel、Annette Milnik、Sebastian Halskov、Semil Eminovic、Charlie A. Hamm、Robin Schmidt、Anika Knupfer、Jana Hutter、Johanna P. Müller、Carolina Dominguez Aleixo、Jawed Nawabi、Jens Vogel-Claussen、Tobias Penzkofer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12066v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12066v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文考察 LLM 能否仅凭医学知识直接「写出」小型 LeNet 式 CNN 的权重与偏置（weight-space programming），全程不看图像、不做训练优化；在胸片、乳腺超声、腹部 CT 与盆腔 MRI 共 7 个任务上，与零样本 MedSigLIP 及用 256 张标注图 Adam 训练的同架构网络对比，结论是 LLM 写出的网络优于随机、部分超过 MedSigLIP，但始终不及少量数据训练。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「无任何视觉输入、仅靠参数内先验完成视觉判别」的设定，可能为核查参数先验与视觉证据各自的贡献、以及标注稀缺时视觉处理能力的来源提供对照思路，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?

**abstract/A1：** Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12067

**作者：** Omar Hamdache、Serdar Kara、Kıvanç Kuzey Dikici、Abdullah Çağlar Öksüz、Anisa Halimi、Erman Ayday、Sinem Sav

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12067v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12067v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 XposedMIA，把 LIME 的局部代理几何以及表格、视觉反事实解释重新解读为样本到决策边界距离的代理，从而构建单次查询、无需影子训练的黑盒成员推理攻击，仅需约 30 个样本校准。

**相关性简评：** 「解释输出可折算为边界距离」这一思路，可能为 LVR 中的停止决策、不确定性估计或视觉反事实类证据筛选提供参照；但它属隐私安全领域，与推理状态表示的联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. After a one-time calibration step on a small labeled calibration set of as few as 30 samples, our attack requires only a single query for each target sample. Unlike prior label-only attacks requiring iterative queries or shadow training, our method relies solely on the predicted label and its accompanying explanation. Our evaluation indicates that XposedMIA achieves high effectiveness, with success rates of up to 0.95 using only a single query per target, revealing that releasing explanations introduces an additional channel for membership leakage.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 失败驱动的重启分配是一种按困难状态分配训练算力/监督的机制，可能可供核查其与 LVR 中训练样本分配、贡献分配的关系；单次前向与搜索的成本-收益对比也可作为动态计算评价的参照，但游戏领域与视觉证据、latent 状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zero-Search Reinforcement Learning for Slay the Spire 2 with Failure-Driven Restarts

**abstract/A1：** Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a deck-building roguelike in which a winning run at the highest difficulty takes several hundred decisions, and most losses happen in late boss fights that a learner seldom reaches. We train agents that choose every action with one forward pass of a 6.6M-parameter entity transformer, without lookahead. Training and evaluation run the game's own compiled assembly (v0.107.1) in a headless .NET host. The host replays a run exactly from its seed and actions, so training episodes can restart from states the learner has visited, and a failure-driven curriculum allocates these restarts in proportion to where complete runs are lost. On 12,800 held-out games at Ascension 10 (A10), the released policies win 8.05% averaged over the five characters (Ironclad 15.6%, Regent 12.5%), and AlphaSpire's released networks used without search win 0.55% on a common panel. Longer A10 training raised Ironclad from 12.4% to 15.6% and Defect from 3.0% to 8.1% on these games. At Ascension 0 the released policies win 80.2%, level with the 80.3% that the tree-search agent Spire Mentor reports, while Mentor leads by 5 to 8 points from A4 upward. Run in our host on the same 2,000 A10 games, Mentor's search wins 8.8% against 8.2% for our policies, which need 21-27 ms per decision on one CPU core. GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning won none of 11 A10 games through our text interface. In a controlled study of 18 training runs from six random initializations, failure-driven allocation exceeds uniform restart allocation on each of three Regent initializations, by 3.6 percentage points on average, while the Silent effect is small and changes sign. Code, trained policies, an in-game mod and the records behind every table are at https://github.com/HalfVulpes/sts2ai.

### 476. [Forecast Value Add: Reward-Based Action Selection over Probabilistic Demand Forecasts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12116

**作者：** Ankur Verma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12116v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把需求预测修正表述为奖励驱动的决策问题：对每个预测期，agent 在集成模型已产出的候选值（基预测、无分布区间界、分位、偏差校正值）中选择，用情境匹配的历史期做评估，并施加季节性结构约束、记录模型/agent/规划者各自贡献；在五个零售部署中平均降低 6.3% WMAPE。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「在既有候选中按奖励挑选并逐值记录来源贡献」的框架，可能为 LVR 中 latent 候选或假设筛选、以及 THINK/LOOK 收益的贡献分配提供可审计的类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Forecast Value Add: Reward-Based Action Selection over Probabilistic Demand Forecasts

**abstract/A1：** Strong machine-learning ensembles capture much of the trend, seasonality, and known events in demand, yet they can still understate peaks, miss moving events, or mistake temporary changes for shifts in demand level. We address this gap by framing forecast refinement as a reward-driven decision problem. For each forecast period, we let an agent choose among values already produced by the ensemble: its base forecast, distribution-free bounds, quantiles, and a bias-corrected estimate. We evaluate these choices against context-matched historical periods, accounting for calendar position, recurring and moving events, trend, price, and promotions. We then apply a structural seasonal guard to constrain adjustments and record the model, agent, and planner contributions to every published value. We evaluate our approach across five retail, consumer-goods, and direct-to-consumer deployments over nine months. Our refined forecasts reduce mean WMAPE by 6.3% compared with the stacked machine-learning forecast for every customer, with gains reaching 16.7%, and achieve the lowest error in 35 of 45 customer-months. Compared with statistical forecasts, our approach reduces mean error by 18.7%. These results demonstrate that context-aware, auditable action selection can add forecast value beyond a strong ensemble.

</details>
