**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Joi-Bench-Task，用可在指定时机插入干预的交互式用户模拟器，评测全双工语音 agent 在任务执行与对话并行时追踪「正在做什么、已完成什么、已告知什么、还需汇报什么」的协调能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「请求变更与中断下任务状态是否保持、何时停止并完整汇报」的评测框架，可能为 LVR 关注的状态持续性与停止决策评价提供概念参照；但材料只涉及语音与工具执行协调，与视觉证据、内部 latent 表示无直接联系，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Joi-Bench-Task: Benchmarking Task Coordination in Full-duplex Voice Agents through Interactive Simulation

**abstract/A1：** Full-duplex voice agents enable natural, hands-free interaction, allowing users to refine requests, redirect ongoing work, and seek clarification while the agent is speaking. However, existing voice-agent benchmarks insufficiently isolate coordination between task execution and conversation. We introduce a benchmark that assesses this coordination by examining whether agents track what is being executed, what has been completed, what has been communicated, and what remains to be reported as the conversation evolves. We propose an interactive user simulator that introduces configurable interventions at designated timing in tool execution and spoken result delivery, supporting controllable and reproducible evaluation conditions. We evaluate five leading commercial voice agents along three dimensions: execution responsiveness, coordination under request changes, and coordination under interruptions. Agent evaluations reveal persistent coordination failures. Under request changes, the highest result completion rate is only 55%, indicating difficulty for current voice agents adapting to new requests while preserving earlier obligations. After user interruption, four of the five agents exhibit average information omission rates of at least 23%. These findings highlight task coordination as a central challenge for current voice agents in complex, evolving conversations.

</details>

### 478. [Toward Sustainable Agentic AI: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Iterative Self-Refinement and Tool-Augmented Coding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12128v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12128

**作者：** Boris Ruf、Adrien de Mailly Nesle、Marcin Detyniecki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12128v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12128v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用两项实证研究估算 agentic AI 的能耗与碳排放：一是在 MATH 上比较 GPT-4.1-mini 多步自我精炼（k=1–5）与单次强模型基线的精度—碳成本权衡；二是在 SWE-bench Lite 上比较三个模型在 Docker 环境中使用代码执行与文件编辑工具时的正确率与「按解决任务归一化」的碳、成本效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「迭代步数/工具调用的收益—碳成本」核算与「每成功任务效率」归一化，可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类动态计算策略的成本侧度量；但只计输出 token、无视觉输入与 latent 状态，与 LVR 机制本身联系较远，属外围借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward Sustainable Agentic AI: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Iterative Self-Refinement and Tool-Augmented Coding

**abstract/A1：** Agentic language model systems can improve performance either by iterating on their own outputs or by using external tools in grounded environments. While these strategies can reduce error rates and substitute for larger models in some settings, their environmental cost remains relatively underexplored. We present two complementary empirical studies that estimate the energy and carbon footprint of agentic AI across settings of increasing complexity. Study~1 evaluates iterative verbal self-refinement: GPT-4.1-mini at $k = 1$--$5$ steps versus a GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline on two MATH benchmark splits. Study~2 evaluates tool-augmented agentic coding: GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Opus~4.6, and GPT-5.3-codex on SWE-bench Lite, where agents operate inside Docker-isolated environments with access to code execution and file editing tools. In Study~1, $k=3$ refinements close a 16-percentage-point accuracy gap to within 1~point, but nearly triple the carbon footprint relative to the cheap single-pass baseline while remaining below the GPT-4.1 single-pass baseline under the current token-based carbon scenario. In Study~2, GPT-5.3-codex achieves the highest resolution rate in this sample (81.2\\%), ahead of Claude Opus~4.6 (68.9\\%) and GPT-4.1-mini (25.0\\%), but resolved-task-normalized efficiency remains mixed: GPT-4.1-mini is lowest on estimated carbon and cost per resolved task, while GPT-5.3-codex delivers substantially higher task success. All carbon estimates cover output-token inference only; prompt tokens, which exceed 99\\% of tokens in Study~2, and tool execution are not charged, so the figures are lower bounds on the full agentic footprint.

**comment/C1：** Presented at the GREEN AI workshop @CIKM 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FedHFT 一次性个性化联邦图学习框架，用保真度驱动的代理精炼和可迁移性引导的客户端协作，缓解单轮传输下的知识压缩失真与整合低效。

**相关性简评：** 代理蒸馏的保真度损失与按可迁移性加权多源知识的做法，可能为 latent 状态的信息坍缩和贡献分配问题提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One-Shot Federated Graph Learning via High-Fidelity Proxies and Transferability-Guided Collaboration

**abstract/A1：** One-shot Federated Graph Learning (OFGL) has emerged as a communication-efficient paradigm for federated graph learning under strict bandwidth constraints, compressing collaboration into a single transmission round. Nevertheless, this extreme setting suffers from a fundamental Single-Transmission Bottleneck, which limits both the quality and utility of exchanged knowledge. First, while existing methods attempt to distill private graphs into shareable proxies, their aggressive one-shot compression inherently triggers a fidelity crisis. This compression distorts local graph topology and semantics across clients, leading to externalized knowledge underexpression. Second, although the server aggregates these proxies to update global models, current integration schemes suffer from transferability agnosticism. The server cannot reliably identify cross-client collaboration potential, thus resulting in integrated knowledge underutilization. To tackle these dual challenges, we propose FedHFT, an effective One-Shot Personalized Federated Graph Learning (OPFGL) framework that addresses this bottleneck from two perspectives, namely High-Fidelity Knowledge Externalization and Transferability-Ware Knowledge Integration. We use Fidelity-Driven Proxy Refinement to preserve client-side knowledge fidelity, and Transferability-Steered Personalized Collaboration to enable adaptive server-side collaboration. The superiority of FedHFT is validated through extensive experiments on both homophilic and heterophilic graphs. The code is available at https://github.com/Jumpy-Juice/FedHFT.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究重尾 bandit 在矩参数未知时的自适应：提出「方差核心可见性」这一单侧、平移不变条件，给出分位数截尾 UCB 索引，刻画可常数因子达到中心矩基准的最优臂分布类，并说明不存在跨可见性层统一的单一策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「承载均值的证据可能藏在稀有事件中」与按可见性分层的不可适应结果，可能为 LVR 中稀有但关键的视觉证据获取、LOOK/STOP 决策与信息下界评价提供问题表述线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visible Tails: Characterizing Adaptation to Unknown Moments in Heavy-Tailed Bandits

**abstract/A1：** Heavy-tailed bandit learners without moment parameters face an obstruction: the rewards that carry an arm's mean can stay unseen. We address the remaining part of a COLT open problem by characterizing the optimal-arm laws that permit adaptation to unknown moments at constant-factor cost. The condition, variance-core visibility, is one-sided and translation-invariant: the mean hidden in any rare event is at most a constant multiple of the standard error of the rewards that remain. A quantile-trimmed UCB index that knows the visibility constants attains the central-moment benchmark on this class, and no single strategy adapts across all visibility levels. The same index achieves logarithmic expected regret on every instance with a visible optimal arm and finite-mean rewards. On an explicit family with no higher moment, gap $Δ$ and constant $A$, its logarithmic coefficient and the information lower bound are of order $Δ^{-1}e^{A/Δ}$, exponential in the inverse gap within one visibility class.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文在股指期货分钟级收益预测上做预注册评估：用五个冻结时序基础模型的零样本预测，比较原生价格、对数收益、波动标准化收益与成交量时钟等输入表示，并对照「无变化」基线与统计检验，结论是模型无增量预测力，而若干常规指标仍显示虚假技能。

**相关性简评：** 其「多数指标显示技能但平凡基线更优、并需在零假设下核查增量」的评估思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理相对简单基线（如直接回答、回退均值）的增益是否被指标与输入表示放大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations

**abstract/A1：** We ask whether the apparent forecasting skill of frozen time-series foundation models (TSFMs) on intraday index-futures returns is incremental skill. In a pre-registered evaluation on E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) and E-mini S&amp;P 500 (ES) futures, a common panel of five zero-shot models (Chronos-Bolt, Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Moirai 2.0 and TiRex), plus separate experiments with Kronos, is compared with a no-change forecast at 5-120 minutes, using native prices, log returns, volatility-standardised returns and a volume clock as inputs. On a blind set opened once, 0 of 160 model-representation-horizon-market cells beat no-change, and a Hansen SPA test gives p = 1.000 on both markets; a later retrospective hold-out, scored as a descriptive check, gives 0 of 120. Input representations change forecast magnitude but not accuracy, and a transformation-aware ridge regression does as well. Several standard measures nevertheless suggest skill. Price-level correlation exceeds 0.9996, but no-change scores higher. Within-day RankIC across forecast origins rewards a trivial revert-to-mean rule (+0.35 at 30 minutes); we derive the expected within-day covariance under a random walk in closed form, and a sign-randomised null reproduces about 95% of the observed value. One model beats HAR for 5-minute volatility, but not the EWMA its input already contains. On strongly planted synthetic signals the models recover part of the signal at 5 minutes, and recovery deteriorates at 30 minutes. Benchmark-level success of TSFMs should therefore not be assumed to carry over to low-signal domains such as intraday returns.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「残差只反映内部一致性而非独立精度」的诊断可能可供核查 LVR 中以跨模态一致性或相似度充当证据、监督信号的评价方式，但本文不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency

**abstract/A1：** Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \\textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\\,\\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\\,\\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\\pm1.29\\,\\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\\pm31.3\\,\\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\\pm0.29\\,\\mathrm{cm}$ after $\\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「由粗到细」的层次化序列化与状态抽象可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的分层组织、更新顺序及计算成本分配提供概念线索；但研究对象是图生成而非多模态推理，迁移可行性需要核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Flat Walks: Compositional Abstraction for Autoregressive Graph Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive graph generators typically linearize graphs through flat node-edge walks, which can obscure higher-order structure in large and complex graphs. We introduce a hierarchical graph abstraction and coarse-to-fine generation pipeline that separates coarsening, tokenization, and decoding. This exposes three design axes: community coarsening, hierarchical tokenization, and order randomization. Across these axes, traversal-based hierarchy consistently improves distributional and structural fidelity, while its V.U.N.\\ cost depends strongly on the coarsening and randomization policy. In particular, the fidelity--V.U.N.\\ trade-off observed under within-community randomization is substantially reduced when traversal order is randomized across the full hierarchy. With a fixed backbone, training protocol, and matched training time across five molecular and five non-molecular benchmarks, hierarchical serialization yields consistent distributional and structural gains on all molecular datasets, while the non-molecular results further show that these gains depend on how well the supplied hierarchy aligns with structure in the target distribution. Together, these results characterize when and how hierarchical serialization benefits autoregressive graph generation.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 NSL-KDD 与 ToN-IoT 上对 Pegasos-QSVC 量子核分类器做受控评测，用精确无噪后端与三个噪声模拟后端共 56 组实验，并结合 Gram 矩阵的有效秩与条件数分析其稳定性与退化行为。

**相关性简评：** 其用核 Gram 矩阵有效秩与病态程度刻画表示脆弱性、并显式检测退化分类器坍缩的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息坍缩与表示几何诊断提供可核查的度量线索，但领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Stability in Network Intrusion Detection

**abstract/A1：** Quantum kernel methods have been proposed for network intrusion detection, yet their performance limitations are often attributed to noise in current quantum hardware. This study evaluates that assumption through a controlled analysis of Pegasos-QSVC on the NSL-KDD and ToN-IoT datasets. We perform 56 quantum experiments using one exact noiseless statevector backend and three noise-simulated superconducting backends while keeping preprocessing, PCA features, data splits, and classical baselines identical. XGBoost achieves accuracies of 98.94% on NSL-KDD and 99.41% on ToN-IoT, compared with 91.80% and 82.98% for Pegasos-QSVC. The quantum model also exhibits substantially greater seed-dependent variability. Eight runs collapse into degenerate classifiers, including four recall-collapse cases and four trivial-positive classifiers. Notably, two failures occur on the noiseless backend, demonstrating that hardware noise is not a necessary condition for classi-fier collapse. Kernel Gram matrix analysis further reveals low effective rank and severe ill-conditioning even in the absence of noise, indicating intrinsic fragility in the learned quantum representation. These results show that average accuracy alone can conceal operationally unacceptable behavior and highlight the importance of reporting worst-case performance, seed-level variability, class-specific metrics, and explicit degeneracy tests in quantum intrusion detection studies.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12243v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12243v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 CADMA，一种面向生成模型召回评估的容量感知框架，通过真实样本与生成样本之间的局部容量匹配，把基于几何的覆盖与有效覆盖区分开，从而对 mode dropping 与 mode collapse 给出多维诊断信号。

**相关性简评：** 其将覆盖度拆分为几何覆盖与有效覆盖、并区分多样性失败类型的思想，可能可供借鉴于评估并行或扩散式 latent 推理中多个 latent 假设的覆盖与坍缩，但与原论文的视觉推理场景关联较远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CADMA: Capacity-Aware Coverage Decomposition for Generative Model Assessment

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating generative models requires measuring not only sample fidelity but also how well a generated set covers the real data distribution. Recent work has therefore introduced recall-oriented metrics for distribution-level evaluation. However, existing recall metrics often reduce distributional coverage to geometry-based coverage. This simplifying assumption weakens their diagnostic value and interpretability in two ways: these metrics provide only a single aggregate score that cannot distinguish essential diversity failures such as mode dropping and mode collapse, and geometry-based coverage can provide unreliable estimates by assigning high scores to poorly covered generative distributions. We therefore introduce CADMA, a capacity-aware framework for recall-oriented evaluation and diagnosis. CADMA evaluates distributional coverage through local capacity matching between real and generated samples, separating geometry-based coverage from effective coverage. This yields multi-dimensional coverage diagnostics that quantify mode dropping and mode collapse while reducing the overly optimistic estimates produced by geometry-based metrics. Through extensive experiments on toy data, real-world datasets, and generative models, we show that CADMA provides more reliable coverage estimates and more fine-grained, interpretable diagnostic signals of diversity failures than existing metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA\_NeurIPS2026.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models increasingly combine geometry, semantics, and spatial context for three-dimensional scene understanding, but their suitability for forensic crime scene reconstruction remains unclear. This study presents a structured forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models and demonstrates it using the Egocentric Foundation Model for 3D (EFM3D). Four simulated indoor crime scenes were recorded with Meta Project Aria Gen~1 at Robert Gordon University's East Lodge House forensic training facility. The framework evaluates room-scale reconstruction, semantic scene understanding, computational performance, and forensic suitability. Across the four scenes, EFM3D generated meshes averaging $12{,}668\\pm2{,}430$ vertices and $24{,}838\\pm4{,}903$ faces, with 39,529 recorded semantic predictions spanning 21--24 categories at a mean confidence of 0.40. Because reference meshes and expert-labelled 3D ground truth were unavailable, these statistics are treated as descriptive outputs rather than measures of geometric or detection accuracy. Final inference runs processed $1{,}388\\pm203$ snippets per scene at $0.69\\pm0.01$ samples/s and required $50.77\\pm6.12$ minutes per recording. A seven-criterion capability profile indicated stronger support for room geometry, furniture localisation, scene context, and spatial relationships than for fine-scale forensic evidence. The results position EFM3D as a complementary tool for contextual documentation and scene review rather than a replacement for high-fidelity forensic capture. The framework provides a reproducible basis for evaluating future egocentric foundation models in specialised forensic settings.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ODDS-DR，把事件时间预测的分布输出参数设计成 log-odds 可加形式，在保持分布回归预测性能的同时，支持随预测时间窗变化的逐层特征归因，并在两个临床队列上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其 log-odds 可加分解与逐层、时间依赖的归因结构，可能为 LVR 中跨推理步的贡献分配与 latent 状态可解释性提供概念对照，可供核查；与视觉多模态推理本身无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Odds-Structured Distributional Regression for Interpretable Time-to-Event Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Time-to-event prediction is fundamentally challenged by partial observability and aleatoric uncertainty. In clinical medicine, for instance, the timing of disease progression or acute readmission is contingent on highly dynamic and largely latent health trajectories. Rather than forcing a deterministic point forecast, distributional regression offers a principled means to address this complexity by predicting a probability distribution over time. However, explaining these distributional predictions presents a key obstacle: raw distribution parameters output by the model are abstract mathematical quantities that do not align well with domain concepts. To gain interpretability, we propose a novel paradigm where output parameters are designed to be additive in log-odds---a widely established measure in clinical risk modeling. Our approach, called ODDS-DR, moves beyond technical convenience to deliver clear domain alignment as well as the layer-wise computational structure required for robust, time-dependent feature attribution. Validated across two real-world clinical cohorts, our framework matches state-of-the-art predictive performance while resolving distributional outputs into interpretable risk markers across flexible prognostic horizons.

</details>

### 488. [Representational Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain in Speech Processing under Audiovisual Noise](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12291v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12291

**作者：** Cheng Luo、Jian Zhu、Zhoujian Sun、Yunyi Qi、Yu Qi、Wenhui Sun、Wenyuan Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12291v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12291v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究在视听噪声语音理解场景下考察 DNN 与人脑表征的对齐：用神经编码模型模拟对声学与语言特征的神经响应，再用 RSA 比较预训练 ASR 模型微调前后各层嵌入与脑响应的相似性，发现浅层偏向声学、深层偏向语言，微调增强了这种分工。

**相关性简评：** 其「按深度比对表征相似性并观察微调前后变化」的分析范式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度受深度与内容维度影响的问题提供评价思路，但属语音模态，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Representational Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain in Speech Processing under Audiovisual Noise

**abstract/A1：** Speech comprehension in the human brain is an incremental process that begins with acoustic processing and advances to linguistic processing. While recent studies have revealed that the hierarchy of deep neural networks (DNNs) correlates with the ascending auditory pathway, the exact nature of this DNN-brain alignment remains underexplored. In this study, we investigate how DNN representations align with the brain's acoustic-to-linguistic processing. Specifically, we employed neural encoding models to simulate neural responses to acoustic (i.e., speech and noise envelope) and linguistic features (i.e., word onset and surprisal). By applying representational similarity analysis (RSA), we quantified the similarity between these neural responses and the DNN embeddings generated by a pre-trained automatic speech recognition (ASR) model, both before and after fine-tuning on audiovisual noisy data. Our results demonstrate significant DNN-brain alignment: embeddings from shallow layers exhibit higher similarity to neural responses associated with acoustic features, while those from deeper layers align more closely with neural responses related to linguistic features. Importantly, the fine-tuning process enhances this alignment by improving noise processing in shallower layers and refining linguistic representations in deeper layers. These results suggest that fine-tuned DNN models can naturally develop human-like processing patterns in noisy environments, highlighting a functional alignment between the human brain and DNNs in speech representation.

**comment/C1：** Alignment between Deep Neural Networks and Human Brain

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12300

**作者：** Jianmin Ji

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12300v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12300v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出可重构动作理论（RAT），把模块的加载与卸载建模为受因果律约束的动作，使动作理论本身可在执行中改变；给出下一配置唯一性、模块加入后行为保持、加载顺序无关的充分条件与推理复杂度，并转译为 ASP，与若干官方 agent harness 执行对比。

**相关性简评：** 该文的模块化因果语义与「加入模块不破坏既有行为、顺序无关」的形式条件，或可借来表述 LVR 中组合多个推理/观察环节时状态更新是否可预测、目标是否可达，但对 latent 表示与视觉证据并无直接讨论，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reconfigurable Action Theories: A Formal Foundation for Dynamically Composable Agent Harnesses

**abstract/A1：** Action theories typically fix their vocabulary and causal laws, whereas agent harnesses can change their tools, providers, and policies during execution. We introduce Reconfigurable Action Theories (RAT), in which actions can change the action theory itself. A theory module in RAT contains a vocabulary, causal laws, and an initializer. A RAT configuration records the active modules and the world state. Module loading and unloading are represented by actions governed by ordinary causal laws. RAT retains the standard causal action semantics of its language fragment when the active module set is fixed. We give sufficient conditions for at most one next configuration, preservation of existing behavior when a module is added, and equal results when modules are loaded in either order. We establish the computational complexity of reasoning tasks in RAT and translate finite RAT systems into nonmonotonic causal theories and Answer Set Programming (ASP), preserving bounded executions. Experiments compare finite RAT models with executions of official DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenHands implementations. RAT provides a formal basis for checking how component changes affect a harness's available actions, behavior, and reachable goals.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12307

**作者：** Riccardo Cavarra、Lupo Lovatelli、Shaheim Ogbomo-Harmitt、Jakub Grzelak、Adelaide De Vecchi、Andrew King、Oleg Aslanidi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12307v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12307v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PACE-ECG：将同一患者时间相邻 ECG 的对比学习与临床引导的多任务监督结合做预训练，并以冻结表示在 MIMIC-IV 及两个外部 HEEDB 队列上预测心梗后全因死亡与新发心衰，同时给出匹配消融。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「配对/监督目标设计决定表示可迁移性」「域内表现不足以确立泛化」的冻结表示跨队列评价思路，可能为 latent 表示的跨分布评估与训练目标取舍提供间接参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PACE-ECG: Patient-Aware Contrastive ECG Pretraining; Leveraging Longitudinal Structure for Transferable Representations

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models for physiological signals are commonly evaluated on in-domain interpretation tasks, but their ability to transfer to longitudinal clinical prognosis across healthcare systems remains uncertain. We developed PACE-ECG, an ECG pretraining framework that combines contrastive learning across temporally neighbouring recordings from the same patient with clinically guided multitask supervision. We evaluated frozen ECG representations for post-myocardial-infarction all-cause mortality and incident heart failure prediction across MIMIC-IV and two external HEEDB cohorts, comparing the proposed representation with DeepECG-SSL, a state-of-the-art model, and two control baselines. Across both downstream tasks, the proposed model outperformed DeepECG-SSL in-domain (AUROC +1.9% for mortality and +4.0% for heart failure) and on external populations in HEEDB-Boston (+5.6% for mortality +10.3% for heart failure) and HEEDB-Atlanta (+6.9% for mortality +11.0% for heart failure) while using an encoder 41 times smaller and a fraction of the pretraining data. A matched ablation showed that patient-temporal pairing improved external mortality and heart failure AUROC over generic self-supervision by 7.0% and 9.4% on HEEDB-Boston and 8.9% and 9.3% on HEEDB-Atlanta. These findings indicate that pretraining-objective design greatly influences downstream transfer alongside model and data scale, and that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to establish the clinical generalisability of ECG foundation representations.

</details>

### 491. [The Optimal Rate Constant of Heavy-Ball Momentum on Smooth Strongly Convex Functions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12310v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12310

**作者：** Marcos Hernanz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12310v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12310v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画 heavy-ball 动量法在光滑强凸函数类上的最优最坏情形收敛速率，证明最优调参下速率常数渐近趋于 8（即比梯度下降快约 4 倍），并用「慢衰减螺旋」构造下界、以显式调参与 Lyapunov 函数给出匹配上界。

**相关性简评：** 循环式 latent 推理可看作带惯性状态更新的迭代动力系统，该文关于加速增益上限与振荡/阻尼权衡的分析及 Lyapunov 工具，可能为评估 loop 结构的收益与停止步数提供类比视角，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Optimal Rate Constant of Heavy-Ball Momentum on Smooth Strongly Convex Functions

**abstract/A1：** The heavy-ball method with a constant step size and a constant momentum parameter accelerates gradient descent on quadratics, but no choice of the two parameters does so on the class of smooth strongly convex functions. We determine how much faster than gradient descent it can be made on this class. Writing the best worst-case rate over all tunings as $1-c(κ)/κ$, where $κ$ is the condition number, we prove that $c(κ)$ tends to $8$ in every dimension of two or more. The lower bound on the rate holds for every tuning, because a tuning that is faster than $1-8/κ$ on quadratics follows a slowly decaying spiral on some function of two variables. The matching upper bound comes from an explicit tuning, with nearly the momentum of Polyak's tuning and a step size about $\\sqrtκ/8$ times smaller, and from a Lyapunov function whose positivity is verified in exact arithmetic. Optimally tuned heavy-ball is therefore asymptotically four times faster than gradient descent on this class.

**comment/C1：** 41 pages, 1 figure. Code and exact certificates: https://github.com/marcoshernanz/heavy-ball-optimal-rate

</details>

### 492. [A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12314v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12314

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12314v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12314v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文从模块化视角拆解多智能体强化学习系统，将其分为智能体、环境、学习、奖励建模、训练与执行模式、通信、对他者的建模及评价标准八个功能模块，并实现模块显式可互换的 MARLKIT 框架以支持受控对比与组合实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「模块显式化＋机制受控隔离与组合」的做法，可能可供核查用于拆解 LVR 中视觉编码、latent 状态更新与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 各部分的贡献与消融设计，但与视觉推理本身无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems

**abstract/A1：** The growing complexity of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has fragmented the literature, obscuring underlying architectural choices behind diverse implementations. This fragmentation makes it difficult to evaluate critical modeling dimensions in isolation, identify how components affect the resulting system dynamics, and compare, reuse, or combine contributions across the literature. This paper proposes a modular perspective for modeling, analyzing, and implementing MARL systems. We decompose them into eight functional modules: agents, environments, learning, reward modeling, training and execution modes, communication, modeling of other agents, and evaluation criteria. For each module, we clarify its role and review representative approaches. We instantiate this decomposition in MARLKIT, a framework whose modules are explicit and interchangeable. MARLKIT demonstrates how the proposed perspective supports transparent experimental assumptions and the controlled variation and combination of MARL mechanisms. Experiments illustrate its ability to prototype, compare, reuse and combine modules while making differences between configurations explicit. Overall, the paper provides a structured perspective on MARL modeling and implementation, offering a common language for making modeling choices explicit, supporting clearer descriptions of MARL approaches, and supporting more controlled experimentation through the systematic isolation and combination of MARL mechanisms.

**comment/C1：** 71 pages. 18 figures. Associated repository: https://github.com/tmaisonhaute/marlkit

</details>

### 493. [How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12324v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12324

**作者：** Ku Onoda、Haruto Kawano、Shota Takashiro、Kohei Hayashi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12324v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12324v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 ARC-AGI-3 交互游戏上追问世界模型需多少次「曝光」才能学会新机制，提出标注 69 种机制的 MechEval 评测、35M 参数 ViT 世界模型 WARC（每次转移后更新全部参数）及配套探索智能体 WARC-Agent。

**相关性简评：** 其以「每次曝光」为单位度量内部状态对新规则的吸收速度、并按机制改变的格子评估预测，可能为 LVR 中证据获取预算、动态计算收益与状态更新监督提供参照，但研究对象是游戏世界模型，与 VLM 视觉细粒度保留仅有间接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time

**abstract/A1：** World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 21 figures, 12 tables. ARC Prize 2026 Paper Track. Code and weights: https://github.com/third-intelligence/WARC

**title/T1：** AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation

**abstract/A1：** For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\\% validity (vs. 32.5\\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

### 495. [Evidence or Marginal? What Moment-Vector Propagation Computes in Polynomial Density Neurons](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12339v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12339

**作者：** Przemysław Spyra

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12339v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12339v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究多项式密度神经元在输入缺失或以信念 q 已知时应输出什么，比较两种公式：p\_CD=E\_q\[N\]/E\_q\[D\]（把信念当作虚拟证据做贝叶斯更新）与 p\_EU=E\_q\[N/D\]（把信念作为新边缘，即 Jeffrey 规则），并以后验解读、合成与前导实验检验二者差异与适用边界。

**相关性简评：** 其“条件化 vs 替换边缘”的形式区分可能为 LVR 中“答案是否真正使用视觉证据、抑或绕开证据走边缘旁路”提供一种可核查的信念状态更新刻画，但对象为密度神经元、无视觉与语言实验，迁移需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evidence or Marginal? What Moment-Vector Propagation Computes in Polynomial Density Neurons

**abstract/A1：** When a neuron's input is lost, or known through a belief $q$, what should it output? For a neuron storing a joint polynomial density $N$ with input density $D$, two formulas compete. $p\_\\mathrm{CD}=E\_q\[N\]/E\_q\[D\]$ costs one matrix-vector product; Hierarchical Correlation Reconstruction introduces it as a constant-denominator approximation to $p\_\\mathrm{EU}=E\_q\[N/D\]$. For a density model both are exact answers to different questions: $p\_\\mathrm{CD}$ is Bayesian updating with the belief as virtual evidence; $p\_\\mathrm{EU}$ installs the belief as a new marginal (Jeffrey's rule). With a missing input $p\_\\mathrm{CD}$ returns the model's conditional; $p\_\\mathrm{EU}$ generally does not. This post hoc reading is proved, and illustrated outside the pair family up to $k=8$ inputs; it has no pre-registered test, only one exploratory real-data pilot. Post hoc, closed forms fall within a factor 2 of all 112 measured gaps, and negative density begins near input correlation $1/k$. In a pre-registered synthetic study (up to 32 inputs), 5 of 15 hypotheses are supported, 2 inconclusive and 8 not supported, including all three on transfer beyond equicorrelated Gaussians. Post hoc, where $p\_\\mathrm{EU}$ is defined, truncation usually outweighs the gap for Beta beliefs in pair neurons; triple neurons under flat and data beliefs are exceptions.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 12 figures, 33 tables. Code: https://github.com/Przemyslaw11/EvidenceOrMarginal

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AutoBuddy-Bench，以时间图模拟组织的员工、项目、业务系统与事件历史并渲染为真实工作区产物，从事件派生待办任务与正确结果，评测 agent 的主动任务发现与执行，并构建可替换骨干 LLM 的参考 agent AutoBuddy。

**相关性简评：** 其「发现」与「执行」能力分离（发现精度与执行质量仅弱相关）以及「已识别任务却提前止步」的失败刻画，可能对 LVR 中证据获取与停止决策的评测设计提供参照；但该工作无视觉输入与 latent 状态，联系较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace

**abstract/A1：** As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.

</details>

### 497. [Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12422v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12422

**作者：** Uros Zivanovic、Rahul Srinivasan、Roberto Trotta、Andre Scaffidi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12422v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12422v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出两阶段似然无关贝叶斯推断方法 RSBI：先由可微模拟器的距离度量构造代理似然，一次性给出高效提议分布，再用 Schrödinger Bridge 扩散采样器配合仅在提议支撑区学习的神经似然比细化到真实后验，并可选 meta-dynamics 改善多峰覆盖。

**相关性简评：** 其「一次性提议＋证据引导细化」的多峰后验采样框架，或可类比 LVR 中多 latent 假设的生成与按视觉证据逐步筛选，其先验体积与模式覆盖的评价方式可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two-Phase Rapid Simulation-Based Inference with Differentiable Simulators

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Rapid Simulation Based Inference (RSBI), a diffusion-based variational approach to likelihood-free Bayesian inference that achieves high sampling efficiency under large prior-to-posterior volumes. RSBI builds on advances in Schrödinger Bridge (SB) diffusion sampling to handle multi-modal posteriors, with an initial likelihood supplied by a distance measure via a differentiable simulator. The key innovation of this initial surrogate likelihood is that it gives a highly efficient proposal distribution, replacing sequential rounds of other methods with an efficient one-shot proposal. Subsequent refinement then transports the proposal to the true posterior as specified by the simulator and the original prior. The SB sampler is warm-started from the proposal, and its energy is corrected by a neural likelihood ratio that is learned only where the proposal places mass. As a variational method, RSBI does not suffer from prior leakage commonly observed in standard sequential posterior estimation methods. To improve mode coverage we optionally utilize the well-tempered meta-dynamics framework, which also encourages exploration of the prior volume. We observe strong performance on standard SBI benchmarks, particularly when the prior volume is increased relative to the ground truth posterior, achieving a performance degradation of only $\\sim5\\%$ on Two Moons under a highly constrained simulation budget. Additionally, we evaluate RSBI's performance for gravitational wave ring-down posterior estimation, in a real-world physics benchmark inspired by black hole spectroscopy.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS Camera Ready

</details>

### 498. [UCB-min: Combining Bandits Under Variance Heterogeneity (Extended Version)](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12427v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12427

**作者：** Lilia Izri、Benoit Groz、Silviu Maniu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12427v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12427v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 UCB-min：在方差异质且未知的情形下，为每个臂自适应地在方差无关与方差感知两类探索奖励中选取更紧的一项，并给出 regret 上界，用合成数据、教育推荐和两个群组推荐基准验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「按单元在稳健与高效估计之间自适应切换、并以 regret 刻画代价」的思路，可能为 LVR 中逐步选择计算/证据获取方式与停止决策提供可核查的线索，但需判断多臂设定能否对应推理中的状态与成本结构。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UCB-min: Combining Bandits Under Variance Heterogeneity (Extended Version)

**abstract/A1：** Multi-armed bandits are a natural framework for many real-world sequential decision problems, from recommender systems and clinical trials to educational test recommendation and online advertising. The performance of these algorithms depends on how they explore different arms, and exploration strategies range from variance-independent (e.g., UCB1) to variance-aware (e.g., UCB-V). In practice the reward variance of each arm is rarely known and varies widely across arms, and the reward support is often underspecified. In these cases no single rule is uniformly best: variance-independent methods are robust but loose when variances are small, while variance-aware methods are tight only when their variance estimates and the assumed support bound are reliable. Such heterogeneous, unknown variances arise in many settings, for instance when multiple objectives are scalarized into a single reward. We propose UCB-min, a per-arm adaptive meta-algorithm that selects, for each arm, the tighter of a variance-independent and a variance-aware exploration bonus, without prior knowledge of the variance regime and without reward normalization. We prove that, with UCB-V as variance-aware base, its regret is bounded by the sum of the two base bounds at the standard exploration constant, and by their per-arm minimum, up to a constant, for a larger one. We validate it on synthetic data, an educational tutoring task, and two group-recommendation benchmarks (MovieLens, Steam), showing that UCB-min consistently tracks the best base algorithm across diverse variance regimes and datasets.

**comment/C1：** Extended version of short conference paper accepted at IEEE BigData 2026

</details>

### 499. [Patching Up Circuit Learning via Parameter Sharing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12436v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12436

**作者：** Charles Bricout、Gennaro Gala、Viacheslav Borovitskiy、Antonio Vergari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12436v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12436v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文重新审视概率电路在图像 patch 上假设独立的做法，指出该假设反而能取得更好的似然，并据此提出递归参数共享构造 RePA，在不假设独立的前提下降低时间与显存开销，并推广为 NoPA 以处理表格等无 patch 结构的数据。

**相关性简评：** 其递归参数共享与可 tract 推断的「效率—似然」权衡，可能为循环/深层复用式 latent 计算的参数与显存预算设计提供思路，可供核查；但研究对象是概率电路而非 VLM 推理，联系较远，需先确认递归共享与循环推理状态更新是否真的可比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Patching Up Circuit Learning via Parameter Sharing

**abstract/A1：** Probabilistic circuits (PCs) have emerged as generative models guaranteeing tractable probabilistic inference. However, tractability comes at the price of larger model sizes than in other generative models. As such, to scale PCs to high-dimensional data such as images, previous work has devised several parameter sharing techniques as well as fast evaluation protocols that consider learning PCs on independent image patches. In this work, we revisit this practice to highlight a surprising learnability issue: models that assume independence counterintuitively can yield better likelihoods than models that do not. To break this apparent bottleneck and to scale PCs further, we introduce a recursive parameter sharing construction (RePA) that fosters efficiency without assuming independence. We show empirically that RePA can greatly reduce time and memory consumption while yielding competitive likelihoods. Inspired by these results, we further generalize the approach to data modalities that do not inherently exhibit patch-structure (NoPA), such as tabular data, showing similar efficiency improvements, with marginal changes in likelihoods and sample quality on seven tabular datasets. Code available at https://github.com/april-tools/RePA.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS26

</details>

### 500. [LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12445v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12445

**作者：** Yu Tang、Zhiyuan You、Zhixiao Wang、Fanghua Yu、Qingyu Zhang、Xiang Yin、Chao Dong、Jinjin Gu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12445v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12445v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** LongSCOP 研究长视频外扩：采用分块迭代生成，并提出含 self-forcing 训练、latent calibration 与未来参考帧的训练方案以抑制块间不一致和误差累积，同时用 VLM 智能体从全片自动挑选信息量最大的参考帧维持主体与场景一致，另构建 62K 视频片段数据和 LVO-Bench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 任务是视频外扩生成而非多模态推理，但其「VLM 智能体筛选参考帧」的视觉证据选择机制和 latent calibration 对长时语义漂移的约束，可能为 LVR 中的证据获取与隐状态漂移控制提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting

**abstract/A1：** Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

A CNN is trained to regress log timing ratios between candidate solvers using spy plot images of matrix nonzero structure as input, achieving strong prediction accuracy on both held-out SuiteSparse matrices and real-world matrices from high-performance simulation codes.

**内容简述：** 该论文在两个材料科学基准上把 TabPFN 与 TabICL 两种表格基础模型直接作为贝叶斯优化代理模型，与高斯过程、随机森林和 CatBoost 等基线对比，发现其无需任务特定训练或核函数选择也能保持竞争力。

**相关性简评：** 材料主动学习与视觉多模态推理相距较远，但贝叶斯优化中以不确定性驱动“继续获取证据还是停止”的采集函数设计，可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与证据筛选评价提供可供核查的形式化视角。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.

**内容简述：** 提出 SciMARS，用共享证据图与独立的组件编辑器递归调整多智能体角色、协作和记忆策略，并以候选探针指导下一套 harness 的组成与选择。

**title/T1：** SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery

**abstract/A1：** We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文研究 POMDP 的似然式参数学习，将参数恢复误差上界表示为与真实模型的似然差、观测与转移核的结构条件数以及数据采集行为策略的函数，并为 MLE 等低似然差估计给出有限样本保证。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「似然拟合不等于潜在状态参数恢复」以及行为策略覆盖与混合影响潜在恢复的结论，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的可辨识性、轨迹数据分布与监督信号设计，但并非直接的视觉推理工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Likelihood Convergence to Parameter Convergence in POMDPs

**abstract/A1：** Likelihood-based methods are widely used to learn the parameters of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). While finite-sample guarantees for policy suboptimality exist for certain POMDP subclasses, analogous guarantees for parameter recovery remain less well understood. For any candidate POMDP parameter, we bound its parameter recovery error in terms of its likelihood gap to the ground truth, the structural conditioning of the observation and transition kernels, and the behavior policy used to collect data. The bound applies in both the undercomplete and overcomplete regimes, with the latter following naturally from the undercomplete analysis. Because the result applies to any sufficiently good candidate, it yields finite-sample guarantees for the maximum-likelihood estimator and any procedure producing a parameter with controlled likelihood gap. This is particularly useful for near-optimal learning in infinite-horizon POMDPs, where existing approaches largely rely on model-based planning with accurate transition and observation kernel estimates. The bound separates the contributions of the behavior policy and model, showing how data-collection choices, including action coverage, and their effects on mixing can accelerate parameter learning.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 TRACE，一个开放式分子贝叶斯优化框架：用图扰动按需生成候选，配合基于 fragprints 的固定化学感知 GP 代理，以 Tanimoto 相似度阈值控制化学探索范围、以候选数量预算控制搜索广度，并由成功/失败控制器自适应扩张或收缩这两项。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRACE: Adaptive Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for Open-Ended Molecular Design

**abstract/A1：** Optimizing molecules under small evaluation budgets requires deciding both where in chemical space to search and which candidate within that region to evaluate. We introduce Trust Region Adaptive Chemical Exploration (TRACE), a framework for open-ended molecular Bayesian optimization (BO), where candidates are generated on demand rather than selected from a fixed library. TRACE combines an objective-free graph-perturbation mechanism with a fixed, chemistry-aware Gaussian process (GP) surrogate using fragprints, a representation combining molecular fingerprints and fragment descriptors. Rather than learning the search geometry itself, TRACE makes the scale of chemical exploration explicit through a Tanimoto-similarity threshold controlling chemical extent and a cardinality budget controlling candidate-search breadth. A simple success/failure controller expands or contracts both quantities during optimization, while the GP and acquisition function select which admissible molecules to evaluate. Across six challenging molecular optimization benchmarks under matched 1,000-evaluation budgets, TRACE achieves the strongest overall sample efficiency as measured by the best molecule found as evaluations accumulate. Crossed ablations on two objectives further show that adaptive region control contributes beyond the proposal mechanism, while its benefit depends on the proposal distribution. We further apply TRACE to the stability of iron phthalocyanine (FePc), a non-precious molecular electrocatalyst whose degradation can involve loss of the Fe center. Using a first-principles density functional theory (DFT) workflow designed for accurate energy evaluation, TRACE increases the computed thermodynamic resistance to Fe dissolution from 0.42 to 2.59 eV over 80 designed evaluations.

</details>

### 506. [Towards Reconstructing and Recognizing Objects behind Fragmented Occlusion using Video](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12624v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12624

**作者：** Roman Pflugfelder、Michael Lindenbaum、Daniel Cremers

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12624v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12624v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究高密度碎片化遮挡（如树叶）下的物体重建与识别：对单相机拍摄的运动物体灰度视频序列做联合配准，通过最大化平均图对比度估计帧间相对位移，得到去遮挡的「integrated image」作为重建表示，并输入现成分类器验证可识别性。

**相关性简评：** 其跨帧累积视觉证据以恢复被遮挡细节的思路，可能与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留与证据筛选问题相关；但方法属传统配准优化，不涉及模型内部状态或 latent 推理生成，仅可供核查是否可作为视觉证据聚合的预处理或评价参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Reconstructing and Recognizing Objects behind Fragmented Occlusion using Video

**abstract/A1：** Perceiving objects through fragmented occlusions, such as foliage, is a natural capability of the human visual system but remains a fundamental challenge for computer vision. This work addresses the problem of object reconstruction, or de-occlusion, in the presence of high-density, fragmented occlusions. We propose a reconstruction framework that operates on a sequence of grayscale images of a moving object, acquired by a single camera, either stationary or in motion. The algorithm estimates the object's relative positions across frames by jointly registering the images and optimizing the alignment parameters to maximize the contrast of their average, referred to as the integrated image. This integrated image serves as the reconstructed representation of the object. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real video sequences demonstrate the feasibility of accurate reconstruction under occlusion densities exceeding 90%. The proposed approach is competitive with synthetic aperture techniques, which are limited to static objects and require complex camera setup with careful calibration. Furthermore, we show that the integrated image enables reliable object classification under severe occlusion when used as input to standard, off-the-shelf classifiers.

**comment/C1：** paper, supplementary material

</details>

### 507. [TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12640

**作者：** Yihan Hank Tang、Peng Yang、Jiayi Xin、Tianqi Shang、Xuyang Chen、Ying Yuan、Yi Lian、Qi Long

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、stat.AP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12640v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12640v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 TrialDesignBench：617 个肿瘤 I/I-II 期剂量探索试验，配以按 FDA 最新监管标准经专家验证的参考设计，并评测五个前沿 LLM，通过消融指出性能差距主要来自隐含设计决定因素的推断与结构化决策树推理。

**相关性简评：** 其「从材料中推断未记录的隐含决定因素」及结构化决策树推理，可能为 LVR 中缺失的任务必要信息补全与推理状态组织提供问题表述上的类比线索，但领域较远，联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge

**abstract/A1：** AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Presented as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS). Code and data: https://github.com/hanktang-research/TrialDesignBench

### 508. [Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12643v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12643

**作者：** Omer Hemo、Ido Sefi、Mirco Mutti、Aviv Tamar、Kfir Y. Levy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12643v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12643v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种基于控制变量（control variates）的保守模拟辅助强化学习框架：模拟数据只用于降低策略评估与 actor-critic 学习过程中的方差，而不直接塑造学习目标，从而避免模拟器偏差把解带离最优策略；方法扩展到策略改进与离线 RL，并在多个 MuJoCo 任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 「用有偏辅助数据只降方差、不改变估计目标」这一控制变量思路，可能可供核查于 VLM 推理的 RL 训练：把模拟器或潜在轨迹等廉价辅助信号当作方差缩减项，而不让其直接定义推理监督目标，与轨迹训练中的贡献分配和偏差控制问题相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as a poster at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text + appendix, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/OmerHemo/Simulation-Aided-Reinforcement-Learning-with-Control-Variates

</details>

### 509. [Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12662v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12662

**作者：** Zhiyuan Li、Lequan Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12662v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12662v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HC-ROCP，一种无需训练的 conformal prediction 框架：在冻结分类器概率基础上加入危害惩罚来选择预测集与临床动作，并以「认证 / 描述性报告 / 拒绝」三种输出处理子群主张；在 COVID-19 胸片、ISIC 2019 皮肤镜与 EyePACS→APTOS 迁移上做回溯评估。

**相关性简评：** 其按风险预算决定「认证、降级报告或拒绝」的三级输出，可能为 LVR 中证据不足时的 STOP／弃答准则与子群风险控制提供概念参照，但与 latent 状态生成无直接关系，需核查其危害门限是否可迁移为推理停止判据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions

**abstract/A1：** Routing a melanoma case to routine follow-up is a serious action error that diagnostic coverage alone does not rule out. We present Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (HC-ROCP), a training-free framework that uses frozen classifier probabilities and adds a harm penalty when choosing prediction sets and actions. We test the resulting policies on disjoint calibration splits with multiplicity adjustment. HC-ROCP certifies supported claims, reports descriptive fallback policies, and refuses unsupported subgroup claims. We evaluate these outputs retrospectively on COVID-19 radiographs, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and EyePACS-to-APTOS retinopathy transfer. Across ten calibration seeds, HC-ROCP reduces COVID-19 severe-action errors from the exact risk-optimal baseline's 4.68\\% to 0.54\\%. At a 5\\% budget, global claims are certified for COVID-19 and ISIC, but the rare squamous-cell-carcinoma claim is refused. At 1\\%, all settings receive descriptive reports. For each budget, we also report the minimum severe-case count needed to pass the global harm gate with zero errors, providing a starting point for further data collection.

**comment/C1：** Findings of the 6th Machine Learning for Health Symposium (ML4H 2026)

</details>

**作者：** Minheng Wu、Di Wen、Ruiping Liu、Junwei Zheng、Yufan Chen、Kailun Yang、Kunyu Peng

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文审计了 12,031 条人工 VOC 2012 scribble 标注，据此设计六种受控扰动算子（类别腐蚀、空间偏移、方向扰动、笔画缩短、随机丢弃、碎片化），在多种骨干与训练流程下测量涂鸦监督分割的鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 其「对稀疏视觉证据做语义与几何扰动并测退化」的协议，或可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节/空间支撑被削弱时内部状态与答案是否仍依赖有效证据，但该文不涉及 latent 推理或推理期状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Breaks Scribble-Supervised Segmentation? An Audit-Informed Benchmark for Scribble Annotation Robustness

**abstract/A1：** Scribble-supervised segmentation is typically evaluated with a fixed annotation set, leaving robustness to distinct semantic and geometric imperfections poorly understood. Motivated by an audit of 12,031 manual PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) 2012 scribbles and prior work, we introduce six controlled perturbation operators. Class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation directly operationalize audit signals. Stroke-length reduction is motivated by prior scribble studies, while random dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. Each operator reports requested and achieved changes. We evaluate manual and automatic scribbles across two image domains, two principal backbone settings, and multiple training pipelines, with an additional MiT-B1 PFA anchor evaluation. In the five-seed Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC study, mean intersection over union (mIoU) drops from 70.08 to 1.46 under class corruption, compared with 35.57 for spatial offset, 52.20 for directional perturbation, and 63.24 for stroke-length reduction at their strongest settings. At the evaluated endpoints, semantic-anchor corruption produces the largest degradation, while geometric and support responses depend on the pipeline and dataset. Our benchmark provides a reproducible protocol for diagnosing annotation robustness beyond clean-set accuracy. The operator code is available at https://github.com/Wmhiram99/scribble-operator-benchmark.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 7 figures

### 511. [CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12689v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12689

**作者：** Jan-Hendrik Ewers、Santiago A. Cadena、Nicolò Foppiani、Andrea Merlo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.plasm-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12689v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12689v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发布 CoilStellaration，一个含约 17.7 万组优化线圈解的数据集与基准，用于根据目标等离子体磁场与间距、曲率、磁场误差等工程要求预测仿星器线圈几何，并给出基线模型与评测代码。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，但其「学习模型先给出初始解、再由传统优化器精修」的混合流程，可能与 LVR 中 latent 提议后接验证与搜索、以及训练目标如何服务下游使用的取舍问题可供类比核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation

**abstract/A1：** Stellarators are fusion devices that use externally generated, three-dimensional magnetic fields to confine hot plasma and offer a promising route to commercial fusion. Their electromagnetic coils pose a challenging design problem: they must reproduce the target magnetic field while satisfying engineering constraints and remaining practical and cost-effective to manufacture. Finding suitable geometries is a highly nonlinear inverse problem that generally has neither a closed-form nor a unique solution. This problem lies at the heart of stellarator design. We introduce CoilStellaration, a dataset and benchmark for learning the mapping between coil geometries from target plasma magnetic fields and engineering requirements. The dataset contains 177,000 optimized filamentary coilsets targeting plasma equilibria from ConStellaration, with sampled engineering requirements and achieved geometric and magnetic-field metrics. It spans multiple coil counts and field-period numbers, supporting studies of both specialized and shared models across configurations. The benchmark asks models to predict coils conditioned on a target equilibrium and requirements on coil-coil and coil-plasma spacing, curvature, and magnetic-field error. We show that magnetic-field accuracy remains the main challenge, with learned models rarely satisfying all requirements simultaneously. However, using learned predictions to initialize conventional coil optimization can accelerate early progress. We release baseline models and evaluation code to support reproducible research on both direct coil generation and learned optimization initializations. By lowering the barrier for machine learning and optimization researchers to engage with stellarator coil design, we aim to accelerate progress toward practical, cost-effective stellarator power plants.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets

</details>

### 512. [Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12696v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12696

**作者：** Marco Bressan、Nataly Brukhim、Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi、Emmanuel Esposito、Yishay Mansour、Shay Moran、Maximilian Thiessen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12696v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12696v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Z-learner，用弱假设在联合假阳性/假阴性保证空间中的可达成集合刻画弱可学习性，给出集合 Z 是否可提升的完全几何刻画，并给出无需预知 Z 的自适应提升算法及置信度放大结果。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉 latent 推理联系较弱，但其对非对称错误代价的几何刻画与「置信度放大」可能为 latent 推理中答案验证的置信度可靠性与非对称误差评估提供概念线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes

**abstract/A1：** Not all mistakes are alike. For example, in medical diagnosis, false positive and false negative mistakes have a different impact and should not be aggregated. By revisiting the classical theory of boosting through this lens, we introduce the notion of $Z$-learner, which returns weak hypotheses achieving joint false-positive/false-negative guarantees $(\\mathrm{FP},\\mathrm{FN})$ from some set $Z \\subseteq \[0,1\]^2$. This formulation generalizes the standard notion of $γ$-weak learning--recovered by taking $Z=\\{(z\_1,z\_2): z\_1+z\_2&lt;1/2-γ\\}$--and allows for more flexible notions of weak learnability that account for the impact of the distribution on the achievable learning guarantees. This raises a natural question: which sets $Z$ are boostable? We answer this by giving a complete geometric characterization that unifies, as special cases, both the classical boosting dichotomy and the recent multi-objective extension of Bressan et al. (COLT 2025). We also present an adaptive algorithm for boosting $Z$-learners without relying on the prior knowledge of $Z$, generalizing AdaBoost's ability to handle unknown margin parameters. Finally, we demonstrate that $Z$-learners can achieve confidence amplification. However, the analysis is significantly more involved than in classical boosting and relies on the centerpoint theorem from discrete and computational geometry.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12725

**作者：** Zhenjie Zhang、Sainan Chen、Kshiteesh Hegde、Mengze、Li、Pouya Rezazadeh Kalehbasti、Munachim Ezema、Karina Sobhani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12725v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12725v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GLOC：用优化的图像 embedding 将语义相近图像聚类，仅在簇级生成描述性洞察并泛化到簇内成员，用于 Pinterest 混合搜索的图像描述与 pivot 查询推荐，离线与线上 A/B 显示质量与效率提升。

**相关性简评：** 簇级摘要替代逐图标注，可能为将视觉证据压缩为原型级表示、服务 latent 工作区的证据筛选与状态抽象提供线索；但论文不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或多步推理，借鉴价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal

**abstract/A1：** Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs. We present Generative Labeling On Clusters (GLOC) as a solution to provide highly scalable, cost-effective, low latency, and high accuracy online image insight services. GLOC leverages highly optimized image embeddings to form image clusters that are semantically close to each other for the purpose of the type of insights, and summarizes the insights at the cluster level, which effectively generalizes to members in the cluster. At Pinterest, GLOC powers image descriptors and pivot query suggestions for Hybrid Search, which is a multimodal search service enabling users to search with both an image and a text query. Our offline and online A/B tests demonstrate that GLOC significantly outperforms previous methods, delivering improvements in quality and efficiency.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Sage-Taiyi，一种受元认知启发的科学发现架构，通过显式监控与控制持续修正对证据、假设和未解决问题的认识，并据此调整研究目标与选用推理方法；在科学构想基准与若干专家合作案例上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「评估证据与未解决问题后决定下一步查什么、怎么查」的元认知调节循环，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡、停止决策及获取证据的调度可供类比核查，但属科学构想智能体，尚需判读其监控信号能否迁移到视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 18 figures. Project homepage: https://alpha-innovator.github.io/Sage-Taiyi/

</details>

### 515. [LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12775v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.12775

**作者：** Suryansh Talukdar、Taha Sarwat、Jin Soung Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12775v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.12775v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** LogCDM 是一个紧凑的日志会话异常检测器，融合三路信号：小因果 Transformer 的下一事件惊讶度、会话转移图与正常参考图之间的图注意力嵌入距离、以及被证明等于频率加权卡方散度的转移漂移统计量；三者经 sigmoid 门控融合，约 8.1–8.8M 参数，CPU 下 5.5–10.5 ms 打分。

**相关性简评：** 把序列转成转移图、以核漂移做统计检验并给出逐边告警分解，以及门控权重指示「每类数据依赖哪路信号」，可能为 LVR 中多源视觉/文本证据的融合与 latent 推理轨迹漂移的可解释评价提供线索，但领域相距较远，是否可迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Log-based anomaly detection is increasingly dominated by large pretrained models, from BERT-scale encoders to 8B-parameter language models, which require GPUs at inference time and are difficult to deploy on the monitoring nodes where logs are produced. We present LogCDM, a compact detector that scores each log session using three complementary signals: the next-event surprise of a small causal Transformer, the distance between a graph-attention embedding of the session's own transition graph and that of a normal reference graph, and a transition-drift statistic that we show is exactly a frequency-weighted chi-squared divergence between transition kernels. The divergence view yields an asymptotic null distribution, a length-standardized score, and a per-edge decomposition that explains each alarm. A sigmoid gate fuses the three signals; under a shared-covariance Gaussian model, this gate is the Bayes posterior, and its learned weights indicate which signal each dataset relies on. With 8.1-8.8M parameters and no GPU required at inference, LogCDM reaches F1 scores of 0.984 on HDFS, 0.870 on chronologically split BGL, and 0.850 on Thunderbird, within 0.013-0.12 of an 8.1B-parameter LLM detector evaluated under the same protocol and above all compact baselines on BGL. It scores a session in 5.5-10.5 ms on a CPU. Ablations show that the structural signals add 0.025-0.030 F1 on BGL and Thunderbird but almost nothing on HDFS, consistent with the learned fusion weights.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables

</details>
